phrases.usage: 形容词框架接不定式，描述行走能力，临床与照护语境高频
phrases.example: Even during recovery she remained able to ambulate for short distances inside the apartment.
phrases.example_translation: 即使在康复期，她仍能在家中短距离行走。

phrases.usage: 后接动名词 ambulating，指行走困难，病历与康复报告用语
phrases.example: Cold weather caused him difficulty ambulating on the icy pavement outside the library.
phrases.example_translation: 寒冷的天气使他在图书馆外结冰的路面上举步维艰。

phrases.usage: 使役结构，指搀扶或用辅具协助患者行走，护理文本常用
phrases.example: Therapists use parallel bars to help patients ambulate safely during the first sessions.
phrases.example_translation: 治疗师在最初几次训练中使用平行杠帮助患者安全行走。

phrases.usage: 后接 with 加辅助器具，指借助某物行走
phrases.example: Grandfather prefers to ambulate with a cane, insisting each morning on reaching the post office.
phrases.example_translation: 祖父喜欢拄着手杖散步，每天早上坚持走到邮局。

phrases.usage: 固定军事搭配，指埋伏守候，主语多为士兵或捕食动物
phrases.example: Rangers lay in ambush along the trail until the poachers came at dusk.
phrases.example_translation: 护林员沿小路埋伏，直到偷猎者在黄昏出现。

phrases.usage: 动宾加 for 引出目标，指为伏击特定对象而设埋伏，叙事文体
phrases.example: The rebels set an ambush for the convoy on the narrow mountain pass.
phrases.example_translation: 反叛者在那条狭窄的山口为车队设下了埋伏。

phrases.usage: 遭遇式搭配，指中伏，战史与回忆录叙述常用
phrases.example: The patrol fell into an ambush and lost two men before withdrawing.
phrases.example_translation: 这支巡逻队中了埋伏，撤出前损失了两人。

phrases.usage: spring 指出其不意地发动，on 引出被袭击者，文学色彩强
phrases.example: Scouts sprang an ambush on the surveyors near the ford at first light.
phrases.example_translation: 伏击者在破晓时分于渡口附近向测量队发动突袭。

phrases.usage: 被动加 by 引出袭击者，新闻与案件报道中的常见结构
phrases.example: The tax collectors were ambushed by bandits who vanished into the gorge.
phrases.example_translation: 收税人遭一伙强盗伏击，那伙人随后消失在峡谷中。

phrases.usage: 军事名词搭配，指负责伏击的一队人马，历史记述用语
phrases.example: The ambush party lay motionless beneath fallen logs beside the narrow road.
phrases.example_translation: 伏击队一动不动地隐蔽在窄路旁的倒木之下。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指“改善（生活、工作）条件”，社会与历史语境
phrases.example: The new sanitation programme sought to ameliorate conditions in the crowded tenements.
phrases.example_translation: 新的卫生项目试图改善拥挤廉租公寓里的居住条件。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指“缓解贫困”，公共政策语境
phrases.example: Modest microloans helped ameliorate poverty in several remote mountain villages.
phrases.example_translation: 小额信贷帮助缓解了若干偏远山村的贫困。

phrases.usage: 动词 + the effects of，指“减轻……的不良影响”，科研常用
phrases.example: Wetlands can help ameliorate the effects of prolonged drought on local farms.
phrases.example_translation: 湿地有助于减轻长期干旱对当地农场的不良影响。

phrases.usage: 副词修饰动词，指“逐步改善”，强调进程缓慢
phrases.example: The soil quality gradually ameliorated after years of cover crops and careful ploughing.
phrases.example_translation: 在多年种植覆盖作物和精心耕作之后，土壤质量逐步改善了。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指“减轻痛苦”，人道主义语境
phrases.example: Relief workers laboured day and night to ameliorate the suffering of displaced families.
phrases.example_translation: 救援人员日夜劳作，以减轻流离失所家庭的痛苦。

phrases.usage: 动词 + fail，指“未能改善”，常用于政策评价
phrases.example: The well-meant reform failed to ameliorate the underlying inequality in schooling.
phrases.example_translation: 这项善意的改革未能改善学校教育中深层的不平等。

translations.translation: 有责任的：顺从的，服从的；有义务的；经得起检验的

phrases.usage: 后接介词to，指乐于听取建议、性情随和，常用于人物评价
phrases.example: The new intern proved amenable to suggestion, revising her drafts without complaint.
phrases.example_translation: 新来的实习生虚心听取意见，毫无怨言地反复修改草稿。

phrases.usage: 医学固定搭配，指病情易于治疗或对流路疗法反应良好
phrases.example: The infection was amenable to treatment once the laboratory identified the strain.
phrases.example_translation: 一旦实验室确定了菌株，这种感染便容易治疗了。

phrases.usage: 指能够以理服之，多用于否定句刻画冥顽不灵者
phrases.example: No negotiator could reach the leader, who was not amenable to reason.
phrases.example_translation: 没有任何谈判代表能打动那位不讲道理的首领。

phrases.usage: 副词perfectly加形容词，表示全然乐意配合，语气缓和礼貌
phrases.example: The committee was perfectly amenable to extending the deadline by one week.
phrases.example_translation: 委员会非常乐意把截止日期延长一周。

phrases.usage: 系动词加形容词，指表面上乐于接受，常暗藏后续转折
phrases.example: The draft contract seemed amenable until the auditors questioned its quiet termination clause.
phrases.example_translation: 合同草案乍看易于接受，直到审计人员质疑其隐蔽的解约条款。

phrases.usage: 法律用语，指争议可交付仲裁解决，对应经得起裁断之义
phrases.example: The long boundary dispute was declared amenable to arbitration under the treaty.
phrases.example_translation: 这桩持久的边界争端被裁定可依据条约交付仲裁。

phrases.usage: 名词搭配，指温顺随和的性情，文学人物描写的书面表达
phrases.example: Her amenable disposition let classmates reshape every group project around themselves.
phrases.example_translation: 她性情太随和，同学们便把每个小组作业都改成了合自己心意的样子。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指修改宪法或根本大法，法律政治语境
phrases.example: Delegates gathered to amend the constitution before the colony became a state.
phrases.example_translation: 在建州之前，代表们齐聚一堂商议修改宪法。

phrases.usage: by 加动名词或手段，指明以何种方式修订条款
phrases.example: The committee chose to amend the budget by quietly trimming discretionary travel funds.
phrases.example_translation: 委员会决定通过悄然削减自由支配的差旅经费来修订预算。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指修订成文法规，正式公文与新闻常用
phrases.example: The upper house voted last night to amend legislation governing how long firms retain user data.
phrases.example_translation: 上议院昨晚投票决定修订关于企业留存用户数据期限的法律。

phrases.usage: 副词修饰动词，指作出实质性重大修改，法律文体高频
phrases.example: The ruling substantially amended the scope of privacy protection in earlier cases.
phrases.example_translation: 该判决实质上修改了此前案件中隐私保护的范围。

phrases.usage: seek to 加不定式结构，指试图推动修订，倡议语境常用
phrases.example: Parent advocates now seek to amend school privacy regulations written decades before smartphones existed.
phrases.example_translation: 家长权益人士如今正设法修订智能手机问世前数十年制定的校园隐私规定。

phrases.usage: 副词加过去分词，指依照程序完成修订，公文体
phrases.example: The duly amended city ordinance took effect on the first day of July.
phrases.example_translation: 经正式程序修订后的市政条例于七月一日生效。

translations.translation: 舒适；礼仪；愉快；便利设施

phrases.usage: 发展经济学高频搭配，供水供电卫生等基本设施
phrases.example: The new settlement finally has basic amenities that older districts lacked for decades.
phrases.example_translation: 新居民点终于有了老城区几十年都缺的基本设施。

phrases.usage: 固定结构，生活起居的便利与舒适，正式书面语
phrases.example: Letters from the expedition describe scarce food but surprisingly decent amenities of life.
phrases.example_translation: 探险队的家信里说食物匮乏，生活设施却意外地还算齐备。

phrases.usage: 城市规划术语，公共便利设施，市政文本常用
phrases.example: The master plan doubles the public amenities along the river, adding toilets and shade structures.
phrases.example_translation: 总体规划让沿河的公共设施翻了一倍，新增厕所与遮阳设施。

phrases.usage: 旅游消费语境，酒店房内设施，少数生活化搭配
phrases.example: Travel writers judged the hotel amenities honestly: decent soap, temperamental heating, thin towels.
phrases.example_translation: 旅行作家如实点评房内设施：香皂尚可，暖气闹脾气，毛巾太薄。

phrases.usage: 动词搭配，缺乏现代设施，描写偏远地区科研站所
phrases.example: The field station lacks modern amenities, so the researchers boil water and burn kerosene.
phrases.example_translation: 考察站没有现代化设施，研究员们只好自己烧开水、点煤油灯。

phrases.usage: 法律与保险术语，生活环境品质贬损，正式索赔语境
phrases.example: Residents sued the mine for loss of amenity after months of dust and drilling noise.
phrases.example_translation: 数月扬尘与钻探噪音之后，居民以生活环境受损为由起诉了矿方。

translations.translation: (Amiable)人名；(法)阿米亚布勒；(英)阿米娅布尔

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指和蔼好客的主人，人物描写常用
phrases.example: Everyone praised our amiable host, who smoothed every awkward silence with wit and tea.
phrases.example_translation: 大家都称赞我们和蔼可亲的东道主，他用机智与热茶化解了每一次冷场。

phrases.usage: 形容词后接 in manner，指举止和气，书面评语
phrases.example: The negotiator remained amiable in manner even as their positions hardened.
phrases.example_translation: 即便双方立场日益强硬，谈判代表依然保持着和气的举止。

phrases.usage: 系表结构，指外表和气，常与后文转折呼应
phrases.example: The neighbors seemed amiable at first, though gossip quietly kept them distant.
phrases.example_translation: 邻居们起初看起来很和气，但闲话暗地里让他们保持疏远。

phrases.usage: 并列形容词，性情温和与亲切叠加，评传文体
phrases.example: Portraits show a clergyman good-natured and amiable, always quick to laugh.
phrases.example_translation: 画像中的牧师性情温和、亲切可人，总是未语先笑。

phrases.usage: 移就用法，指友好和睦的竞争关系
phrases.example: The two editors carried on an amiable rivalry through their newspaper columns.
phrases.example_translation: 两位编辑借着报纸专栏展开了一场君子之争。

phrases.usage: 副形搭配，指过分随和，暗含失威之虞
phrases.example: The director worried that being excessively amiable had quietly cost him authority.
phrases.example_translation: 导演担心自己过分随和，已在不知不觉间流失了威信。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指和善的微笑
phrases.example: He answered every insult with an amiable smile that disarmed the crowd.
phrases.example_translation: 面对每一句侮辱，他都报以和善的微笑，令喧闹的人群顿时没了脾气。

phrases.usage: 动宾固定句式，指通过协商达成友好和解，法律与商业新闻高频
phrases.example: After months of mediation, the two companies finally reached an amicable settlement.
phrases.example_translation: 经过数月的调解，两家公司最终达成了友好和解。

phrases.usage: 习用结构，指关系结束时不伤和气，多用于分手或离职语境
phrases.example: The founders parted on amicable terms, though their visions for the firm differed.
phrases.example_translation: 两位创始人友好地分道扬镳，尽管他们对公司的愿景并不一致。

phrases.usage: 高频形名搭配，指无争讼的协议离婚，家庭法与报道常用
phrases.example: They arranged an amicable divorce, sharing custody without ever hiring lawyers.
phrases.example_translation: 他们安排了一场友好的离婚，共同抚养孩子且从未请过律师。

phrases.usage: 名词搭配后接 between，指双方间友好关系，外交与学术语域
phrases.example: Trade helped maintain amicable relations between the two republics for a generation.
phrases.example_translation: 贸易帮助这两个共和国维持了一代人的友好关系。

phrases.usage: 系动词加形容词，指在冲突中保持友善姿态，谈判与人际描写
phrases.example: Negotiators worked hard to remain amicable even when the talks stalled repeatedly.
phrases.example_translation: 谈判代表努力保持友好，即使会谈屡次陷入僵局。

phrases.usage: resolution to 搭配，指对某争端的圆满解决，正式书面语
phrases.example: The editor proposed an amicable resolution to the dispute over the manuscript.
phrases.example_translation: 编辑就这份手稿的归属争议提出了一个友好解决方案。

phrases.usage: 并列形容词，形容彬彬有礼且友善的举止，人物评价常用
phrases.example: His manner at the conference was courteous and amicable, winning over skeptics.
phrases.example_translation: 他在会议上的举止谦和有礼，赢得了原本怀疑者的好感。

translations.translation: 友好；亲善关系；友好关系

phrases.usage: 介词短语 in amity with + 对象，指与…和睦相处，正式书面语
phrases.example: The two farming villages have lived in amity with each other for generations.
phrases.example_translation: 这两个村庄世代彼此友好相处。

phrases.usage: 名词搭配，指友好状态，外交与国际关系文本常用
phrases.example: Trade ties helped the neighbours maintain a state of amity throughout the crisis.
phrases.example_translation: 贸易纽带帮助这两个邻国在整个危机期间维持了友好状态。

phrases.usage: 固定并列抽象名词，指通商与友好，历史外交论述常见
phrases.example: Envoys hoped the river treaty would bring commerce and amity to the distant frontier.
phrases.example_translation: 使节们希望这份界河条约能为遥远的边地带来通商与友好。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，cultivate 指培养善意，书面劝导语体
phrases.example: The headmaster worked each term to cultivate amity between the rival student houses.
phrases.example_translation: 校长每学期都努力培养相互竞争的各学生社团之间的友好气氛。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指国际间友好关系，政论与基金会宗旨语体
phrases.example: The foundation awards yearly grants that promote international amity among university students.
phrases.example_translation: 该基金会每年颁发奖学金，促进大学生之间的国际友好。

phrases.usage: of 属格结构，指友善的氛围或心态，谈判与礼仪场合常用
phrases.example: Negotiations began in a spirit of amity, and both delegations made early concessions.
phrases.example_translation: 谈判在友好的气氛中开始，双方代表团都尽早作出了让步。

phrases.usage: 工业化学术语，指无水氨，化肥与制冷领域常见
phrases.example: Farmers store anhydrous ammonia in pressurized tanks before spreading it across the fields.
phrases.example_translation: 农民先将无水氨储存在加压罐中，再施撒到田地里。

phrases.usage: 物质状态搭配，指液氨，实验室与物理化学文本常用
phrases.example: The reaction proceeds smoothly when the metal dissolves in liquid ammonia at low temperature.
phrases.example_translation: 该金属在低温下溶于液氨时，反应可以平稳进行。

phrases.usage: 名词前置修饰，指氨气，常与 smell 或 detect 搭配
phrases.example: Technicians detected a faint smell of ammonia gas near the old refrigeration unit.
phrases.example_translation: 技术人员在老旧制冷设备附近检测到淡淡的氨气味。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指释放氨，描述化学分解与代谢过程
phrases.example: Certain soil bacteria release ammonia when they break down organic nitrogen compounds.
phrases.example_translation: 某些土壤细菌在分解有机氮化合物时会释放氨。

phrases.usage: 测量类名词短语，指氨浓度，水质监测文本高频
phrases.example: Aquaculture ponds require regular testing because a high ammonia concentration stresses the fish.
phrases.example_translation: 养殖池塘需要定期检测，因为氨浓度过高会使鱼类产生应激反应。

phrases.usage: 医学与环境预警术语，指氨水平偏高，多与监测搭配
phrases.example: Patients with elevated ammonia levels need close monitoring for signs of neurological decline.
phrases.example_translation: 血氨水平升高的患者需要密切监测，以发现神经功能衰退的迹象。

phrases.usage: 试剂名称搭配，指氨水溶液，实验操作说明常用
phrases.example: A dilute ammonia solution neutralizes the acid before the sample enters the spectrometer.
phrases.example_translation: 稀氨水溶液在样品进入光谱仪之前先将酸中和。

translations.translation: 健忘症，[内科] 记忆缺失

phrases.usage: 动词加 from 的固定搭配，指罹患记忆缺失，临床语境
phrases.example: After the accident he suffered from amnesia and could not recall the week before.
phrases.example_translation: 事故后他患上失忆症，无法回忆起此前一周的事。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指暂时性遗忘，医学术语，常与长期记忆对比
phrases.example: The concussion caused temporary amnesia, yet her long-term memory remained intact.
phrases.example_translation: 脑震荡造成了暂时性失忆，但她的长期记忆完好无损。

phrases.usage: 隐喻引申，指集体的历史遗忘，社会评论高频用法
phrases.example: The demolished theater became an emblem of the city's collective amnesia about its past.
phrases.example_translation: 被拆毁的剧院成了这座城市对自身历史集体失忆的象征。

phrases.usage: 复合定语，指药物诱发的记忆缺失，精确临床用语
phrases.example: The pamphlet warned patients about brief drug-induced amnesia following the outpatient endoscopy.
phrases.example_translation: 宣传册提醒患者，门诊内镜检查后可能出现短暂的药物性失忆。

phrases.usage: 形名加 for 引出遗忘对象，指对部分事件失忆
phrases.example: He had partial amnesia for the trial, recalling faces but no testimony.
phrases.example_translation: 他对庭审只有部分遗忘，记得面孔却想不起证词。

phrases.usage: 名词加 of，医学统计搭配，指失忆病例
phrases.example: Doctors documented rare cases of amnesia triggered by emotional shock rather than injury.
phrases.example_translation: 医生记录了一些罕见病例，其失忆由情绪冲击而非外伤引发。

phrases.usage: 固定动词框架，肆虐狂乱而行，该词最核心搭配
phrases.example: The rumor ran amok across campus before anyone thought to verify it.
phrases.example_translation: 还没人想去核实，谣言就在校园里疯传开了。

phrases.usage: 系动词加 amok，发起狂来，与 run amok 互换使用
phrases.example: The crowd outside the stadium went amok the moment the iron gate gave way.
phrases.example_translation: 铁门一塌，体育场外的人群立刻陷入狂乱。

phrases.usage: 后接 through 强调横扫的路径，穿过某处肆虐
phrases.example: Uncontrolled curiosity ran amok through the laboratory and wrecked three experiments.
phrases.example_translation: 失控的好奇心在实验室里横行，毁掉了三项实验。

phrases.usage: 名词加现在分词后置，正在疯传的谣言，评论转述句式
phrases.example: Officials spent the afternoon correcting a single rumour running amok online.
phrases.example_translation: 官员们花了一下午澄清一条在网上疯传的谣言。

phrases.usage: 使役框架，放任某物失控泛滥，带批评立场
phrases.example: Regulators refused to let the untested algorithm run amok in the market.
phrases.example_translation: 监管机构拒绝让未经检验的算法在市场上肆意横行。

translations.translation: 多情的；恋爱的；热情的；色情的

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，含情脉脉的对视，叙事描写高频
phrases.example: The two clerks exchanged amorous glances across the busy counting house.
phrases.example_translation: 两个职员在忙碌的账房里含情脉脉地对望。

phrases.usage: 后接介词 of，钟情于某人，古雅文学语域
phrases.example: The ballad tells of a duke who grew amorous of a millers daughter.
phrases.example_translation: 叙事谣曲讲一位公爵爱上磨坊主女儿的故事。

phrases.usage: 修饰文学体裁，情诗，文学批评固定搭配
phrases.example: The anthology pairs civic odes with lighter amorous verse from the same decade.
phrases.example_translation: 诗选把公民颂诗与同年代较轻盈的情诗编在一起。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，求爱行为，常带诙谐或揶揄色彩
phrases.example: His amorous pursuits became the quiet gossip of the entire department.
phrases.example_translation: 他的风流追求成了整个部门私下议论的话题。

phrases.usage: 冠词搭配，风流韵事，回忆与小说叙事语体
phrases.example: The diary turned a brief amorous adventure into an elaborate legend.
phrases.example_translation: 日记把一段短暂的风流韵事渲染成了动人的传奇。

phrases.usage: 程度副词修饰形容词，颇为殷勤多情，含轻微调侃
phrases.example: At the ball he grew rather amorous, which embarrassed his partner.
phrases.example_translation: 舞会上他变得颇为殷勤多情，让舞伴难堪。

translations.translation: 无定形的；无组织的；[物] 非晶形的

phrases.usage: 高频搭配，无定形的团块，物理和日常描述通用
phrases.example: The molten lava cooled into an amorphous mass at the base of the dormant volcano.
phrases.example_translation: 熔岩在休眠火山底部冷却成了一团无定形的物质。

phrases.usage: 材料科学术语，无定形结构，与晶体结构对比
phrases.example: Glass has an amorphous structure, lacking the long-range periodic order of crystals.
phrases.example_translation: 玻璃具有无定形结构，缺乏晶体的远程周期性排列。

phrases.usage: 比喻用法，模糊不清的概念，学术批评常见
phrases.example: The professor argued that justice remains an amorphous concept without clearly defined criteria.
phrases.example_translation: 教授认为，如果没有明确标准，正义仍是一个模糊的概念。

phrases.usage: 化学术语，非晶态固体，学科核心概念
phrases.example: Polymers, gels, and certain metals can form an amorphous solid under rapid cooling.
phrases.example_translation: 聚合物、凝胶和某些金属在快速冷却下可形成非晶态固体。

phrases.usage: 并列形容词，没有固定形态且不断变化，文学评论用语
phrases.example: The novelist presented identity as fundamentally amorphous and shifting across the entire trilogy.
phrases.example_translation: 小说家在整部三部曲中将身份呈现为根本上流动而不固定的。

phrases.usage: 描述没有明确形状的云或雾，自然写作常见
phrases.example: An amorphous cloud drifted over the valley, obscuring the distant snow-covered peaks.
phrases.example_translation: 一团无定形的云飘过山谷，遮住了远处白雪皑皑的山峰。

phrases.usage: 指形状不明的团块，略带贬义，口语和文学均可
phrases.example: On the data visualization, the population cluster appeared as an amorphous blob of blue pixels.
phrases.example_translation: 在数据可视化中，人口聚集区呈现为一团模糊的蓝色像素。

translations.translation: 总计，合计；相当于；共计；产生…结果

phrases.usage: 不及物动词加 to，合计达某一数额，主语为复数款项
phrases.example: The donations from the alumni chapter amounted to barely enough to fund one scholarship.
phrases.example_translation: 校友分会的捐款合计仅够设立一份奖学金。

phrases.usage: 引申义，实质上等同于承认，评论与法律论证常用
phrases.example: A refusal to answer amounted, in the editor's view, to an admission of guilt.
phrases.example_translation: 在编辑看来，拒绝回应本身就无异于认罪。

phrases.usage: 量词结构，后接不可数名词，正式而中性
phrases.example: The project required a large amount of archival work that few graduate students enjoyed.
phrases.example_translation: 这个项目需要大量档案工作，而很少有研究生乐在其中。

phrases.usage: litotes 修辞，绝非少量，实为相当多，散文笔调
phrases.example: Restoring the mural took no small amount of patience, as each flake was glued separately.
phrases.example_translation: 修复这幅壁画需要极大的耐心，因为每一片剥落都要单独粘回去。

phrases.usage: the amount of 加不可数名词，后接分词定语，量化叙述
phrases.example: The report compared the amount of carbon captured each year with the cost of the pipeline.
phrases.example_translation: 报告将每年捕获的碳量与管道建设成本作了比较。

phrases.usage: 介词短语，等量混合，实验操作与配方说明常用
phrases.example: Mix the two powders in equal amounts, then add water until the paste holds shape.
phrases.example_translation: 将两种粉末等量混合，然后加水调至糊状能定形的程度。

phrases.usage: 形容词加强量词，海量研究，学术综述引入语
phrases.example: A vast amount of research now informs how cities plan for extreme heat.
phrases.example_translation: 如今已有大量研究成果为城市应对极端高温的规划提供支撑。

phrases.usage: 冠词加形容加名词，文学与传记语境指秘密恋情
phrases.example: The diary hinted at a secret amour during her years in Florence.
phrases.example_translation: 日记暗示她在佛罗伦萨的那些年里有一段秘密恋情。

phrases.usage: 冠词加形容加名词，多指不正当关系，语域偏文学
phrases.example: The period novel frames the scandal around an illicit amour at the royal court.
phrases.example_translation: 这部历史小说把丑闻框架设定在王室的一段不正当恋情上。

phrases.usage: 冠词加形容加名词，指年少时的短暂爱情
phrases.example: The late memoir recalls a brief youthful amour from the summer after graduation.
phrases.example_translation: 这本身后出版的回忆录回忆起毕业后那个夏天一段短暂的青春恋情。

phrases.usage: 法语借词固定搭配，指自尊心，哲学与心理学语境
phrases.example: The philosopher argued that wounded amour propre drives most of the pettiest conflicts.
phrases.example_translation: 这位哲学家认为，受伤害的自尊心驱动着大多数最琐碎的冲突。

phrases.usage: 冠词加形容加名词，指转瞬即逝的爱情
phrases.example: Her private letters describe a fleeting amour that lasted a single bitter winter.
phrases.example_translation: 她的私人信件描述了一段短暂的恋情，仅仅持续了一个严寒的冬季。

phrases.usage: 关系从句句式，常用于叙事回顾
phrases.example: The mournful folk song remembers an amour that ended quietly by the river.
phrases.example_translation: 这首哀婉的民歌怀念一段在河边悄然结束的恋情。

translations.translation: 安培（计算电流强度的标准单位）

phrases.usage: 介词搭配，指电流以安培为单位计量，物理说明文常用
phrases.example: Electric current in this circuit is measured in amperes rather than volts.
phrases.example_translation: 这个电路中的电流以安培而非伏特为单位来计量。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指装置从电路吸取若干安培电流，工程语境
phrases.example: The motor draws nearly fifteen amperes the moment it starts under load.
phrases.example_translation: 这台电动机一带载启动，瞬间就要吸取近十五安培电流。

phrases.usage: 数量结构，描述特定强度的电流，实验报告常用
phrases.example: A current of five amperes passed through the coil for half a minute.
phrases.example_translation: 五安培的电流通过线圈持续了半分钟。

phrases.usage: 复合单位术语，指安时，电池容量标称常用
phrases.example: The battery pack stores forty ampere-hours, enough for a short commute ride.
phrases.example_translation: 这组电池容量为四十安时，足够一趟短途通勤。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指国际标准组织重新定义单位，计量史语境
phrases.example: Delegates met to redefine the ampere using a fixed elementary charge value.
phrases.example_translation: 代表们召开会议，用固定的基本电荷值重新定义安培。

phrases.usage: 形名工程搭配，指设备额定电流，安全规范文本常见
phrases.example: The switch failed because the heater exceeded its ampere rating during winter testing.
phrases.example_translation: 开关损坏是因为加热器在冬季测试中超过了额定电流。

translations.translation: [生物] 两栖的，水陆两用的；具有双重性的

phrases.usage: 军事术语搭配，两栖突击，战史与军事学文本的核心短语
phrases.example: The doctrine warned that an amphibious assault required total control of nearby waters.
phrases.example_translation: 该作战条令警告说，两栖突击必须以完全掌控附近海域为前提。

phrases.usage: 复数名词搭配，两栖作战行动，军事编制与训练文本常用
phrases.example: The naval training base specialized in amphibious operations along a rocky, hostile coast.
phrases.example_translation: 这座海军训练基地专攻在礁石遍布的敌对海岸进行两栖作战。

phrases.usage: 生物学术语搭配，指水陆两栖物种，生态调查文本常用
phrases.example: Flooded fields favored an amphibious species that moves easily between water and land.
phrases.example_translation: 被淹的农田有利于一种能在水陆间自如活动的两栖物种繁衍。

phrases.usage: 指水陆两栖植物，植物学课堂与田野笔记常见说法
phrases.example: The botany class studied an amphibious plant that grows emersed leaves above water.
phrases.example_translation: 植物学课研究了一种两栖植物，它会在水面之上长出挺水叶。

phrases.usage: 工程与交通史语境，指水陆两用车，展览与文献说明常用
phrases.example: The transport museum displayed an amphibious vehicle once used in coastal survey work.
phrases.example_translation: 交通博物馆展出了一种曾用于海岸测绘的水陆两用车。

phrases.usage: 行为学术语，指在两栖环境中活动的习性，动物行为研究文本常见
phrases.example: The crab's amphibious behavior lets it forage far inland from the rocky shoreline.
phrases.example_translation: 这种螃蟹的水陆两栖习性使它能在远离礁石海岸的内陆觅食。

translations.translation: 竞技场；[建] 圆形露天剧场；古罗马剧场

phrases.usage: 专名修饰的历史类搭配，考古与旅游书写中的典型结构
phrases.example: The ruined Roman amphitheater still anchors the old town's civic identity and seasonal tourism.
phrases.example_translation: 这座残破的古罗马圆形露天剧场仍是老城公民认同和季节性旅游的依托。

phrases.usage: 地理用法，指天然环形谷地形成的剧场般地形，自然书写常见
phrases.example: A glacial valley formed a natural amphitheater that carried the choir's sound across the lake.
phrases.example_translation: 一条冰川谷地形成了天然剧场般的地形，把合唱团的歌声送到了湖面彼岸。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，露天剧场，校园活动与公共文化报道常用
phrases.example: The university has hosted its commencement each June in the same open-air amphitheater for decades.
phrases.example_translation: 几十年来，这所大学每年六月都在同一座露天剧场举行毕业典礼。

phrases.usage: 介词搭配，交代演出或集会的场所，书面叙述常用
phrases.example: Evening crowds in the amphitheater watched performers project their voices without any microphones.
phrases.example_translation: 傍晚，剧场里的观众看着演员们不用任何麦克风把声音送到全场。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，描述剧场环形结构，考古发掘报道中的说明性用语
phrases.example: Archaeologists uncovered the lower tiers of a smaller circular amphitheater buried beneath the modern plaza.
phrases.example_translation: 考古学家在今天广场之下发掘出一座较小的环形露天剧场的下层看台。

phrases.usage: 复合形容词修饰座位，指阶梯环绕式布局，建筑与教学空间设计用语
phrases.example: The seminar room was designed with amphitheater-style seating around a central discussion table.
phrases.example_translation: 这间研讨室采用环绕中央讨论桌布置的阶梯式座位设计。

phrases.usage: 后接 for + 名词，表示「充足的余地」，常见于学术与法律论述
phrases.example: The draft proposal left ample room for modification before the committee voted.
phrases.example_translation: 草案在委员会表决前留下了充足的修改余地。

phrases.usage: 后接 of + 名词，指「充分的证据」，法律与学术文体高频搭配
phrases.example: The study provided ample evidence of long-term ecological decline in wetlands.
phrases.example_translation: 该研究提供了湿地长期生态退化的充分证据。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，「充足的机会」，议论文中用于讨论社会公平
phrases.example: Rural students rarely receive ample opportunity to access advanced coursework.
phrases.example_translation: 农村学生很少获得选修高阶课程的充足机会。

phrases.usage: 后接 of + 名词，「充足的供给」，经济学与环境科学语境
phrases.example: The reservoir ensures an ample supply of fresh water for surrounding farms.
phrases.example_translation: 水库为周边农场确保了充足的淡水供给。

phrases.usage: 后接不定式，「充裕的时间做某事」，叙事与说明文体通用
phrases.example: Travelers should allow ample time to navigate the sprawling terminal building.
phrases.example_translation: 旅客应预留充裕时间在这个庞大的航站楼内找到方向。

phrases.usage: 固定短语，「大量地」，多见于文学评论与正式散文
phrases.example: Her memoir possesses in ample measure the qualities of wit and candor.
phrases.example_translation: 她的回忆录大量兼具机智与坦率的品质。

phrases.usage: 后接同位语从句，「充分证明……」，论证文体高频
phrases.example: The archived correspondence is ample proof that the policy shifted years earlier.
phrases.example_translation: 存档的通信充分证明该政策早在数年前就已改变。

phrases.usage: 物理学标准搭配，指振动的振幅，学术文本高频
phrases.example: The amplitude of oscillation decayed steadily as friction dissipated energy.
phrases.example_translation: 随着摩擦力耗散能量，振动振幅稳步衰减。

phrases.usage: 电信术语固定搭配，调幅，用于广播和通信领域
phrases.example: Amplitude modulation was the dominant radio broadcast method before the 1950s.
phrases.example_translation: 调幅是二十世纪五十年代之前占主导地位的无线电广播方式。

phrases.usage: 形容意义、格局等抽象事物的广阔或丰富，文学评论常用
phrases.example: The critic marveled at the vast amplitude of meaning compressed into a single sentence.
phrases.example_translation: 评论家惊叹于一个句子中压缩了如此丰富的意义。

phrases.usage: 波动学通用表达，指波的振幅，基础物理概念
phrases.example: The amplitude of a wave determines how much energy it carries through a medium.
phrases.example_translation: 波的振幅决定了它在介质中携带多少能量。

phrases.usage: 指振幅加倍，常见于实验描述和工程计算
phrases.example: Doubling the amplitude of the signal quadrupled the output power.
phrases.example_translation: 将信号振幅加倍使输出功率增至四倍。

phrases.usage: 比喻政治或舆论的波动幅度，评论文体常用
phrases.example: Analysts debated the amplitude in swing between the two candidates after the debate.
phrases.example_translation: 辩论后，分析人士就两位候选人之间的摇摆幅度展开了争论。

phrases.usage: 指峰值振幅，地震学和电子工程学科搭配
phrases.example: Seismologists recorded the peak amplitude of the tremor at forty kilometers from the epicenter.
phrases.example_translation: 地震学家记录了距震源四十公里处的峰值振幅。

phrases.usage: 比喻用法，指意义的重要程度，学术散文常见
phrases.example: The historian argued for the full amplitude of significance that the treaty carried for the region.
phrases.example_translation: 历史学家论证了该条约对该地区所具有的充分意义。

phrases.usage: 副词修饰动词，指充分证明，正式论文与评论文体高频
phrases.example: The archived letters amply demonstrate how widely the banned pamphlet had circulated.
phrases.example_translation: 档案中的信件充分证明了那份被查禁的小册子流传之广。

phrases.usage: 副词加过去分词，指完全正当，常用于为某决定辩护
phrases.example: The delay, critics agreed, was amply justified by the sudden storm season.
phrases.example_translation: 批评人士一致认为，延期因突如其来的雨季而完全说得过去。

phrases.usage: 法律与公文用法，指条文对某事作出周详规定，后接 for
phrases.example: The new charter amply provides for independent public oversight of the harbor authority.
phrases.example_translation: 新章程对港务局的独立公众监督作了周详的规定。

phrases.usage: 副词修饰形容词，指十分明确，书面评价语，稍带古雅色彩
phrases.example: By the second chapter the distinction between the two claims was amply clear.
phrases.example_translation: 到第二章，两种主张之间的区别已经再清楚不过。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指给予丰厚回报，常用于投入与努力的语境
phrases.example: Patience at the microscope is amply rewarded by a single clean frame.
phrases.example_translation: 在显微镜前的耐心，往往被一个清晰的画面充分回报。

phrases.usage: 副词加形容词，指绰绰有余，正式文体强调数量宽裕
phrases.example: The reserve fund was amply sufficient to cover repairs through two hard winters.
phrases.example_translation: 储备基金绰绰有余，足以支付两个严冬的维修开支。

phrases.usage: 及物动词接 limb 作宾语，指截去肢体，医学语境标准表达
phrases.example: The surgeons decided to amputate the limb below the knee to halt the infection.
phrases.example_translation: 外科医生决定在膝下截肢以阻止感染扩散。

phrases.usage: 接 above + 部位，指明截肢平面，临床记录专有搭配
phrases.example: They had to amputate above the knee after the frostbite refused to heal.
phrases.example_translation: 冻伤久不愈合，他们不得不进行膝上截肢。

phrases.usage: need to 接动词原形，指必须截肢，叙述医疗决断的常用句式
phrases.example: The trauma team realized they would need to amputate within the very first hour.
phrases.example_translation: 创伤团队意识到他们必须在最初的一小时内实施截肢。

phrases.usage: 接具体部位作宾语，指切除脚趾等末端，医学文本常见
phrases.example: Gangrene forced the clinic to amputate the toe rather than risk the spread.
phrases.example_translation: 坏疽迫使诊所切除那根脚趾，以免感染蔓延。

phrases.usage: 接 from + 整体，把某部分从主体上截去，含比喻用法
phrases.example: The editor amputated three chapters from the manuscript to meet the press deadline.
phrases.example_translation: 编辑从稿子里删去了三章，以赶在出版截止前定稿。

phrases.usage: 被动结构接 without，指在无麻醉等条件下截肢，历史或急救文本
phrases.example: On the battlefield many limbs were amputated without any antiseptic at all.
phrases.example_translation: 战场上许多肢体是在完全没有消毒剂的情况下被截去的。

phrases.usage: 常与 a 连用，source of amusement，指成为笑料或乐趣来源，评论性叙述常见
phrases.example: His mild protests became a source of amusement for the whole seminar group.
phrases.example_translation: 他那点无力的抗议成了整个研讨小组的乐趣来源。

phrases.usage: 固定结构 to the amusement of + 人群，表示“令某人觉得好笑”，多引领句首或句尾状语
phrases.example: He opened with a self-mocking aside to the amusement of the front row.
phrases.example_translation: 他以一句自嘲的插话开场，把前排的听众都逗乐了。

phrases.usage: find amusement in + 名词或动名词，指从某事中自得其乐，书面回忆录常用
phrases.example: Retired professors often find amusement in cataloguing the small absurdities of campus life.
phrases.example_translation: 退休的教授们常以罗列校园生活里的小荒诞为乐。

phrases.usage: with detached amusement 作方式状语，指带着超然的旁观趣味，刻画人物姿态
phrases.example: She watched the quarrel over the budget with detached amusement, saying nothing.
phrases.example_translation: 她带着超然的趣味看着那场关于预算的争吵，一言不发。

phrases.usage: 后接 at + 触发之物，表示对某事流露出觉得好笑，演讲与课堂语境常见
phrases.example: The audience showed open amusement at the speaker's hesitant answer during the lecture.
phrases.example_translation: 讲座期间，听众对演讲者吞吞吐吐的回答毫不掩饰地觉得好笑。

phrases.usage: for amusement 表目的，purely 强调只为消遣而非严肃意图，含辩白语气
phrases.example: The satirical sketch was written purely for amusement, yet it sharpened public debate.
phrases.example_translation: 这则讽刺小品本只是为消遣而写，却反而让公众讨论更为尖锐。

phrases.usage: 及物句式 stir amusement in sb，多用于否定，指毫无逗趣效果，评价语体
phrases.example: His repeated jokes about the weather stirred no amusement in the tired team.
phrases.example_translation: 他反复拿天气开玩笑，疲惫的团队却丝毫觉得不好笑。

translations.translation: 时代错误；不合潮流的人或物

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指把不同时代事物混为一体的错误，影评与史评常用
phrases.example: The film drew mockery for a historical anachronism that placed a mechanical clock in Roman times.
phrases.example_translation: 这部影片因把机械钟放进古罗马时代这一时代错误而遭到嘲笑。

phrases.usage: 固定说法，指人或制度像活化石般停留在旧时代，略带调侃
phrases.example: With his quill and ledger, the accountant seemed a living anachronism in the glass office tower.
phrases.example_translation: 那位会计用鹅毛笔和手写账簿，在玻璃幕墙写字楼里俨然一个活化石。

phrases.usage: 动宾加 as 补语结构，把某事物贬为过时之物，评论文体常见
phrases.example: Reformers were quick to dismiss the boarding rule as an anachronism from another century.
phrases.example_translation: 改革者们很快便把这条住宿规定斥为来自另一个世纪的陈旧之物。

phrases.usage: 后接 in 加时代或领域，指出现在某环境中的突兀旧事物
phrases.example: The rotary telephone survived as an anachronism in the otherwise spotless research laboratory.
phrases.example_translation: 那部转盘电话作为一个时代错位残留在原本一尘不染的实验室里。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指文化层面的时代错位，学术分析文本常用
phrases.example: The essay treated the revival of Latin declamation as a peculiar cultural anachronism of the age.
phrases.example_translation: 这篇文章把拉丁语诵读的复兴视为那个时代一种奇特的文化错位。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指作者或研究者不慎弄错时代，语气客观中性
phrases.example: Even careful historians commit an anachronism when they project modern categories onto the past.
phrases.example_translation: 即便是谨慎的史学家，把现代范式投射到过去时也会犯下时代错误。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，强调某物不过是时代残留，含轻描淡写之意
phrases.example: The guild hall was by then a mere anachronism, its rituals long emptied of real authority.
phrases.example_translation: 到那时公会会堂不过是一个时代残迹，其仪式早已失去真正的权威。

phrases.usage: 程度副词+形容词，过时得无可救药
phrases.example: He realized the club's rule against women guests now seemed hopelessly anachronistic.
phrases.example_translation: 他意识到俱乐部禁止女性入内的规矩如今过时得无可救药。

phrases.usage: 系动词+形容词，变得不合时宜
phrases.example: Many skilled factory jobs became anachronistic within a decade after automation arrived.
phrases.example_translation: 自动化到来后十年之内，许多技术熟练的工厂岗位便已不合时宜。

phrases.usage: 正式被动+by，被新现实变得过时，学术语域
phrases.example: The old zoning code was rendered anachronistic by a sudden surge of remote work.
phrases.example_translation: 远程办公的骤增使旧的分区法规变得不合时宜。

phrases.usage: 形容词+名词，过时的制度机构，批评文体
phrases.example: The essay attacked an anachronistic institution that still ranked people by birth.
phrases.example_translation: 这篇文章抨击了一种仍按出身论人高下的过时制度。

phrases.usage: 系动词+形容词，措辞听来陈旧
phrases.example: To modern readers the phrase must sound anachronistic, evoking gas lamps and carriages.
phrases.example_translation: 对现代读者而言，那个短语听来必定古意盎然，令人想起煤气灯与马车。

phrases.usage: 副词+形容词，艺术上刻意设置的年代错置
phrases.example: The director chose deliberately anachronistic costumes to set Shakespeare among neon towers.
phrases.example_translation: 导演特意选择错置时代的戏服，把莎剧搬进霓虹高楼之间。

translations.translation: [植] 无氧呼吸；[微] 厌氧呼吸

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指细胞进行无氧呼吸，生理学教材核心句式
phrases.example: Muscle fibers undergo anaerobic respiration when oxygen delivery cannot match the demand of sprinting.
phrases.example_translation: 当氧气供应无法满足短跑需求时，肌纤维便会进行无氧呼吸。

phrases.usage: 后接 of，指无氧呼吸速率，实验测量与曲线描述常用
phrases.example: Students measured the rate of anaerobic respiration in yeast by counting the released gas bubbles.
phrases.example_translation: 学生通过计数释放的气泡来测量酵母的无氧呼吸速率。

phrases.usage: 后接 in 指明生物体，发酵实验与酿造语境常见
phrases.example: Anaerobic respiration in yeast converts sugar into ethanol and carbon dioxide under sealed conditions.
phrases.example_translation: 在密闭条件下，酵母的无氧呼吸将糖转化为乙醇和二氧化碳。

phrases.usage: 名词作定语的组合，无氧呼吸途径，生化代谢图解常用
phrases.example: A single enzyme blocked at an early step can shut down the whole anaerobic respiration pathway.
phrases.example_translation: 早期步骤中一种酶被阻断，就足以使整条无氧呼吸途径停止运作。

phrases.usage: 并列结构，用于辨析两类缺氧代谢，考试与教材高频
phrases.example: Textbooks often contrast anaerobic respiration and fermentation by their final electron acceptors.
phrases.example_translation: 教材常依据最终电子受体来对比无氧呼吸与发酵。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，维持无氧呼吸，微生物生态与沉积物研究常用
phrases.example: Bacteria buried in seabed sediment sustain anaerobic respiration for weeks by reducing sulfate.
phrases.example_translation: 埋藏在海底沉积物中的细菌通过还原硫酸盐，可维持数周无氧呼吸。

translations.translation: 类似的；[昆] 同功的；可比拟的

phrases.usage: 形容词后接 to，指出两者可比拟，学术论证的核心结构
phrases.example: The committee noted that the new tax was analogous to a tariff.
phrases.example_translation: 委员会指出，这项新税与关税相类似。

phrases.usage: closely、directly 加强相似程度，法律与科学比附常用
phrases.example: Lawyers searched for closely analogous precedents before the appeal hearing last month.
phrases.example_translation: 上个月上诉听证之前，律师们搜寻高度类似的判例。

phrases.usage: case 或 situation 与 analogous 连用，指可比案例，论证用
phrases.example: The professor cited a closely analogous case from an eighteenth-century trade ruling.
phrases.example_translation: 教授援引了一件十八世纪贸易判例中高度相似的情形。

phrases.usage: loosely、only 弱化可比性，表示勉强相似，评论语气谨慎
phrases.example: His description of the market was only loosely analogous to evolutionary biology.
phrases.example_translation: 他对市场的描述只是与演化生物学粗略可比附而已。

phrases.usage: 生物学术语，指同功器官，与 homologous structures 相对照
phrases.example: Wings of birds and insects are analogous structures shaped by similar pressures.
phrases.example_translation: 鸟翼与昆虫翼是在相似选择压力下形成的同功结构。

phrases.usage: prove、turn out 加 analogous to，指结果证明可与…类比
phrases.example: The laboratory method later proved analogous to an older rural folk technique.
phrases.example_translation: 后来证明，这套实验室方法与一种古老的乡间民间技艺原理相似。

phrases.usage: seem、appear 加 analogous，指表面上可比，常含保留判断
phrases.example: Two eras seem analogous, though the underlying property laws differ far more sharply.
phrases.example_translation: 两个时代看似可比，尽管底层的财产法差异其实大得多。

phrases.usage: 动宾 + between 结构，指在两者之间建立类比，学术论证常用
phrases.example: The philosopher drew an analogy between consciousness and the flow of a river.
phrases.example_translation: 这位哲学家将意识与河流的流动进行了类比。

phrases.usage: 介词短语作方式状语，指通过类比，科学与法律推理常见
phrases.example: By analogy with fluid dynamics, the research team modeled the rapid spread of online misinformation.
phrases.example_translation: 通过与流体动力学的类比，研究者对错误信息的传播进行了建模。

phrases.usage: 形容词 + 名词，指贴切的类比，评论与写作指导语境
phrases.example: Comparing the immune system to a border patrol is an apt analogy for students.
phrases.example_translation: 将免疫系统比作边境巡逻对学生而言是一个贴切的类比。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指过度引申类比，批评论证常见表达
phrases.example: If you push the analogy too far, it collapses into a misleading comparison.
phrases.example_translation: 如果把类比推得太远，它就会变成一种误导性的比较。

phrases.usage: 形容词 + 名词，指紧密的相似性，法律判例与比较研究用语
phrases.example: There is a close analogy between the two economic depressions in terms of policy failure.
phrases.example_translation: 就政策失误而言，两次经济萧条之间存在紧密的相似性。

phrases.usage: 指牵强的或松散的类比，用于批评不严谨的比较
phrases.example: The editorial relied on a loose analogy between ancient Rome and modern politics.
phrases.example_translation: 这篇社论使用了古罗马与现代政治之间牵强的类比。

phrases.usage: 名词 + to 结构，指与某物的类比，科技与人文通用
phrases.example: She made an analogy to computer memory to explain how the brain stores information.
phrases.example_translation: 她用电脑存储做类比来解释大脑如何储存信息。

phrases.usage: 指类比失效、不再适用，逻辑与哲学讨论中常见
phrases.example: The analogy breaks down when you consider that ecosystems lack a central authority.
phrases.example_translation: 当你考虑到生态系统没有中央权威时，这个类比就不再成立了。

phrases.usage: 形容词加 of 结构，指对某物的详尽分析，论文与报告通用
phrases.example: A detailed analysis of the survey revealed inconsistencies in three regional samples.
phrases.example_translation: 对问卷所做的详尽分析显示，三个地区的样本存在不一致。

phrases.usage: 指细读式精微分析，人文文本研究与文献学常用
phrases.example: Close analysis of the marginal notes dates the manuscript to the mid-fifteenth century.
phrases.example_translation: 对页边批注的细密分析把这份手稿定在十五世纪中叶。

phrases.usage: 方法学搭配，指统计分析，常与 confirm、cannot explain 连用
phrases.example: The statistical analysis confirmed the trend but could not explain the sudden reversal.
phrases.example_translation: 统计分析证实了这一趋势，却无法解释那次突然反转。

phrases.usage: 被动式动词搭配，指样品或数据接受分析，实验室规程语体
phrases.example: Every sample must undergo analysis before the laboratory releases results to the public.
phrases.example_translation: 每份样本都必须接受分析，实验室才会向公众发布结果。

phrases.usage: 分析作主语接从句，指新研究揭示事实，学术新闻导语高频
phrases.example: Recent analysis reveals how quickly reading habits shifted once screens entered the classroom.
phrases.example_translation: 最新分析揭示，屏幕一旦进入课堂，阅读习惯的变化竟是如此之快。

phrases.usage: 介词 for 后置修饰，指分析框架，方法论章节常用
phrases.example: The committee lacked a shared framework for analysis, so each bureau reported differently.
phrases.example_translation: 委员会缺少共同的分析框架，因此各部门的汇报彼此不一。

phrases.usage: 指初步分析，暗示结论待修正，工程与医学报告常用
phrases.example: Preliminary analysis suggested the fault lay in the valve rather than the pump.
phrases.example_translation: 初步分析显示，故障出在阀门而非水泵。

phrases.usage: 动词短语后接分析宾语，指援引分析成果支撑论断
phrases.example: The argument draws on independent analysis of shipping records from the same decade.
phrases.example_translation: 这一论点援引了对同十年航运记录的独立分析。

translations.translation: 分析者；精神分析医师；分解者

phrases.usage: 职业名复合词，金融行业最常见头衔，SAT 社科文本高频
phrases.example: A junior financial analyst recalculated the projections after quarterly earnings disappointed investors.
phrases.example_translation: 季度业绩令投资者失望后，一名初级金融分析师重新计算了预测数据。

phrases.usage: 信息技术学科搭配，指梳理业务流程并设计系统的人
phrases.example: The systems analyst mapped every workflow before recommending changes to the legacy software.
phrases.example_translation: 这位系统分析师先梳理了每一项工作流程，才对那套老旧软件提出修改建议。

phrases.usage: 证券行业术语，指为券商发布买入卖出评级者，与 buy-side 相对
phrases.example: A sell-side analyst published an optimistic note that the broader market promptly ignored.
phrases.example_translation: 一位卖方分析师发布了乐观的报告，但整个市场对此置之不理。

phrases.usage: 集体量词搭配，也可换 panel/pool，指协作的研究小组
phrases.example: A small team of analysts spent the winter reconstructing census records district by district.
phrases.example_translation: 一个由几名分析师组成的小组花了一整个冬天，逐区重建人口普查记录。

phrases.usage: 引述句式，新闻与评论中为观点标注来源，客观转述
phrases.example: According to one analyst, the merger will raise prices long before it improves service.
phrases.example_translation: 据一位分析师称，这次并购会先推高价格，改善服务则遥遥无期。

phrases.usage: 后接 for + 机构，说明供职单位，简历与报道通用
phrases.example: She worked as an analyst for the municipal budget office for six quiet years.
phrases.example_translation: 她在这个城市预算办公室安静地做了六年分析师。

phrases.usage: 动词短语，接 with 表向专业人士征询意见，正式建议语境
phrases.example: Publishers often consult with an analyst before committing to such a large print run.
phrases.example_translation: 出版商在决定如此大规模印数之前，通常会先咨询分析师的意见。

phrases.usage: 动词加副词 closely，表仔细审视某方案或数据
phrases.example: The committee will analyze the proposal closely before endorsing any budget increase.
phrases.example_translation: 委员会将在仔细分析该提案后才决定是否支持增加预算。

phrases.usage: 后接 how 引导的宾语从句，学术写作分析机制的句型
phrases.example: Recent scholars analyze how ordinary citizens experienced rationing during the two world wars.
phrases.example_translation: 近年的学者分析普通民众在两次大战期间如何经历物资配给。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，法律与科研语境，可与 fail to 连用表过失
phrases.example: Defense attorneys argued that the lab had failed to analyze the DNA evidence properly.
phrases.example_translation: 辩护律师主张，该实验室未能妥善分析这份DNA证据。

phrases.usage: 人文学科用法，analyze...as...句型表分析视角
phrases.example: In seminar we learned to analyze poems as verbal artifacts rather than confessions.
phrases.example_translation: 在研讨课上，我们学会把诗作当作语言制品而非个人忏悔来分析。

phrases.usage: 固定二连动词，医学影像与数据分析领域标准表述
phrases.example: The software enables clinicians to analyze and interpret brain scans in minutes.
phrases.example_translation: 这款软件让临床医生能在几分钟内分析并解读脑部扫描图像。

phrases.usage: analyze + 样品 + for + 目标成分，实验科学专用结构
phrases.example: Geochemists analyzed dozens of sediment cores for traces of an ancient volcanic eruption.
phrases.example_translation: 地球化学家分析了几十个沉积物岩芯，寻找远古火山喷发的痕迹。

phrases.usage: seek to + 动词，报告与论文引出分析意图的正式句式
phrases.example: The report seeks to analyze why voter turnout fell among younger adults.
phrases.example_translation: 这份报告试图分析年轻人投票率下滑的原因。

translations.translation: 无政府状态；混乱；无秩序

phrases.usage: plunge into加宾语，指骤然陷入无政府混乱，史论高频
phrases.example: The collapse of the central court plunged the province into anarchy within months.
phrases.example_translation: 中央法庭的崩溃使该省在数月之内陷入无政府状态。

phrases.usage: give way to指既有秩序让位于混乱，评论语体
phrases.example: Brief reforms gave way to anarchy once the army withdrew from the capital.
phrases.example_translation: 军队一撤出首都，短暂的新政便让位于一片混乱。

phrases.usage: 形容词修饰名词，指政治失序，社科论述的核心概念搭配
phrases.example: Foreign observers feared that political anarchy would follow the disputed royal succession.
phrases.example_translation: 外国观察家担心，王位继承之争将带来政治上的无政府状态。

phrases.usage: 介词短语指处于秩序崩溃的边缘，新闻与史学通用
phrases.example: Within a year the once orderly colony stood on the brink of anarchy.
phrases.example_translation: 不到一年，这片曾经井然有序的殖民地便摇摇欲坠，濒临失控。

phrases.usage: 近义名词并列加强失序程度，描写社会崩解的固定修辞
phrases.example: The archives preserve little but records of anarchy and chaos after the great fire.
phrases.example_translation: 大火之后，档案中除了一页页混乱失序的记录，几乎别无留存。

phrases.usage: of名词短语，常作强化管控的正当化理由
phrases.example: Both parties invoked the threat of anarchy to justify the emergency law.
phrases.example_translation: 两党都援引失序的威胁来为紧急状态法辩护。

phrases.usage: anarchy作主语配动词reign，指无法无天之势横行，历史叙事语体
phrases.example: As anarchy reigned through the valley, the once steady river trade all but stopped.
phrases.example_translation: 随着混乱在整个河谷蔓延，曾经稳定的河运贸易几乎完全停滞。

translations.translation: 诅咒；革出教门；被诅咒者；令人厌恶的人

phrases.usage: 最常用结构，be anathema to somebody，后接人，指为某人所深恶痛绝
phrases.example: The new zoning rules were anathema to longtime residents who prized neighborhood quiet.
phrases.example_translation: 新的分区规定令珍视街区宁静的老住户深恶痛绝。

phrases.usage: 系表动态用法，强调由中立转为集体厌恶的过程，评论文体常见
phrases.example: Once celebrated, the banker gradually became anathema to the public after the crisis.
phrases.example_translation: 那位曾受推崇的银行家在危机之后逐渐成了公众憎恨的对象。

phrases.usage: 后接 at， hurl 带激烈动作感，指向某人某事公开咒骂
phrases.example: From the pulpit he hurled an anathema at greed, naming no one but sparing nothing.
phrases.example_translation: 他在布道坛上对着贪婪破口诅咒，不点名却毫不留情。

phrases.usage: 宗教史用法，指被革出教门、处于受诅咒状态，书面语
phrases.example: The exiled nobleman lived out his years under an anathema issued by his own church.
phrases.example_translation: 那位流亡贵族在自己教会发布的绝罚令中度完了余生。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，bitter 加强厌恶程度，可指诅咒言语也可指被憎者
phrases.example: To purists, the rewritten ending was nothing but a bitter anathema to the novel.
phrases.example_translation: 在原著拥趸看来，改写后的结尾不过是对小说的可恨亵渎。

phrases.usage: 后接 against，指针对某对象发出的正式诅咒或激烈谴责
phrases.example: The pamphlet collected centuries of anathema against merchants, usurers, and moneylenders alike.
phrases.example_translation: 这本小册子汇集了几个世纪以来针对商人、高利贷者的种种诅咒。

phrases.usage: 由宗教义引申为政论用法，指在政治上人人喊打的主张或人物
phrases.example: Raising transit fares became a political anathema that no council member dared defend.
phrases.example_translation: 上调公交票价成了一个人人喊打的政治议题，无议员敢为其辩护。

phrases.usage: 学科术语，比较解剖学，指对不同物种身体构造的对照研究，生物学文本常见
phrases.example: The course contrasts the forelimbs of mammals, a classic exercise in comparative anatomy.
phrases.example_translation: 这门课对照哺乳动物的前肢结构，是比较解剖学的经典练习。

phrases.usage: 名词作定语+noun，指人体结构或其研究，最常规的修饰搭配
phrases.example: First-year medical students spend their mornings studying models of human anatomy.
phrases.example_translation: 医学一年级学生上午的时间都用来研习人体解剖模型。

phrases.usage: anatomy of + 名词，隐喻用法，指对某事的层层剖析，评论与纪实写作常见
phrases.example: The long essay examined the anatomy of a political scandal in fine detail.
phrases.example_translation: 这篇长文细致地剖析了一桩政治丑闻的内里结构。

phrases.usage: course 后接 in + 学科，指一门课程安排，校园语境常用
phrases.example: She decided to take a course in anatomy to strengthen her biology background.
phrases.example_translation: 她决定选修一门解剖学课程，以夯实自己的生物学基础。

phrases.usage: 名词复合，本义解剖课，常喻指一次淋漓尽致的示范或教学
phrases.example: His step-by-step demonstration of the bill was an anatomy lesson in legislation.
phrases.example_translation: 他逐步演示法案的诞生过程，堪称一堂立法解剖课。

phrases.usage: 名词作定语，解剖学教科书，指医学教材，具体物件搭配
phrases.example: The old anatomy textbook had pages worn soft from decades of careful use.
phrases.example_translation: 那本旧解剖学教科书纸页因数十年的反复翻阅而磨得柔软。

phrases.usage: 动宾加 back to，指把血统追溯到某一源头，家谱语境
phrases.example: He traced his ancestry back to farmers who crossed the sea in steerage.
phrases.example_translation: 他把自己的祖籍追溯到乘统舱漂洋过海的农夫。

phrases.usage: of 结构作表语或定语，指混血血统，人口统计常用
phrases.example: The neighborhood's families are of mixed ancestry, speaking several heritage languages at home.
phrases.example_translation: 这个社区的家庭血统多元，在家中说着好几种祖传语言。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指名门血统，常与 boasts、claims 连用带怀疑色彩
phrases.example: She dismissed the boasts of noble ancestry as charming but useless family trivia.
phrases.example_translation: 她把家族名门血统的夸耀看作中听却无用的家史趣谈。

phrases.usage: 遗传学术语搭配，指共同祖先，DNA 研究语境
phrases.example: Geneticists measured the shared ancestry of isolated mountain villages through DNA markers.
phrases.example_translation: 遗传学家借助 DNA 标记测定了与世隔绝山村之间的同源血统。

phrases.usage: 后接 in…of，指对祖辈的自豪感，可褒可贬
phrases.example: Pride in one's ancestry can harden into prejudice when history is mythologized.
phrases.example_translation: 一旦历史被神话化，对自身血统的自豪感便可能固化为偏见。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指借档案重建断裂的谱系，家谱学语境
phrases.example: The archive's immigration records let adopted children reconstruct a largely forgotten ancestry.
phrases.example_translation: 档案馆的移民事录让被收养的孩子得以重建几乎被遗忘的血脉谱系。

phrases.usage: 商业与技术搭配，指辅助性服务
phrases.example: The factory outsources most of its ancillary services to specialist local firms.
phrases.example_translation: 这家工厂把大部分辅助服务外包给当地的专业公司。

phrases.usage: 后接 to 加主体，指从属于、辅助于
phrases.example: The basic research was purely ancillary to the company's main product line.
phrases.example_translation: 这项基础研究纯粹从属于公司的主营产品线。

phrases.usage: 财经搭配，指附带成本、杂费
phrases.example: Careful buyers should always budget for ancillary costs such as installation.
phrases.example_translation: 审慎的买家总应将安装费等附带成本纳入预算。

phrases.usage: 指辅助性角色，学术与职场语境
phrases.example: Nurses play an ancillary but absolutely indispensable role in clinical trials.
phrases.example_translation: 护士在临床试验中扮演着辅助却绝对不可或缺的角色。

phrases.usage: 副词修饰，强调仅为附属内容
phrases.example: The committee stressed that this clause was merely ancillary to the main treaty.
phrases.example_translation: 委员会强调该条款仅是主要条约的附属内容。

phrases.usage: 法律搭配，指附属法规
phrases.example: Judges consistently interpreted the ancillary legislation in light of the principal act.
phrases.example_translation: 法官始终依据主法来解释这些附属法规。

phrases.usage: 最常用动宾搭配，讲述轶事，讲座与谈话场景通用
phrases.example: The professor paused to tell an anecdote about his first season in the archives.
phrases.example_translation: 教授停下来讲了一个他在档案馆第一个冬天的轶事。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，耐人寻味、透露内情的轶事，评论性写作高频
phrases.example: One revealing anecdote about the committee meeting says more than a hundred pages of minutes.
phrases.example_translation: 关于那次委员会会议的一则揭底轶事，比百页会议记录更有说明力。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，分享亲身经历的小故事，演讲开场与访谈常用
phrases.example: She opened the lecture by sharing a personal anecdote about a mislabeled field sample.
phrases.example_translation: 她以分享一则标错标签的野外样本的亲身经历开场。

phrases.phrase: illustrate a point with an anecdote
phrases.usage: 介词结构，用轶事佐证论点，学术写作与辩论中的策略表达
phrases.example: Writers often illustrate a point with an anecdote, yet a story is not an argument.
phrases.example_translation: 作者常以轶事说明观点，但故事本身并不等于论证。

phrases.usage: 名词加 of 复数，轶事集，书名与文献体裁描述
phrases.example: The appendix holds a collection of anecdotes gathered from retired harbour pilots.
phrases.example_translation: 附录收录了从退休引航员那里搜集的一批轶事。

phrases.usage: 后接 about 引出轶事对象，讲述关于某人某事的趣闻
phrases.example: He told an amusing anecdote about the rehearsal when the scenery collapsed twice.
phrases.example_translation: 他讲了个有趣的轶事，说那次彩排布景塌了两次。

phrases.usage: 学科化搭配，指真伪存疑的轶闻，史学与文献批评常用
phrases.example: Biographers must decide whether each apocryphal anecdote rests on a credible contemporary source.
phrases.example_translation: 传记作者须判断每则存疑轶闻是否有可靠的同时代史料支撑。

phrases.usage: 医学术语复合词，缺铁性贫血，公共健康文献中的最常见类型
phrases.example: Iron-deficiency anemia is common among adolescent girls and remains a leading cause of chronic fatigue.
phrases.example_translation: 缺铁性贫血在少女中很常见，仍是慢性疲劳的主要病因。

phrases.usage: 学科术语，恶性贫血，与维生素B12吸收障碍相关，医学史文本常见
phrases.example: Before the cause of pernicious anemia was understood, the diagnosis was effectively a death sentence.
phrases.example_translation: 在恶性贫血的病因被弄清之前，这一诊断实际上等于死刑判决。

phrases.usage: suffer from + 疾病的固定结构，患贫血，一般叙述高频
phrases.example: Many pregnant women suffer from anemia if their diets lack sufficient iron and folate.
phrases.example_translation: 若饮食缺乏足够的铁和叶酸，许多孕妇会患上贫血。

phrases.usage: 程度修饰，重度贫血，临床分级与病例描述用语
phrases.example: Severe anemia forced the hiker to abandon the summit attempt and descend slowly.
phrases.example_translation: 重度贫血迫使这位徒步者放弃登顶计划，缓缓下撤。

phrases.usage: 医疗流程搭配 screen for + 病症，筛查贫血，公共卫生语境
phrases.example: Campus health staff screen for anemia each fall as part of the student wellness program.
phrases.example_translation: 校园健康人员每年秋天都作为学生健康项目的一环筛查贫血。

phrases.usage: 被动关系搭配，与贫血存在关联，医学文献的标准表述
phrases.example: Chronic infection is often associated with anemia in patients whose immune systems are weakened.
phrases.example_translation: 慢性感染常与免疫功能低下患者的贫血相关联。

translations.translation: 风力计，[气象] 风速计

phrases.usage: 学科术语，杯式风速计，气象站的经典测量仪器
phrases.example: The observatory mounted a cup anemometer on the exposed ridge above the valley.
phrases.example_translation: 气象站把一台杯式风速计安装在山谷上方那道迎风的山脊上。

phrases.usage: 名名搭配，风速计读数，观测报告的核心数据项
phrases.example: The anemometer reading spiked minutes before the gust toppled the equipment shed.
phrases.example_translation: 风速计读数骤升几分钟之后，一阵狂风便掀翻了设备棚。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，校准风速计，仪器维护的固定动词
phrases.example: Technicians calibrate every anemometer against a reference fan before the storm season.
phrases.example_translation: 技术人员在风暴季来临前用标准风扇校准每一台风速计。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，安装风速计，站点建设报道常用
phrases.example: The team installed an anemometer atop the tower to log sustained wind speeds.
phrases.example_translation: 研究团队在塔顶安装了一台风速计，用以记录持续风速。

phrases.usage: 学科术语，超声风速计，无活动部件的现代仪器
phrases.example: A sonic anemometer measures turbulence without moving parts, even in freezing spray.
phrases.example_translation: 超声风速计没有任何活动部件，即便在冰冷的飞沫中也能测量湍流。

phrases.usage: 医学术语，局部麻醉药，门诊与牙科语境常用
phrases.example: The dentist injected a local anesthetic before removing the impacted tooth.
phrases.example_translation: 牙医在拔除阻生齿之前注射了局部麻醉剂。

phrases.usage: 全身麻醉药，大手术描述的核心搭配
phrases.example: The surgeons chose a general anesthetic for the delicate eight-hour spinal operation.
phrases.example_translation: 外科医生为这台精细的八小时脊柱手术选择了全身麻醉。

phrases.usage: 正式动宾搭配，实施麻醉，主语多为医护人员
phrases.example: The nurse began to administer the anesthetic while the heart monitors steadied.
phrases.example_translation: 护士在心电监护趋于平稳时开始给患者实施麻醉。

phrases.usage: 状态介词搭配，处于麻醉状态下，病历语体
phrases.example: Routine cataract surgery rarely requires patients to be fully under an anesthetic.
phrases.example_translation: 常规白内障手术很少需要患者完全处于麻醉状态。

phrases.usage: 表面麻醉剂，皮肤或黏膜给药的医学说法
phrases.example: A topical anesthetic quickly eased the burn before the bandage was applied.
phrases.example_translation: 在包扎之前，涂抹的表面麻醉剂很快缓解了烫伤的疼痛。

phrases.usage: of属格结构，麻醉效果，描述余效与副作用
phrases.example: Numbness lingered for hours, a common effect of the dental anesthetic after the procedure.
phrases.example_translation: 麻木感持续了好几个小时，这是牙科麻醉在治疗后常见的效应。

translations.translation: 天使的；似天使的；天国的

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，天使般的微笑，常含反差性情感色彩
phrases.example: Despite the diagnosis, the child greeted visitors with an angelic smile that unsettled everyone.
phrases.example_translation: 尽管已确诊，孩子仍用天使般的微笑迎接来访者，那反而让每个人心生不安。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，天籁般的嗓音，合唱与声乐评论的常用褒词
phrases.example: The choir director chose the soprano for her angelic voice and steady pitch.
phrases.example_translation: 合唱指挥选中这位女高音，因为她嗓音纯净如天使，音准又稳。

phrases.usage: 副词强化形容词，简直如同天使，用于赞叹耐心的极限
phrases.example: Tired after the night shift, the nurse's patience struck them as positively angelic.
phrases.example_translation: 值完夜班后疲惫不堪，这位护士的耐心在他们看来简直如同天使一般。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，天使般的面容，圣像画与肖像描述常见
phrases.example: The icon retains its angelic face despite centuries of candle smoke and handling.
phrases.example_translation: 尽管历经数个世纪的烛烟熏染和触摸，这幅圣像画仍保留着天使般的面容。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，纯洁如天使的孩子，文学与艺术题名常用
phrases.example: The portrait of an angelic child with a lute became the museum's emblem.
phrases.example_translation: 这幅画着一个怀抱鲁特琴的天使般孩童的肖像成了博物馆的徽标。

phrases.usage: 神学用语，天使般的存在，宗教思想史讨论等级序列时使用
phrases.example: Medieval theologians debated the ranks of angelic beings in meticulous hierarchies for centuries.
phrases.example_translation: 中世纪神学家在数个世纪里以极为精密的等级序列争论天使存在的品级。

phrases.usage: 动词短语介词搭配，指拐弯抹角地谋取某物，稍带贬义
phrases.example: Reporters angling for a scoop crowded the minister after the press conference ended.
phrases.example_translation: 记者们为了抢独家新闻，在发布会结束后把部长团团围住。

phrases.usage: 介词框架搭配 this/that，指从这个视角观察问题，议论与说明文常用
phrases.example: Seen from this angle, the policy looks less like reform and more like retrenchment.
phrases.example_translation: 从这个角度看，这项政策更像紧缩而不是改革。

phrases.usage: 介词短语，字面指倾斜，比喻用法指偏离常规地叙述
phrases.example: The old church settled at an angle after decades of foundation trouble.
phrases.example_translation: 数十年地基出问题之后，这座老教堂倾斜成了斜角。

phrases.usage: 几何术语，指九十度角，与 acute、obtuse 对举
phrases.example: Surveyers used a rope and stakes to lay out a perfect right angle.
phrases.example_translation: 测量员用绳子和木桩量出一个精确的直角。

phrases.usage: 物理与光学术语，指入射线与法线的夹角
phrases.example: Light bends differently depending on the angle of incidence at the glass surface.
phrases.example_translation: 光在玻璃表面上的偏折程度取决于入射角的大小。

phrases.usage: 介词搭配 on，指对某议题的新视角，评论与研究常用
phrases.example: The documentary offers a fresh angle on a well-known episode of the civil rights movement.
phrases.example_translation: 这部纪录片为民权运动中一段耳熟能详的历史提供了全新的视角。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，几何指小于九十度的锐角，比喻指尖锐的姿态
phrases.example: The negotiations took a sharp angle after the deadline was quietly extended.
phrases.example_translation: 在截止日期被悄悄延长之后，谈判骤然转向。

phrases.usage: 摄影与光学术语，指镜头覆盖的视野角度
phrases.example: A wide angle of view lets landscape photographers capture the whole valley in one frame.
phrases.example_translation: 广阔的视角让风光摄影师能够在一个画面里拍下整条山谷。

phrases.usage: 历史时期形名搭配，盎格鲁-撒克逊时期的英格兰，史学叙述常用
phrases.example: Monasteries preserved most of the written culture of Anglo-Saxon England before the Norman arrival.
phrases.example_translation: 诺曼人到来之前，修道院保存了盎格鲁-撒克逊时期英格兰的大部分书面文化。

phrases.usage: 专有文献名，《盎格鲁-撒克逊编年史》，中古英语史料的固定称谓
phrases.example: Annals of two centuries of reigns appear in the Anglo-Saxon Chronicle, copied in monastic scriptoria.
phrases.example_translation: 两个世纪各朝的记录见于《盎格鲁-撒克逊编年史》，由修道院抄写室誊录。

phrases.usage: 复数政治体术语，指七国时代诸王国，历史与考古语境
phrases.example: Viking raids shattered the balance among the Anglo-Saxon kingdoms until Wessex regrouped the resistance.
phrases.example_translation: 维京人的劫掠打破了盎格鲁-撒克逊诸王国间的均势，直到威塞克斯重新集结抵抗力量。

phrases.usage: 史学过程名词，定居与迁徙，常接 of Britain 限定
phrases.example: Archaeologists date the Anglo-Saxon settlement of Britain from the fifth century onward.
phrases.example_translation: 考古学家把盎格鲁-撒克逊人对不列颠的定居定于五世纪以后。

phrases.usage: influence on 结构，制度或语言的深远影响，学术评论高频
phrases.example: The legal vocabulary shows lasting Anglo-Saxon influence on the everyday speech of common law.
phrases.example_translation: 法律词汇显示，普通法的日常用语至今带有盎格鲁-撒克逊的影响。

phrases.usage: of 加血统名词短语，谱系与身份叙述，社科人口话题常见
phrases.example: Families of Anglo-Saxon descent and families of recent immigrants live side by side in this town.
phrases.example_translation: 盎格鲁-撒克逊后裔家庭与新近移民家庭在这座小镇比邻而居。

phrases.usage: 化工术语，无水氨，直接作氮肥储存，安全报道常见
phrases.example: A leaking tank of anhydrous ammonia forced the evacuation of two rural schools.
phrases.example_translation: 无水氨储罐泄漏，迫使两所乡村学校疏散。

phrases.usage: 实验室与燃料术语，无水乙醇，指含水量极低的纯乙醇
phrases.example: The protocol calls for anhydrous ethanol because water slows the reaction sharply.
phrases.example_translation: 实验方案要求使用无水乙醇，因为水分会显著拖慢反应。

phrases.usage: 实验操作惯用框架，指隔绝水分的环境，化学实验说明高频
phrases.example: The synthesis must proceed under strictly anhydrous conditions or the catalyst fails.
phrases.example_translation: 该合成必须在严格的无水条件下进行，否则催化剂失效。

phrases.usage: 试剂搭配，无水硫酸铜，白色，遇水变蓝用于检水
phrases.example: Anhydrous copper sulfate turns blue when it detects trace water in the solvent.
phrases.example_translation: 无水硫酸铜在检测到溶剂中的微量水分时会变蓝。

phrases.usage: 副词加形容词，几乎不含水，描述干燥程度的量化表述
phrases.example: The gas leaving the drying tower was virtually anhydrous by the time it reached the gauge.
phrases.example_translation: 气体到达仪表时，经干燥塔后已几乎不含水分。

phrases.usage: 后接 upon + 对象，对…的严厉批评，正式书面古雅措辞
phrases.example: The editor's lengthy animadversion upon the new translations discouraged several young contributors.
phrases.example_translation: 编辑对新译作长篇大论的苛责，让几位年轻撰稿人灰心丧气。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，尖刻的非难，drew 常作其谓语动词
phrases.example: The report drew harsh animadversion from auditors who had twice requested the same corrections.
phrases.example_translation: 这份报告招致了审计人员的严厉指责，因为他们已两次要求作同样的整改。

phrases.usage: 复数形式接 on，指一连串针砭时弊的评语，日记随笔常见
phrases.example: His private journal bristles with witty animadversions on the manners of the court.
phrases.example_translation: 他的私人日记里满是机智刻薄的评语，讥刺宫廷中的种种做派。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，逃过一顿指摘，否定句式中出现频率高
phrases.example: Not a single department escaped animadversion in the comptroller's final review of the accounts.
phrases.example_translation: 在财务主管对账目的最终审查中，没有一个部门逃得过批评。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，表达不满与责难，可加副词调节语气
phrases.example: The dean expressed his animadversion gently, in a memo nobody could fairly call cruel.
phrases.example_translation: 院长委婉地表达了不满，那纸备忘录公道地说起来并无刻薄之处。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，理应受到批评，merit 表“足以招致”，论说语体
phrases.example: The proposal merited little animadversion, since its methods were sound and its scope modest.
phrases.example_translation: 这份提案几乎没有招致什么批评，因为它的方法稳妥、范围也克制。

phrases.usage: 固定介词搭配，后接 on，对某事进行批评，正式书面语
phrases.example: The essayist liked to animadvert on the hypocrisy lurking beneath public virtue.
phrases.example_translation: 这位随笔作家喜欢批评隐藏在公共美德之下的虚伪。

phrases.usage: 与 upon 搭配，比 on 更正式更古旧，十八世纪文献常见
phrases.example: The bishop animadverted upon the moral failings of the court with great eloquence.
phrases.example_translation: 主教以雄辩的口才抨击了宫廷的道德败坏。

phrases.usage: 后接 against，公开反对或批评某事物
phrases.example: Several senators animadverted against the proposed reduction in scientific research funding.
phrases.example_translation: 多名参议员公开反对拟议削减科研经费的提案。

phrases.usage: 副词修饰，强烈批评，强调批评力度
phrases.example: The reviewer animadverted strongly against the methodological flaws running through the report.
phrases.example_translation: 审稿人强烈批评了贯穿整份报告的方法论缺陷。

phrases.usage: 不加节制地批评，含贬义，文学评论常见
phrases.example: The satirist animadverted freely on every political faction of the day without fear.
phrases.example_translation: 这位讽刺作家毫无顾忌地肆意抨击当时每个政治派别。

phrases.usage: 指在某篇文章中批评，新闻和学术评论语境
phrases.example: The columnist animadverted in a recent piece about the steady decline of local journalism.
phrases.example_translation: 这位专栏作家在最近一篇文章中批评了地方新闻业的持续衰落。

phrases.usage: 动词加 animosity 再加 toward，指长期怀有敌意，书面语
phrases.example: She harboured little open animosity toward the rivals who had replaced her.
phrases.example_translation: 她对那些取代自己位置的对手几乎没有公开的敌意。

phrases.usage: 后接 between 加复数主体，指双方之间的对立，社论常见
phrases.example: The animosity between the two factions stalled negotiations for nearly a decade.
phrases.example_translation: 两个派系之间的敌意使谈判停滞了近十年。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指相互敌视，政治与历史叙述中的高频说法
phrases.example: Mutual animosity between the newspapers escalated into lawsuits within a single year.
phrases.example_translation: 两家报纸相互敌视，在一年之内就升级为诉讼。

phrases.usage: 固定句式 give rise to，指某种安排激起敌意，学术语体
phrases.example: The new quota system gave rise to bitter animosity inside the department.
phrases.example_translation: 新的配额制度在系里激起了强烈的敌意。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指刻意煽动仇恨，含明显的贬义与道德指责
phrases.example: Columnists warned that the speech was designed to stir up religious animosity.
phrases.example_translation: 专栏作家警告说，这篇演说意在煽动宗教仇恨。

phrases.usage: 后接物主限定词加 animosity，指把敌意藏在客气举止之下
phrases.example: He could not conceal his animosity, however carefully his letters were worded.
phrases.example_translation: 无论信件措辞多么谨慎，他都无法掩饰自己的敌意。

phrases.usage: 与 with 连用的状态描写，指内心怒火涌动，文学色彩较强
phrases.example: The crowd seethed with animosity after the verdict was read aloud in the courthouse.
phrases.example_translation: 判决在法院当众宣读后，人群中涌动着愤恨。

translations.translation: 编年史作者；纪年表编者

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，中世纪编年史作者，annalist最常见的时代身份修饰
phrases.example: A medieval annalist at the abbey recorded each harvest failure in careful Latin.
phrases.example_translation: 修道院的一位中世纪编年史家用一丝不苟的拉丁文记录每次歉收。

phrases.usage: 引述来源结构，据编年史作者记载，史学文本引用原始记录时常用
phrases.example: According to the annalist, the comet appeared for seven nights above the frozen sea.
phrases.example_translation: 据那位编年史家记载，彗星在冰封的海面上空连续出现了七个夜晚。

phrases.usage: 宫廷编年史官，指为王室服务的记录者，暗含立场偏向的评价语境
phrases.example: The court annalist softened every account of the king's disastrous northern campaign.
phrases.example_translation: 宫廷编年史家在记述国王灾难性的北征时总是笔下留情。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，严谨细致的纪年编者，用于评价史家笔法
phrases.example: As a meticulous annalist she dated every entry and noted her own uncertainties.
phrases.example_translation: 作为一位一丝不苟的编年史家，她给每条记载标注年代，并记下自己的存疑之处。

phrases.usage: as引导的引述句式，正如编年史所载，其后常接具体史事
phrases.example: As the annalist records, the bridge collapsed during the spring flood of that year.
phrases.example_translation: 正如那位编年史家所记载的，桥在那年春汛中坍塌了。

phrases.usage: 动词加介词宾语，征引编年史家的记载，史学方法中的常见动作
phrases.example: Modern historians draw on this annalist for the only surviving details of the famine.
phrases.example_translation: 现代史家正是依据这位编年史家的记述，才获知这场饥荒仅存的细节。

phrases.usage: annals 后接 of，in the annals of 指在某一领域史册中，史笔语体
phrases.example: A storm of this intensity appears only rarely in the annals of the coast.
phrases.example_translation: 如此强度的风暴在该海域的历史记录中极为罕见。

phrases.usage: 定型搭配，the annals of history 指历史记载，庄重修辞
phrases.example: Few rescue expeditions have endured so long in the annals of history.
phrases.example_translation: 在汗牛充栋的历史记载中，很少有救援探险能持续如此之久。

phrases.usage: 固定句式，go down in the annals 指载入史册
phrases.example: The midnight rescue went down in the annals of the small harbor town.
phrases.example_translation: 这场午夜救援载入了这座小海港小镇的史册。

phrases.usage: of 加学科名，指某一学科的年鉴或文献记录，学术史语境
phrases.example: The strange recovery was recorded among the quiet annals of medicine.
phrases.example_translation: 这一离奇的康复病例被记录在医学文献之中。

phrases.usage: annals 接所有格，指某学会的会刊年鉴，机构文献语境
phrases.example: Volunteers spent the winter digitizing fifty years of the historical society's annals.
phrases.example_translation: 志愿者们花了一整个冬天，把历史学会五十年的年鉴数字化。

phrases.usage: entry in 搭配，指史册中的一条记录，个案叙述
phrases.example: Each coroner's report became another grim entry in the annals.
phrases.example_translation: 每一份验尸报告都成了编年史中又一个沉重的条目。

phrases.usage: 及物动词接领土宾语，指吞并领土，国际关系与历史文本核心搭配
phrases.example: The empire moved to annex a territory whose borders had been vague for centuries.
phrases.example_translation: 帝国着手吞并那个边界模糊了数个世纪的地区。

phrases.usage: 副词修饰动词，指非法吞并，当代外交声明与国际法评论高频
phrases.example: The resolution declared that the occupying power had illegally annexed the coastal region.
phrases.example_translation: 决议宣布占领当局非法吞并了沿海地区。

phrases.usage: 副词搭配，指正式兼并，强调法律程序完成的时点
phrases.example: Parliament voted to formally annex the district after a disputed referendum.
phrases.example_translation: 在一场饱受争议的公投之后，议会投票决定正式兼并该地区。

phrases.usage: 名词用法，指建筑的东部配楼，方位词加 annex 的建筑描述搭配
phrases.example: The archive's fragile manuscripts were moved to a climate-controlled east annex of the library.
phrases.example_translation: 档案馆易损的手稿被移到了图书馆气候控制良好的东部配楼。

phrases.usage: 名词搭配，指新建的附楼，校园、医院等机构扩建语境常用
phrases.example: The hospital opened a new annex to house its expanding pediatric ward.
phrases.example_translation: 医院开设了一栋新附楼，安置不断扩张的儿科病房。

phrases.usage: 被动风险框架，指面临被吞并的危险，地缘政治分析常见
phrases.example: Small principalities survived for decades precisely by playing larger neighbors off one another against the risk of being annexed.
phrases.example_translation: 那些小公国之所以能存续数十年，靠的正是挑拨大邻国相互制衡，从而避免被吞并的危险。

phrases.usage: 基础动宾搭配，指歼灭敌军，军事史文本常用
phrases.example: The general refused to annihilate the enemy, preferring a negotiated surrender that would spare the winter capital.
phrases.example_translation: 将军拒绝歼灭敌军，而选择协商受降，以免冬都毁于兵火。

phrases.usage: 被动加 by 引出施动者，指被彻底消灭，语气极端
phrases.example: The invasion fleet was annihilated by a storm before a single soldier reached the shore.
phrases.example_translation: 入侵舰队在一名士兵登岸之前就被风暴彻底摧毁。

phrases.usage: 数量词加名词，指屠戮整群人口，含强烈谴责
phrases.example: The chronicle records how a border raid annihilated an entire population whose name survives only in that entry.
phrases.example_translation: 编年史记载了一次边境劫掠如何灭绝整群人口，其族名仅存于这一条记录。

phrases.usage: 后接不定式，指以彻底毁灭相威胁，外交与政治语境
phrases.example: Both delegations threatened to annihilate the other's claims, and the talks collapsed within a single afternoon.
phrases.example_translation: 两个代表团都威胁要彻底摧毁对方的主张，谈判在一个下午便告破裂。

phrases.usage: 抽象宾语搭配，指使希望彻底破灭，比喻用法
phrases.example: The rejections did not annihilate her hopes, though they forced a slower and humbler research plan.
phrases.example_translation: 这些拒稿并未扑灭她的期望，只是迫使她制定更缓慢也更谦逊的研究计划。

phrases.usage: 副词短语加被动，指几乎被消灭殆尽，史与生态叙述常用
phrases.example: The coastal herd was all but annihilated by hunting, and its recovery took six decades.
phrases.example_translation: 这支沿海种群几乎被猎杀殆尽，其恢复历时六十年。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，常加narrowly，指侥幸免于覆灭，战史叙述常用
phrases.example: The exhausted regiment narrowly escaped annihilation when the damaged bridge finally held.
phrases.example_translation: 当那座受损的桥终于撑住时，疲惫不堪的团侥幸免于全军覆没。

phrases.usage: 后接of加毁灭类型，指生存威胁，冷战与国际关系文本高频
phrases.example: Small states conducted diplomacy under the constant threat of nuclear annihilation for decades.
phrases.example_translation: 数十年来，小国在核毁灭的持续威胁下开展外交。

phrases.usage: 指面临消亡，主语可为语言、物种等抽象群体
phrases.example: The fragile minority language faces annihilation as fewer children now learn it at home.
phrases.example_translation: 随着如今在家里学它的孩子越来越少，这门脆弱的少数语言面临消亡。

phrases.usage: 军事术语搭配，指相互毁灭，与威慑理论紧密相关
phrases.example: Military planners warned that any escalation of the conflict meant mutual nuclear annihilation.
phrases.example_translation: 军事规划者警告说，冲突的任何升级都意味着相互的核毁灭。

phrases.usage: 后接of加被消灭的对象，指彻底消灭，史书与纪事常用
phrases.example: The medieval chronicle coldly records the annihilation of an entire farming village.
phrases.example_translation: 这部中世纪编年史冷酷地记录了一整座农庄被灭绝的过程。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指彻底毁灭，语气极强，多见于论述与警告
phrases.example: The general insisted that nothing short of total annihilation would break the city's resistance.
phrases.example_translation: 这位将军坚称，除非彻底毁灭，否则无法瓦解这座城市的抵抗。

phrases.usage: 及物+文献宾语，指为手稿作注，文献学研究语境
phrases.example: Monks annotated the manuscript with margins that preserve early readings of lost passages.
phrases.example_translation: 修士们为该手稿作注，其页边保存了佚文的早期读法。

phrases.usage: 教学基本搭配，指批注文本以辅助阅读或写作
phrases.example: Students were asked to annotate the text before seminar, marking turns in the narrator's tone.
phrases.example_translation: 学生被要求在研讨前批注文本，标出叙述者语气的转折。

phrases.usage: with引出方式，指以引证作注，学术规范叙述
phrases.example: The editor annotated with citations drawn from archives, strengthening each disputed claim.
phrases.example_translation: 编辑以取自档案的引证作注，夯实每一条有争议的论断。

phrases.usage: 副词+动词，指细密批注，强调治学态度
phrases.example: She carefully annotated every interview transcript, flagging contradictions for the follow-up call.
phrases.example_translation: 她为每份访谈记录细密作注，标出矛盾之处以便回访核实。

phrases.usage: 以处所作宾语的转喻用法，指在页边写批注
phrases.example: Readers past and present annotated the margins, so the library shelved the copy behind glass.
phrases.example_translation: 历代读者写满了页边批注，图书馆于是把这册书藏入玻璃柜。

phrases.usage: 分词作定语，指机器标注的数据，数字人文与算法语境
phrases.example: The lab compared human judgments with machine-annotated data, finding disagreement on ambiguous images.
phrases.example_translation: 实验室把人类判断与机器标注的数据相比较，发现歧义图像上分歧明显。

phrases.usage: for+对象，指为后人作注说明，编辑与出版叙述
phrases.example: The archivist annotated each folder for future readers, dating letters that bore no year.
phrases.example_translation: 档案员为每只文件夹作注以便来者，为无年份信件标注日期。

phrases.usage: 机构年度例行报告，商务与公共治理文本中的固定搭配
phrases.example: The charity's annual report disclosed that administrative costs had quietly doubled over five years.
phrases.example_translation: 该慈善机构的年报披露，行政成本在五年间悄然翻倍。

phrases.usage: 统计学术语，指全年平均值，气候与经济数据描述高频
phrases.example: The annual average rainfall masks dramatic swings between record droughts and devastating floods.
phrases.example_translation: 年均降水量掩盖了创纪录干旱与毁灭性洪水之间的剧烈波动。

phrases.usage: 经济学术语，指年度增长率，评论与图表分析常用
phrases.example: Analysts revised the annual growth rate downward after the manufacturing data disappointed investors.
phrases.example_translation: 制造业数据令投资者失望后，分析师下调了年增长率。

phrases.usage: 树木学名词，指年轮，年代学与环境史文本中的学科搭配
phrases.example: Each annual ring in the trunk records a year of climate in the mountain valley.
phrases.example_translation: 树干上的每个年轮都记录了山谷中某一年的气候状况。

phrases.usage: 指每年如期而至的大量涌入，生态迁徙与人口话题皆适用
phrases.example: Researchers monitor the annual influx of migratory birds that rest in the coastal wetlands.
phrases.example_translation: 研究人员监测每年涌入沿海湿地栖息的候鸟。

phrases.usage: 学会或机构一年一度的学术会议，正式文体常见
phrases.example: Delegates at the annual conference debated whether funding should favor basic or applied science.
phrases.example_translation: 年会的代表们辩论资助应偏向基础科学还是应用科学。

phrases.usage: annual 作名词指一年生植物，动宾搭配园艺术语，注意与多年生植物对照
phrases.example: The demonstration garden grows annuals that bloom quickly before the first autumn frost arrives.
phrases.example_translation: 示范园里种的是初秋霜降前就能迅速开花的一年生植物。

translations.translation: 年金，养老金；年金保险；年金享受权

phrases.usage: 金融动词搭配，指购买年金产品，后接 that 从句说明给付方式
phrases.example: She chose to purchase an annuity that would pay a fixed sum each quarter.
phrases.example_translation: 她选择购买一份年金，每季度支付固定金额。

phrases.usage: 名词作定语，指年金给付款，常与 inflation、erode 同现
phrases.example: Rising inflation eroded the value of the annuity payments within a decade.
phrases.example_translation: 不断上涨的通胀在十年之内侵蚀了这些年金给付的实际价值。

phrases.usage: 专业术语搭配，指递延年金，理财建议语境常用
phrases.example: A deferred annuity suited him, since he expected no income need before sixty.
phrases.example_translation: 递延年金适合他，因为他预计六十岁之前不需要这笔收入。

phrases.usage: 后接介词 on，指靠年金度日，传记与史传常用
phrases.example: The widowed scholar lived on a modest annuity and refused every editorial offer.
phrases.example_translation: 这位丧偶的学者靠一份微薄的年金过活，拒绝了所有编务邀约。

phrases.usage: 动词 yield 后接 of 加金额，指产生年金收益，法律与遗嘱文体
phrases.example: The trust was arranged to yield an annuity of twelve thousand a year to the founder.
phrases.example_translation: 该信托被安排为创设人每年产生一万两千的年金收益。

phrases.usage: 行业搭配，指年金市场，常与 thin、regulate 连用
phrases.example: Regulators warned that a thin annuity market left retirees unable to compare offers.
phrases.example_translation: 监管者警告说，年金市场规模狭小，使退休者无从比较各家报价。

phrases.usage: 产品属性搭配，指固定年金，与 variable 对举
phrases.example: Advisers recommended a fixed annuity to hedge the risk of outliving their savings.
phrases.example_translation: 顾问建议配置固定年金，以对冲储蓄先于寿命耗尽的风险。

phrases.usage: 介词搭配，指在阳极处发生氧化等反应，电化学讲解的基本方位表述
phrases.example: In every galvanic cell oxidation occurs at the anode and reduction at the cathode.
phrases.example_translation: 在原电池中，氧化发生在阳极，而还原发生在阴极。

phrases.usage: 腐蚀工程术语，指牺牲阳极，船体与管道防锈的核心概念
phrases.example: Boatyards bolt a zinc sacrificial anode to the hull so the zinc corrodes first.
phrases.example_translation: 船坞把锌制牺牲阳极螺栓固定在船体上，让锌先被腐蚀。

phrases.usage: 材料与冶金搭配，指石墨阳极，电解铝工业中会耗损的部件
phrases.example: The aluminium works replace every graphite anode once it has thinned and pitted.
phrases.example_translation: 铝厂会在每个石墨阳极变薄起坑之后予以更换。

phrases.usage: 电学术语搭配，指阳极电势，电镀与电化学实验报告的计量名词
phrases.example: In the plating bath, raising the anode potential changed the thickness of the deposit.
phrases.example_translation: 在电镀槽中，提高阳极电势会改变镀层的厚度。

phrases.usage: 并列结构，指阳极与阴极这对电极，教学与实验语境成套出现
phrases.example: The lecture began by labeling the anode and cathode on the battery diagram.
phrases.example_translation: 这堂课先从给电池示意图上的阳极和阴极标名开始。

phrases.usage: 形容词搭配，表面上的反常，先疑后解的论述起手式
phrases.example: The apparent anomaly in the survey data dissolved once the missing month was restored.
phrases.example_translation: 调查数据中这处看似反常的地方，补回缺失的那个月后便烟消云散。

phrases.usage: 强烈修饰语，触目惊心的异常，批评与自查语境
phrases.example: The audit flagged a glaring anomaly: the same contractor kept winning sealed bids.
phrases.example_translation: 审计标出一处扎眼的异常：同一家承包商屡中标于密封投标。

phrases.usage: 量化研究术语，统计异常值，数据解读常用
phrases.example: Isolated readings aside, the temperature dip proved nothing more than a statistical anomaly.
phrases.example_translation: 撇开个别读数不谈，这轮降温只是一次统计上的异常而已。

phrases.usage: 计算机术语，异常检测，安全与机器学习领域
phrases.example: The network relies on anomaly detection to spot intrusions that signature filters miss.
phrases.example_translation: 该网络依靠异常检测来揪出特征库过滤器漏掉的入侵。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，察觉异常，监测与安防叙述
phrases.example: Sensors along the pipeline can detect an anomaly in flow within milliseconds.
phrases.example_translation: 管道沿线的传感器能在几毫秒内察觉流量的异常。

phrases.usage: 动词加 as 结构，斥为偶然异常而不深究，含警示义
phrases.example: Researchers warned against dismissing the repeated quake swarm as an anomaly of the instruments.
phrases.example_translation: 研究人员告诫，不要把反复出现的震群简单归为仪器异常了事。

phrases.usage: 形容词搭配，孤立的反常现象，常与规律性相对
phrases.example: One failed trial remained an isolated anomaly amid the study's otherwise consistent results.
phrases.example_translation: 在研究其余一贯的结果中，那次失败的试验仍是一处孤立的反常。

translations.translation: 匿名的，无名的；无个性特征的

phrases.usage: 与 donor、benefactor 连用，指匿名捐助者，慈善新闻常见
phrases.example: An anonymous donor paid the laboratory fees for every student in the program.
phrases.example_translation: 一位匿名捐赠者支付了该项目中每位学生的实验费用。

phrases.usage: tip、information 与 anonymous 搭配，指匿名线报，警务司法语境
phrases.example: Police reopened the investigation after an anonymous tip pointed to a storage unit.
phrases.example_translation: 警方在一则匿名线报指向一间仓储单元后重启了调查。

phrases.usage: remain、keep、stay 加 anonymous，指坚持匿名身份，用于保护信源
phrases.example: The witnesses agreed to testify but insisted on remaining anonymous until the trial.
phrases.example_translation: 证人们同意出庭作证，但坚持在开庭前保持匿名。

phrases.usage: 新闻用语，指匿名消息人士，常与 according to 结构同现
phrases.example: According to an anonymous source, the merger talks had stalled since autumn.
phrases.example_translation: 据一位匿名消息人士称，并购谈判自秋季以来便陷入停滞。

phrases.usage: 与 letter、note 连用，指匿名信，多含告发或威胁意味
phrases.example: The curator received an anonymous letter warning that two paintings were reproductions.
phrases.example_translation: 馆长收到一封匿名信，警告说有两幅画是复制品。

phrases.usage: keep 或 render 加宾语加 anonymous，使作者身份保密，出版评论语境
phrases.example: The publisher used a pen name to keep the author anonymous throughout the controversy.
phrases.example_translation: 出版方使用笔名，好让作者在整场争议中始终保持匿名。

phrases.usage: 借匿名写都市疏离感，of 短语所属，文学与评论常用
phrases.example: He felt calm among a crowd of anonymous faces at the busy station.
phrases.example_translation: 在喧闹车站那一张张陌生的面孔中间，他反而感到平静。

phrases.usage: 固定形容词搭配，指根深蒂固的敌意，社论与人物分析常用
phrases.example: Deep-seated antagonism between the two departments survived every reorganization attempt for years.
phrases.example_translation: 多年来，两个部门之间根深蒂固的对立挺过了每一次改组尝试。

phrases.usage: 后接 between + 双方，指两者间的对立关系
phrases.example: The report documented antagonism between developers and long-time residents of the district.
phrases.example_translation: 报告记录了开发商与该区老住户之间的对立。

phrases.usage: 后接 toward + 对象，指对某人某事的敌意
phrases.example: Her early antagonism toward the plan mellowed once the numbers were explained.
phrases.example_translation: 她起初对该方案的敌意，在数据被解释清楚后便缓和了。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指南引起、激起对立情绪，政策与评论语境常用
phrases.example: The new parking rules provoked antagonism among shopkeepers who relied on visitors.
phrases.example_translation: 新的停车规定激起了依赖过路客商的店主们的反感。

phrases.usage: 量词比喻结构，指表面之下的敌意暗流，小说与报道皆可
phrases.example: Beneath the polite debate ran a constant undercurrent of antagonism nobody acknowledged.
phrases.example_translation: 彬彬有礼的辩论之下，涌动着一股无人承认的持续敌意暗流。

phrases.usage: 形容词搭配，指双方互相敌对，政治与劳资关系文本常用
phrases.example: Mutual antagonism between the two parties stalled the budget for another season.
phrases.example_translation: 两个政党之间的相互敌对使预算搁置了又一个会期。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指以礼貌掩饰敌意，人物刻画与政治报道常见
phrases.example: He masked his antagonism with courtesy, which fooled the committee for a month.
phrases.example_translation: 他以客气掩饰敌意，这骗过了委员会整整一个月。

translations.translation: 敌手；[解剖] 对抗肌；[生化] 拮抗物；反协同试剂

phrases.usage: 后接名词，表示「…的对手」或「…的对抗物」，文学分析与药理语境均用
phrases.example: The old minister proved to be the antagonist of every reform the cabinet proposed.
phrases.example_translation: 这位老部长成了内阁所提每一项改革的反对者。

phrases.usage: 指戏剧小说主角与反派的二元框架，文学分析与写作教学常用术语
phrases.example: The play explores how protagonist and antagonist gradually exchange moral authority over three acts.
phrases.example_translation: 这部戏剧在三幕之中探讨了主角与反派如何逐步交换道德话语权。

phrases.usage: 解剖学术语，指与主动肌相对抗的对抗肌，运动医学文献常见搭配
phrases.example: The coach stressed that each muscular antagonist needs equal training to prevent joint injury.
phrases.example_translation: 教练强调每块对抗肌都需要同等训练，以预防关节损伤。

phrases.usage: 指在冲突中充当对立角色，叙事、政治与表演语境均可使用
phrases.example: He gladly played the antagonist in the negotiations, shielding his partners from direct blame.
phrases.example_translation: 他乐于在谈判中扮演反角，为同伴挡下直接指责。

phrases.usage: 药理学概念，指通过化学作用抵消药效的拮抗物，生化与医药文献常用
phrases.example: Activated charcoal can serve as a chemical antagonist when certain toxins enter the stomach.
phrases.example_translation: 活性炭可在某些毒素进入胃部时充当化学拮抗剂。

phrases.usage: 后接作品或故事，指其中的反派角色，文学与影视评论高频搭配
phrases.example: The true antagonist in the novel is not a person but an indifferent system.
phrases.example_translation: 小说中真正的反派不是某个人，而是冷漠的体制。

phrases.usage: 指与某势力针锋相对的对立者，政治冲突与历史叙事常用
phrases.example: Each faction chose an antagonist against its rival, turning the council into open warfare.
phrases.example_translation: 各派系均选出与对手针锋相对的人物，将议事会变成公开交锋。

translations.translation: 使…敌对；使…对抗；对…起反作用

phrases.usage: 副词修饰及物动词，指公开树敌，政治与职场评论高频结构
phrases.example: The minister risked losing votes by openly antagonizing the party's rural wing.
phrases.example_translation: 这位部长公然与该党农村派系为敌，面临失票的风险。

phrases.usage: the very 强调恰恰是本该合作者，政论中常见的批评句式
phrases.example: The new policy antagonized the small farmers whose cooperation the program required.
phrases.example_translation: 新政策得罪的恰恰是该项目需要其合作的小农户。

phrases.usage: avoid 后接动名词，指外交与管理中刻意不树敌的谨慎策略
phrases.example: Diplomats were trained to avoid antagonizing host governments during the delicate final round of the summit.
phrases.example_translation: 外交官受训避免在峰会微妙的最后一轮激怒东道国政府。

phrases.usage: 药理学术语用法，指抵消或对抗某药物的作用，医学科普常见
phrases.example: Some herbs can antagonize the effects of prescribed blood thinners without clear warning.
