phrases.example_translation: 某些草药会在没有明确警示的情况下对抗处方抗凝药的作用。

phrases.usage: 过去分词加 by 表被动情绪，指被深深激起敌意，人物心理描写
phrases.example: The editors, deeply antagonized by the accusation, resigned from the panel the next morning.
phrases.example_translation: 编辑们被这一指控深深激怒，次日上午便辞去了评审职务。

phrases.usage: 副词 needlessly 加动词，指无谓地招怨，检讨与评论常用措辞
phrases.example: The mayor admitted he had needlessly antagonized neighborhood groups during the rezoning fight.
phrases.example_translation: 市长承认他在重新划区的争执中无谓地得罪了社区团体。

phrases.usage: 介词搭配，在前厅等候，正式公务与宫廷叙事常用
phrases.example: The petitioners waited in the ante-room until the clerk finally admitted them one by one.
phrases.example_translation: 请愿者们在接待室里等候，直到书记官最终逐一召见他们。

phrases.usage: 后接 to，指通往正厅的前厅，英式建筑与宅邸描写常用
phrases.example: A quiet ante-room to the council chamber held maps from the previous round of talks.
phrases.example_translation: 通往议事厅的一间安静前厅里放着上一轮会谈的地图。

phrases.usage: 动宾结构，引导某人进入接待室，礼仪与小说叙事常用
phrases.example: The butler showed the reluctant guests into the ante-room and offered them tea in silence.
phrases.example_translation: 管家把几位拘谨的客人领进接待室，默然奉上茶水。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，寂静的前厅，文学氛围与心理铺垫描写
phrases.example: A hushed ante-room, lit by a single lamp, gathered anxious applicants before the hearing.
phrases.example_translation: 听证会开始前，一间仅有一盏灯照明的寂静前厅里聚满了焦虑的申请人。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，布置接待室，室内装饰与建筑文本用语
phrases.example: They decided to furnish the ante-room plainly, with wooden benches and a single worn carpet.
phrases.example_translation: 他们决定简朴地布置前厅，只放木长椅和一张旧地毯。

phrases.usage: 定语从句，指发生在……之前的事件，史学论述常见
phrases.example: The historian meticulously catalogued the events that antecede the formal declaration of war.
phrases.example_translation: 史学家详尽整理了正式宣战之前发生的一系列事件。

phrases.usage: 不及物动词后接in time，指时间上更早，学术语体
phrases.example: These oral ballads antecede in time the printed anthologies that later preserved them.
phrases.example_translation: 这些口传民谣在时间上早于后来收录它们的印刷选集。

phrases.usage: 及物动词后接by加时间段，指早数百年，年代学常用
phrases.example: The carved stone tablets antecede by several centuries the earliest known manuscript copies.
phrases.example_translation: 这些石刻碑文比已知最早的手抄本早几个世纪。

phrases.usage: 过去分词短语作状语，by引出在先的事物，历史叙述用
phrases.example: The Renaissance, anteceded by the Black Death, reshaped European society in unexpected ways.
phrases.example_translation: 以黑死病为先声的文艺复兴以意想不到的方式重塑了欧洲社会。

phrases.usage: 定语从句，指时间早于某事的记录，考古科研常用
phrases.example: Archaeologists carefully studied the fragmentary records that antecede the collapse of the dynasty.
phrases.example_translation: 考古学家细致研究了那些早于王朝崩溃的残缺记录。

phrases.usage: 复数名词加形容词，历史先例，学术溯源开篇常用
phrases.example: The essay traces the historical antecedents of modern budget oversight to medieval audit practices.
phrases.example_translation: 这篇文章把现代预算监督的历史前身追溯到中世纪的审计做法。

phrases.usage: 语法术语，先行名词，与代词回指配对，教学语境
phrases.example: The exercise asked pupils to circle the antecedent noun before correcting each pronoun.
phrases.example_translation: 练习让学生先圈出先行名词，再逐一订正代词。

phrases.usage: 回指关系表述，代词须清晰指回先行词，写作规范讲评
phrases.example: Ambiguous writing arises when a pronoun fails to point clearly back to its antecedent.
phrases.example_translation: 当代词无法清晰回指其先行词时，文义便含混起来。

phrases.usage: 指古典渊源，建筑与文学批评中论及继承关系
phrases.example: The architect acknowledged the building's classical antecedents while insisting the design stayed modern.
phrases.example_translation: 建筑师承认这座楼有古典渊源，却坚称设计仍属现代。

phrases.usage: 形容词用法后接 to，先于某事发生，法律与史学正式语
phrases.example: Claims based on events antecedent to the charter were dismissed by the tribunal.
phrases.example_translation: 仲裁庭驳回了基于特许状颁布前事件的索赔请求。

phrases.usage: 复数名词表家世祖先，谱牒与移民史文本，语体古雅
phrases.example: The parish register records the family antecedents of settlers who arrived in seventeen eighty-nine.
phrases.example_translation: 教区登记册记载了一七八九年抵达的定居者的家世渊源。

phrases.usage: 指文学前身与源头，书评与比较文学常用
phrases.example: The novel's literary antecedents include picaresque journeys and eighteenth-century essays on self-interest.
phrases.example_translation: 这部小说的文学渊源包括流浪汉游记与十八世纪论私利的随笔。

phrases.usage: 后接 by 加时间段，指在年代上早于某物数个世纪
phrases.example: The settlement's street grid antedates the royal charter by several centuries, archaeologists showed.
phrases.example_translation: 考古学者证明，这片定居点的街网比王室特许状早了几个世纪。

phrases.usage: 接名词短语，指早于某机构的建立，学术年代学
phrases.example: Local custom here may antedate the founding of the medieval university itself.
phrases.example_translation: 此地的习俗或许早于中世纪大学本身的创建。

phrases.usage: 被动结构，指文件日期被倒填，法律与文书语境
phrases.example: The old deed turned out to be antedated to evade the new inheritance tax.
phrases.example_translation: 那份旧契据原来是倒签日期，用以规避新的遗产税。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指早于文字记载，史前与口头传统研究
phrases.example: Several oral epics evidently antedate the earliest written records of the same campaign.
phrases.example_translation: 若干部口头史诗显然早于同一场战役最早的文献记载。

phrases.usage: 互相结构，指彼此年代先后难以判定，校勘与断代语境
phrases.example: The two manuscript families antedate one another, so editors cannot fix a clear stemma.
phrases.example_translation: 两支抄本系统互有早晚，编者因此无法确定清晰的谱系。

translations.translation: 大洪水前的；远古的；陈旧的；旧式的
大洪水以前的人；年迈的人；不合时宜的人

phrases.usage: 宗教与史学搭配，指《创世记》所载洪水之前的时代
phrases.example: Antediluvian times, in the literal reading, ended with a flood that repopulated the earth.
phrases.example_translation: 按字面解读，洪水之前的时代终结于一场重新滋生万物的大洪水。

phrases.usage: 泛指极遥远、蒙昧的远古年代，带文学色彩
phrases.example: The essay imagines an antediluvian era when the desert was still a fertile plain.
phrases.example_translation: 这篇文章想象了一个洪荒时代，那时沙漠仍是一片沃土。

phrases.usage: 圣经研究专名搭配，指洪水前的族长，常出现在谱系叙述中
phrases.example: The genealogy lists the antediluvian patriarchs with lifespans far beyond ordinary record.
phrases.example_translation: 这份家谱列出了洪水前的诸族长，其寿数远超寻常记载。

phrases.usage: 副形搭配，讽喻陈旧得荒唐，现代语境中的比喻用法
phrases.example: By modern standards the office still ran on an absurdly antediluvian filing system.
phrases.example_translation: 以今日标准看，这间办公室仍靠一套陈旧得荒唐的档案系统运转。

phrases.usage: attitude 后接 toward，指守旧过时、抗拒新事物的观念
phrases.example: His antediluvian attitude toward typing machines cost the journal several young contributors.
phrases.example_translation: 他对打字机的陈旧观念让这份刊物损失了好几位年轻投稿人。

phrases.usage: relic from 框架，既可指真正的远古遗物，也常作讽刺喻体
phrases.example: That drafting committee behaves like a relic from antediluvian times, guarding paper forms.
phrases.example_translation: 那个起草委员会表现得像是洪荒时代的遗老，死守着纸质表格。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指正午之前的时段，古雅罕见词，文学笔调
phrases.example: He drafted his most careful essays during the antemeridian hours before breakfast.
phrases.example_translation: 他在早餐前那段上午早些时候的时光里写下最讲究的随笔。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指午前柔和的光线，景物与绘画题材描写
phrases.example: The gallery arranged its windows to admit soft antemeridian light for the watercolors.
phrases.example_translation: 美术馆特意调整窗户，让午前柔和的光线洒在这些水彩画上。

phrases.usage: 定冠词名词接形容词，指上午的空气，风景叙述用语
phrases.example: She walked the cliff path wrapped in the cool antemeridian air from the sea.
phrases.example_translation: 她走在悬崖小径上，裹挟着海面吹来的清冷晨间空气。

phrases.usage: 成对对照结构，区分午前与午后，词源或历法解释语境
phrases.example: Old parish records divided each day into antemeridian and postmeridian segments for payments.
phrases.example_translation: 古老的教区记录把每一天分成午前和午后两段来登记付款。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指设在正午前的截止时限，办公场景的戏用雅词
phrases.example: The editor set an antemeridian deadline, requiring every manuscript review by eleven.
phrases.example_translation: 编辑把截止时间设在午前，要求所有书稿须在十一点前审完。

phrases.usage: 形容词修饰名词，神学语境指“世界形成前的存在”，极为罕见学术用法
phrases.example: The philosopher contemplated whether the soul could possess an antemundane existence prior to birth.
phrases.example_translation: 这位哲学家思考灵魂是否能在出生之前拥有先于世界的存在。

phrases.usage: 形容词修饰名词，指“太初之前的纪元”，神学与创世论学术文本罕见用法
phrases.example: Certain Gnostic texts describe an antemundane era in which divine emanations preceded material creation.
phrases.example_translation: 某些诺斯替文献描述了一个神圣流溢先于物质创造的太初之前的纪元。

phrases.usage: 形容词修饰名词，哲学语境指“创世前的原初状态”，神学论著极罕见用法
phrases.example: The treatise argued that the antemundane state was neither temporal nor spatial in any ordinary sense.
phrases.example_translation: 这篇论文认为创世前的状态在任何通常意义上既非时间性的也非空间性的。

phrases.usage: 形容词修饰名词，创世神话研究语境指“太初混沌”，神话学与宗教比较研究常见
phrases.example: Mesopotamian and Greek cosmogonies both begin with imagery of an antemundane chaos.
phrases.example_translation: 美索不达米亚和希腊的宇宙起源论都以先于世界的混沌意象开篇。

phrases.usage: 形容词修饰学科名词，指关于创世之前状态的宗教学说，极为专业的神学用语
phrases.example: Scholars of antemundane theology debate whether Origen truly taught the pre-existence of all souls.
phrases.example_translation: 研究先世神学的学者们争论俄利根是否真的教导过所有灵魂的先存。

phrases.usage: 学科搭配，指孕期保健服务，公共卫生与政策文本最高频
phrases.example: Free antenatal care lowered infant mortality across the district within a single decade of the programme.
phrases.example_translation: 该项目实施十年之内，免费产前保健就降低了整个地区的婴儿死亡率。

phrases.usage: 接机构名词，指产前检查门诊，医疗叙事与统计语境
phrases.example: Midwives at the antenatal clinic monitor blood pressure and weight at every scheduled visit.
phrases.example_translation: 产前门诊的助产士在每次预约就诊时监测血压和体重。

phrases.usage: 接检查类名词，指产前筛查，常与伦理讨论并现
phrases.example: Antenatal screening can detect certain conditions early, which raises difficult questions for expectant parents.
phrases.example_translation: 产前筛查能早期发现某些病症，这给准父母带来了艰难的抉择。

phrases.usage: 复数搭配，指孕妇学校课程，生活与公共服务语境
phrases.example: They met in antenatal classes on Tuesday evenings and learned breathing techniques together.
phrases.example_translation: 他们周二晚上的产前课上相识，一起练习呼吸技巧。

phrases.usage: 接过程名词，指胚胎期发育，生物学与医学论述常用
phrases.example: Poor nutrition during antenatal development can affect organ growth for the rest of a life.
phrases.example_translation: 产前发育期营养不良会影响器官生长，其后果持续一生。

phrases.usage: 接病症名词，指孕期抑郁，心理健康议题的专业表述
phrases.example: Antenatal depression often goes unreported, so clinicians now ask about mood at each checkup.
phrases.example_translation: 产前抑郁常常不被报告，因此临床医生现在每次产检都会询问情绪状况。

phrases.usage: 接抽象服务名词，指孕产知识普及，社区健康项目语境
phrases.example: Community midwives provide antenatal education that helps first-time mothers recognise warning signs early.
phrases.example_translation: 社区助产士提供产前教育，帮助初产妇及早识别危险信号。

translations.translation: [电讯] 天线；[动] 触角，[昆] 触须

phrases.usage: 工程术语，天线阵列，多个单元合成定向波束
phrases.example: The observatory's antenna array can resolve details invisible to a single dish.
phrases.example_translation: 这台天文台的天线阵列能够分辨单个碟形天线无法看到的细节。

phrases.usage: 名词修饰的技术搭配，无线电收发天线，日常科技描述
phrases.example: A rusted radio antenna on the barn still picked up the faint broadcasts of distant stations.
phrases.example_translation: 谷仓上那副锈迹斑斑的无线电天线，仍能收到远处电台微弱的广播。

phrases.usage: 生物学复数形式 antennae 加量词，描述昆虫感觉器官
phrases.example: The beetle swept a pair of antennae across the leaf, sampling chemicals invisible to us.
phrases.example_translation: 甲虫用一对触须在叶面上拂过，采样那些我们无法察觉的化学物质。

phrases.usage: 名词复合，发射塔，景观与基础设施描写常见
phrases.example: The antenna tower raised on the hill reshaped local debates about the skyline.
phrases.example_translation: 山丘上新立的发射塔，重新点燃了当地关于城市天际线的争论。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，架设天线，技术动作描写
phrases.example: Volunteers mounted an antenna on the chapel roof to reach the isolated valley.
phrases.example_translation: 志愿者们在小教堂屋顶装起一副天线，以便联络与世隔绝的山谷。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，把天线调谐到频率，业余无线电操作描写
phrases.example: He learned to tune the antenna by ear, listening for the cleanest signal.
phrases.example_translation: 他学会了凭听觉调谐天线，只辨那最干净的信号。

phrases.usage: 学科固定术语，前交叉韧带，运动医学报道高频
phrases.example: The skier tore her anterior cruciate ligament and faced nearly a year of rehabilitation.
phrases.example_translation: 这名滑雪运动员撕裂了前交叉韧带，面临将近一年的康复训练。

phrases.usage: 后接 to + 结构，解剖学方位表达，指位于…前方
phrases.example: The surgeon placed the incision just anterior to the existing scar tissue.
phrases.example_translation: 外科医生把切口恰好开在原有瘢痕组织的前方。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，前部区域，神经与解剖文献的常规表述
phrases.example: Blood flow increased in the anterior region of the brain during the verbal task.
phrases.example_translation: 在完成语言任务时，大脑前部区域的血流量增加了。

phrases.usage: 学科术语，腺垂体（垂体前叶），内分泌话题专名
phrases.example: The anterior pituitary gland releases several hormones that regulate growth and reproduction throughout life.
phrases.example_translation: 腺垂体分泌的多种激素在人的一生中调节生长与生殖功能。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，眼前段，眼科检查与手术语境
phrases.example: The lamp examined the anterior segment of the eye for signs of inflammation.
phrases.example_translation: 裂隙灯检查了患者眼睛的前段，查看是否有炎症迹象。

phrases.usage: 学科术语，前房，指角膜与虹膜之间的腔隙
phrases.example: Fluid drained from the anterior chamber eased the pressure behind the cornea.
phrases.example_translation: 从前房引流出液体，缓解了角膜后方的压力。

phrases.usage: 名词 + of + 复数名词，表示诗文曲选集，最常用结构
phrases.example: The editor assembled an anthology of neglected nineteenth-century nature essays drawn from provincial archives.
phrases.example_translation: 编辑从地方档案中辑录被忽视的十九世纪自然随笔，编成一部选集。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指编辑选集的工作，文学出版语境
phrases.example: She spent three years compiling an anthology of immigrant oral histories for publication.
phrases.example_translation: 她花了三年时间编纂一部移民口述史选集以备出版。

phrases.usage: 动词 + 介词短语，指向选集供稿
phrases.example: The novelist agreed to contribute to an anthology marking the poet's centenary.
phrases.example_translation: 小说家同意为纪念诗人诞辰一百周年的选集供稿。

phrases.usage: 名名搭配，限定体裁，教学与书评语境
phrases.example: The survey course assigns a poetry anthology covering work written after the war.
phrases.example_translation: 这门导论课指定一本收录战后作品的诗歌选集。

phrases.usage: 名名搭配，指每集独立成篇的电视剧集模式
phrases.example: Each episode of the anthology series follows a different family in the same city.
phrases.example_translation: 这部诗选剧集的每一集都讲述同一座城市里不同的家庭。

phrases.usage: 介词短语限定收录范围，评论文章高频
phrases.example: No earlier essay in this anthology captures urban noise with such precision.
phrases.example_translation: 这本选集里没有一篇更早的随笔能如此精确地捕捉城市噪音。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指即将出版的选集，出版预告语境
phrases.example: A forthcoming anthology will gather the columnist's scattered pieces from the war years.
phrases.example_translation: 一部即将问世的选集将辑录这位专栏作家战争年代散落的专栏。

translations.translation: 类人猿的；类人的；（猿等）似人类的

phrases.usage: 学科名词搭配，指类人猿，灵长类学与传统博物学文本的固定说法
phrases.example: Researchers compared social bonds in gorillas with those of other anthropoid apes.
phrases.example_translation: 研究者将大猩猩的社会纽带与其他类人猿进行了比较。

phrases.usage: 形容词修饰名词，指类人猿祖先，演化人类学讨论谱系时常用
phrases.example: The fossil was hailed as a possible anthropoid ancestor from the Miocene epoch.
phrases.example_translation: 这枚化石被誉为可能出自中新世的类人猿祖先。

phrases.usage: 形容词修饰名词，指类人猿头骨，博物馆藏品与体质人类学语境
phrases.example: The museum catalogues an anthropoid skull collected during the remote river survey.
phrases.example_translation: 博物馆著录了一具在偏远河流考察中采集的类人猿头骨。

phrases.usage: 名词复数前加fossil，指化石类人猿，古生物学论文常见
phrases.example: Fossil anthropoids from the rift valley reshaped debates about early brain size.
phrases.example_translation: 来自裂谷的化石类人猿重塑了关于早期脑容量的争论。

phrases.usage: 形容词修饰名词，指似人的面部特征，艺术与体质描述皆可
phrases.example: The sculptor exaggerated the anthropoid features of the guardian statue on purpose.
phrases.example_translation: 雕塑家故意夸大了那尊守护雕像的似人特征。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，人类学最常见分支之一
phrases.example: A cultural anthropologist spent three years recording the oral histories of coastal villages.
phrases.example_translation: 一位文化人类学家花了三年时间记录沿海村庄的口述历史。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，体质人类学方向
phrases.example: The physical anthropologist examined skeletal remains to estimate the age of the burial site.
phrases.example_translation: 体质人类学家检查骨骼遗骸以估计墓葬遗址的年代。

phrases.usage: 主谓搭配，学术履历与研究兴趣介绍常用
phrases.example: The anthropologist specializes in kinship systems among pastoral communities in East Africa.
phrases.example_translation: 这位人类学家专攻东非游牧社群的亲属制度。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，强调田野调查工作的从业者
phrases.example: As a field anthropologist she lived among remote communities to document fading rituals.
phrases.example_translation: 作为田野人类学家，她生活在偏远社群中记录正在消逝的仪式。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，强调受过专业训练以避免外部预设
phrases.example: Only a trained anthropologist can read such gestures without importing outside assumptions.
phrases.example_translation: 只有受过训练的人类学家才能在不带入外部预设的情况下解读这类手势。

phrases.usage: 主语加动词搭配，学术写作中描述观察与论述
phrases.example: In the monograph the anthropologist observes how gift exchange binds rival families together.
phrases.example_translation: 在这部专著中，人类学家观察到礼物交换如何将敌对家族联系在一起。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，人类学的主要分支，学科分类表述中最常见
phrases.example: Cultural anthropology examines how groups make shared meaning out of everyday routine, ritual and trade.
phrases.example_translation: 文化人类学研究人们如何从日常惯例、仪式与交换中创造共同的意义。

phrases.usage: 后接 in 加学科名，指某专业学位，申请与简历语境的标准介词
phrases.example: She returned to campus for a degree in anthropology after nearly a decade at sea.
phrases.example_translation: 在海上工作了近十年后，她回到校园攻读人类学学位。

phrases.usage: fieldwork 是该学科的招牌方法，介词 in 引出所属学科领域
phrases.example: Two decades of patient fieldwork in anthropology taught him to listen before drawing conclusions.
phrases.example_translation: 人类学二十年的耐心田野调查教会他先倾听再下结论。

phrases.usage: of 短语，指学科发展史，学术史与批评综述里的常见话题
phrases.example: The history of anthropology includes several uncomfortable chapters on colonial collecting and display.
phrases.example_translation: 人类学的历史中包含着若干关于殖民时期收集与展陈的不光彩篇章。

phrases.usage: 另一分支搭配，研究人类演化与体质，与 cultural 形成对照
phrases.example: Biological anthropology uses skeletal remains and dental wear to trace ancient migration across the strait.
phrases.example_translation: 体质人类学借助骨骼遗存与牙齿磨损追溯穿越海峡的古代迁徙。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，最朴素的职业表述，人物简介与校园语境常用
phrases.example: For twenty quiet years he taught anthropology at a small agricultural college in the plains.
phrases.example_translation: 他在平原上一所安静的小型农业学院教了二十年人类学。

phrases.usage: within 限定学科内部，指理论争鸣，期刊述评常用表达
phrases.example: Recent debates within anthropology have reshaped how researchers describe kinship, exchange and the limits of evidence.
phrases.example_translation: 近年人类学内部的论争重塑了研究者描述亲属关系、交换与证据边界的方式。

phrases.usage: 医疗量词搭配，一个疗程的抗生素，医嘱与病历叙述标准说法
phrases.example: She completed a long course of antibiotics before resuming the theater rehearsals.
phrases.example_translation: 她足足完成了一个疗程的抗生素治疗，才重返戏剧排练。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，开具抗生素，处方政策与公共卫生讨论的核心动词
phrases.example: Current guidelines discourage family doctors from prescribing antibiotics for ordinary viral fevers.
phrases.example_translation: 现行指南不鼓励家庭医生为普通病毒性发热开抗生素。

phrases.usage: 药学术语，广谱抗生素，指作用于多种细菌，附带生态争议
phrases.example: Broad-spectrum antibiotics can quietly disturb the delicate microbial balance of the gut.
phrases.example_translation: 广谱抗生素可能在不知不觉中扰乱肠道脆弱的微生物平衡。

phrases.usage: 后接 to 结构，对抗生素的耐药性，演化医学的关键表述
phrases.example: Careless dosing fosters growing resistance to antibiotics across crowded hospital wards.
phrases.example_translation: 不规范的用药在拥挤的病房中助长了对抗生素日益增强的耐药性。

phrases.usage: 名词化搭配，抗生素滥用，政策评论与环境健康议题高频词组
phrases.example: The committee warned about the chronic overuse of antibiotics in industrial livestock farming.
phrases.example_translation: 委员会就工业化畜牧养殖中长期滥用抗生素的问题发出警告。

phrases.usage: 不及物加 to，对抗生素治疗有反应，预后判断的临床用语
phrases.example: Most ordinary chest infections respond quickly to antibiotics within two quiet days.
phrases.example_translation: 大多数普通胸部感染在使用抗生素后两天内即可迅速见效。

phrases.usage: 名名搭配，指抗体检测，流行病学与新闻报道标准用语
phrases.example: The antibody test identified residents in the harbor district who had already been infected.
phrases.example_translation: 抗体检测甄别出港区中此前已被感染的居民。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指免疫系统生成抗体，生物学基础表述
phrases.example: The immune system produces antibodies that bind tightly to particular viral surface proteins.
phrases.example_translation: 免疫系统生成抗体，紧紧结合在特定的病毒表面蛋白上。

phrases.usage: 学科搭配，指抗体应答，疫苗研究文献核心术语
phrases.example: Vaccination aims to train a rapid antibody response against an invading pathogen.
phrases.example_translation: 接种疫苗旨在训练机体对入侵病原体产生快速的抗体应答。

phrases.usage: 专业搭配，指能阻断病毒入胞的中和抗体，病毒学高频
phrases.example: Researchers isolated a neutralizing antibody that prevents the virus from entering host cells.
phrases.example_translation: 研究人员分离出一株中和抗体，可阻止病毒进入宿主细胞。

phrases.usage: 主谓搭配核心名词，指抗体水平/滴度，随访研究常测指标
phrases.example: Antibody levels in the recovered patients declined steadily within a single year.
phrases.example_translation: 康复患者体内的抗体水平在一年之内稳步下降。

phrases.usage: 医药术语搭配，指单克隆抗体疗法，现代生物技术标志
phrases.example: A monoclonal antibody therapy was approved for several patients with a rare autoimmune disorder.
phrases.example_translation: 一种单克隆抗体疗法获批用于数名罕见自身免疫疾病患者。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指（检测中）检出抗体，血清学实验语境
phrases.example: Serum assays can still detect antibodies long after the acute symptoms fade.
phrases.example_translation: 血清检测在急性症状消退很久之后仍能检出抗体。

translations.translation: 预期，期望；占先，抢先；提前使用

phrases.usage: 后接 that 从句，指预期某事将发生，书面与财经评论高频
phrases.example: The board anticipated that modest price cuts would steady demand before autumn.
phrases.example_translation: 董事会预期，适度的降价会在秋季到来前稳住需求。

phrases.usage: 副词修饰过去分词作定语，指万众期待的成果，可引出落差叙述
phrases.example: The eagerly anticipated survey results arrived three weeks late and quietly disappointed the research team.
phrases.example_translation: 那份万众期待的调查结果迟了三周才到，让研究团队暗自失望。

phrases.usage: as 引导省略结构，指出乎意料之外地正如所料，评论连接语
phrases.example: The vote collapsed within minutes, exactly as the party whips had anticipated.
phrases.example_translation: 表决在几分钟内便告崩盘，恰恰如党鞭们此前所料。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指预先想到并防备批评，政治与公关语境常用
phrases.example: The minister prepared blunt answers to anticipate criticism of the housing plan.
phrases.example_translation: 部长准备了直截了当的答问，以预先应对针对住房计划的批评。

phrases.usage: 接 of 引出对象，指想在他人开口之前满足其需求，含褒义服务意识
phrases.example: A good archivist anticipates the needs of readers who have not yet arrived.
phrases.example_translation: 优秀的档案员会预判尚未登门的读者将来的需求。

phrases.usage: 否定框架，指未能预见到某后果，事故分析与史学复盘高频
phrases.example: Engineers failed to anticipate how quickly repeated thawing would weaken the roadbed.
phrases.example_translation: 工程师们未能预见到反复冻融会以多快的速度掏空路基。

phrases.usage: every move 夸张宾语，指料敌先机、步步算中，竞赛与博弈语境
phrases.example: The veteran fencer seemed to anticipate her opponent's every move across the strip.
phrases.example_translation: 这位老将击剑手似乎算准了对手在剑道上的每一步动作。

phrases.usage: 形容词加不定式结构，指难以预料，常承认预测的固有局限
phrases.example: Market swings of this scale remain hard to anticipate even for seasoned analysts.
phrases.example_translation: 如此幅度的市场震荡，即便是经验丰富的分析师也难以预料。

translations.translation: 突降法；虎头蛇尾；令人扫兴的结尾

phrases.usage: 名词短语，指令人失望的收尾，常见于剧评
phrases.example: The grand finale proved a bitter anticlimax after such a promising opening.
phrases.example_translation: 在精彩的开场之后，宏大的终场竟成了令人苦涩的扫兴收尾。

phrases.usage: 动介搭配，指以虎头蛇尾收场，叙事评论常用
phrases.example: The long negotiation ended in anticlimax with a brief, awkward handshake.
phrases.example_translation: 漫长的谈判以一次简短尴尬的握手虎头蛇尾地结束了。

phrases.usage: 名词短语，指明显的落差与扫兴，书面评价语
phrases.example: After weeks of tense buildup, the announcement proved a marked anticlimax.
phrases.example_translation: 在数周紧张的铺垫之后，这则声明成了明显的扫兴落差。

phrases.usage: 动词短语，指演讲或情节滑向平淡结尾，修辞语境
phrases.example: The oration risked dropping into anticlimax with its thin and hurried ending.
phrases.example_translation: 这篇演说因其单薄仓促的结尾而难免落入虎头蛇尾。

phrases.usage: 名词后接 from，指源自某处的扫兴落差
phrases.example: The film suffered an anticlimax from a rushed and unfinished final act.
phrases.example_translation: 这部影片因匆忙而未完成的最后一幕而显得令人扫兴。

phrases.usage: 名词短语，指令人沮丧的结局，评论语域常见
phrases.example: Many reviewers called the sequel a frustrating anticlimax to the trilogy.
phrases.example_translation: 许多评论家称这部续集是整部三部曲令人沮丧的扫兴收尾。

phrases.usage: 名词后接 of，指某事的草草收场，描写落差
phrases.example: Guests were left baffled by the anticlimax of the festival's muted closing.
phrases.example_translation: 节日悄无声息的闭幕令在场的宾客倍感扫兴与困惑。

phrases.usage: 气象学科搭配，形名结构指强度大、控制范围广的高压系统，常见于天气报道与论文
phrases.example: A strong anticyclone settled over the plains, keeping the skies clear and the winds almost still.
phrases.example_translation: 一个强反气旋停留在平原上空，使天空晴朗、几乎无风。

phrases.usage: of 属格结构，指高压系统中心，气流下沉、天气晴稳，用于描述气压场
phrases.example: At the center of an anticyclone, air sinks slowly and surface pressure reaches its seasonal maximum.
phrases.example_translation: 在反气旋中心，空气缓慢下沉，地面气压达到季节内的最高值。

phrases.usage: 介词搭配，表示处于高压系统控制之下，多用于解释静风、逆温等天气现象
phrases.example: Under the anticyclone, the valley experienced several windless days with a persistent temperature inversion.
phrases.example_translation: 在反气旋控制下，山谷经历了数个无风之日，逆温层持续不散。

phrases.usage: 术语搭配，指高压向外延伸的脊线，用于说明天气系统的移动与阻挡作用
phrases.example: The ridge of the anticyclone extended eastward, steering the storm system away from the coast.
phrases.example_translation: 反气旋的高压脊向东延伸，把风暴系统引导离开海岸。

phrases.usage: 主谓加介词结构，描述高压系统在某一地区生成，地理与气象语境通用
phrases.example: In winter, a cold anticyclone often forms over the Siberian interior and then drifts westward.
phrases.example_translation: 冬季，冷性反气旋常在西伯利亚内陆生成，随后向西漂移。

phrases.usage: 主谓搭配，指高压系统势力减退，常与季节转换、降水回归并述
phrases.example: As the anticyclone weakens in spring, moist ocean air finally reaches the parched farmland.
phrases.example_translation: 随着反气旋在春季减弱，湿润的海洋气流终于抵达干裂的农田。

translations.translation: [药] 解毒剂；解药；矫正方法

phrases.usage: 核心介词搭配，比喻义多用 to，指矫正某种弊病之法
phrases.example: Many doctors now describe regular evening exercise as an antidote to mild sleeplessness.
phrases.example_translation: 许多医生如今把傍晚规律运动称作轻度失眠的解药。

phrases.usage: 医学动宾搭配，administer 表施予，for 引出中毒类型
phrases.example: The toxicologists moved quickly to administer an antidote for the contaminated shellfish.
phrases.example_translation: 毒理专家迅速行动，为受污染贝类中毒者注射了解药。

phrases.usage: 系表结构，指起到解毒或补救作用，科普与评论常见
phrases.example: These blunt corrections act as an antidote to years of flattering gossip.
phrases.example_translation: 这些直率的纠正起到了解毒剂的作用，抵消了多年的阿谀传闻。

phrases.usage: against 强调抵御具体毒物，药理与博物史文本用词
phrases.example: The museum displayed a clay jar said to hold an antidote against poison.
phrases.example_translation: 博物馆展出一只陶罐，据说曾盛放防毒的解药。

phrases.usage: for 引出所治之症，亦用于比喻，语气较为绝对
phrases.example: Time is sometimes described by columnists as the only antidote for public outrage.
phrases.example_translation: 专栏作者有时称时间是平息公众愤怒的唯一解药。

phrases.usage: 加 metaphorical 明示修辞用法，文学评论与随笔常见
phrases.example: In his essays he offered long walks as a metaphorical antidote to a desk-bound career.
phrases.example_translation: 他在随笔中把长距离散步比作久坐书斋生活的解毒剂。

phrases.usage: 修辞学与逻辑批评术语，指论证内部的前后矛盾，书面语
phrases.example: The reviewer found a subtle antilogy in the argument, praising markets while demanding central control.
phrases.example_translation: 书评人在其论证中发现一处微妙的自相矛盾：既赞美市场，又要求中央管控。

phrases.usage: charge sth with 结构，指指斥某文自相矛盾，辩论与批评语域
phrases.example: Opponents charged the essay with antilogy, quoting two passages that denied each other.
phrases.example_translation: 反对者指责这篇文章前后矛盾，并援引了两段互相否定的文字。

phrases.usage: glaring 强调矛盾触目惊心，该词罕见，搭配需靠形容词撑起语感
phrases.example: Only a careless editor would miss so glaring an antilogy in the opening chapter.
phrases.example_translation: 如此触目惊心的自相矛盾出现在开篇第一章，只有粗心的编辑才会视而不见。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指说出或写下前后抵触的话，正式评论语气
phrases.example: Having denied the rumour, the minister committed an antilogy by confirming it the next morning.
phrases.example_translation: 大臣先否认传闻，次日清晨又加以确认，犯了前后矛盾的毛病。

phrases.usage: apparent 表示表面上的矛盾，学术校勘用语，常用于为作者辩护
phrases.example: The lecture explained the apparent antilogy between passages as a change of audience rather of view.
phrases.example_translation: 讲座把两段文字之间表面的矛盾解释为听众对象的变化，而非观点的转变。

phrases.usage: 核心介词搭配，antipathy to/toward sth，指“对某事物的反感”
phrases.example: In her diary she confessed a lifelong antipathy to every form of organized sport.
phrases.example_translation: 她在日记中坦承自己一生都反感一切有组织的体育运动。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，harbor 指“暗藏”，抽象语体，强调持久于心
phrases.example: The editor harbored an antipathy toward puns that colored decades of house style.
phrases.example_translation: 这位编辑心存对双关语的厌恶，影响了该报数十年文风。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指“根深蒂固的反感”，评论与人物分析常用
phrases.example: The essay traces a deep-seated antipathy between urban planners and itinerant street vendors.
phrases.example_translation: 文章追溯了城市规划者与流动摊贩之间根深蒂固的相互厌恶。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指“相互厌恶”，外交与人际关系描写
phrases.example: Decades of mutual antipathy between the two dailies ended only with their merger.
phrases.example_translation: 这两家日报之间数十年的相互厌恶直到它们合并才告终。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指“本能的、生理性的厌恶”，强调发自身体而非理性
phrases.example: His memoir explains a visceral antipathy to crowded rooms rooted in childhood illness.
phrases.example_translation: 他的回忆录解释说，对拥挤房间的生理性厌恶根源于儿时的疾病。

phrases.usage: 分词 + 名词，指“不断增长的厌恶”，表示情绪升级过程
phrases.example: A growing antipathy to the committee's secrecy finally pushed several senior members to resign.
phrases.example_translation: 对委员会神秘作风日益加深的反感，最终迫使数名资深成员辞职。

phrases.usage: border on 结构，指“近乎蔑视的厌恶”，高级写作强化搭配
phrases.example: The stern critic regarded the bestselling novelist with an antipathy bordering on contempt.
phrases.example_translation: 那位严厉的书评人以近乎蔑视的厌恶看着这位畅销小说家。

translations.translation: 地球上处于正相对应的两个地区，尤指（与欧洲形成对跖地的）澳大拉西亚

phrases.usage: 后接 of，指“…的正对跖地”，地理术语，也喻截然相反之物
phrases.example: Geographers debated whether the town lay near the antipodes of a coastal city.
phrases.example_translation: 地理学家们争论这座小镇是否位于某座海岸城市的正对跖地附近。

phrases.usage: 动词搭配，指“抵达对跖之地”，探险与历史叙事用语
phrases.example: Early navigators struggled for months before they could reach the distant antipodes.
phrases.example_translation: 早期航海者苦苦航行了数月才抵达遥远的大洋洲那一带。

phrases.usage: 介词短语，指“居住在对跖地区”，特指澳大拉西亚，书面语
phrases.example: Her family had lived in the antipodes so long that Europe felt abstract.
phrases.example_translation: 她的家人长期居住在对跖地区，欧洲对他们而言反而显得抽象。

phrases.usage: 比喻用法，指“在理念上与…完全对立”，学术评论常见
phrases.example: His austere style was the philosophical antipodes of the ornate school he opposed.
phrases.example_translation: 他朴素简约的风格正是他所反对的那派繁缛学派在理念上的极端对立面。

phrases.usage: 动宾介词搭配，指“与远在对跖之地的地区通商”，经济史语境
phrases.example: The port grew wealthy on ships that traded with the antipodes each season.
phrases.example_translation: 这座港口因每季往返对跖地区的商船而变得富裕起来。

translations.translation: 古文物研究的；古文物的
古文物研究者；[古] 古文物收藏家

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指经营珍本古籍的书商，文化随笔与藏书题材常见
phrases.example: The antiquarian bookseller authenticated a rare first edition discovered in a country estate sale.
phrases.example_translation: 那位古籍书商鉴定了在一场庄园拍卖中发现的一本珍罕初版书。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指古文物研究学会，学术史与地方志语境的固定名称
phrases.example: The local antiquarian society has published a careful edition of the medieval parish records.
phrases.example_translation: 地方古文物学会整理出版了中世纪教区档案的精校版本。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指古物藏品 collection，博物馆与私人藏家叙述常用
phrases.example: His antiquarian collection of antique maps eventually filled an entire wing of the reading room.
phrases.example_translation: 他收藏的古旧地图藏品最终占满了阅览室的一整侧厅堂。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指以文献遗物为对象的古物研究，学术史评价用语
phrases.example: Patient antiquarian research preserved several village charters that later perished in the great fire.
phrases.example_translation: 耐心细致的古物研究保存下来了几份后来毁于大火的村庄宪章。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指古文物方面的兴趣或价值，描述建筑遗存受关注时用
phrases.example: The crumbling gatehouse attracted widespread antiquarian interest after the restoration plans were announced.
phrases.example_translation: 修复方案公布后，这座破败的门楼引起了广泛的古物研究关注。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指关于古迹旧事的掌故学问，带典雅而略古旧的色彩
phrases.example: The guide entertained visitors with charming antiquarian lore about the ruined riverside abbey.
phrases.example_translation: 导游用关于那座河畔修道院废墟的有趣掌故逗得游客们很开心。

phrases.usage: 名词用法，指古物交易者，与 art dealer 结构相同，鉴定语境用
phrases.example: An experienced antiquarian dealer warned the museum about the suspiciously perfect bronze mirror.
phrases.example_translation: 一位经验丰富的古物商人提醒博物馆注意那面完美得可疑的铜镜。

translations.translation: 古文物研究者；古董商人；收集古文物者

phrases.usage: 复数形式的学会称谓，古文物研究家学会，学术机构史文体
phrases.example: The society of antiquaries meets quarterly, debating coins, charters and carved stone crosses.
phrases.example_translation: 这个古文物研究家学会每季度聚会一次，讨论钱币、特许状和石刻十字架。

phrases.usage: 所有格搭配，古文物学者的田野笔记，指珍贵一手资料
phrases.example: A damp cellar saved one antiquary's notebook, and with it the parish records.
phrases.example_translation: 一间潮湿的地下室意外保存了一位古文物研究者的笔记，连同教区记录一并留存。

phrases.usage: 形容词修饰本词，一丝不苟的古文物研究者，人物刻画中性偏褒
phrases.example: The meticulous antiquary copied every inscription twice before dating the ruined chapel.
phrases.example_translation: 这位一丝不苟的古文物研究者把每一处铭文都抄了两遍，才为坍塌的小教堂断代。

phrases.usage: 所有格加 labors，古文物学者的艰辛考据工作，文史笔调
phrases.example: Later scholars built on the antiquary's labors, correcting parish dates by a century.
phrases.example_translation: 后来的学者在这位古文物研究者心血的基础上，把教区的纪年修正了一个世纪。

phrases.usage: 所有格加 craft，指古文物研究的方法与技艺，随笔评论语域
phrases.example: He judged the antiquary's craft by a simple rule: touch the artifact itself.
phrases.example_translation: 他用一条简单的准则评判古文物研究的功夫：亲手触碰器物本身。

translations.translation: 废弃；使…过时；使…具有古旧形式或风格

phrases.usage: 系表结构，表示变得过时，渐进含义，评论文体常用
phrases.example: The software became antiquate within months of the platform's major update.
phrases.example_translation: 该平台大更新后仅数月，这款软件就变得过时了。

phrases.usage: 使役用法，使某事物过时，科技评论高频搭配
phrases.example: The invention of the printing press rendered scribal traditions antiquate overnight.
phrases.example_translation: 印刷术的发明使抄写传统在一夜之间变得过时。

phrases.usage: 不及物用法，逐渐变得陈旧，常与 years 搭配
phrases.example: As decades passed, the legal terminology grew antiquate and increasingly inaccessible.
phrases.example_translation: 随着数十年过去，法律术语逐渐变得陈旧，越来越难以理解。

phrases.usage: 形容词修饰语，古旧风格，艺术和建筑评论常用
phrases.example: The designer deliberately chose an antiquate style for the furniture line.
phrases.example_translation: 设计师故意选择了一种古旧风格来设计这批家具。

phrases.usage: 被动结构，因进步而被淘汰，社科技评论常见
phrases.example: Entire industries have been antiquate by technological progress within a single generation.
phrases.example_translation: 整整几代人时间里，整个产业因技术进步而被淘汰。

phrases.usage: 固定短语，陷入过时做法，含贬义，制度批评常用
phrases.example: The curriculum had fallen into antiquate ways, ignoring decades of pedagogical research.
phrases.example_translation: 课程早已陷入过时的老路，忽视了几十年的教育研究成果。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，过时的制度或机构，社论和学术批评常用
phrases.example: The columnist denounced the monarchy as an antiquate institution out of step with modernity.
phrases.example_translation: 专栏作家抨击君主制是一个与现代脱节的过时制度。

translations.translation: 古老的，年代久远的；过时的，古董的；古风的，古式的
古董，古玩；古风，古希腊和古罗马艺术风格

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指古董家具，收藏与家居语境
phrases.example: The restored antique furniture gave the old townhouse a dignified, lived-in warmth.
phrases.example_translation: 修复过的古董家具给这栋老宅邸增添了一种体面而有人气的美感。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指古董商，描述职业身份
phrases.example: A shrewd antique dealer spotted the forged clock before anyone else in the room.
phrases.example_translation: 一位精明的古董商在屋里其他人之前一眼看穿了那只需伪造的钟。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指收藏古玩，爱好与市场语境
phrases.example: He began to collect antiques as a hobby and slowly turned it into a business.
phrases.example_translation: 他起初把收藏古玩当作爱好，慢慢地把它做成了一门生意。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指古旧地图，历史文献语境
phrases.example: The library displayed a fragile antique map charting the unknown northern coastline.
phrases.example_translation: 图书馆展出了一幅绘制未知北方海岸线的脆弱古旧地图。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指货真价实的古董，区别于赝品
phrases.example: Experts confirmed the carved chest to be a genuine antique from the early eighteenth century.
phrases.example_translation: 专家确认这只雕花木箱是十八世纪早期货真价实的古董。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指古董店，描述场所
phrases.example: She lost whole afternoons browsing dust-shrouded treasures in the cramped antique shop.
phrases.example_translation: 她常在那间狭小拥挤的古董店里逛上一整个下午，细看蒙尘的珍宝。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指古钟，器物描写
phrases.example: The mantel held an antique clock whose hands had not moved for nearly a century.
phrases.example_translation: 壁炉架上摆着一座古钟，它的指针几乎有一个世纪没有走动过了。

translations.translation: 防腐的，抗菌的；非常整洁的

phrases.usage: 医学复合名词，消毒液，护理说明与实验规程的标准搭配
phrases.example: The nurse cleansed the incision with an antiseptic solution before applying the dressing.
phrases.example_translation: 护士先用消毒液清洗切口，然后才敷上纱布。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，涂抹抗菌剂，急救指南与日常健康写作的常用句
phrases.example: After rinsing the scrape, apply a mild antiseptic and cover it with gauze.
phrases.example_translation: 冲洗擦伤后，涂抹温和的抗菌剂并用纱布覆盖。

phrases.usage: 起杀菌作用，描述物质功效时的谓语框架，科普文本常用
phrases.example: Diluted vinegar acts as a mild antiseptic in household cleaning.
phrases.example_translation: 稀释的醋酸在家庭清洁中可起到温和抗菌的作用。

phrases.usage: of 结构，消毒水气味，医院场景书写的标志性意象
phrases.example: The smell of antiseptic hung in the corridor, unsettling every visiting child.
phrases.example_translation: 消毒水的气味弥漫在走廊里，让每个来探病的孩子心神不宁。

phrases.usage: 比喻义形名搭配，冷酷般的精确洁净，文学评论形容文风笔法
phrases.example: The surgeon's memoir impressed critics with its antiseptic precision and dry humor.
phrases.example_translation: 外科医生的回忆录以其冷静精确的笔法和干式幽默赢得了评论界的好评。

phrases.usage: 被动搭配+as，被归类为抗菌剂，药理与法规文本的功能定性
phrases.example: The compound was once classified as an antiseptic before being banned for toxicity.
phrases.example_translation: 这种化合物曾因毒性被禁用之前，一度被归类为抗菌剂。

phrases.usage: 比喻义搭配，不带感情色彩的疏离态度，人物与叙事风格批评用语
phrases.example: She described the disaster with an antiseptic detachment that disturbed the panel.
phrases.example_translation: 她以超然冷漠的口吻描述这场灾难，令评审小组深感不安。

phrases.usage: 医学动宾搭配，指注射或给予抗毒素，临床与疫情报道常用
phrases.example: Doctors administered the antitoxin within hours, and the patient's fever began to fall.
phrases.example_translation: 医生在数小时内就注射了抗毒素，病人的体温开始下降。

phrases.usage: 疾病名加名词的学科搭配，白喉抗毒素，医学史文本高频
phrases.example: Before antibiotics were widely available, diphtheria antitoxin saved countless children during winter epidemics.
phrases.example_translation: 在抗生素普及之前，白喉抗毒素在冬季疫情中救下了无数儿童。

phrases.usage: 后置介词 against 引出所抗之毒，科研写作表述研制对象
phrases.example: Laboratory teams eventually developed an antitoxin against the neurotoxin released by the bacterium.
phrases.example_translation: 实验室团队最终研制出一种对抗该细菌释放神经毒素的抗毒素。

phrases.usage: 免疫学并列对举，讲解毒素与抗体相互作用时的教科书式框架
phrases.example: The lecture explained how toxin and antitoxin interact during a developing immune response.
phrases.example_translation: 讲座讲解了免疫应答发展过程中毒素与抗毒素如何相互作用。

phrases.usage: 量词结构指抗毒素储备，公共卫生与防疫物流语境常用
phrases.example: The port hospital kept a stock of antitoxin in case of shipboard outbreaks.
phrases.example_translation: 港口医院备有抗毒素存货，以防船上暴发疫情。

phrases.usage: 同义复合术语，指含抗毒素的血清，历史医疗文献常见写法
phrases.example: A horse-derived antitoxin serum was the only hope for children in the crowded ward.
phrases.example_translation: 马源抗毒素血清是拥挤病房里患病儿童唯一的希望。

phrases.usage: 后接 of，指严格的直接反义词，词典学与语言学讨论常用
phrases.example: For most learners, big functions as a direct antonym of small long before formal opposites appear.
phrases.example_translation: 对大多数学习者来说，早在接触正式的反义关系之前，big 就已经充当 small 的直接反义词了。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指完全对应的反义词，多用于否定句说明语义不对等
phrases.example: Commentators joked that no word is an exact antonym of viral, since internet culture keeps redefining it.
phrases.example_translation: 评论员们开玩笑说，没有一个词能精确对应 viral 的反义，因为网络文化不断在重新定义它。

phrases.usage: 后接 for 表对象，指某词的反义词，教学与测试语境常见
phrases.example: The worksheet asked for an antonym for diligent, and most children wrote lazy without thinking about nuance.
phrases.example_translation: 练习单要求写出 diligent 的反义词，多数孩子不假思索地写下了 lazy。

phrases.usage: 最高级搭配，指最接近的反义词，用于语义不完全对称时的措辞
phrases.example: The editor chose candid as the nearest antonym to the evasive phrasing in the official statement.
phrases.example_translation: 编辑选了 candid，作为官方声明中那套闪躲措辞最接近的反义表达。

phrases.usage: 系表句式，指两词起反义作用，语言学分析用语
phrases.example: Hot and cold function as antonyms in everyday temperature talk but merge into one scale in physics.
phrases.example_translation: hot 和 cold 在日常谈论温度时构成反义，但在物理学中却归于同一标尺。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指词典或词条中列反义词，辞书编写语境
phrases.example: A good thesaurus does more than list antonyms beside synonyms; it flags where the opposition breaks down.
phrases.example_translation: 一部好的同义词词典不只是在同义词旁列出反义词，还会标明反义关系在何处失效。

translations.translation: 焦虑的；担忧的；渴望的；急切的

phrases.usage: 后接about加担忧对象，指为某事焦虑，最常用的介词搭配
phrases.example: Parents grew anxious about the delayed flight, though the airline offered no explanation.
phrases.example_translation: 尽管航空公司未作任何解释，父母们仍为延误的航班渐渐焦虑起来。

phrases.usage: 后接for加所盼之事，表渴望而非担忧，书面语体
phrases.example: The delegation was anxious for a resolution before the trading deadline expired.
phrases.example_translation: 代表团迫切希望在交易截止期限到来之前达成解决方案。

phrases.usage: 后接动词不定式，表示急切想做某事，口语与书面皆常用
phrases.example: She was anxious to finish the manuscript before her visiting fellowship ended in June.
phrases.example_translation: 她急切想在六月访问研究员任期结束前完成这部书稿。

phrases.usage: 副词visibly修饰，指焦虑之情外露可见，人物描写常用
phrases.example: The witness appeared visibly anxious under the prosecutor's quiet, patient questioning about the timeline.
phrases.example_translation: 在律师对时间线沉静而耐心的讯问下，证人显得明显焦虑。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，交换焦虑的眼神，叙事中表现集体不安
phrases.example: The travellers exchanged anxious glances as the cabin lights flickered twice in turn.
phrases.example_translation: 当机舱灯光先后闪烁两次时，旅客们不安地交换了眼色。

phrases.usage: 系表结构，指感到焦虑，心理健康讨论的基础表述
phrases.example: Many students feel anxious in the week before examinations, even when thoroughly prepared.
phrases.example_translation: 许多学生在考试前一周会感到焦虑，即便已经准备充分。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指煎熬般的等待，结果揭晓语境惯用
phrases.example: The applicants endured an anxious wait of six weeks before the scholarship list appeared.
phrases.example_translation: 申请者们忍受了六周焦灼的等待，奖学金名单才公布出来。

translations.translation: 冷漠的；无动于衷的，缺乏兴趣的

phrases.usage: 副词修饰形容词，指政治上冷漠，评论高频
phrases.example: A generation raised on cable news proved unexpectedly politically apathetic at the ballot box.
phrases.example_translation: 在有线电视新闻陪伴下成长的一代，在投票箱前却出人意料地在政治上无动于衷。

phrases.usage: 系表搭配，指外表显得无动于衷，心理学文本常见
phrases.example: The patients appeared apathetic yet reported rich inner lives to the visiting psychologist.
phrases.example_translation: 病人们看似无动于衷，却向来访的心理医生诉说了丰富的内心世界。

phrases.usage: 后接 about + 名词，指对某事毫无兴趣
phrases.example: The students were apathetic about the school board election and barely bothered to register.
phrases.example_translation: 学生们对校董会选举漠不关心，甚至连登记都懒得做。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指冷漠的选民群体，政治学常见
phrases.example: The candidate wagered that an apathetic electorate would ignore the scandal entirely.
phrases.example_translation: 那位候选人赌冷漠的选民会完全无视这桩丑闻。

phrases.usage: 表示已经变得冷淡，暗示从前并非如此
phrases.example: Voters had grown apathetic after a decade of broken campaign promises.
phrases.example_translation: 经历十年的竞选空许之后，选民们已变得心灰意冷。

phrases.usage: 与近义形容词并列，刻画无精打采的精神状态
phrases.example: The heat left the crowd apathetic and listless through the long afternoon.
phrases.example_translation: 漫长的午后酷暑让人群无精打采、毫无生气。

translations.translation: 冷漠，无兴趣，漠不关心；无感情

phrases.usage: 名名搭配，政治冷漠，社科与选举报道核心词组
phrases.example: The record abstention rate reflected a deep political apathy among urban voters under thirty.
phrases.example_translation: 创纪录的弃权率反映出三十岁以下城市选民深层的政治冷漠。

phrases.usage: 名词 + toward，对……的冷漠，toward 引出对象
phrases.example: His apathy toward the committee's work frustrated colleagues who had drafted the charter.
phrases.example_translation: 他对委员会工作的漠不关心，让起草章程的同事们倍感挫败。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，滋生冷漠，制度批评常用句式
phrases.example: Rules that change without notice breed apathy, because people stop believing action matters.
phrases.example_translation: 朝令夕改的规则会滋生冷漠，因为人们不再相信行动有意义。

phrases.usage: sheer + 抽象名词，纯粹的、十足的冷漠，强调语
phrases.example: The archive decayed not through malice but through sheer apathy over several quiet decades.
phrases.example_translation: 档案室的衰败并非出于恶意，而是整整几十个太平年月里十足的冷漠。

phrases.usage: 近义连用，冷漠与惰性，政论固定对子
phrases.example: Apathy and inertia kept the town from replacing the bridge for twenty years.
phrases.example_translation: 冷漠和惰性让这座小镇二十年都没有更换那座桥。

phrases.usage: 动宾短语，摆脱麻木状态，呼吁性文体常见
phrases.example: The documentary aimed to shake off public apathy about the drying of the lake.
phrases.example_translation: 这部纪录片旨在唤起公众摆脱对湖泊干涸的麻木。

phrases.usage: 隐喻搭配，冷漠的氛围/风气，社论高频
phrases.example: A climate of apathy settled over the office after the layoffs were announced.
phrases.example_translation: 裁员名单公布之后，一种冷漠的气氛笼罩了整个办公室。

translations.translation: 孔，穴；（照相机，望远镜等的）光圈，孔径；缝隙

phrases.usage: 摄影术语搭配，大光圈，虚化背景并增加进光量
phrases.example: A wide aperture renders the background soft and keeps the subject sharp.
phrases.example_translation: 大光圈能把背景柔化，同时让主体保持清晰。

phrases.usage: 摄影术语搭配，小光圈，增大景深，风光摄影常用
phrases.example: A narrow aperture keeps the whole landscape acceptably sharp from foreground to ridge.
phrases.example_translation: 小光圈能让从前景到山脊的整幅画面都清晰可用。

phrases.usage: 相机模式术语，光圈优先，操作说明与评测文体
phrases.example: Wildlife photographers often rely on aperture priority in dim forest light at dawn.
phrases.example_translation: 拍野生动物的摄影师常在黎明昏暗的林光里使用光圈优先模式。

phrases.usage: 动词加宾语，设定光圈值，技术操作叙述
phrases.example: Before shooting he learned to set the aperture for each light condition.
phrases.example_translation: 开拍之前，他学会了按不同光照条件设定光圈。

phrases.usage: 镜头规格术语，最大光圈，衡量器材性能
phrases.example: This lens opens to a maximum aperture of f/2.8, useful indoors without flash.
phrases.example_translation: 这只镜头的最大光圈可达 f/2.8，室内不补光也够用。

phrases.usage: 属格结构，望远镜口径，天文科普文本
phrases.example: The telescope's aperture limits how faint a star it can detect from Earth.
phrases.example_translation: 这台望远镜的口径决定了它从地球能探测到多暗弱的恒星。

phrases.phrase: a narrow aperture in the wall
phrases.usage: 本义用法，墙上狭小的孔洞，建筑与文学描写
phrases.example: Light entered through a narrow aperture high in the tower wall above the gate.
phrases.example_translation: 光线从门洞上方塔壁高处的一道狭小孔洞里透了进来。

phrases.usage: 生态学术语，指食物链顶端无天敌的捕食者，环保题材高频
phrases.example: After their return, wolves acted as an apex predator that reshaped the valley's deer herd.
phrases.example_translation: 重新引入后，狼作为顶级捕食者重塑了山谷中的鹿群。

phrases.usage: 后接 career、power 等名词，指处于权力或事业的巅峰，书面语
phrases.example: At the apex of her career she abandoned fame for quiet field research.
phrases.example_translation: 在事业的巅峰期，她舍弃声名，转而投身安静的田野研究。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指达到最高点，多用于紧张局势或发展的隐喻
phrases.example: Tensions between the two departments reached an apex before the board intervened.
phrases.example_translation: 两部门的紧张关系在董事会介入之前达到了顶点。

phrases.usage: 名词加 of 结构，指某事物的顶峰或最高成就，评论常用
phrases.example: Many visitors consider the cathedral the apex of medieval engineering in this region.
phrases.example_translation: 许多游客认为这座大教堂是本地区中世纪工程的巅峰。

phrases.usage: 物主代词加介词短语，指在最鼎盛或最要紧的时刻，历史文体常见
phrases.example: The empire at its apex governed distant lands stretching across three separate continents.
phrases.example_translation: 处于鼎盛期的帝国统治着横跨三大洲的遥远土地。

phrases.usage: 几何术语，指三角形两腰相交的顶点，理科说明文体
phrases.example: The geometry software measured the angle formed at the apex of the triangle.
phrases.example_translation: 几何软件测量了三角形顶点处所成的角。

phrases.usage: 形容词加名词，pithy 强调言简意赅，书评与散文中最典型的修饰搭配
phrases.example: The essay closes with a pithy aphorism that readers still quote decades later.
phrases.example_translation: 这篇散文以一条精警的格言收尾，数十年后读者仍在引用。

phrases.usage: 介词 into 表转化结果，指把长篇论述浓缩为警句，书面语
phrases.example: The philosopher compressed a decade of argument into one memorable aphorism for his final book.
phrases.example_translation: 这位哲学家把十年的论辩浓缩成一句令人难忘的格言，放进他的遗著。

phrases.usage: 后接 about 引出话题，格言警句类文本的内容限定结构
phrases.example: La Rochefoucauld wrote a sharp aphorism about vanity that still reads as contemporary observation.
phrases.example_translation: 拉罗什富科写下一条关于虚荣的犀利格言，今天读来仍像对当下的观察。

phrases.usage: 被动加 as 表身份转换，指普通话语被后人当作格言引用
phrases.example: Her casual remark about patience was later quoted as an aphorism in leadership seminars.
phrases.example_translation: 她关于耐心的一句随口之言，后来在领导力研讨会上被当作格言引用。

phrases.usage: of 结构复数形式，指以格言为文体的作者，文学评论用语
phrases.example: As a careful writer of aphorisms, Lichtenberg kept notebooks filled with compressed observations.
phrases.example_translation: 作为一位严谨的格言作家，利希滕贝格留下了写满凝练观察的笔记本。

phrases.usage: 过去分词修饰，指结集出版的格言全集，学术书目常见表达
phrases.example: The class read the collected aphorisms of Baltasar Gracian alongside their modern translations.
phrases.example_translation: 全班阅读了格拉西安的格言全集，并对照其现代译本。

phrases.usage: 动词加 with 结构，指演讲或文章以格言开篇，课堂与评论语境
phrases.example: The lecturer opened with an aphorism about uncertainty and then asked us to challenge it.
phrases.example_translation: 讲师以一条关于不确定性的格言开场，随后要求我们反驳它。

phrases.usage: 数词加 apiece 表单价，指每个或每人十美元，分账语境常用
phrases.example: Old atlases sold for ten dollars apiece at the library's yearly discard sale.
phrases.example_translation: 旧地图集在图书馆一年一度的剔旧处理中每册十美元售出。

phrases.usage: 名词加 apiece，指每人一份，颁发或分发语境常用
phrases.example: The principal handed every volunteer a certificate apiece during the closing assembly.
phrases.example_translation: 校长在闭幕式上给每位志愿者都发了一张证书。

phrases.usage: 时间量加 apiece，指每人分配十五分钟，课堂与议事日程语境
phrases.example: Each debater received fifteen minutes apiece, with no interruptions allowed from the floor.
phrases.example_translation: 每位辩手各有十五分钟，台下不得插话打断。

phrases.usage: 名词加 apiece，指各得均等一份，遗产或收益分配语境
phrases.example: The partners settled quietly on an equal share apiece after the aging firm dissolved.
phrases.example_translation: 这家老字号散伙后，合伙人悄然商定每人分得均等的一份。

phrases.usage: 分数加 apiece，指各得二十分，评分与竞赛语境常见
phrases.example: Judges awarded the two finalists twenty points apiece, leaving the outcome entirely undecided.
phrases.example_translation: 评委给两位入围者各打二十分，胜负依然悬而未决。

phrases.usage: 时间量加 apiece，指每人各一小时，临床与教学排程语境
phrases.example: The therapist scheduled an hour apiece for the three students recovering from the accident.
phrases.example_translation: 治疗师为三名从事故中康复的学生各安排了一小时。

phrases.usage: apiece 前置修饰继承份额，指遗产中各得一份，法律文书语体
phrases.example: The will named three grandchildren and recorded for each of them fifty acres apiece in the estate.
phrases.example_translation: 遗嘱提及三名孙辈，并载明每人在遗产中各得五十英亩。

translations.translation: 位于远地点；位于最高点

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，后接事业或权力，表示达到巅峰，书面语
phrases.example: The dynasty reached the apogee of its power under a capable young empress.
phrases.example_translation: 这个王朝在一位干练的年轻女皇后统治下达到了权力的巅峰。

phrases.usage: 名词短语，指某事物最兴盛或最辉煌的阶段，评论文常用
phrases.example: Many critics regard that glittering decade as the apogee of impressionist painting.
phrases.example_translation: 许多评论家认为那光彩夺目的十年是印象派绘画的巅峰。

phrases.usage: 介词短语，表示处于……鼎盛时期，多用于历史叙述
phrases.example: At the apogee of the Roman peace, trade routes stretched into northern Europe.
phrases.example_translation: 在罗马和平的鼎盛时期，贸易路线一直延伸到北欧。

phrases.usage: 轨道术语对举，借指从最高点跌至最低点，比喻用法
phrases.example: The novelist traces a hero's fortunes from apogee to perigee across three wars.
phrases.example_translation: 小说家跨越三场战争描写了主人公从巅峰到谷底的命运。

phrases.usage: 所有格搭配，指职业生涯顶点，人物传记与回顾常用
phrases.example: The prize marked the apogee of a career spent documenting vanishing dialects.
phrases.example_translation: 这个奖项标志着一段致力于记录濒危方言的职业生涯的顶点。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指越过鼎盛期开始衰落，历史与艺术评论用
phrases.example: Baroque architecture in the colony passed its apogee long before the great earthquake.
phrases.example_translation: 殖民地的巴洛克建筑早在大地震之前就已越过鼎盛期。

translations.translation: 道歉；谢罪；辩护；勉强的替代物

phrases.usage: 动词加名词，致歉道歉，正式而得体的认错表达
phrases.example: The company offered a public apology after the leak contaminated three reservoirs.
phrases.example_translation: 在泄漏污染了三座水库之后，公司发表了公开道歉。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，要求道歉，常见于维权、外交或舆论对峙语境
phrases.example: Several nations demanded an apology after the survey drone crossed their border.
phrases.example_translation: 在勘测无人机越境之后，数国要求对方道歉。

phrases.usage: 固定介词短语，作为道歉之意，引出具体的补救姿态
phrases.example: By way of apology he replanted the hedge he had accidentally bulldozed.
phrases.example_translation: 作为道歉，他重新栽上了自己不慎推倒的树篱。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，迟来的道歉，暗示道歉已迟、弥补有限
phrases.example: The belated apology arrived decades after the villagers lost their farmland to the dam.
phrases.example_translation: 这份迟来的道歉到达时，村民失去耕地建坝已过去数十年。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，不情不愿的道歉，贬义色彩，指勉强而无诚意
phrases.example: He muttered a grudging apology, already calculating how quickly to leave the room.
phrases.example_translation: 他嘟囔着挤出几句不情愿的道歉，心里盘算着如何尽快离场。

phrases.usage: 习语用法，聊胜于无的替代物，指勉强凑数的拙劣代用品，贬义
phrases.example: That leaking shed was a poor apology for the laboratory the budget promised.
phrases.example_translation: 那间漏雨的小棚子，不过是对预算所承诺实验室的寒酸替代。

phrases.usage: apology取辩护义，为某种受质疑立场撰文申辩，文史学术语境
phrases.example: The philosopher wrote a lengthy apology for his unpopular views on private property.
phrases.example_translation: 这位哲学家为其关于私有财产的招人反感的观点写了一篇长篇申辩。

phrases.usage: 动词搭配，指施行变节或背教行为，书面语
phrases.example: The old chronicle accused him of committing apostasy after he abandoned the oath.
phrases.example_translation: 古老的编年史指责他在背弃誓言后行变节之举。

phrases.usage: 法律或宗教指控用语，指被控背教
phrases.example: In the strict colony, a charge of apostasy could bring the harshest punishment.
phrases.example_translation: 在严苛的殖民地，被控背教会招致最严厉的惩罚。

phrases.usage: 后接 from，指脱离某种信仰或事业
phrases.example: His quiet apostasy from the party shocked the colleagues who had always trusted him.
phrases.example_translation: 他悄悄脱离该政党，令一直信任他的同事震惊。

phrases.usage: 定名搭配，指政治变节，社科语境
phrases.example: Her political apostasy marked the sudden end of a long and bitter factional quarrel.
phrases.example_translation: 她的政治变节标志着一场漫长痛苦的派系之争突然结束。

phrases.usage: 后接 of，指指控某人背教
phrases.example: Rival leaders openly accused the young reformer of secret apostasy from their shared principles.
phrases.example_translation: 敌对领袖公开指责这位年轻改革者悄悄背弃了共同的原则。

phrases.usage: 并列名词，史述中背教常与流亡相连
phrases.example: The careful historian linked his later apostasy and exile to a single failed rebellion.
phrases.example_translation: 这位细致的史家把他后来的变节与流亡归因于一次失败的叛乱。

phrases.usage: 后接 from + 信仰或团体，名词与形容词皆可，史学与宗教文本高频
phrases.example: The medieval chronicler branded him an apostate from the order's founding ideals.
phrases.example_translation: 这位中世纪编年史家指责他是背离修会初创理想的变节者。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，史学语境，指背弃国教或誓言的君主
phrases.example: The apostate prince reopened the cathedral as a warehouse, shocking his former allies.
phrases.example_translation: 那位变节的亲王把大教堂改作仓库，令昔日盟友大为震惊。

phrases.usage: 被动多见 be denounced as，指控他人背教，语气严厉，含宗教裁判色彩
phrases.example: Reformers feared being denounced as apostates once the inquisition resumed its inquiries.
phrases.example_translation: 宗教裁判所重启调查后，改革派担心被指为叛教者。

phrases.usage: 形名修饰作家或学者，指背弃早年信念者，思想史评论常用
phrases.example: The essay reconsidered the charge that the novelist had become an apostate writer.
phrases.example_translation: 这篇文章重新审视了那位小说家已成变节作家的指责。

phrases.usage: 系表结构，turn 后零冠词，强调身份转变的瞬间，叙事语体
phrases.example: Several senior monks turned apostate during the controversy and married in the next decade.
phrases.example_translation: 争论期间数名资深修士变节，并在随后的十年里成家。

phrases.usage: 量词搭配，指一小群脱离信仰者，复数形式常见于秘密结社叙述
phrases.example: A small circle of apostates met weekly to read the banned pamphlets aloud.
phrases.example_translation: 一小圈变节者每周聚会，朗读那些被查禁的小册子。

phrases.usage: 历史叙事搭配，指乡村药剂师，用于旧时职业与场景描写
phrases.example: The village apothecary kept jars of dried herbs behind the wooden counter.
phrases.example_translation: 村里的药剂师在木柜台后存放着几罐干草药。

phrases.usage: 名词修饰名词，指旧式药店，历史与建筑类文本常用
phrases.example: An old apothecary shop still stands near the center of the market square.
phrases.example_translation: 一家古老的药材铺至今仍坐落在集市广场的中心附近。

phrases.usage: 指跟随药剂师学徒的制度，后接with加雇主，史学文体
phrases.example: He served a long apprenticeship with a London apothecary before opening his own practice.
phrases.example_translation: 他在伦敦一位药剂师手底下当了多年学徒，才自立门户。

phrases.usage: 主谓宾结构，prepared后接药剂类名词，叙事中固定用法
phrases.example: In the winter, the apothecary prepared a bitter tonic for sleepless travellers.
phrases.example_translation: 冬天里，药剂师为失眠的旅人配制一种苦味补药。

phrases.usage: 指配药用的精密砝码，物品搭配，博物馆与器物描写常见
phrases.example: Brass apothecary weights lined the shallow drawers upstairs in the physician's study.
phrases.example_translation: 铜制药剂砝码排满楼上医生书房里那些浅抽屉。

phrases.usage: 被动或系表结构，指接受药剂师训练，谈职业史时常用
phrases.example: She trained as an apothecary at a time when few women held licences.
phrases.example_translation: 她在女性极少获得执照的年代接受了药剂师训练。

translations.translation: 神化；崇拜，颂扬；尊奉为神

phrases.usage: 后接 of，某事物的巅峰或神化，核心介词结构
phrases.example: Tour guides hailed the soaring cathedral as the apotheosis of centuries of medieval stonework.
phrases.example_translation: 导游们盛赞这座高耸的大教堂是中世纪数百年石构工艺的极致。

phrases.usage: serve as 框架，充当最高升华，乐评艺评专用
phrases.example: The final movement serves as an apotheosis of the symphony's quiet opening theme.
phrases.example_translation: 末乐章将交响曲开头的静谧主题升华到了顶点。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，标志某流派的登峰造极，史论笔调
phrases.example: The vast 1925 exposition is often said to mark the apotheosis of the Art Deco movement.
phrases.example_translation: 人们常认为盛大的1925年博览会标志着装饰艺术运动的巅峰。

phrases.usage: depict 加名词，描绘美德升华为神，宗教艺术分析语域
phrases.example: The baroque allegory depicts the apotheosis of virtue rising triumphantly above every courtly vice.
phrases.example_translation: 这幅巴洛克寓意画描绘美德凌驾于宫廷诸恶之上的神化场景。

phrases.usage: 所有格修饰，英雄被奉若神明，神话学与影评用语
phrases.example: The film's long closing scene wordlessly depicts the exhausted firefighter's gradual apotheosis into myth.
phrases.example_translation: 影片冗长的结尾镜头无声地展现疲惫消防员逐渐被神化的过程。

phrases.usage: grand 修饰，盛大的神化场面，描写典礼景观
phrases.example: The coronation's pageantry formed what chroniclers called a grand apotheosis of monarchy.
phrases.example_translation: 加冕典礼的盛大排场被编年史家称为王权的神化盛典。

translations.translation: 使惊骇， 使大吃一惊， 使恐怖

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指令公众震惊，新闻与评论语体常用
phrases.example: The scale of the pollution scandal began to appall the public once the internal memos were published.
phrases.example_translation: 内部备忘录公布后，这场污染丑闻的规模开始令公众震惊。

phrases.usage: 被动加 by 引出对象，指对某事深感震惊，语气强烈
phrases.example: The reviewers were appalled by the carelessness of the citation practice, though the errors themselves were minor.
phrases.example_translation: 尽管错误本身细小，评审者仍对引文处理的马虎程度感到震惊。

phrases.usage: 被动加 at 后接所见情形，强调当场受到的冲击
phrases.example: She was appalled at how quickly the meeting abandoned the question it had been convened to answer.
phrases.example_translation: 会议如此迅速地抛开其本要回答的问题，令她大为惊骇。

phrases.usage: 后接让步宾语，指连老手都为之咋舌，语气夸张
phrases.example: The figure for unreported cases appalled even the most cynical analysts seated on the committee.
phrases.example_translation: 未报告病例的数字，即便让委员会里最愤世嫉俗的分析人士也瞠目结舌。

phrases.usage: 形名结构，指惊骇之下的沉默，小说与报道渲染气氛
phrases.example: An appalled silence followed the verdict, broken only by the sound of the clerk stacking papers.
phrases.example_translation: 判决之后是一片惊骇的沉默，唯有书记官叠放纸张的声音打破它。

phrases.usage: 并列动词，指既令人震动又令人胆寒，常见于正式谴责
phrases.example: The report was written to shock and appall the legislature into funding a permanent inspectorate.
phrases.example_translation: 这份报告的目的是震惊并震慑立法机关，促其为常设监察机构拨款。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指骇人的恶劣条件，新闻与调查报告高频
phrases.example: State inspectors carefully documented the appalling conditions inside the aging textile factory.
phrases.example_translation: 州检查员仔细记录了这座老旧纺织厂内骇人的恶劣条件。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配后接 of 或 about，指惊人的无知，评论文体含强烈贬义
phrases.example: The national public health report criticized appalling ignorance about basic childhood nutrition.
phrases.example_translation: 这份全国公共卫生报告批评了人们对儿童基础营养惊人的无知。

phrases.usage: 副形搭配，utterly 强化程度，口语与评论均常用，纯贬义
phrases.example: The service at the seaside hotel was utterly appalling despite the unusually high price.
phrases.example_translation: 尽管价格异常高昂，这家海滨酒店的服务仍糟得令人发指。

phrases.usage: appalling 加名词 lack 后接 of，指惊人的匮乏，社论文体常用
phrases.example: Few officials noted the appalling lack of clean water in the rural district.
phrases.example_translation: 很少有官员注意到这个乡村地区清洁水源的惊人匮乏。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指惊人的速度，多用于描述负面趋势的加剧
phrases.example: Coastal wetlands are disappearing at an appalling speed as development reaches the marshes.
phrases.example_translation: 随着开发逼近沼泽，沿海湿地正以惊人的速度消失。

phrases.usage: find 加宾语加形容词句式，指认为某事令人震惊，评价主观感受
phrases.example: Many loyal readers found the novel's final chapter frankly appalling in its cruelty.
phrases.example_translation: 许多忠实读者坦言，这部小说的最后一章因其残酷而令人震惊。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指实验装置，科研与教学语境最典型
phrases.example: The undergraduate teaching laboratory had inherited an experimental apparatus that no manual described.
phrases.example_translation: 本科教学实验室继承了一套没有任何说明书介绍的实验装置。

phrases.usage: 政治学术语，指国家机器，后接 of 表所属
phrases.example: Weber's essay links modern law to the impersonal apparatus of the state.
phrases.example_translation: 韦伯的论文把现代法律与非人格化的国家机器联系起来。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指官僚机构体系，含滞重僵化之意
phrases.example: The budget reform stalled inside a vast bureaucratic apparatus that rewarded careful delay.
phrases.example_translation: 预算改革卡在了庞大的官僚体系内部，那里恰恰奖励蓄意的拖延。

phrases.usage: 后接 for + 名词，指实现某种功能的构造，科技文体
phrases.example: In insect anatomy, the stinger functions as an apparatus for defense rather than attack.
phrases.example_translation: 在昆虫解剖学中，螫针是一种用于防卫而非攻击的构造。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指拆装仪器，实验收尾与档案整理场景
phrases.example: Two graduate students dismantled the old apparatus and catalogued every valve and tube.
phrases.example_translation: 两名研究生拆下旧装置，把每个阀门和导管都编目登记。

phrases.usage: 名词修饰，指宣传机器，历史与媒体研究常用
phrases.example: The truth commission documented how the wartime propaganda apparatus had manufactured public consent.
phrases.example_translation: 真相委员会记录了战时宣传机器如何制造出公众的同意。

phrases.usage: 后接依据来源，表示从某处可见显然，学术与日常皆高频
phrases.example: The flaw was apparent from the first page of the otherwise careful report.
phrases.example_translation: 这份其他方面颇为严谨的报告，第一页就显露出那个缺陷。

phrases.usage: 系表变化结构，指逐渐变得明显，叙述发现过程常用
phrases.example: It soon became apparent that the two geologists had reached opposite conclusions.
phrases.example_translation: 很快就能看出，这两位地质学家得出了相反的结论。

phrases.usage: 固定表达，指未见明显尝试，法律与新闻描述行为常用
phrases.example: The driver made no apparent attempt to brake in the seconds before the collision.
phrases.example_translation: 碰撞前的几秒内，司机没有任何明显的刹车尝试。

phrases.usage: 固定短语，指就表面目的而言，暗示实际情况或有出入
phrases.example: To all apparent purposes the treaty had ended the dispute, yet tensions lingered.
phrases.example_translation: 表面上这条约似乎结束了争端，但紧张情绪仍挥之不去。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指表面上的矛盾，议论文分析数据与观点常用
phrases.example: The essay resolves an apparent contradiction between the growth records and the harvest yields.
phrases.example_translation: 这篇文章厘清了生长记录与产量数据之间表面上的矛盾。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指表面原因，强调未必是真正根由，学术审慎表述
phrases.example: Investigators listed flooding as the apparent cause before examining the faulty wiring.
phrases.example_translation: 调查人员在检查故障线路之前，先把洪水列为表面上的起因。

phrases.usage: 系动词加形容词，表示看似明显，常与否定或保留连用
phrases.example: No immediate motive seemed apparent to the small board reviewing the sudden resignation.
phrases.example_translation: 对于审查这份突然辞呈的小型委员会来说，看不出任何直接的动机。

phrases.usage: 限定从句结构，指就目前可见而言，学术谨慎声明常用
phrases.example: As far as is apparent, the species has not been observed outside this valley.
phrases.example_translation: 就目前所见的情况来看，这个物种尚未在这条河谷之外被观察到。

translations.translation: 幽灵；幻影；鬼怪；离奇出现的东西

phrases.usage: apparition of加人或物，指幽灵般的突然出现，书面叙述用
phrases.example: The apparition of a white figure at the window unsettled the entire household.
phrases.example_translation: 窗边出现一个白色身影，令全家人心神不宁。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，文学与志怪叙事中描写幽灵的标准说法
phrases.example: Readers long dismissed the ghostly apparition as a metaphor for the hero's guilt.
phrases.example_translation: 读者长期以来把那个幽灵般的身影视为主人公负罪感的隐喻。

phrases.usage: like引导比喻结构，指转瞬消失得无影无踪
phrases.example: The ferryman vanished like an apparition once the last coin changed hands.
phrases.example_translation: 最后一枚硬币一交接，摆渡人便如幻影般消失了。

phrases.usage: conjure up加apparition，指凭想象或巫术召出幻影，含虚构意味
phrases.example: Old houses seem to conjure up an apparition out of drafts, creaks and shadow.
phrases.example_translation: 老房子似乎总能借穿堂风、木板吱响和阴影召出一个幻影。

phrases.usage: pale修饰，后接of，指某人憔悴失色的残影，人物描写用
phrases.example: He returned from exile a pale apparition of the confident young mayor.
phrases.example_translation: 流放归来的他形容枯槁，全无当年那位自信年轻市长的模样。

phrases.usage: dismiss加宾语加as，指把所见斥为幻觉，论辩与叙事通用
phrases.example: In the end, the committee dismissed the testimony as an apparition of wishful thinking.
phrases.example_translation: 最终委员会驳回了这份证词，认为它不过是一厢情愿的幻象。

phrases.usage: loom加like比喻，指庞然之物在雾光中如幽灵般显现
phrases.example: The unfinished tower loomed like an apparition above the fogbound valley for a decade.
phrases.example_translation: 十年间，那座未完工的塔楼总在雾锁的山谷上空幽灵般耸立。

translations.translation: 呼吁，恳求；上诉；诉诸，求助；有吸引力，迎合爱好；（体育比赛中）诉诸裁判
呼吁，请求；吸引力，感染力；上诉；诉诸裁判

phrases.usage: 不及物用法后接 to，表示对某人有吸引力，日常与学术文体通用
phrases.example: The popular lecture series appeals to students from fields far outside the host department.
phrases.example_translation: 这系列广受欢迎的讲座吸引着远超主办院系范围的其他专业的学生。

phrases.usage: 法律及物用法，上诉请求撤销定罪，后常接理由状语
phrases.example: His attorneys intend to appeal the conviction, citing irregular jury instructions at trial.
phrases.example_translation: 他的律师打算对定罪提出上诉，援引审判中程序不当的陪审团指示。

phrases.usage: 名词搭配 lose，指新鲜感或吸引力消退，叙述性文体常用
phrases.example: After one rainy week, the remote island lost much of its appeal for the tourists.
phrases.example_translation: 下了一个星期的雨之后，这座偏远小岛对游客的吸引力大减。

phrases.usage: 形容词 broad 修饰名词 appeal，指受众面广的吸引力，策展与宣传语境
phrases.example: The museum redesigned its galleries to give the permanent collection broad and lasting appeal.
phrases.example_translation: 博物馆重新设计了展厅，让常设藏品具备广泛而持久的吸引力。

phrases.usage: 逻辑学固定说法，情感诉求，也指诉诸情感谬误，议论文常见
phrases.example: The debater was warned for relying on appeal to emotion rather than documented evidence.
phrases.example_translation: 那位辩论者因依赖情感诉求而非有据可查的证据而受到警告。

phrases.usage: make an appeal 后接 for 引出请求内容，指正式呼吁、募捐
phrases.example: The librarian made an urgent appeal for donations to rebuild the flooded archive.
phrases.example_translation: 图书管理员发出紧急呼吁，请求捐款重建被水淹的档案室。

phrases.usage: irresistible 修饰 appeal，指难以抗拒的魅力，文体略带文学性
phrases.example: Brass bands held an almost irresistible appeal for adolescents seeking loud public fun.
phrases.example_translation: 对于追求热闹的公共乐趣的青少年来说，铜管乐队有着几乎不可抗拒的吸引力。

phrases.usage: 法条与赛事规则通用，上诉或申诉的权利，后常接 against
phrases.example: Athletes retain a right of appeal against judges' decisions within thirty minutes.
phrases.example_translation: 运动员保留在三十分钟内对裁判裁决提出申诉的权利。

translations.translation: 使平息；使满足；使和缓；对…让步
平息； 安抚， 缓和； 满足

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指平息公众怒火，政府公关与社会运动语境
phrases.example: The mayor released the audit records hoping to appease public anger over the stalled project.
phrases.example_translation: 市长公布审计记录，指望平息公众对停摆项目的怒火。

phrases.usage: refuse 加不定式结构，指拒绝绥靖让步，政治立场叙述常用
phrases.example: The senator refused to appease the loudest faction, insisting the committee deliberate in public.
phrases.example_translation: 那位参议员拒绝向嗓门最大的派系让步，坚持委员会公开议事。

phrases.usage: 动宾历史搭配，指对侵略者让步，特指三十年代失败政策的讨论
phrases.example: Historians still debate whether conceding the border region would have appeased an aggressor or emboldened one.
phrases.example_translation: 历史学家仍在争论：割让边境地区究竟是安抚了侵略者，还是使其更加胆大妄为。

phrases.usage: 后接 with 引出手段，指以让步求平息，社论常用结构
phrases.example: The board tried to appease the striking workers with concessions that satisfied no one fully.
phrases.example_translation: 董事会试图以让步安抚罢工工人，却谁也没能真正满足。

phrases.usage: rather than 对比框架，指只求安抚而不思变革，贬义政策批评
phrases.example: Critics accused the government of appeasing rather than reforming the failing housing system.
phrases.example_translation: 批评者指责政府对濒临失败的住房制度只求安抚而不思改革。

phrases.usage: 泛称宾语的动宾搭配，指取悦所有批评者，多用于否定句与反问
phrases.example: The director decided she could not appease every critic and returned to her original edit.
phrases.example_translation: 导演认定自己无法讨好每一位批评者，于是回到最初的剪辑版本。

phrases.usage: 法律搭配，指上级法院受理上诉的管辖权，常见于司法与宪政文本
phrases.example: The Supreme Court exercised appellate jurisdiction only after every state remedy had failed.
phrases.example_translation: 只有在穷尽所有州级救济之后，最高法院才行使上诉管辖权。

phrases.usage: 名词修饰搭配，指受理上诉的法院，司法层级论述中的标准用语
phrases.example: The appellate court reversed the verdict, finding serious errors in the trial record.
phrases.example_translation: 上诉法院推翻了原判，认定审判记录中存在严重错误。

phrases.usage: 指上级法院复审下级裁判，多作宾语或主语，正式法律语体
phrases.example: Most administrative decisions receive only limited appellate review, which constrains their practical impact.
phrases.example_translation: 大多数行政决定只接受有限的上诉审查，这限制了它们的实际影响。

phrases.usage: 动宾结构，指法院行使上诉审判权，正式法律文书措辞
phrases.example: Federal courts rarely exercise appellate jurisdiction over questions that states have already settled.
phrases.example_translation: 联邦法院很少对州内已有定论的问题行使上诉管辖权。

phrases.usage: 固定对举表达，对比初审与上诉两种管辖权，常见于宪法机构介绍
phrases.example: The Constitution distinguishes the Court's original and appellate jurisdiction with careful precision.
phrases.example_translation: 宪法以审慎的精确区分了最高法院的初审管辖权与上诉管辖权。

phrases.usage: 名词修饰，指审理上诉案件的法官，常用于评论司法人事
phrases.example: An experienced appellate judge weighed the competing precedents before delivering a narrow ruling.
phrases.example_translation: 一位经验丰富的上诉法官权衡了相互冲突的判例，然后作出范围狭窄的裁决。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，官方名称或正式称谓，行政文书与制度文本用语
phrases.example: The settlement kept its informal name long after an official appellation appeared on maps.
phrases.example_translation: 这片聚落在官方名称登上地图很久之后仍沿用原来的土名。

phrases.usage: 名词加 of 结构，……这一名号，正式语体，SAT 级书面词汇
phrases.example: Scholars debate the origins of the appellation of knight in medieval court records.
phrases.example_translation: 学者们争论中世纪宫廷文献中 knight 这一称谓的起源。

phrases.usage: 法语借词，原产地命名控制，饮食文化类文章的固定专名
phrases.example: The valley's growers lobbied for appellation contrôlée status to protect their traditional grape varieties.
phrases.example_translation: 谷地的种植户游说争取原产地命名保护资格，以守护传统葡萄品种。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，身负某种名号，指正式获得并保有称号，书面语
phrases.example: Few vineyards in the region bear the appellation that the oldest estate received last year.
phrases.example_translation: 这一产区很少有葡萄园能挂上那座最古老庄园去年获得的称号。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，配得上这一名号，评价色彩浓，用于论辩
phrases.example: Only a truly original composer deserves the appellation of master that critics hand out so freely.
phrases.example_translation: 只有真正原创的作曲家才配得上评论家随手封出的大师称号。

phrases.usage: 介词短语，凭名号被人知晓，多与 be known 结构连用
phrases.example: The factory quarter was known by the appellation of Little Manchester among local traders.
phrases.example_translation: 在本地商人之间，那片厂区以小曼彻斯特的名号著称。

translations.translation: 设置数据文件的搜索路径

phrases.usage: 动宾加 to，指在正文之后附加说明，编辑与出版语境
phrases.example: The editor appended a short note to the final chapter, correcting an earlier date.
phrases.example_translation: 编辑在最后一章之后附了一则短注，更正了早先的日期。

phrases.usage: 法律与公文搭配，指在文件末尾署名盖章
phrases.example: Each witness appended his signature beneath the statement, then left the hall.
phrases.example_translation: 每位证人都在这份陈述下方署名，随后离开了大厅。

phrases.usage: 正式公文惯用语，指如下所附，用于引导附录内容
phrases.example: The survey instrument, as appended below, contains forty items grouped by theme.
phrases.example_translation: 如下文所附的调查问卷包含四十个按主题分组的问题。

phrases.usage: 计算机用语，指把内容追加到文件或数据流末端
phrases.example: The script appends each measurement to the end of the log file.
phrases.example_translation: 这段脚本把每次测量结果追加到日志文件末尾。

phrases.usage: 科研数据管理搭配，指把原始数据附加到档案或表中
phrases.example: Researchers append raw data to the shared archive rather than emailing it separately.
phrases.example_translation: 研究人员把原始数据附加到共享档案库，而不是单独用邮件发送。

phrases.usage: 过去分词作定语，指文末附表，论文与报告用语
phrases.example: An appended table lists every parish register consulted, together with its shelf mark.
phrases.example_translation: 文末附表列出了所查阅的每一册教区登记簿及其索书号。

translations.translation: 附加物；下属；[动][解剖] 附器（如植物的枝叶和动物的腿尾）

phrases.usage: 贬义隐喻，指沦为附庸、丧失自主性，评论与政治散文中常见
phrases.example: Critics warned that the small republic had become a mere appendage of the expanding empire.
phrases.example_translation: 批评者警告说，这个小共和国已沦为扩张帝国的一个附属。

phrases.usage: 后接to加名词，指从属于更大机构的分支或下属，含轻蔑语气
phrases.example: The regional office operates as little more than an appendage to headquarters.
phrases.example_translation: 这个地区办事处的运作几乎只是总部的一个附属机构。

phrases.usage: 生物学术语搭配，指退化无用的附器，常见于进化论说明文
phrases.example: Some nineteenth-century biologists dismissed the limb as a vestigial appendage without survival value.
phrases.example_translation: 一些十九世纪生物学家认为这只肢体是没有生存价值的退化附器。

phrases.usage: 动物学描述用语，指分节的附肢，用于节肢动物等形态描写
phrases.example: The crab swept the sand aside with its jointed appendages, uncovering buried shells.
phrases.example_translation: 螃蟹用分节的附肢扫开沙子，翻出埋在下面的贝壳。

phrases.usage: 解剖与动物行为语境，指感知环境的附器，学术说明文体
phrases.example: The lobster waves its sensory appendages to detect chemicals drifting in the current.
phrases.example_translation: 龙虾挥动感知附器，探测水流中漂来的化学物质。

phrases.usage: 以形态修饰附器，多用于海洋无脊椎动物的描写性科普文字
phrases.example: The sea cucumber fans its feathery appendages to filter particles from passing water.
phrases.example_translation: 海参展开羽状附器，从流过的水中滤取微粒。

phrases.usage: 不及物动词加 to，最核心的介词搭配，指隶属于或关乎，正式书面语
phrases.example: The clause applies only to those rights appertaining to the original town charter of 1849.
phrases.example_translation: 该条款仅适用于一八四九年最初市镇宪章所赋予的那些权利。

phrases.usage: 现在分词短语作后置定语，法律文本中界定职权附属的权益
phrases.example: The unanimous ruling restored all privileges and allowances appertaining to the office he had resigned.
phrases.example_translation: 一致通过的裁决恢复了他所辞职务附带的一切特权与津贴。

phrases.usage: to 加抽象身份，指与某种身份相关的义务，政论常见
phrases.example: The plain pamphlet listed the duties appertaining to citizenship in the fragile new republic.
phrases.example_translation: 这本朴素的小册子列出了脆弱新生共和国公民身份所系的各种义务。

phrases.usage: 副词修饰动词，指天然归属，哲学与法学论述中的推论语气
phrases.example: Certain public responsibilities naturally appertain to whoever holds the operating license for the plant.
phrases.example_translation: 某些公共责任天然归属于持有该工厂营运执照之人。

phrases.usage: 近义动词并列，法律或庄严文体中求表述周全的固定写法
phrases.example: The old deed states that the woodland belongs and appertains to the riverside estate.
phrases.example_translation: 那份老地契载明这片林地归属并附属于河畔的庄园。

phrases.usage: 主谓加 to，指疑点指向某一环节，学术评论限定批评范围的书面表达
phrases.example: The careful reviewer noted that these lingering doubts appertain to the method, not to the data.
phrases.example_translation: 那位细致的评论者指出，这些挥之不去的疑点关乎方法，而非数据。

phrases.usage: 形容词修饰名词，指贴切的评论，书评与演讲评论常见
phrases.example: The editor closed the long essay with a single apposite remark that reframed the whole debate.
phrases.example_translation: 编辑用一句中肯的话结束长文，为整场辩论重新定调。

phrases.usage: 副词修饰形容词，指极为贴切，学术评价常用
phrases.example: The reviewer judged the closing analogy highly apposite for the turbulent period in question.
phrases.example_translation: 评审认为结尾的类比非常贴合所讨论的那个动荡时期。

phrases.usage: 形容词后接to，指与……相称、适用于，书面语常见
phrases.example: His hushed tone seemed apposite to the unusual gravity of the memorial occasion.
phrases.example_translation: 他低沉的语气似乎与追思场合不同寻常的庄重氛围相得益彰。

phrases.usage: 形容词修饰名词，指恰当的事例，议论文与教学常用
phrases.example: The lecturer offered an apposite example from Roman law to clarify the tricky point.
phrases.example_translation: 讲师举了一个罗马法的恰当例子来说明这个棘手的要点。

phrases.usage: 系表结构，指似乎贴切，语气体贴委婉
phrases.example: A moment of quiet seemed apposite before the student's first public piano recital.
phrases.example_translation: 在学生首场公开钢琴独奏会之前，片刻的沉寂似乎恰到好处。

phrases.usage: 语法术语介词框架，与某词构成同位关系，后接被释项
phrases.example: In that sentence, the phrase the capital city stands in apposition to the subject.
phrases.example_translation: 在那句中 the capital city 这一短语与主语构成同位关系。

phrases.usage: 动词框架，把两者并置同位以形成对照或互释，书面修辞
phrases.example: The editor placed the two essays in apposition to sharpen the contrast.
phrases.example_translation: 编辑把两篇文章并置同列，以强化二者对照。

phrases.usage: 术语搭配，处于同位位置的名词，语法教材表达
phrases.example: A noun in apposition must share the case of the term it explains.
phrases.example_translation: 同位名词须与其所解释的词保持同一格。

phrases.usage: 学术限定，严格同位，区别于宽泛的并置用法
phrases.example: Linguists distinguish strict apposition, as in my brother Sam, from looser juxtapositions.
phrases.example_translation: 语言学家把如 my brother Sam 式的严格同位与较宽泛的并置区分开来。

phrases.usage: 同位的一个实例，语法讲解与考试分析常用
phrases.example: The sentence offers a clean case of apposition that still puzzles many students.
phrases.example_translation: 这个句子提供了一个清晰的同位格案例，却仍让许多学生困惑。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，评估房产价值，银行与税务语境的标准用法
phrases.example: The bank hired two firms to appraise the property before approving the mortgage.
phrases.example_translation: 银行在批准按揭前，聘请了两家公司评估这处房产。

phrases.usage: appraise + 宾语 + at + 金额，把某物估价为……，拍卖与保险惯用
phrases.example: Specialists appraised the disputed landscape at a figure far below the auction estimate.
phrases.example_translation: 专家给那幅有争议的风景画定出的价格远低于拍卖行的预估。

phrases.usage: 人力资源管理用法，考核某人绩效，教育与职场评估常见
phrases.example: Schools should appraise teachers' performance on mentoring quality, not solely on examination results.
phrases.example_translation: 学校应当依据指导质量而非仅凭考试成绩来评价教师表现。

phrases.usage: 副词修饰动词，指独立（第三方）鉴定，规避利益冲突的说法
phrases.example: Collectors routinely have rare coins independently appraised to avoid inflated insurance valuations.
phrases.example_translation: 收藏者通常请人独立鉴定稀有硬币，以避免保险估值虚高。

phrases.usage: 后接 of，评估某物的价值，也可用于抽象事物的评论语体
phrases.example: Historians struggle to appraise the value of oral traditions absent any written records.
phrases.example_translation: 在缺乏文字记录的情况下，历史学家很难评估口述传统的价值。

phrases.usage: 方式副词 + 动词，指审慎评估，决策与分析语境常用
phrases.example: The committee carefully appraised each of the proposals before distributing the research grants.
phrases.example_translation: 委员会在分配研究资助之前，仔细评估了每一项申请。

translations.translation: 可感知的；可评估的；相当可观的

phrases.usage: 形名，可感知的差异，测量与比较语境
phrases.example: The redesigned wing made an appreciable difference in fuel burn over long routes.
phrases.example_translation: 重新设计的机翼令长途航线的油耗出现明显变化。

phrases.usage: 否定搭配，无显著效果，医学与实验报告
phrases.example: The dose was raised weekly, yet the blood tests showed no appreciable effect.
phrases.example_translation: 剂量每周上调，但血液检查未见明显效果。

phrases.usage: 形名，可观的改善，评估类文本
phrases.example: The river trail saw an appreciable improvement after the city rebuilt two crossings.
phrases.example_translation: 市政重建两处河滨通道后，步道状况明显好转。

phrases.usage: 固定程度状语，在一定程度上，学术散文常用
phrases.example: The treaty shaped frontier law to an appreciable extent for the following century.
phrases.example_translation: 该条约在相当程度上塑造了此后一个世纪的边疆法规。

phrases.usage: 让步式对举，轻微却仍可察觉，实验记录用语
phrases.example: During the second test flight the pilots logged a slight but appreciable tremor in the panel.
phrases.example_translation: 第二次试飞中，飞行员记录了仪表板上轻微但可察觉的震颤。

phrases.usage: 形名，相当可观的延误，工程与交通语境
phrases.example: The repairs caused an appreciable delay, but the crew finished before the festival opened.
phrases.example_translation: 维修造成了不小的延误，但施工队仍在节庆开幕前完工。

translations.translation: 感谢， 感激； 正确评价， 欣赏， 赏识

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，领会微妙之处，文学艺术鉴赏语境
phrases.example: Few readers appreciate the subtleties of her early essays, which seem plain at first glance.
phrases.example_translation: 很少有读者能领会她早期随笔的微妙之处，那些文章初看似乎平淡。

phrases.usage: 渐进结构，逐渐认识到，常用于转变过程的叙述
phrases.example: Over the summer the interns came to appreciate how fragile the wetland data series was.
phrases.example_translation: 整个夏天实习生们逐渐认识到湿地数据序列有多么脆弱。

phrases.usage: 惯用被动，十分感激，书信与正式致谢语
phrases.example: Your patience during the archive closure is much appreciated by the whole research team.
phrases.example_translation: 整个研究团队都非常感激你在档案馆藏关闭期间的耐心。

phrases.usage: 动词加状语，增值，经济与地产语境
phrases.example: Farmland near the restored river has appreciated in value as water security improved.
phrases.example_translation: 随着供水安全性改善，修复后河流附近的农田已经增值。

phrases.usage: 副形被动，广受赞赏，作品评价语
phrases.example: The translator's version was widely appreciated by readers for preserving the novel's dry humor.
phrases.example_translation: 译本因保留了小说冷峻的幽默而广受读者赞赏。

phrases.usage: 副形搭配，深得感激，低调致谢语境
phrases.example: The quiet funding was deeply appreciated, though the lab never publicly acknowledged it.
phrases.example_translation: 这笔不事张扬的资助深受感激，尽管实验室从未公开致谢。

phrases.usage: 后接宾语从句，体会多么……，说明认知难度
phrases.example: Visitors rarely appreciate how much maintenance a historic timber roof demands each year.
phrases.example_translation: 游客很少能体会到一座历史木构屋顶每年需要多少维护。

phrases.usage: 动宾接 of，理解……的复杂性，教学目标表述
phrases.example: The course helps students appreciate the complexity of economic data collected under colonial rule.
phrases.example_translation: 这门课帮助学生理解殖民统治时期收集的经济数据的复杂性。

phrases.usage: 副形搭配，几乎难以理解，形容晦涩文本，书面语
phrases.example: The philosophical opening chapter remains barely apprehensible without the editor's explanatory notes.
phrases.example_translation: 缺少编者注释时，这部哲学著作的开篇章节几乎无从理解。

phrases.usage: 后接 to 加对象，普通读者所能理解，写作评论高频
phrases.example: A good essayist makes abstract theory apprehensible to the general reader without condescension.
phrases.example_translation: 好的随笔作家能让普通读者领会抽象理论，却又不显得居高临下。

phrases.usage: render 加宾语再加补语，把某物讲得可懂，学术教学语境
phrases.example: The lecturer rendered the arcane theorem apprehensible through a simple analogy with flowing water.
phrases.example_translation: 讲师用流水的浅显类比，把这个晦涩的定理讲得明白可懂。

phrases.usage: 后接 through 加手段，凭借类比得以领会，科普写作常用
phrases.example: Quantum behavior, alien at first, gradually became apprehensible through carefully chosen everyday analogies.
phrases.example_translation: 量子行为起初令人陌生，借助精心挑选的日常类比才渐渐变得可以领会。

phrases.usage: 否定副词加 without 条件，脱离语境便不可解，文本分析常用
phrases.example: Medieval allegory remains scarcely apprehensible without some knowledge of Christian ritual and lore.
phrases.example_translation: 若对基督教仪礼与掌故略无所知，中世纪寓意作品几乎难以索解。

phrases.usage: 副形搭配，理智层面可以理解，哲学讨论常用限定语
phrases.example: She argued that moral truth is intellectually apprehensible yet remains emotionally elusive to most.
phrases.example_translation: 她论证道：道德真理在理智上可以理解，对多数人却在情感上难以把握。

translations.translation: 忧虑的；不安的；敏悟的；知晓的

phrases.usage: 形容词后接 about 加事由，指为某事忧虑，最常用的介词
phrases.example: The investigators were apprehensive about the trial until the first safety data arrived from two sites.
phrases.example_translation: 在两个试验点的首批安全数据到达之前，研究者们一直对试验感到忧虑。

phrases.usage: 后接 for 加人作宾语，指替某人的安危担心，新闻常用
phrases.example: The coast guard grew apprehensive for the fishermen as the barometer continued to fall.
phrases.example_translation: 随着气压计持续下降，海岸警卫队开始替渔民们的安危担忧。
