phrases.example: The trial asked volunteers to reduce calorie intake by a modest fifth.
phrases.example_translation: 该试验要求志愿者将热量摄入降低温和的五分之一。

phrases.usage: 复合形容词 + 名词，热量密度高的食物，食品科学用语
phrases.example: Nuts are calorie-dense packets, evolved to nourish a seedling through its first months.
phrases.example_translation: 坚果是热量密集的包裹，其进化本是为幼苗提供最初几个月的养分。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，标定热量数值，标签与实验室语境
phrases.example: Food labels calculate calories using a conversion set devised more than a century ago.
phrases.example_translation: 食品标签用一套一百多年前制定的换算标准来计算卡路里。

phrases.usage: 复合定语 + 名词，控制热量的饮食方案，临床营养语境
phrases.example: The hospital placed him on a calorie-controlled diet before the elective surgery.
phrases.example_translation: 在择期手术之前，医院让他接受热量控制的饮食方案。

phrases.usage: 正式及古雅动词，后接被诽谤者作宾语，多见于政治史论述
phrases.example: The pamphlet sought to calumniate a political rival by inventing letters and forging dates.
phrases.example_translation: 这本小册子靠捏造信件、伪造日期来中伤一位政敌。

phrases.usage: 后接 as + 罪名，指诬称某人为某类人，带强烈贬义
phrases.example: Witnesses objected when the report calumniated the manager as a thief without evidence.
phrases.example_translation: 报告毫无证据地诬称经理是小偷，证人们就此提出抗议。

phrases.usage: 副词修饰动词，强调恶意中伤，法律与新闻伦理语境常用
phrases.example: The editor refused to print paragraphs that maliciously calumniated an absent candidate.
phrases.example_translation: 编辑拒绝刊登那些恶意诽谤缺席候选人的段落。

phrases.usage: 被动结构，后接 by + 施害者，用于历史人物平反叙述
phrases.example: The explorer was calumniated by rivals who envied the fame of his crossing.
phrases.example_translation: 这位探险家遭到对手的诋毁，那些人嫉妒他因穿越之旅赢得的声名。

phrases.usage: 后接 memory of + 已故者，指诬蔑逝者身后名，书面语色彩重
phrases.example: Later biographers were careful not to calumniate the memory of a difficult but honest teacher.
phrases.example_translation: 后来的传记作者小心落笔，以免诋毁那位严厉却诚实的教师的声名。

phrases.usage: level...at结构，指把诽谤矛头对准某人，书面语
phrases.example: The tabloid leveled its sharpest calumny at the retiring judge, inventing a bribery story.
phrases.example_translation: 这家小报把最刻毒的诽谤指向即将退休的法官，凭空编造了一段受贿传闻。

phrases.usage: a victim of搭配，指诬蔑的受害者，传记与史论常见
phrases.example: She spent years as a victim of calumny before the archives cleared her name.
phrases.example_translation: 在档案为她洗清名誉之前，她做了多年诬蔑的受害者。

phrases.usage: slander and calumny近义并列，语气加重，指造谣与诬蔑并用
phrases.example: The pamphlet mixed slander and calumny so recklessly that the author fled the city.
phrases.example_translation: 这本册子肆意混用流言与诬蔑，作者最终不得不逃离该城。

phrases.usage: 后接against加对象，指针对某人的中伤，法律语境
phrases.example: He sued for the calumny against his character published in three consecutive issues.
phrases.example_translation: 他针对连续三期杂志登载的诋毁其品行的言论提起诉讼。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配expose the calumny，指揭穿诬蔑，常用于平反叙事
phrases.example: The committee spent a term exposing the calumny that had shadowed the headmaster.
phrases.example_translation: 委员会用一学期时间揭露了笼罩在校长身上的那些诬蔑之辞。

phrases.usage: 比喻量词a web of，形容诬蔑交织成网难以摆脱
phrases.example: Once a web of calumny becomes public, denial tends only to thicken it further.
phrases.example_translation: 一旦诬蔑织成的网公之于众，否认往往只会令其更加稠密。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配suffer calumny，指遭受中伤，含隐忍受害的意味
phrases.example: Founders of unpopular movements must expect to suffer calumny from respectable commentators.
phrases.example_translation: 不得人心的运动的发起者必须预料到会遭受体面评论者的中伤。

translations.translation: 加尔文主义；加尔文教派

phrases.usage: 名词短语加 of 结构，指教义扩散，宗教史叙事常用
phrases.example: The spread of Calvinism reshaped literacy and work habits across northern Europe.
phrases.example_translation: 加尔文主义的传播重塑了北欧各地的读写水平与劳动习惯。

phrases.usage: 固定短语，指加尔文主义的信条要点，论述性文本常见
phrases.example: The tenets of Calvinism, especially predestination, provoked decades of bitter pamphlet wars.
phrases.example_translation: 加尔文主义的教义，尤其是预定论，引发了长达数十年的激烈论战小册子。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指接受该教义，含信仰转向意味
phrases.example: Several merchant families embraced Calvinism for reasons of conscience as well as trade.
phrases.example_translation: 几家商人家庭出于良知也出于贸易考量接受了加尔文主义。

phrases.usage: 身份加 of 结构，指研究该教派的学者，学术介绍常用
phrases.example: As a historian of Calvinism, she traced how sermon style altered civic argument.
phrases.example_translation: 作为研究加尔文主义的历史学者，她考察了布道风格如何改变城市的公共论辩。

phrases.usage: 动词搭配 to，指改宗加入该教派，宗教冲突叙事常见
phrases.example: Whole towns along the coast converted to Calvinism within a single generation.
phrases.example_translation: 沿海成片的城镇在一代之内改宗了加尔文主义。

phrases.usage: 名词短语，指教派兴起，历史叙事开篇常用
phrases.example: The rise of Calvinism in the city coincided with a boom in local printing.
phrases.example_translation: 加尔文主义在这座城市的兴起恰逢当地印刷业的繁荣期。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指质疑或反对其教义，宗教论战语境
phrases.example: Arminian writers challenged Calvinism by disputing its narrow account of divine election.
phrases.example_translation: 阿米尼乌斯派作者通过质疑其狭隘的神圣拣选之说来挑战加尔文主义。

phrases.usage: 度量结构，指团队内部的情谊感，职场与运动语境
phrases.example: The rescue team developed a strong sense of camaraderie during three brutal winters.
phrases.example_translation: 救援队在三个严冬中培养出了深厚的战友情谊。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指刻意培养团队情谊，管理类文本高频
phrases.example: Annual field surveys foster camaraderie across departments faster than ordinary office meetings ever could.
phrases.example_translation: 年度野外考察在培养跨部门情谊方面，远胜于普通会议。

phrases.usage: 后接 among 引出群体，指成员之间的同志情谊
phrases.example: A warm camaraderie among the retired veterans softened this year's reunion awkwardness.
phrases.example_translation: 退役老兵之间融融的袍泽之情，冲淡了今年重聚时的生疏。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指历久弥坚的情谊，常与磨砺经历呼应
phrases.example: Hardship abroad forged an enduring camaraderie among the exchange students that outlasted graduation.
phrases.example_translation: 海外求学的艰辛，让交换生结下延续到毕业之后仍坚固不渝的情谊。

phrases.usage: 抽象精神搭配，指团队凝聚的风气，体育报道常用
phrases.example: The locker room's spirit of camaraderie impressed even the rival visiting coach.
phrases.example_translation: 更衣室里团结互助的风气，连客队教练都赞叹不已。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，genuine 强调情谊真挚，评价剧组或团队常用
phrases.example: Offstage, the cast displayed a genuine camaraderie that sharpened every ensemble scene.
phrases.example_translation: 台下的演员们真情相待，反而让每场群戏更加出彩。

translations.translation: （影视剧中的）配角；刻有浮雕的宝石或贝壳；小品文

phrases.usage: 影视搭配，指客串角色，戏份极少
phrases.example: The director offered her a cameo role, a few lines that rewarded loyal fans of the series.
phrases.example_translation: 导演给了她一个客串角色，几句台词便足以让剧迷会心一笑。

phrases.usage: 固定搭配，make a cameo appearance 指露面客串
phrases.example: The ageing actor made a cameo appearance in the final episode, to the delight of viewers.
phrases.example_translation: 这位上了年纪的演员在最后一集中客串露面，令观众大喜过望。

phrases.usage: 形容词修饰名词，指短暂客串
phrases.example: Even a brief cameo by the original star could not revive interest in the sequel.
phrases.example_translation: 即便是原版明星的短暂客串，也无法重新唤起观众对续集的兴趣。

phrases.usage: as 结构表示以客串身份出现
phrases.example: The veteran comedian appeared in the film only as a cameo, yet every review mentioned him.
phrases.example_translation: 这位资深喜剧演员在片中只是客串，但每篇影评都提到了他。

phrases.usage: 工艺术语，指在宝石或贝壳上雕刻浮雕的卡梅奥饰件
phrases.example: She inherited a carved cameo in a gold brooch, a wedding gift from her grandmother.
phrases.example_translation: 她继承了一枚镶在金胸针上的浮雕贝雕，那是祖母的结婚礼物。

phrases.usage: 形容词修饰，指反复出现的客串，常见于系列作品评论
phrases.example: His recurring cameo as the village pub keeper gave the long-running series its quiet humour.
phrases.example_translation: 他反复客串村中酒馆老板，为这部播了多年的剧集注入了内敛的幽默。

phrases.usage: 生物学术语，指动物天生的保护色伪装
phrases.example: The moth's mottled wings provide natural camouflage against the lichen-covered bark of oaks.
phrases.example_translation: 这种蛾斑驳的翅膀在长满地衣的橡树皮上形成天然伪装。

phrases.usage: 动词搭配，serve as，指起伪装作用
phrases.example: The scrubby brush along the ridge served as camouflage for the retreating column.
phrases.example_translation: 山脊沿线的低矮灌木为撤退的纵队充当了伪装。

phrases.usage: 介词搭配，指身着迷彩装
phrases.example: The survey team, dressed in camouflage, counted nesting turtles along the muddy riverbank.
phrases.example_translation: 考察队身着迷彩服，在泥泞的河岸清点筑巢的海龟。

phrases.usage: 反身用法，指动物自行伪装融入环境
phrases.example: A cuttlefish can camouflage itself in seconds, matching the reef's texture and color.
phrases.example_translation: 乌贼能在几秒内完成自身伪装，仿出礁石的质地与颜色。

phrases.usage: 被动分词搭配，指部分被伪装遮蔽
phrases.example: The artillery battery remained partially camouflaged until the decisive moment of firing.
phrases.example_translation: 炮兵阵地一直保持部分伪装，直到开火的关键时刻。

phrases.usage: 名词用法，后接 of，指由……构成的伪装物
phrases.example: The nest lay beneath a camouflage of twigs that fooled every predator.
phrases.example_translation: 巢穴掩在树枝搭成的伪装之下，骗过了所有天敌。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，后接 for，指为……提供掩护伪装
phrases.example: The morning fog provided welcome camouflage for the quiet evacuation of the wounded.
phrases.example_translation: 晨雾为悄然后送伤员提供了难得的掩护。

translations.translation: 作战；参加竞选；参加活动
参加活动， 从事活动； 作战

phrases.usage: 动词+for，为争取某事而开展活动，后接改革、权利等抽象目标
phrases.example: Local teachers campaigned for smaller class sizes throughout the spring session.
phrases.example_translation: 当地教师在整个春季学期都为争取小班额而奔走呼吁。

phrases.usage: 动词+against，反对某事物而发起运动，常见于公共卫生与政策语境
phrases.example: The health ministry campaigned against sugary drinks with billboards in every district.
phrases.example_translation: 卫生部在每个区竖起广告牌，开展反对含糖饮料的宣传运动。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，发起一场运动或活动，新闻与正式文体高频
phrases.example: The museum launched a campaign to restore the eighteenth-century manuscript before winter.
phrases.example_translation: 博物馆发起了一项运动，赶在入冬前修复那部十八世纪手稿。

phrases.usage: 固定介词短语，指竞选巡回途中，美国政治报道惯用语
phrases.example: While the candidate was on the campaign trail, reporters rarely got detailed policy answers.
phrases.example_translation: 候选人奔波于竞选途中时，记者们很少能得到具体的政策答复。

phrases.usage: 名词定语+campaign，指总统竞选活动，政治类文章常见
phrases.example: Her presidential campaign rested on a promise to rebuild the aging rail network.
phrases.example_translation: 她的总统竞选活动立足于重建老化铁路网络的承诺。

phrases.usage: 动词+副词，不知疲倦地四处奔走，带褒义，用于评价人物投入
phrases.example: The archivists campaigned tirelessly for funding to digitize the county records.
phrases.example_translation: 档案管理员不知疲倦地争取资金，以便将县档案数字化。

phrases.usage: 类别名词+campaign，指宣传造势活动，常含刻意营造之意
phrases.example: The studio wrapped up a publicity campaign that spanned three continents.
phrases.example_translation: 制片公司收尾了这场横跨三大洲的宣传造势活动。

phrases.usage: 动词wage+campaign，强调持续而激烈地展开斗争，语体正式
phrases.example: The mayor waged a campaign against the derelict factories poisoning the river.
phrases.example_translation: 市长对那批污染河流的废弃工厂发起了一场整治运动。

phrases.usage: 名词作定语的复合颜色词，指淡黄色
phrases.example: The kitchen walls were painted a soft canary yellow in morning light.
phrases.example_translation: 厨房的墙壁被涂成柔和的金丝雀黄色，在晨光中显得格外温暖。

phrases.usage: 俚语固定句式，指招供、和盘托出，语域口语化
phrases.example: Detectives persuaded the suspect to sing like a canary in exchange for leniency.
phrases.example_translation: 侦探说服嫌疑人像金丝雀般和盘托出，以换取宽大处理。

phrases.usage: 比喻搭配，指预警危险的早期信号，社科与时评常用
phrases.example: Rising teen allergies act as a canary in the coal mine for urban environmental stress.
phrases.example_translation: 青少年过敏率上升是城市环境压力的煤矿金丝雀式预警。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，日常与历史生活语境，指笼养金丝雀
phrases.example: Her grandmother would keep a canary by the window of every apartment.
phrases.example_translation: 她的奶奶总会在每间公寓的窗边养一只金丝雀。

phrases.usage: 名词作定语的形名搭配，文学描写常用
phrases.example: A cheerful canary song carried through the empty kitchen every sunny morning.
phrases.example_translation: 每天晴朗的早晨，欢快的金丝雀歌声穿过空荡的厨房。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，历史矿业与安全语境，指放鸟探测瓦斯
phrases.example: Miners used to release a canary underground to warn of dangerous gas.
phrases.example_translation: 矿工过去常在地下放一只金丝雀，以警示危险气体。

phrases.usage: 过去分词作定语的形名搭配，常含被囚禁意味
phrases.example: The little caged canary grew silent whenever the old furnace began to leak.
phrases.example_translation: 每当旧炉子开始漏气，笼中的小金丝雀就会安静下来。

phrases.usage: 名名搭配，指航班取消，出行与统计报道高频
phrases.example: A single flight cancellation late on Friday can strand dozens of connecting passengers overnight.
phrases.example_translation: 周五深夜一趟航班取消，就可能让几十名中转旅客滞留过夜。

phrases.usage: 合同与法律固定短语，指取消通知，条款文本常用
phrases.example: The club sent written notice of cancellation three weeks before the season began.
phrases.example_translation: 俱乐部在赛季开始前三个星期寄出了书面的取消通知。

phrases.usage: 比喻量词，指成片出现的取消，经济与文化报道常用
phrases.example: A wave of cancellations left the small venue struggling to pay its crew.
phrases.example_translation: 一连串的取消让这座小场馆难以支付工作人员薪酬。

phrases.usage: 后接 due to 说明原因，公告与邮件的标准写法
phrases.example: Refunds happen automatically for any cancellation due to official severe weather warnings.
phrases.example_translation: 凡因官方恶劣天气预警而取消的，都会自动退款。

phrases.usage: 名名搭配，指取消费用，服务条款文本高频
phrases.example: The hidden cancellation fee surprised couples who had booked more than a year earlier.
phrases.example_translation: 那笔隐藏的取消费让提前一年多预订的新婚夫妇大吃一惊。

phrases.usage: 后接 of 引出被取消的事物，正式书面叙述
phrases.example: The cancellation of the bridge project altered the valley's economy for a decade.
phrases.example_translation: 桥梁项目被取消，此后十年间改变了整个山谷的经济。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，避免被取消，条款说明与建议语气常用
phrases.example: Passengers were urged to confirm their itineraries early to avoid costly cancellation.
phrases.example_translation: 乘客被提醒尽早确认行程，以免遭遇会造成高额损失的取消。

phrases.usage: 与 battle 搭配的抽象用法，指抗癌斗争，回忆录与公益文本常见
phrases.example: Her memoir about the battle against cancer became required reading in nursing programmes.
phrases.example_translation: 她写的抗癌回忆录成了护理专业的必读读物。

phrases.usage: 器官名加 cancer 构成病种术语，医学科普与病例报告通用
phrases.example: The surgeon explained that pancreatic cancer rarely shows symptoms until late stages.
phrases.example_translation: 外科医生解释说，胰腺癌在晚期之前很少出现症状。

phrases.usage: 名词作定语，指癌症研究，科研经费与政策讨论中的高频搭配
phrases.example: Public funding for cancer research rose after the trial results were broadcast nationwide.
phrases.example_translation: 试验结果在全国播出后，政府对癌症研究的拨款随之增加。

phrases.usage: 现在分词修饰发病率短语，流行病学语境，暗含成因待查
phrases.example: Epidemiologists linked rising cancer rates in the valley to contaminated well water.
phrases.example_translation: 流行病学家将该山谷癌症发病率上升与受污染的井水联系起来。

phrases.usage: 及物动词直接带宾语，表示战胜癌症存活下来，语气积极
phrases.example: Many patients survive cancer today, but follow-up scans still cause anxiety each year.
phrases.example_translation: 如今许多患者都能战胜癌症存活下来，但每年的复查影像仍令人焦虑。

phrases.usage: 比喻用法，指侵蚀社会肌体的痼疾，社论贬义色彩强烈
phrases.example: The editorial called corruption a cancer on the body politic that no election alone could cure.
phrases.example_translation: 社论称腐败是侵蚀国家肌体的毒瘤，单靠一次选举无法根除。

phrases.usage: 被动结构加 with，表示被确诊患癌，叙述病情的标准说法
phrases.example: He was diagnosed with cancer in spring and finished his manuscript before winter.
phrases.example_translation: 他春天被确诊患癌，却在冬天来临前完成了书稿。

translations.translation: 公正的；坦白的；率直的；偷拍的

phrases.usage: 形容词加 with 短语，指对某人坦诚相告，人际交往与书信高频
phrases.example: Let me be candid with you: the committee will not fund the project as proposed.
phrases.example_translation: 让我对你直说：委员会不会按现有方案资助这个项目。

phrases.usage: 形容词接 about 对象，指坦率承认失败，人物评价与回忆录常见
phrases.example: The memoir is unusually candid about failure, naming each abandoned expedition without excuse.
phrases.example_translation: 这本回忆录对失败的描写异常坦率，逐一列出被放弃的探险而不找借口。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指实事求是的评估，政策报告与学术评审高频
phrases.example: The board asked for a candid assessment of enrollment trends before the budget vote.
phrases.example_translation: 董事会要求在预算表决前对入学趋势做出实事求是的评估。

phrases.usage: 名词搭配，指抓拍肖像或生动真实的文字画像，摄影与传记通用
phrases.example: The photographer's candid portraits of dockworkers defined an era of urban realism.
phrases.example_translation: 摄影师对码头工人的抓拍肖像定义了一个城市现实主义的时代。

phrases.usage: 介词框架，指用直白的措辞，转述严厉评价的缓冲说法
phrases.example: The diplomat, in candid terms leaked to journalists, called the talks moribund.
phrases.example_translation: 据泄露给记者的直白措辞，那位外交官称谈判已奄奄一息。

phrases.usage: 副词强化搭配，指毫不留情地直率，人物性格描写的常见评价
phrases.example: Her review was brutally candid, yet so precise that the playwright thanked her.
phrases.example_translation: 她的剧评直率得毫不留情，却精准到连剧作者本人都向她道谢。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指坦率的承认，政论与历史叙述中衡量可信度的标志
phrases.example: The mayor's candid admission of error cost him politically but restored public trust.
phrases.example_translation: 市长坦率承认错误让他付出了政治代价，却重建了公众信任。

phrases.usage: 后接 for + 职位或奖项，最典型的介词搭配
phrases.example: She is the leading candidate for the vacancy in the linguistics department.
phrases.example_translation: 她是语言学系那个空缺职位的头号人选。

phrases.usage: 系表结构，指正式参选，选举与校园政治话题常用
phrases.example: Three teachers announced they would stand as candidates in the school board election.
phrases.example_translation: 三位教师宣布他们将作为候选人参加学区董事会选举。

phrases.usage: 名名搭配作定语，指总统候选人，政治新闻报道高频
phrases.example: Each presidential candidate had ninety seconds at the podium.
phrases.example_translation: 每位总统候选人在讲台上只有九十秒的时间。

phrases.usage: 学术体制用语，指已开题待答辩的博士生，区别于硕士生
phrases.example: A doctoral candidate in epidemiology drafted the trial protocol.
phrases.example_translation: 一位流行病学方向的博士生起草了这项试验方案。

phrases.usage: 遗传学术语，指被推测与某性状相关的基因，学术文体
phrases.example: The laboratory narrowed the search to three candidate genes on chromosome two.
phrases.example_translation: 实验室把搜寻范围缩小到二号染色体上的三个候选基因。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指有力竞争人选，招聘与评审语境通用
phrases.example: The archivist was a strong candidate, but the post went to a conservator.
phrases.example_translation: 那位档案管理员是很有力的候选人，但这个职位最终给了修复师。

phrases.usage: 否定判断句式，指不再适合某用途或地位，评论性表述
phrases.example: After the fire the building was no longer a candidate for restoration.
phrases.example_translation: 火灾之后，这座建筑已不再有修复的价值。

phrases.usage: in 结构表参与某阶段选举，美国政治报道常见
phrases.example: Four candidates entered the primary before the filing deadline closed.
phrases.example_translation: 在登记截止前有四位候选人加入了初选。

phrases.usage: 介词固定搭配，坦率直言，访谈与议事场合常用
phrases.example: She asked the panel to speak with candor about the budget shortfall.
phrases.example_translation: 她请小组成员就预算缺口坦率直言。

phrases.usage: 后接 about 加话题，指对某事开诚布公
phrases.example: His candor about the failed trial won the lab a hearing it had not expected.
phrases.example_translation: 他对那次失败试验开诚布公，反倒让实验室得到了意料之外的倾听。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指令人放下戒备的直率，人物评价常用
phrases.example: The witness displayed a disarming candor that left the cross-examiner without questions.
phrases.example_translation: 证人表现出一种令人卸下心防的坦率，让交叉询问的律师无话可问。

phrases.usage: 动宾结构，怀疑某人是否坦诚，社论与听证语境
phrases.example: Peer reviewers questioned the author's candor about the funding behind two years of fieldwork.
phrases.example_translation: 同行评审者质疑作者对两年田野调查背后的资助情况是否坦诚。

phrases.usage: 后常接 with，指以坦诚相待，伦理与人际评论用语
phrases.example: The board promised to treat staff with candor even when the news was bad.
phrases.example_translation: 董事会承诺即便消息不利，也会坦诚对待员工。

phrases.usage: 名词短语，指不够坦白，常用于批评证词或声明
phrases.example: The committee blamed the scandal less on greed than on a lack of candor.
phrases.example_translation: 委员会认为这起丑闻与其说源于贪婪，不如说源于坦诚的缺失。

phrases.usage: 介词固定短语，出于直率，用于引出坦白之语
phrases.example: Out of candor the principal admitted that the reading program had stalled.
phrases.example_translation: 校长坦言相承，承认那项阅读计划已经停滞不前。

translations.translation: 犬的；犬齿的；犬科的；似犬的

phrases.usage: 解剖术语，指犬齿、尖牙，人类与动物牙齿研究通用
phrases.example: The fossil's worn canine teeth suggested a diet of tough roots and fallen fruit.
phrases.example_translation: 这块化石上磨损的犬齿表明，它以坚韧的根茎和落地果实为食。

phrases.usage: 兽医固定病名，指犬瘟热，出现在接种与防疫语境
phrases.example: The shelter vaccinated every puppy against canine distemper within its first week there.
phrases.example_translation: 收容所在幼犬到达的第一周内便为它们接种了犬瘟热疫苗。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指犬类行为，动物学与驯养研究文本高频
phrases.example: Researchers tracked canine behaviour in wolf packs to test the old dominance theory.
phrases.example_translation: 研究人员追踪狼群中的犬科行为，以检验旧有的支配地位理论。

phrases.usage: 作名词指犬只，学术与法律文体里避免口语 dog 的正式说法
phrases.example: The report describes a small domestic canine buried beside its owner in a Neolithic grave.
phrases.example_translation: 报告描述了一只新石器时代墓葬中与被主人合葬的小型家犬。

phrases.usage: 数量加解剖部位名词，指下颌犬齿，古生物与兽医记录常用
phrases.example: A fractured lower canine left the wounded wolf unable to grip its prey securely.
phrases.example_translation: 下犬齿骨折让那头受伤的狼无法牢牢咬住猎物。

phrases.usage: 公共卫生术语搭配，指犬源狂犬病，防疫宣传与流行病学文本
phrases.example: Rural campaigns now focus on vaccinating dogs against canine rabies every spring.
phrases.example_translation: 农村地区的防疫活动如今着重于每年春季为犬只接种狂犬病疫苗。

phrases.usage: 与商业人物名词搭配，指精明审慎的投资人，褒义评价语体
phrases.example: A canny investor bought the quiet street's houses before the new transit line was announced.
phrases.example_translation: 一位精明的投资人在新交通线公布之前买下了那条安静街道的房产。

phrases.usage: 后接 with + 资源，指在钱物上精打细算
phrases.example: She was canny with the department budget yet generous with her time.
phrases.example_translation: 她在部门预算上精打细算，在个人时间上却慷慨大方。

phrases.usage: 后接动词不定式，表示精明到足以做出某事，评价性句式
phrases.example: The curator was canny enough to loan the painting instead of selling it.
phrases.example_translation: 策展人足够精明，选择出借那幅画而非将它卖掉。

phrases.usage: 副形搭配，指政治上精明算计，时政评论与人物素描常见
phrases.example: The mayor's decision was politically canny, if a little hard on the shopkeepers.
phrases.example_translation: 市长的决定在政治上颇为精明，只是对店主们略苛刻了些。

phrases.usage: 后接 of + 对象，指精到准确的评估，书评与报告常用
phrases.example: The article offers a canny appraisal of the town's fading textile trade.
phrases.example_translation: 这篇文章对该镇日渐衰落的纺织业作出了精辟的评估。

phrases.usage: 近义形容词并列，强化精明意味，人物评价语体
phrases.example: Negotiators found her shrewd and canny, quick to spot a buried clause.
phrases.example_translation: 谈判对手发现她既精明又谨慎，总能迅速揪出埋藏的条款。

phrases.usage: 与 move 或 decision 搭配，指一步妙棋
phrases.example: Hiring the retired engineer proved a canny move that saved the project a year.
phrases.example_translation: 雇用那位退休工程师被证明是一步妙棋，为项目省下整整一年。

translations.translation: 标准；教规；正典圣经；教士

phrases.usage: 名词作定语的固定搭配，指教会法规，历史与宗教研究常用
phrases.example: Many students of medieval society study how canon law shaped marriage contracts.
phrases.example_translation: 许多研究中世纪社会的学生都探讨教会法如何塑造婚约。

phrases.usage: 专名搭配，指被教会认定的正典经卷集合，宗教学术文本常用
phrases.example: Scholars still debate which early writings properly belong within the biblical canon.
phrases.example_translation: 学者们仍在争论哪些早期著作真正属于圣经正典。

phrases.usage: 动词搭配，指作品被公认入典成为经典，文学评论高频
phrases.example: The novel slowly entered the literary canon after three generations of neglect.
phrases.example_translation: 这部小说在被冷落了三代人之后才缓缓进入文学经典之列。

phrases.usage: 文化批评术语，指欧美经典作品体系，常见于课程争论
phrases.example: The seminar questioned whether the Western canon still suits a global classroom.
phrases.example_translation: 研讨课质疑西方经典是否仍适合今天的全球课堂。

phrases.usage: 介词搭配，指未被纳入经典序列的作品或作者
phrases.example: Much twentieth-century pulp fiction has remained stubbornly outside the accepted literary canon.
phrases.example_translation: 大量二十世纪通俗低俗小说始终固执地处在公认经典之外。

phrases.usage: 取准则义，后接 of，指行为规范条律，正式书面语
phrases.example: The old guild enforced a strict canon of conduct among all its members.
phrases.example_translation: 这家古老的行会对所有成员执行一套严格的行为准则。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指质疑经典标准的权威性，教育改革语境常见
phrases.example: Young literary critics increasingly challenge the narrow canon taught in most universities.
phrases.example_translation: 年轻文学批评者日益质疑多数大学所讲授的那套狭窄经典。

translations.translation: 依教规的；权威的；牧师的

phrases.usage: 形名宗教学科搭配，指被奉为标准的正典文本，宗教文献学常用
phrases.example: Scribes copied each canonical text at least twice, carefully checking letter against letter.
phrases.example_translation: 抄写员把每部正典文本抄两遍，逐字相互核对。

phrases.usage: 数学与计算机术语，指标准形式或规范形式，学科高频
phrases.example: Rewriting it in the canonical form made the equation's hidden symmetry obvious.
phrases.example_translation: 把它改写成规范形式后，方程隐藏的对称性便一目了然。

phrases.usage: 文学批评搭配，of 后接领域或年代，指公认典范之作
phrases.example: The novel became a canonical work of the period despite its lukewarm start.
phrases.example_translation: 这部小说尽管开局冷淡，却成了该时期的典范之作。

phrases.usage: 介词固定短语，指按正典或规范次序排列，校勘学常用
phrases.example: The editor printed the fragments in canonical order rather than by date.
phrases.example_translation: 编者按正典次序而非年代排印了这些残篇。

phrases.usage: 系表动态用法，指作品由边缘升格为公认经典，批评史常用
phrases.example: A film ignored in its own decade later became canonical for students of cinema.
phrases.example_translation: 一部在其年代被忽视的影片后来成为电影学生的经典。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指经典性的权威，用于评价学者或著作影响
phrases.example: The old dictionary held canonical authority for three generations of careful editors.
phrases.example_translation: 这部词典在数代编辑心中享有经典权威。

translations.translation: 斜面；伪善之言；黑话；角落
行话的；哀诉声的；假仁假义的

phrases.usage: 道德伪善之言，贬义极强，政论与文学批评常见
phrases.example: The editorial dismissed the senator's speech as moral cant from a man who had never visited a school.
phrases.example_translation: 社论把这位参议员的演说斥为伪善的道德说教，出自一个从未踏进过学校的人之口。

phrases.usage: 爱国主义的口头禅式空话，含讥讽，评论文体
phrases.example: He grew weary of the patriotic cant that passed for serious argument during the campaign.
phrases.example_translation: 他对选举期间被当作严肃论据的那种爱国空话早已厌倦。

phrases.usage: cant 的古义'黑话、行话'，the cant of + 群体，指圈内用语
phrases.example: Anthropologists must learn the cant of the village before they can record its stories faithfully.
phrases.example_translation: 人类学家必须先学会村子里的黑话，才能如实地记录当地的故事。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配 + about，滔滔不绝地讲某方面的假话，口语化批评
phrases.example: He spouts cant about freedom while quietly supporting every censorship bill that appears.
phrases.example_translation: 他满嘴自由的高调，背地里却暗中支持每一项出台的审查法案。

phrases.usage: 英式方言旧语，指歪斜地、一侧倾斜，文学描写姿态用具
phrases.example: His hat sat at a cant above one ear, giving the clerk a faintly roguish look.
phrases.example_translation: 他的帽子歪戴在一只耳朵上方，让这位书记员显得有些淘气。

phrases.usage: 多愁善感的滥情空话，书评与影评中针砭时用
phrases.example: Her review stripped away the sentimental cant to expose the novel's bleak moral core.
phrases.example_translation: 她的书评剥去滥情的空话，揭示了小说阴冷的道德内核。

translations.translation: 脾气坏的；爱吵架的；难相处的

phrases.usage: 常修饰老年男性，SAT 阅读里刻画脾气乖戾的典型形象
phrases.example: The cantankerous old man cursed every delivery driver who dared ring his bell.
phrases.example_translation: 那位脾气乖戾的老人对每一个敢按他门铃的快递员破口大骂。

phrases.usage: 系表结构，指随着年龄或处境变得脾气暴躁
phrases.example: After weeks of delays and unanswered emails, the usually patient editor grew cantankerous.
phrases.example_translation: 数周的延误和无人回复的邮件让一向耐心的编辑变得脾气暴躁。

phrases.usage: 后接 with + 名词，形容与同事相处时爱挑争执
phrases.example: She became cantankerous with colleagues whenever the quarterly budget came under scrutiny.
phrases.example_translation: 每当季度预算被审查时，她就会对同事变得尖刻好吵。

phrases.usage: 副词修饰形容词，指出名的坏脾气，常见于人物特写
phrases.example: The notoriously cantankerous professor turned down every invitation to chair yet another university committee.
phrases.example_translation: 那位出了名脾气乖戾的教授拒绝再主持任何大学委员会。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指乖戾易怒的天性，多用于性格描写
phrases.example: His cantankerous disposition made long meetings unbearable for everyone in the room.
phrases.example_translation: 他那乖戾易怒的天性让室内每个人都难以忍受冗长的会议。

phrases.usage: 口语化搭配，指为琐事大动肝火，含轻微贬义
phrases.example: Neighbors got cantankerous over the shared driveway and left terse notes on each other's doors.
phrases.example_translation: 邻居为共用车道闹起了脾气，彼此在对方门上留下措辞生硬的纸条。

phrases.usage: 与近义形容词并列使用，加强乖戾色彩，常见于评论文体
phrases.example: The columnist was curmudgeonly and cantankerous, savaging every new trend in modern architecture.
phrases.example_translation: 那位专栏作者乖戾又暴躁，对现代建筑的每一股新风都要冷嘲热讽。

translations.translation: 大合唱；（意）清唱剧；康塔塔（一种声乐套曲）

phrases.usage: 名词复合，指教会康塔塔，巴洛克宗教音乐体裁搭配
phrases.example: The chamber choir rehearsed a church cantata for the feast-day service at the cathedral.
phrases.example_translation: 室内合唱团为教堂的节庆礼拜排练了一首教会康塔塔。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指创作康塔塔，创作与传记语境
phrases.example: Exiled during the war, the composer managed to finish a cantata for solo voices and brass.
phrases.example_translation: 战争期间流亡在外，这位作曲家仍完成了为独唱与铜管而作的康塔塔。

phrases.usage: 定语区分世俗题材，与宗教康塔塔对举，音乐学术语
phrases.example: Her lecture contrasted the secular cantata with the sacred forms Bach wrote for Leipzig.
phrases.example_translation: 她的讲座将世俗康塔塔与巴赫为莱比锡创作的宗教体裁作了对照。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指演出康塔塔，音乐会节目单语境
phrases.example: The student orchestra will perform the cantata alongside a newly discovered overture.
phrases.example_translation: 学生管弦乐团将演出这部康塔塔，并与一首新发现的序曲同台呈现。

phrases.usage: 量词框架，指成套的康塔塔，如巴赫按礼仪年写作的系列
phrases.example: The series presents a cycle of cantatas composed for successive Sundays of the liturgical year.
phrases.example_translation: 该系列音乐会演出了为礼仪年连续各个主日创作的一套康塔塔。

phrases.usage: 后接 of 加长诗名，标明篇章归属，文学评论标准句式
phrases.example: The lecture analyzed a canto of Byron's narrative poem that most anthologies omit.
phrases.example_translation: 讲座分析了拜伦叙事诗中大多数选本都略去的一个篇章。

phrases.usage: 指长诗的末篇，评论结尾段落时常用
phrases.example: In the closing canto the narrator finally reconciles with the exile who haunted the earlier books.
phrases.example_translation: 在末篇中，叙述者终于与萦绕前几卷的那个流亡者和解。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指创作一个篇章，文学史叙述常用
phrases.example: Working through the war years, the poet managed to compose only a single canto.
phrases.example_translation: 在战争的年月里笔耕不辍，那位诗人却只写成了一篇长诗。

phrases.usage: 与数字连用标示具体篇章，注释与课程索引常见
phrases.example: Students were asked to read canto IX before Thursday and prepare questions on its imagery.
phrases.example_translation: 老师要求学生在周四前读完第九篇，并就其中的意象准备问题。

phrases.usage: 后接现在分词短语作定语，指歌颂某主题的篇章
phrases.example: The volume opens with a canto celebrating ordinary laborers rather than the usual heroes.
phrases.example_translation: 诗集以一首赞颂普通劳动者而非传统英雄的开篇长诗起首。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指朗诵篇章，课堂与纪念活动场景常用
phrases.example: She agreed to recite a canto from memory at the evening commemorating the poet.
phrases.example_translation: 她答应在纪念那位诗人的晚间活动上背诵一段长诗。

phrases.usage: 军事史术语，指冬季营房营地，常见于战史记述
phrases.example: The exhausted brigade reached its winter cantonment two weeks before the first snows.
phrases.example_translation: 疲惫的旅队在初雪前两周抵达了冬季营地。

phrases.usage: 动词后接 into，指开赴营地休整，军事行动叙述用语
phrases.example: After the review, the battered regiment marched into cantonment for much-needed rest.
phrases.example_translation: 检阅结束后，这支伤亡惨重的团队开进营地，以获得急需的休整。

phrases.usage: 介词短语，指处于驻营状态，区别于作战或行军
phrases.example: The troops spent the damp months in cantonment, drilling twice each morning.
phrases.example_translation: 部队在营地度过了潮湿的几个月，每天上午操练两次。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指设立兵营，殖民与国防行政语境
phrases.example: The colonial administration decided to establish a cantonment on the ridge above the river crossing.
phrases.example_translation: 殖民当局决定在渡口上方的山脊上设立一处兵营。

phrases.usage: 名词修饰，指以军营为中心的城镇，城市史文本用语
phrases.example: The old cantonment town still keeps its parade ground and rows of single-storey officers' quarters.
phrases.example_translation: 这座旧的军营城镇至今仍保留着阅兵场和成排的单层军官住宅。

translations.translation: 宽敞的；广阔的；容积大的

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指涵盖面广、宽泛的定义或概念，学术与法律评论常用
phrases.example: The court adopted a capacious definition of privacy that covers most digital communications.
phrases.example_translation: 法院采纳了一个宽泛的隐私定义，涵盖大多数数字通讯。

phrases.usage: 形容词 + enough + 不定式，强调容量足以容纳某物
phrases.example: The old train station proved capacious enough to hold the entire visiting school choir.
phrases.example_translation: 老火车站证明容量足够大，装得下整支来访的学校合唱团。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，比喻记忆力强、能容纳大量内容
phrases.example: She kept a capacious memory of every bargain struck during the long negotiations.
phrases.example_translation: 她对冗长谈判中达成的每一笔交易都记忆犹新。

phrases.usage: 形容词 + in + 名词，指覆盖范围广，用于评价性写作
phrases.example: The anthology proved capacious in scope, spanning four centuries of maritime poetry.
phrases.example_translation: 这本诗选视野广阔，跨越了四个世纪的海洋题材诗歌。

phrases.usage: 形名空间搭配，指容积巨大的厅堂建筑
phrases.example: The lecture moved to a capacious hall that could seat five hundred students comfortably.
phrases.example_translation: 讲座改到了可舒适容纳五百名学生的大厅举行。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指卷帙浩繁的档案库，人文社科语境
phrases.example: Capacious archives in the capital document three decades of municipal water policy.
phrases.example_translation: 首都卷帙浩繁的档案馆记录了这个城市三十年的水利政策。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，比喻包容兼蓄、能容纳异见的头脑
phrases.example: A truly capacious mind welcomes dissenting views in seminar rather than silencing them.
phrases.example_translation: 真正开阔的头脑在研讨课上欢迎不同意见，而不是将其压制。

phrases.usage: 物理术语搭配，指两块平行极板构成的电容器，教科书基本模型
phrases.example: The lecture derived the capacitance formula for an ideal parallel-plate capacitor in vacuum.
phrases.example_translation: 这堂课推导了真空中理想平行板电容器的电容公式。

phrases.usage: 类型搭配，指容量较大的有极性电容器，电子维修文本常见
phrases.example: The power supply failed after the electrolytic capacitor near the regulator bulged.
phrases.example_translation: 稳压块附近的电解电容鼓包之后，电源就坏了。

phrases.usage: 类型搭配，指陶瓷介质电容器，电路设计与元件选型文本常用
phrases.example: Low-noise circuits favor a ceramic capacitor because it stays stable across temperatures.
phrases.example_translation: 低噪声电路偏爱陶瓷电容，因为它在不同温度下都保持稳定。

phrases.usage: 术语搭配，指容量可调的电容器，调谐回路的经典元件
phrases.example: Turning the variable capacitor slowly brought the old radio receiver into clear focus.
phrases.example_translation: 慢慢旋转可变电容，这台老收音机终于收到了清晰的信号。

phrases.usage: 集合量词结构，指成组并联的电容器组，工业储能与功率补偿语境
phrases.example: A bank of capacitors smooths the irregular power drawn by the arc furnace.
phrases.example_translation: 一组电容器用来平滑电弧炉所抽取的不稳定功率。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指释放储存的电荷，实验手册中的安全用语
phrases.example: Always discharge the capacitor before touching any terminal on the circuit board.
phrases.example_translation: 触碰电路板上任何接线端之前，务必先给电容放电。

phrases.usage: 动宾加介词结构，描述电容储能的基本功能，科普讲解语体
phrases.example: The physics demonstration showed how to store energy in a capacitor connected to a battery.
phrases.example_translation: 这堂物理演示展示了如何在接在电池上的电容器中储存能量。

phrases.usage: 物理术语，capillary action，毛细作用，液体在细管中升降的现象
phrases.example: Tall plants raise water through narrow stems partly by capillary action and transpiration.
phrases.example_translation: 高大的植物借助毛细作用和蒸腾拉力，把水分沿细茎向上输送。

phrases.usage: 实验器具名词搭配，capillary tube，毛细管，课堂与实验室常用
phrases.example: Physics students measured precisely how far coloured dye climbed each narrow capillary tube.
phrases.example_translation: 物理课学生精确测量了彩色染液在每根细毛细管中上升的高度。

phrases.usage: 生理学术语，capillary network，毛细血管网，肿瘤与循环研究用语
phrases.example: Rapid tumour growth depends on first building a dense capillary network of its own.
phrases.example_translation: 肿瘤的快速生长取决于其首先构建起自身致密的毛细血管网。

phrases.usage: 解剖学术语，capillary bed，毛细血管床，物质交换发生的微循环区
phrases.example: Gas exchange occurs slowly along each sprawling capillary bed within the lung tissue.
phrases.example_translation: 气体交换沿着肺组织内蔓延开的每一处毛细血管床缓慢进行。

phrases.usage: 医学描述，ruptured capillary，破裂的毛细血管，常见于外伤与冻伤叙述
phrases.example: A single ruptured capillary left a faint crimson mark on the frostbitten skin.
phrases.example_translation: 一根破裂的毛细血管在冻伤的皮肤上留下了一抹淡红的痕迹。

phrases.usage: 复数名词搭配，capillary walls，毛细血管壁，物质扩散的屏障
phrases.example: In working muscle, oxygen diffuses across thin capillary walls into the hungry tissue.
phrases.example_translation: 在运动中的肌肉里，氧气透过薄薄的毛细血管壁扩散进饥渴的组织。

translations.translation: 认输，屈服；屈从，停止反抗；有条件投降；让步
有条件投降； 屈服， 停止抵抗

phrases.usage: 后接 to + 对手或要求，向某人屈服投降，最核心介词搭配
phrases.example: The strikers refused to capitulate to terms that barred rehiring any of their leaders.
phrases.example_translation: 罢工者拒绝向那项禁止重新雇用任何工会领袖的条款屈服。

phrases.usage: 后接动词不定式的否定框架，拒不投降，军事与谈判语境
phrases.example: The besieged garrison refused to capitulate even after weeks of shelling and famine.
phrases.example_translation: 被围的守军即便在数周的炮击与饥馑之后仍拒绝投降。

phrases.usage: on + 条件，有条件投降，对应规格中的让步义项
phrases.example: The general finally capitulated on terms that preserved his army's honors and arms.
phrases.example_translation: 将军最终同意投降，条件是保留其军队的荣誉与装备。

phrases.usage: in the face of + 压力，面对逼迫而让步，社论高频
phrases.example: Retail chains did not capitulate in the face of the boycott; they negotiated quietly instead.
phrases.example_translation: 零售连锁并未在抵制压力下让步，而是悄然转入谈判。

phrases.usage: 被动加不定式，被迫屈服，强调走投无路的处境
phrases.example: Bankrupt and abandoned by its allies, the firm was forced to capitulate to creditors.
phrases.example_translation: 破产且众叛亲离，这家公司被迫向债权人低头。

phrases.usage: 副词加动词，轻易让步，含缺乏原则的批评意味
phrases.example: The cabinet readily capitulated on the funding clause once the deadline loomed.
phrases.example_translation: 截止日期一逼近，内阁在拨款条款上便轻易作了让步。

phrases.usage: before + 压力源，向民意舆论屈从，书面近于 capitulate to
phrases.example: The leadership vowed it would not capitulate before the reviewers' every demand.
phrases.example_translation: 领导层立誓不会对方审稿人的每一项要求都低头屈从。

translations.translation: 任性，反复无常；随想曲，怪想

phrases.usage: fit 接 of caprice，指一阵任性发作，含贬义心理描写
phrases.example: He canceled the contract in a sudden fit of caprice that stunned the entire board.
phrases.example_translation: 他在突如其来的任性发作中撕毁了合同，令整个董事会震惊。

phrases.usage: 接 of + 抽象名词，指命运无常，文学与历史评论用语
phrases.example: Her candid memoirs attributed every bitter reversal to the restless caprice of unseen fortune.
phrases.example_translation: 她坦率的回忆录把每一次苦涩的转折都归因于无形命运反复无常的捉弄。

phrases.usage: mere 修饰，指不过是任性，含轻蔑与否定
phrases.example: The sudden dismissal was mere personal caprice cleverly disguised as a neutral policy decision.
phrases.example_translation: 那次突然解职不过是假借中立政策决定的个人任性之举。

phrases.usage: give way to 接抽象名词，指由着性子来，书面道德批评
phrases.example: A ruler who gives way to caprice inevitably invites a court of smooth flatterers.
phrases.example_translation: 一味由着性子的统治者招来的只会是一朝圆滑的谄媚之徒。

phrases.usage: arbitrary 修饰 caprice，指反复无常的专断，政治语境
phrases.example: The villagers suffered far more from the official's arbitrary caprice than from any regular tax.
phrases.example_translation: 比起任何常规税赋，村民们更苦于那位官员反复无常的专断。

phrases.usage: 作名词指随想曲，musical 修饰强调体裁，音乐评论用语
phrases.example: The young composer scored a sparkling musical caprice for full strings and solo harp.
phrases.example_translation: 那位年轻作曲家为一整组弦乐与独奏竖琴谱写了一首光彩的随想曲。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，历史与政治语境指反复无常的统治者，贬义
phrases.example: Courtiers learned that pleasing a capricious ruler mattered more than honest advice.
phrases.example_translation: 廷臣们渐渐明白，讨好反复无常的君主比进献忠言更要紧。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指变化无常的天气，探险与农业叙述常用
phrases.example: Capricious weather delayed the expedition twice and ruined the carefully planned ascent.
phrases.example_translation: 反复无常的天气两次延误了探险队，也毁掉了精心策划的登顶。

phrases.usage: 系表结构，指变得飘忽不定，多用于风势、情绪
phrases.example: The wind grew capricious near the cliffs, forcing the sailors to reef early.
phrases.example_translation: 风在悬崖附近变得飘忽不定，迫使水手们早早收起帆。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，人物评价中指任性的性情，书面贬义
phrases.example: Her editor tolerated a capricious temperament because her copy never needed revising.
phrases.example_translation: 编辑容忍了她任性的脾气，因为她的稿件从不需要修改。

phrases.usage: 副词修饰形容词，指执行或行为日益反复无常，评论用语
phrases.example: Judges warned that the new rule made enforcement increasingly capricious across districts.
phrases.example_translation: 法官们警告说，新规定让各地执法变得越来越随意无常。

phrases.usage: 同级比较结构，后接比较对象，用于修辞性描写
phrases.example: The committee's priorities proved as capricious as the weather that unpredictable summer.
phrases.example_translation: 事实证明，委员会的轻重缓急与那个无常夏天的天气一样难以捉摸。

translations.translation: 加上标题； 加上说明

phrases.usage: 名词接 beneath 短语，指照片下方的说明文字
phrases.example: The caption beneath the photograph identified the unknown soldier only by his hometown.
phrases.example_translation: 照片下方的说明只以那位无名士兵的家乡来指认他。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指撰写图注或字幕，出版与摄影语境
phrases.example: The archivist asked the interns to write a caption for each newly scanned image.
phrases.example_translation: 档案馆员要求实习生为每张新扫描的图像撰写说明文字。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指俏皮的风趣图注，多评论漫画语境
phrases.example: The cartoon depended on a witty caption to deliver its quiet political sting.
phrases.example_translation: 这幅漫画靠一句风趣的图注传递它含蓄的政治讽刺。

phrases.usage: 动词用法，指为照片加说明，新闻编辑规范常用
phrases.example: Editors must caption each photograph factually, naming places and dates without speculation.
phrases.example_translation: 编辑必须如实为每张照片加注说明，标出地点和日期而不得臆测。

phrases.usage: 媒体无障碍术语，指可开关的隐藏字幕，流媒体与电视常用
phrases.example: Viewers with hearing loss can switch on the closed captions at any moment.
phrases.example_translation: 有听力损失的观众可以随时打开隐藏字幕。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指阅读说明文字，强调图注补充信息
phrases.example: Only after they read the caption did visitors realize the portrait was a self-portrait.
phrases.example_translation: 参观者读了说明才意识到那幅肖像其实是自画像。

phrases.usage: 后接 about 加对象，因细枝末节挑剔，SAT 人物描写的贬义用法
phrases.example: The reviewer had grown captious about trifles, flagging a stray comma in a novel of four hundred pages.
phrases.example_translation: 那位书评人变得对琐事吹毛求疵，竟在四百页小说里挑出一个多余的逗号。

phrases.usage: 形容词直接修饰人或职务名词，指专门苛责的批评者
phrases.example: A captious critic can make a generous first draft seem hopeless by noon.
phrases.example_translation: 一个吹毛求疵的批评者，能让一份内容丰厚的初稿到中午就显得毫无希望。

phrases.usage: 系表结构加压力状语，指紧迫情境下变得苛责，社科与职场语境
phrases.example: Under deadline pressure the editor became captious, rejecting punctuation choices she had praised the week before.
phrases.example_translation: 在截稿压力下，编辑变得挑剔起来，否定了自己上周还称赞过的标点选择。

phrases.usage: 后接 in 加活动名，指在辩论中钻牛角尖，评论性书面语
phrases.example: He is captious in argument, pursuing each semantic distinction until the original point disappears entirely.
phrases.example_translation: 他在辩论中过于挑剔，追逐每一处语义区分，直到原本论点彻底消失。

phrases.usage: 修饰抽象气质名词，把苛责归为性格特征，心理类文本常见
phrases.example: Her captious temperament made group study difficult, though it served her well as a proofreader.
phrases.example_translation: 她吹毛求疵的气质让小组学习难以进行，却使她成为出色的校对员。

phrases.usage: 后接 with 加人，指对具体对象挑剔苛刻，语气较 about 更人际化
phrases.example: Senior surgeons can be captious with residents, treating small deviations as evidence of carelessness.
phrases.example_translation: 资深外科医生可能对住院医格外挑剔，把微小偏差都当作粗心的证据。

phrases.usage: 修饰异议类名词，指出于苛责而非实质的反对，学术讨论常用
phrases.example: The committee dismissed the remark as a captious objection rather than a genuine scholarly concern.
phrases.example_translation: 委员会把这句话斥为吹毛求疵的反对，而非真正有学术价值的关切。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，令听众着迷，演讲与表演艺术的核心用法
phrases.example: The lecturer could captivate an audience of hundreds with nothing but a chalkboard.
phrases.example_translation: 这位讲师仅凭一块黑板，就能让数百名听众为之着迷。

phrases.usage: 被动加 by 引出施动者，被深深吸引，抒情常用
phrases.example: Visitors are often captivated by the archive's hand-drawn botanical plates.
phrases.example_translation: 来访者常常被档案库中手绘的植物图版深深吸引。

phrases.usage: 动词加 with 点明手段，以生动意象打动，写作指导语域
phrases.example: The documentary continues to captivate viewers with vivid imagery of the vanishing wetlands.
phrases.example_translation: 这部纪录片以正在消失的湿地的生动画面，持续打动着观众。

phrases.usage: 程度副词修饰动词，完全迷住，强烈的褒义叙述
phrases.example: Her first novel utterly captivated a generation of young readers across Europe.
phrases.example_translation: 她的首部小说让整整一代欧洲年轻读者为之倾倒。

phrases.usage: 固定句式 fail to 否定式，总能引人入胜，评论结语常用
phrases.example: The reef's colors never fail to captivate even the most jaded divers.
phrases.example_translation: 即便对最见多识广的潜水员，珊瑚礁的色彩也总能令人着迷。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，激发想象，教育与历史叙事的高频表达
phrases.example: Medieval guild records have long captivated the imagination of urban historians.
phrases.example_translation: 中世纪行会档案长期以来一直激发着城市史学家的想象。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，使读者入迷，出版与书评话语
phrases.example: A brisk opening chapter can captivate readers before the plot has explained itself.
phrases.example_translation: 利落的开篇章节往往能在情节交代之前便使读者入迷。

translations.translation: [有化] 碳水化合物；[有化] 糖类

phrases.usage: 营养学术语，复合碳水化合物，指消化缓慢、供能平稳的一类
phrases.example: Nutritionists favor oatmeal as a complex carbohydrate that releases energy steadily.
phrases.example_translation: 营养师推崇燕麦，因为它是一种能平稳释放能量的复合碳水化合物。

phrases.usage: 营养学术语，简单碳水化合物，升糖快，常被与甜食关联
phrases.example: Whole fruit is often wrongly avoided as though it were merely a simple carbohydrate.
phrases.example_translation: 完整的水果常被错误地回避，好像它只是一种简单的碳水化合物。

phrases.usage: 名词作定语，碳水化合物摄入量，饮食研究与运动营养核心指标
phrases.example: Endurance athletes carefully time their carbohydrate intake around heavy training.
phrases.example_translation: 耐力运动员会围绕大运动量训练精心安排碳水化合物的摄入时间。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，分解碳水化合物，生理过程描述的标准说法
phrases.example: Salivary enzymes begin to break down carbohydrates before food reaches the stomach.
phrases.example_translation: 食物还未到达胃部，唾液酶就已开始分解其中的碳水化合物。

phrases.usage: 复合形容词加名词，高碳水饮食，营养学对照研究的常用类别
phrases.example: The trial compared a Mediterranean pattern with a conventional high-carbohydrate diet.
phrases.example_translation: 这项试验将地中海饮食模式与常规高碳水饮食进行了对比。

phrases.usage: 表语搭配，富含碳水化合物，食物成分说明常用表达
phrases.example: Dried legumes remain inexpensive staples that are rich in carbohydrate and protein.
phrases.example_translation: 干豆类依旧是富含碳水化合物和蛋白质的平价主食。

phrases.usage: 环境科学与政策文本高频搭配，后接 from 点明来源，指二氧化碳排放量
phrases.example: Many nations pledged to curb carbon dioxide emissions from coal-fired plants within a decade.
phrases.example_translation: 许多国家承诺在十年内削减燃煤电厂的二氧化碳排放量。

phrases.usage: 作前置定语，指大气中的二氧化碳，气候学与地质记录论文常见
phrases.example: Measurements of atmospheric carbon dioxide at the mountaintop observatory showed a record high.
phrases.example_translation: 山顶观测站对大气二氧化碳的测量结果显示出了历史最高值。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指海洋、植被等吸收二氧化碳，生态学通用表达
phrases.example: Coastal wetlands absorb carbon dioxide at a rate far exceeding that of open ocean water.
phrases.example_translation: 沿海湿地吸收二氧化碳的速率远高于开阔海域。

phrases.usage: 后接 in 指明介质，指某环境中的二氧化碳浓度，实验与地学常用
phrases.example: Ice cores reveal how carbon dioxide concentration in the air changed over hundreds of thousands of years.
phrases.example_translation: 冰芯揭示了数十万年来空气中二氧化碳浓度的变化。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指排放二氧化碳，工业、交通与环境报道高频
phrases.example: Older engines emit carbon dioxide and other pollutants at levels modern standards no longer permit.
phrases.example_translation: 老旧发动机排放的二氧化碳及其他污染物已超出当代标准允许的水平。

phrases.usage: 作主语的常用搭配，指二氧化碳含量，科普与新闻文本高频
phrases.example: Carbon dioxide levels inside the unventilated classroom rose sharply during the long winter sessions.
phrases.example_translation: 在通风不良的教室里，二氧化碳浓度在漫长的冬季课程中急剧上升。

phrases.usage: 生物学科术语，二氧化碳固定，光合作用与碳循环章节核心概念
phrases.example: Carbon dioxide fixation in marine algae depends on enzymes that operate efficiently at low gas concentrations.
phrases.example_translation: 海洋藻类的二氧化碳固定依赖于在低气体浓度下仍能高效运作的酶。

phrases.usage: 医学与安全高频搭配，一氧化碳中毒，事故报道常用
phrases.example: Improvised heating inside the tent caused carbon monoxide poisoning among the exhausted climbers.
phrases.example_translation: 帐篷内临时设置的取暖装置导致几位精疲力竭的登山者一氧化碳中毒。

phrases.usage: 家居安全与建筑规范术语，一氧化碳报警器
phrases.example: Fire regulations now require a carbon monoxide detector beside every bedroom in new dwellings.
phrases.example_translation: 消防规范如今要求新住宅每间卧室旁都安装一氧化碳报警器。

phrases.usage: 监测指标搭配，一氧化碳浓度，矿井与实验室安全文本常用
phrases.example: Sensors logged carbon monoxide levels in the tunnel at the start of every work shift.
phrases.example_translation: 传感器在每个工作班次开始时记录隧道内的一氧化碳浓度。

phrases.usage: 环境工程搭配，一氧化碳排放，机动车尾气研究高频
phrases.example: Catalytic converters sharply reduced the carbon monoxide emissions from the entire vehicle fleet.
phrases.example_translation: 催化转化器大幅降低了整个车队的一氧化碳排放量。

phrases.usage: 后接 for，指对一氧化碳的亲和力，生化机制解释常用
phrases.example: Hemoglobin's stronger affinity for carbon monoxide explains why minor leaks cause severe symptoms.
phrases.example_translation: 血红蛋白对一氧化碳更强的亲和力解释了为何轻微泄漏也会造成严重症状。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，产生一氧化碳，指燃料不完全燃烧
phrases.example: A blocked flue produces carbon monoxide that accumulates quietly in tightly sealed rooms.
phrases.example_translation: 堵塞的烟道会产生一氧化碳，并悄然积聚在密闭的房间里。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，致命的一氧化碳，安全警示与救援叙事常用
phrases.example: Firefighters warned that lethal carbon monoxide can linger in a room long after the flames die.
phrases.example_translation: 消防员警告，火焰熄灭后致命的一氧化碳仍可在房间中长时间残留。

translations.translation: （人或动物的）尸体；残骸；（除脏去头备食用的）畜体

phrases.usage: 形容词修饰名词，指“腐烂的尸体”，自然或罪案描写常见
phrases.example: A rotting carcass lay beside the highway, picked clean by crows and circling vultures.
phrases.example_translation: 一具腐烂的动物尸体躺在公路旁，已被乌鸦和盘旋的秃鹫啄食干净。

phrases.usage: of + 名词，喻指“船的残骸”，用于灾难或沉船描写
phrases.example: Divers carefully explored the rusted carcass of a ship that sank off the rocky cape.
phrases.example_translation: 潜水员仔细探查了那艘在嶙峋海角外沉没、锈迹斑斑的船体残骸。

phrases.usage: 过去分词修饰名词，指“烧毁后的空壳”，多用于建筑或车辆
phrases.example: Firefighters surveyed the blackened carcass of a warehouse after the blaze was contained.
phrases.example_translation: 大火被控制后，消防员勘查了仓库烧剩的焦黑残骸。

phrases.usage: 行业术语，指“屠宰后的牛胴体”，见食品加工文本
phrases.example: The inspector examined each beef carcass for signs of disease before it left the plant.
phrases.example_translation: 检验员在牛胴体出厂前逐一检查，查看是否有病害迹象。

phrases.usage: 动词 + 宾语 + of，指“将残骸上某物尽数剥离”
phrases.example: Scavengers over the winter stripped the old carcass of every useful metal part.
phrases.example_translation: 整个冬天，拾荒者把那辆旧车的残骸上每一块可用的金属部件都拆走了。

phrases.usage: 动词 + at + 宾语，指“啄食、翻食尸体”，多写食腐动物
phrases.example: A pair of vultures picked at the deer carcass beside the dry riverbed.
phrases.example_translation: 两只秃鹫在干涸河床边啄食着一头鹿的尸体。

phrases.usage: of + 名词，指“鲸的尸体”，自然科学与环保报道常用
phrases.example: Scientists studied the gases released as the beached carcass of a whale decayed.
phrases.example_translation: 科学家研究了搁浅鲸鱼尸体在腐解过程中释放的气体。

translations.translation: 心脏的；心脏病的；贲门的

phrases.usage: 医学术语，指心脏骤停，公共健康与新闻文本高频
phrases.example: A bystander began chest compressions within a minute of the cardiac arrest.
phrases.example_translation: 心脏骤停发生不到一分钟，一名旁观者便开始了胸外按压。

phrases.usage: 生理学术语，指心肌，教材与科普文章常用
phrases.example: Cardiac muscle contracts rhythmically without the conscious control that skeletal muscle requires.
phrases.example_translation: 心肌有节奏地收缩，而不需要骨骼肌那种意识控制。

phrases.usage: 生理学术语，指心脏每分钟泵出的血量
phrases.example: Regular aerobic training can raise a patient's cardiac output during moderate effort.
phrases.example_translation: 规律的有氧训练能够提高患者在中等强度运动时的心输出量。

phrases.usage: 学科名搭配，指心脏外科，医院与医学报道语境
phrases.example: The hospital's cardiac surgery unit performed two hundred valve repairs last year.
phrases.example_translation: 该院心脏外科病区去年完成了二百例瓣膜修复手术。

phrases.usage: 动词搭配，指突发心脏骤停，新闻讣告与医学叙述常用
phrases.example: The former runner suffered a cardiac arrest while walking his daily loop.
phrases.example_translation: 那位昔日长跑者在走每日固定路线时突发心脏骤停。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指心脏专科医生，就诊与转诊语境
phrases.example: The school nurse arranged for a cardiac specialist to review the athlete's records.
phrases.example_translation: 校医安排了一名心脏专科医生复核那名运动员的病历。

translations.translation: 红衣主教；枢机主教；鲜红色；【鸟类】(北美)主红雀
主要的，基本的；深红色的

phrases.usage: 取“主要的”义，宗教源流转用于比喻致命错误，评论高频
phrases.example: To duplicate sources seemed, in this seminar, a cardinal sin of scholarship.
phrases.example_translation: 在这个研讨班上，重复引用文献似乎被视为治学的头号禁忌。

phrases.usage: 数学术语，指基数，与序数 ordinal numbers 对照讲解
phrases.example: Cardinal numbers count objects, while ordinal numbers express position in a sequence.
phrases.example_translation: 基数用来计数对象，序数则表示在序列中的位置。

phrases.usage: 固定地理表达，指东南西北四个基本方位，测绘用语
phrases.example: The survey team recorded bearings relative to the four cardinal directions from the old station.
phrases.example_translation: 测量队以旧观测点为基准，按四个基本方位记录方位角。

phrases.usage: 介词短语作后置定语，指头等重要，法律与学术评议正式语
phrases.example: The judge treated procedural fairness as a matter of cardinal importance throughout the trial.
phrases.example_translation: 在整个审判过程中，法官都把程序公正视为头等大事。

phrases.usage: 名词义指红衣主教，教会史与政治叙事中的主体用法
phrases.example: The cardinal withdrew from court politics after the pope named his successor.
phrases.example_translation: 教皇任命继任者之后，这位枢机主教退出了宫廷政治。

phrases.usage: 名词义指北美红雀，鸟类观察文本常用 male 区分羽色
phrases.example: A male cardinal guarded the hedgerow where the seeds had fallen that autumn.
phrases.example_translation: 一只雄性主红雀守着那年秋天种子撒落的树篱。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指基本原则，实验室与行业规范文体常见
phrases.example: Every laboratory follows a cardinal rule about logging each instrument reading during the run.
phrases.example_translation: 每个实验室都遵循一条基本规则：运行期间记录每次仪器读数。

phrases.usage: 动宾加of结构，指为某人画漫画像，街头与报章语境
phrases.example: At the market he drew a caricature of the mayor in two swift minutes.
phrases.example_translation: 在集市上，他用飞快的两分钟画了一幅市长的漫画像。

phrases.usage: 动词用法，后接as加形象，指把某人漫画化成某种样子
phrases.example: The satirical journal caricatured the reformer as a donkey burdened with ledgers.
phrases.example_translation: 那份讽刺刊物把改革者画成了一头驮满账本的驴。

phrases.usage: 被动结构，指被简化为漫画式的脸谱，批评扁平化描写
phrases.example: Complex opponents were reduced to caricature in the pamphlets of both camps.
phrases.example_translation: 在阵营双方的宣传册里，复杂的对手都被简化成了漫画式的丑角。

phrases.usage: 形容词修饰结构，指善意的夸张描摹，褒义评论用语
phrases.example: His own account of village life is an affectionate caricature that never mocks the weak.
phrases.example_translation: 他讲述自己乡村生活的文字是一幅饱含温情的漫画，从不嘲弄弱者。

phrases.usage: 名词修饰搭配，指政治讽刺画，艺术史与传媒研究术语
phrases.example: The exhibition traced a century of political caricature in the popular press.
phrases.example_translation: 这场展览梳理了大众报刊一个世纪以来的政治讽刺画。

phrases.usage: 形容词biting修饰，指辛辣的讽刺描摹，评论文体常用
phrases.example: The essay is a biting caricature of committee culture, and every chairman recognizes himself.
phrases.example_translation: 这篇文章是对委员会文化的辛辣讽刺画，每位主任都能从中认出自己。

phrases.usage: 战争评论与反战文学中的高频搭配，指战争的屠戮
phrases.example: The novel refuses to sentimentalize the carnage of war, showing instead the confusion and fear of ordinary soldiers.
phrases.example_translation: 这部小说拒绝把战争屠戮感伤化，转而呈现普通士兵的慌乱与恐惧。

phrases.usage: 描写战场或灾难现场的搭配，常与 found/witnessed 连用
phrases.example: Rescuers reached the valley and found a scene of carnage, with debris scattered for hundreds of metres.
phrases.example_translation: 救援人员赶到山谷，映入眼帘的是一片屠场般的景象，碎石狼藉数百米。

phrases.usage: 动词搭配，指目睹屠杀惨状，常见于记者、士兵、医生的叙述
phrases.example: Few medics witnessed the carnage of the earthquake and yet returned to their posts so calmly.
phrases.example_translation: 很少有那么几位医护人员目睹了地震的惨烈杀戮，还能如此平静地回到岗位。

phrases.usage: 社论与呼吁语境套语，指停止屠戮
phrases.example: Editorials across the country demanded that both sides stop the carnage and reopen negotiations immediately.
phrases.example_translation: 全国各地的社论要求双方停止屠戮并立即重启谈判。

phrases.usage: sheer 强调规模之大，指纯粹的杀戮场面，常见于感情强烈的评论
phrases.example: What struck the visitors most was not the size of the battlefield but the sheer carnage recorded in its field hospitals.
phrases.example_translation: 最令访客震撼的不是战场的规模，而是野战医院记录下的那份触目惊心的杀戮。

phrases.usage: 后置 of-phrase 变体，以 on a vast scale 修饰，强调屠戮的规模
phrases.example: Drone warfare has raised troubling questions about whether carnage on a vast scale can be made to seem distant and clean.
phrases.example_translation: 无人机战争提出了令人不安的问题：大规模屠戮能否被包装得遥远而干净。

phrases.usage: 媒体批评语境，指新闻中连日不断的杀戮
phrases.example: Evening news had grown numb to the daily carnage, reducing whole provinces to a single statistic.
phrases.example_translation: 晚间新闻已对连日的杀戮麻木不仁，把整个省份简化成一个统计数字。

translations.translation: 肉体的；肉欲的；淫荡的；性欲的

phrases.usage: 形名核心搭配，指“肉欲、情欲”，宗教哲学与文学语体，庄重
phrases.example: The monastery's rule demanded that novices renounce worldly and carnal desires alike.
phrases.example_translation: 修道院院规要求初学修士同样弃绝世俗与肉体的欲望。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指“感官肉体的享乐”，常含道德评判色彩
phrases.example: Rabelais celebrates carnal pleasures of food, drink and laughter without the least apology.
phrases.example_translation: 拉伯雷毫无歉意地歌颂饮食欢笑这些感官享乐。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指“肉体的欲望”，道德神学讨论术语
phrases.example: Sermons of the period warned that unchecked carnal appetite gradually corroded the soul.
phrases.example_translation: 那个时代的布道警告说，不受节制的肉欲会渐渐腐蚀灵魂。

phrases.usage: 古法律固定术语，婉指“性行为”，今仅见于法律史文本
phrases.example: The statute's archaic phrase carnal knowledge still appears in some legal history dictionaries.
phrases.example_translation: 法令中那个古雅的“carnal knowledge”一词至今仍见于某些法律史词典。

phrases.usage: 并列对照用法，指“肉体与灵魂”，宗教哲学话语的张力对子
phrases.example: Augustine wrestled all his life with the pull between carnal and spiritual loyalties.
phrases.example_translation: 奥古斯丁终其一生都在肉体与灵性忠诚之间的撕扯中挣扎。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指“属肉体的心智”，布道与经文语域常见
phrases.example: The preacher argued that a carnal mind mistakes temporary appetite for eternal truth.
phrases.example_translation: 牧师认为，属肉体的心智会把一时的欲望误认为永恒的真理。

phrases.usage: 生态学术语，顶级食肉动物，食物网与再野化讨论的核心词
phrases.example: As an apex carnivore, the wolf reshapes the entire food web of the valley.
phrases.example_translation: 作为顶级食肉动物，狼重塑了整条山谷的食物网。

phrases.usage: 生物学术语，专性食肉动物，须以肉为食，与犬猫比较常用
phrases.example: Unlike dogs, cats are obligate carnivores that cannot thrive on plant protein alone.
phrases.example_translation: 与狗不同，猫是专性食肉动物，仅靠植物蛋白无法繁盛。

phrases.usage: 保护生物学习惯说法，大型食肉动物，人兽冲突政策语境
phrases.example: Reserves hosting large carnivores require buffer zones where grazing is carefully regulated.
phrases.example_translation: 栖息着大型食肉动物的保护区需要放牧严格管控的缓冲带。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，重新引入本地灭绝的肉食动物，生态伦理辩题
phrases.example: Officials debated whether to reintroduce carnivores that had vanished from the range a century earlier.
phrases.example_translation: 官员们争论是否重新引入一个世纪前从这片山脉消失的食肉动物。

phrases.usage: 被动分类句式，按分类学归为食肉动物，饮食与分类反差常用于举例
phrases.example: The giant panda, classified as a carnivore by taxonomists, subsists almost wholly on bamboo shoots.
phrases.example_translation: 大熊猫在分类学家眼中属食肉动物，却几乎完全以竹笋为食。

phrases.usage: 古生物定语搭配，化石肉食动物，鉴定与地层叙述语境
phrases.example: The isolated tooth identified the Devonian specimen as a fossil carnivore of the ancient seas.
phrases.example_translation: 这颗单独的牙齿将该泥盆纪标本鉴定为远古海洋中的一种化石食肉动物。

phrases.usage: 食肉植物，生物学最著名搭配，捕蝇草、猪笼草等语境
phrases.example: A carnivorous plant such as the Venus flytrap lures insects with sweet-smelling nectar.
phrases.example_translation: 捕蝇草一类的食肉植物用芳香的蜜汁引诱昆虫。

phrases.usage: 副词 strictly 强调纯肉食性，解剖与食性讨论常用
phrases.example: Though anatomically strictly carnivorous, the giant panda subsists almost entirely on bamboo shoots.
phrases.example_translation: 大熊猫在解剖结构上本是严格的肉食性动物，却几乎只靠竹笋为生。

phrases.usage: 肉食性恐龙，古生物学科普与博物馆文本高频
phrases.example: Fossils suggest that a carnivorous dinosaur with blade-like teeth stalked the old riverbank at dusk.
phrases.example_translation: 化石表明，一种长着刀刃般利齿的肉食性恐龙曾于黄昏时分在古老河岸边潜行捕猎。

phrases.usage: 肉食性饮食，常与纯肉、消化道结构等表述连用
phrases.example: A purely carnivorous diet has shaped the short digestive tract of the domestic ferret.
phrases.example_translation: 纯粹的肉食性饮食塑造了雪貂短促的消化道。

phrases.usage: 肉食性鱼类，渔业生态与湖泊调查语体常见
phrases.example: The pike, a voracious carnivorous fish, usually ambushes smaller prey among the reeds of quiet lakes.
phrases.example_translation: 狗鱼是一种贪婪的肉食性鱼类，常在静湖的芦苇间伏击小鱼。

phrases.usage: 副词 highly 修饰，以肉食为主，描述兼食腐动物的食性偏向
phrases.example: Although they also scavenge, spotted hyenas remain highly carnivorous and hunt in coordinated packs.
phrases.example_translation: 尽管也食腐，斑鬣狗仍是高度肉食性的动物，会成群协同捕猎。

translations.translation: 喧闹的酒会或宴会；一饮而尽

phrases.usage: 动词后接 with 加人，指与某人痛饮狂欢，书面语含放纵色彩
phrases.example: University graduates caroused with the neighbors until dawn after the final examination ended.
phrases.example_translation: 期末考试结束后，毕业生们与邻居畅饮狂欢直到天明。

phrases.usage: 动词加时间状语，指通宵欢宴，叙述节庆或颓放场景
phrases.example: They caroused through the night beneath lanterns strung along the old harbor wall.
phrases.example_translation: 他们就在沿旧港墙高挂的灯笼下通宵欢饮。

phrases.usage: 名词用法，指狂欢之夜，回忆录与文学笔法常见
phrases.example: A decade later he still recalled one night of carouse as his last carefree hour.
phrases.example_translation: 十年之后，他仍把某一个狂欢之夜视作自己最后的无忧时光。

phrases.usage: 动词并列搭配，指寻欢作乐、纵情痛饮，史述与讽喻常用
phrases.example: Courtiers would revel and carouse while the realm's accounts quietly slid into ruin.
phrases.example_translation: 朝臣们纵情宴饮作乐，王国的账目却在悄然间滑向崩溃。

phrases.usage: 动词加地点介词，指在酒馆狂欢，历史与小说叙述常用
phrases.example: Retired clerks still carouse at the tavern where the union was first organized.
phrases.example_translation: 退休的老职员们仍在那间工会最初成立时的酒馆里畅饮狂欢。

phrases.usage: 名词用法，指一段纵情欢宴的时光，传记与评论笔调
phrases.example: The candid memoir confesses a season of carouse that ended in debt and solitude.
phrases.example_translation: 这本坦率的回忆录坦承了一段以欠债与孤独收场的狂欢岁月。

phrases.usage: feed on 加腐食对象，指以腐肉为食，生态与动物学说明的核心搭配
phrases.example: Foxes and ravens feed on carrion left by hunters, cleaning the hillside within days.
phrases.example_translation: 狐狸和渡鸦以猎人留下的腐肉为食，几天内便清理了整片山坡。

phrases.usage: 名词作定语，carrion birds 指食腐鸟类，如秃鹫，自然写作常用类别词
phrases.example: Carrion birds gathered high on thermals, their circles narrowing above the dry plain.
phrases.example_translation: 食腐鸟类乘着热气流高飞盘旋，圆圈渐渐收缩在干旱荒原上空。

phrases.usage: 学科类别搭配，carrion beetles 即尸食性甲虫，生物学文本的标准术语
phrases.example: Carrion beetles bury small carcasses, a habit that shaped whole ecosystems of decay.
phrases.example_translation: 尸食性甲虫会掩埋小型尸体，这一习性塑造了整套分解生态系统。

phrases.usage: of 短语表属性，the stench of carrion 指腐肉的恶臭，多用于现场描写
phrases.example: Travelers reported the stench of carrion miles before sighting the stranded herd.
phrases.example_translation: 旅行者在看到搁浅的兽群前几英里就闻到腐肉的恶臭。

phrases.usage: 物种专名搭配，carrion crow 即小嘴乌鸦，鸟类学记录中的固定名称
phrases.example: The carrion crow differs from the rook by its hoarse, grinding call.
phrases.example_translation: 小嘴乌鸦与秃鼻乌鸦的区别在于其粗哑摩擦般的叫声。

phrases.usage: 解剖学术语搭配，关节面软骨，医学与运动科学文本的标准说法
phrases.example: Repeated impact can erode articular cartilage long before pain appears.
phrases.example_translation: 反复撞击早在疼痛出现之前就会侵蚀关节软骨。

phrases.usage: 部位搭配，鼻软骨，法医、人类学与手术描述常用
phrases.example: The surgeon reshaped the nasal cartilage to restore the patient's breathing.
phrases.example_translation: 外科医生重塑鼻软骨，以恢复患者的呼吸功能。

phrases.usage: 学科复合搭配，软骨再生，研究文献里常与 limited 并现
phrases.example: Because cartilage regeneration proceeds slowly, athletes often require repeated procedures.
phrases.example_translation: 由于软骨再生进展缓慢，运动员往往需要反复接受治疗。

phrases.usage: 过去分词修饰，磨蚀变薄的软骨，临床叙事中的常见意象
phrases.example: The scan revealed worn cartilage along the inner edge of the knee joint.
phrases.example_translation: 扫描显示膝关节内侧的软骨已被磨蚀变薄。

phrases.phrase: the cartilage of the rib cage
phrases.usage: of 属格结构，胸廓软骨，生物教材描述骨骼构造时的句式
phrases.example: The cartilage of the rib cage flexes with every breath, then slowly stiffens with age.
phrases.example_translation: 胸廓的软骨随每一次呼吸而舒展，又随年龄增长逐渐硬化。

phrases.usage: of 结构名短语，软骨流失，疾病进展与老龄化研究的高频说法
phrases.example: Progressive loss of cartilage defines the earliest stage of the arthritis.
phrases.example_translation: 软骨的进行性流失正是这种关节炎最早期的特征。

phrases.usage: early 限定时代序列，科学史与档案叙述常用
phrases.example: The archive attributes the 1527 chart to an early cartographer working in Lisbon.
phrases.example_translation: 档案馆认为这张 1527 年的海图出自一位在里斯本工作的早期制图师之手。

phrases.usage: 并列身份名词，零冠词，传记中概括人物的双重角色
phrases.example: The expedition honored its patron as cartographer and explorer, though only the maps survive.
phrases.example_translation: 考察队尊赞助人为制图师兼探险家，尽管留存下来的只有那些地图。

phrases.usage: 形容词 + 名词的性格定性，褒义，强调工艺严谨
phrases.example: A meticulous cartographer will verify each coastline before committing ink to the engraved plate.
phrases.example_translation: 一丝不苟的制图师会在落墨刻版之前逐一核实每段海岸线。

phrases.usage: 所有格 + 名词，指制图作坊，行业史与艺术史语境
phrases.example: In the cartographer's workshop, apprentices copied coastlines by candlelight for a decade.
phrases.example_translation: 在制图师的作坊里，学徒们借着烛光描摹海岸线，一干就是十年。

phrases.usage: 时代限定词搭配，讨论古地图观念时高频出现
phrases.example: The medieval cartographer placed Jerusalem at the center of the world map.
phrases.example_translation: 那位中世纪制图师把耶路撒冷画在了世界地图的中心。

phrases.usage: 动宾结构含所有格，指揭露制图失误，科史叙述常用
phrases.example: Modern surveyors eventually exposed a cartographer's error that had steered ships onto rocks.
phrases.example_translation: 现代测量员最终查明了某位制图师的一处差错——正是它把船只引向暗礁。

translations.translation: 弹药筒，打印机的（墨盒）；[摄] 暗盒；笔芯；一卷软片

phrases.usage: 名名搭配，指打印机墨盒，办公与日常语境，该词最常见实物义
phrases.example: The printer warned that the ink cartridge had failed, halting two hundred exam papers halfway.
phrases.example_translation: 打印机提示墨盒故障，两百份试卷印到一半就停了。

phrases.usage: 摄影语境搭配，指胶卷暗盒，历史档案类文章常见
phrases.example: Examined decades later, the recovered film cartridge redrew the chronology of the expedition.
phrases.example_translation: 数十年后重新检验，那卷寻回的胶卷暗盒改写了探险队的时间线。

phrases.usage: 法律与现场勘查语境搭配，指击发后遗留的空弹壳
phrases.example: A spent cartridge found near the gate became the central exhibit of the trial.
phrases.example_translation: 在门边发现的一枚空弹壳成了这次庭审的核心物证。

phrases.usage: 影视道具与安全规范搭配，指不含弹头的空包弹
phrases.example: The props master insisted that only a blank cartridge could be loaded on stage.
phrases.example_translation: 道具师坚持舞台上只能装填空包弹。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指装入胶卷或墨盒，操作说明常用
phrases.example: The technician demonstrated how to insert the cartridge without touching the exposed film.
phrases.example_translation: 技术员示范如何装入胶卷暗盒而不碰到裸露的胶片。

phrases.usage: 信息技术搭配，指磁带数据盒，用于长期存档
phrases.example: Archivists migrated the recordings onto a newer data cartridge before the old format became unreadable.
phrases.example_translation: 档案员在旧格式无法读取之前，把录音转移到了更新的磁带盒上。

translations.translation: （印度社会中的）种姓；（具有严格等级差别的）社会地位；（排他的）社会团体

phrases.usage: 最核心搭配，种姓制度，社会学和历史学科高频
phrases.example: The caste system has shaped social hierarchies in South Asia for millennia.
phrases.example_translation: 种姓制度数千年来一直塑造着南亚的社会等级秩序。

phrases.usage: 法律和社会议题常用搭配，种姓歧视
phrases.example: Laws against caste discrimination remain difficult to enforce in many rural districts.
phrases.example_translation: 禁止种姓歧视的法律在许多农村地区仍然难以执行。

phrases.usage: 指高种姓阶层，描述社会分层时的常用搭配
phrases.example: Historically, upper caste families monopolized access to formal religious education.
phrases.example_translation: 历史上，高种姓家族垄断了接受正规宗教教育的机会。

phrases.usage: 种姓壁垒，描述社会流动性的障碍
phrases.example: The reformer devoted his life to dismantling the caste barrier in public education.
phrases.example_translation: 这位改革家毕生致力于消除公共教育中的种姓壁垒。

phrases.usage: 社会学概念，种姓认同，身份政治研究常见
phrases.example: Electoral politics in the region remains profoundly shaped by caste identity.
phrases.example_translation: 该地区的选举政治仍然深受种姓认同的影响。

phrases.usage: 超越种姓界限，常用于平权运动语境
phrases.example: The organization envisions a civic society organized beyond caste and class divisions.
phrases.example_translation: 该组织设想建立一个超越种姓和阶级划分的公民社会。

phrases.usage: 复合形容词，基于种姓的，学术和政策文件常见
phrases.example: The survey revealed persistent caste-based disparities in access to healthcare.
phrases.example_translation: 调查显示，在获得医疗方面存在持续的基于种姓的差异。

phrases.usage: 后接 for 引出原因，指因某事严厉惩处或苛责，最典型的动词框架
phrases.example: The editorial castigated the minister for the delays that plagued the public housing project.
phrases.example_translation: 社论就保障房项目久拖不决严词痛斥那位部长。

phrases.usage: 副动搭配，指严厉谴责，评论与书评类文体常用
phrases.example: Historians have severely castigated the administration for dismantling the earlier reform program.
phrases.example_translation: 历史学家曾严厉抨击该政府拆除早前的改革计划。

phrases.usage: 副动搭配，强调当众斥责，常用于政治与职场场景，带负面色彩
phrases.example: Rather than address the error privately, the manager publicly castigated the junior analyst at the staff meeting.
phrases.example_translation: 经理没有私下指正错误，而是在员工会议上当众痛斥那位初级分析师。

phrases.usage: 反身用法，指过度自责，心理学文本与叙事中常见
phrases.example: She tended to castigate herself for every small oversight, long after colleagues had forgiven her.
phrases.example_translation: 同事早已原谅她，她却仍为每一个小疏忽深深自责。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，宾语多为身居其位者，SAT 评论类语境高频
phrases.example: The grand jury report did not hesitate to castigate a public official who ignored repeated warnings.
phrases.example_translation: 大陪审团报告毫不迟疑地痛斥了那位无视多次警告的公职人员。

phrases.usage: 动宾套 of 结构，指抨击某事物的过分之处，长篇评论用语
phrases.example: Late Victorian writers loved to castigate the excesses of industrial capitalism in serialized essays.
phrases.example_translation: 维多利亚晚期作家喜欢在连载散文中痛斥工业资本主义的种种过分行径。

translations.translation: 随便的；非正式的；临时的；偶然的
便装；临时工人；待命士兵

phrases.usage: 形容词修饰名词，指非正式的着装，常见于校园与职场通知
phrases.example: The invitation specified casual attire, so most guests arrived in jeans and loafers.
phrases.example_translation: 请帖注明便装出席，因此多数客人穿着牛仔裤和乐福鞋到场。

phrases.usage: 固定形名搭配，指外行或浅层旁观者，评论文体常见
phrases.example: To the casual observer, the renovation seems finished, but several floors remain incomplete.
phrases.example_translation: 在外行观察者看来，装修似乎已经完成，但还有几层尚未完工。

phrases.usage: 后接 about 加名词，表示对某事满不在乎、态度随意
phrases.example: He is casual about deadlines, which frustrates teammates who plan their week carefully.
phrases.example_translation: 他对截止日期满不在乎，这让那些认真规划一周的成员感到沮丧。

phrases.usage: 名词作定语，指临时工或零工，社会科学文本常见
phrases.example: Farmers rely on casual labor during the harvest, when demand for workers peaks.
phrases.example_translation: 农忙时节农民依赖临时工，因为那时对劳动力的需求达到高峰。

phrases.usage: 指偶然的相遇，强调非计划性，叙事与书面皆可用
phrases.example: A casual encounter at the library led to a decade-long collaboration between the two historians.
phrases.example_translation: 图书馆里的一次偶遇，让这两位历史学家开启了长达十年的合作。

phrases.usage: 介词短语作状语，指以随意的语气说话或写作
phrases.example: She dismissed the rumor in a casual tone, as though it were beneath her notice.
phrases.example_translation: 她以随意的语气否定了那则谣言，仿佛根本不屑一顾。

phrases.phrase: a casual wave of the hand
phrases.usage: 描绘漫不经心的挥手动作，含轻率或洒脱之意
phrases.example: He brushed off the question with a casual wave of the hand and changed the subject.
phrases.example_translation: 他只是随意挥了挥手，便把这个问题搪塞过去，随即转移了话题。

translations.translation: 意外事故；伤亡人员；急诊室

phrases.usage: 后接 of 表归属，字面与比喻两解，叙事与评论常见
phrases.example: The novel follows a farmer who becomes an unwilling casualty of war.
phrases.example_translation: 小说讲述一位农民身不由己沦为战争牺牲品的经历。

phrases.usage: 形容词修饰复数，平民伤亡惨重，新闻与军政文本
phrases.example: The bombardment caused heavy civilian casualties and emptied the district within days.
phrases.example_translation: 轰炸造成大量平民伤亡，几天之内这一区便人去楼空。

phrases.usage: 统计搭配，伤亡率，军事医学与流行病学语境
phrases.example: Sanitation reforms lowered the casualty rate among troops far more than new weapons did.
phrases.example_translation: 卫生改革降低军队伤亡率的程度，远远超过新式武器。

phrases.usage: 比喻用法，改革进程中的牺牲者，社科评论高频
phrases.example: Many veteran clerks counted themselves casualties of the reforms that automated their work.
phrases.example_translation: 许多老职员把自己看作那场把工作自动化的改革的牺牲者。

phrases.usage: 形容词修饰，伤亡轻微，战报与灾情通报用语
phrases.example: Despite the ferocity of the storm, the harbor recorded remarkably light casualties.
phrases.example_translation: 尽管风暴来势凶猛，港口记录的伤亡却出奇地轻。

phrases.usage: 英式医疗搭配，急诊病房，医院场景描写
phrases.example: Nurses in the casualty ward worked through the night after the factory explosion.
phrases.example_translation: 工厂爆炸之后，急诊病房的护士们通宵工作。

phrases.usage: 后接 of，最新的一个牺牲品，评论式引申
phrases.example: The collapsed bridge is the latest casualty of a decade of deferred maintenance.
phrases.example_translation: 这座坍塌的桥，是十年维护拖延的最新牺牲品。

phrases.usage: 名名搭配，生化术语，指蛋白质分解代谢，科研文本常见于主题前置
phrases.example: Protein catabolism accelerates during prolonged fasting and severe illness.
phrases.example_translation: 在长时间禁食和重症期间蛋白质分解代谢会加快。

phrases.usage: 后接 of + 底物，描述特定分子被分解的过程，代谢通路描述常用
phrases.example: The catabolism of glucose releases energy stored in chemical bonds.
phrases.example_translation: 葡萄糖的分解代谢释放出化学键中储存的能量。

phrases.usage: 并列术语，指分解代谢与合成代谢两条相反途径，教材对照性表述
phrases.example: The lecture contrasted catabolism and anabolism as two halves of metabolism.
phrases.example_translation: 讲座把分解代谢与合成代谢作为新陈代谢的两个方面加以对照。

phrases.usage: 介词搭配，用于量化分解代谢速度，实验报告常见
phrases.example: Researchers measured the rate of catabolism under controlled temperature.
phrases.example_translation: 研究人员在受控温度下测量了分解代谢速率。

phrases.usage: 主谓句式，描述应激状态下分解代谢上升的生理规律
phrases.example: Catabolism increases during stress, drawing on muscle reserves.
phrases.example_translation: 应激状态下分解代谢增强，消耗肌肉储备。

translations.translation: 灾难；大洪水，地震；（社会政治的）大变动

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指政治大变动或政治灾难，历史评论比喻性高频
phrases.example: The tariff collapse proved a political cataclysm, sweeping two ruling families from office.
phrases.example_translation: 关税体系的崩溃被证明是一场政治浩劫，将两个执政家族一举赶下台。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指洪水、地震等自然巨变，灾害与地质书写正式用语
phrases.example: Coastal island residents rehearsed evacuation routes every year against the next natural cataclysm.
phrases.example_translation: 沿海岛屿居民每年演练撤离路线，以防备下一次自然巨变。

phrases.usage: 介词短语，指濒临大灾难，用于战争与经济危机前的紧张时刻描写
phrases.example: Europe teetered on the brink of cataclysm through the summer of 1914.
phrases.example_translation: 整个1914年夏天，欧洲都在大浩劫的边缘摇摇欲坠。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，precipitate 指促成、引发，强调小事引爆全局灾难
phrases.example: Careful diplomats feared the minor border incident might precipitate a far wider cataclysm.
phrases.example_translation: 谨慎的外交官们担心这桩边境小事件可能引发一场波及远为更广的大灾难。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指躲避灭顶之灾，常与政策或侥幸语境相联
phrases.example: The reserve policy helped the town avoid cataclysm during the banking panic.
phrases.example_translation: 储备金政策帮助这座小镇在银行风潮中免于灭顶之灾。

phrases.usage: 所属加介词结构，指大灾难的善后期，灾后重建与史学叙事常用
phrases.example: Rebuilding reshaped the harbor city for a full generation in the cataclysm's aftermath.
phrases.example_translation: 在这场大灾难的善后时期，重建整整重塑了这座港口城市一代人的面貌。

phrases.usage: 图情领域搭配，指图书馆馆藏目录，检索与编目语境的基本名词
phrases.example: The graduate student searched the library catalog for the curator's unpublished letters.
phrases.example_translation: 那名研究生在图书馆目录中检索那位馆长未曾公开发表的信件。

phrases.usage: 动词用法，指给标本登记造目，博物馆与科考记录的标准流程用语
phrases.example: Volunteers helped catalog the specimens gathered during the three-month coral reef survey.
phrases.example_translation: 志愿者们协助登记了为期三个月的珊瑚礁调查所采集的标本。

phrases.usage: 动介搭配，by 引出分类标准，指按某依据编目登录
phrases.example: New curators catalog the donated coins by date, mint mark and condition.
phrases.example_translation: 新任馆员按年代、铸造厂印记和品相为捐赠的钱币编目登录。

phrases.usage: 介词搭配，指收录于目录之中，鉴定与档案核验语境常用
phrases.example: Because the painting appears nowhere in the official catalog, its provenance remains contested.
phrases.example_translation: 由于官方目录里根本找不到这幅画，它的流传经历一直存在争议。

phrases.usage: 隐喻搭配，指一长串问题的清单，事故调查与评论文体常用
phrases.example: The inquiry produced a bleak catalog of failures behind the collapse of the old footbridge.
phrases.example_translation: 调查揭示出一份令人沮丧的清单，列满了那座旧人行桥垮塌背后的一连串失误。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指网络检索目录，数字化档案与公共服务的现代场景
phrases.example: The county archive now maintains an online catalog of baptismal records dating to 1740.
phrases.example_translation: 县档案馆现已建立起网络目录，可检索上溯到 1740 年的洗礼记录。

phrases.usage: 名词作定语，指目录条目，强调编目质量的常见说法
phrases.example: Careless catalog entries written decades earlier made half of the insect collection effectively untraceable.
phrases.example_translation: 几十年前草率录入的目录条目，使半数昆虫标本实际上已无从查考。

phrases.usage: 图书馆学术语，卡片目录，检索史话题常见
phrases.example: Older libraries still store handwritten citations inside the wooden card catalogue downstairs.
phrases.example_translation: 一些老图书馆仍把手抄的引文条目存放在楼下的木制卡片目录柜里。

phrases.usage: 及物动词用法，为藏品编目，博物馆工作核心动词
phrases.example: Interns spent the entire summer systematically cataloguing the museum's ceramic collection for the university archive.
phrases.example_translation: 实习生们花了整个夏天，为大学档案系统地给博物馆的陶瓷藏品编目。

phrases.usage: 表一系列同类事物，a catalogue of failures指问题成串
phrases.example: The audit revealed a catalogue of failures at the aging chemical plant.
phrases.example_translation: 审计揭示出这座年久失修的化工厂一连串的管理失效。

phrases.usage: 商业与数字化语境，线上目录或产品图册
phrases.example: Shoppers now compare prices across every major retailer's online catalogue within minutes.
phrases.example_translation: 顾客如今几分钟内就能在各大零售商的线上目录之间比价。

phrases.usage: 名词修饰名词，目录条目，学术著录语境
phrases.example: A single catalogue entry can transform how scholars date an unsigned painting.
phrases.example_translation: 一条目录条目就可能改变学者为无名画作断代的方式。

phrases.usage: 文献著录搭配，被收入目录，鉴定与拍卖语境常用
phrases.example: The newly found letters appear in the catalogue under a mistaken year.
phrases.example_translation: 新发现的这些信件在目录中被误收入了一个错误的年份之下。

phrases.usage: 后接 for，指引发变革的催化剂，比喻用法高频
phrases.example: The sudden scandal served as an unlikely catalyst for sweeping institutional change.
phrases.example_translation: 这桩突发丑闻成了一场席卷性制度变革出人意料的催化剂。

phrases.usage: 固定搭配，指充当催化剂，化学与社会语境通用
phrases.example: A single enzyme can act as a catalyst, dramatically speeding up a slow biochemical reaction.
phrases.example_translation: 一种酶就能充当催化剂，极大地加快原本缓慢的生化反应。

phrases.usage: 固定搭配，指起到催化作用，正式书面常用
phrases.example: Her generous early grant served as a catalyst for a decade of fruitful research.
phrases.example_translation: 她慷慨的早期资助成了一个多产研究十年的催化剂。

phrases.usage: 后接 for，指推动改革的触发因素，政论常用
phrases.example: The sudden economic crisis became a powerful catalyst for long-delayed political reform.
phrases.example_translation: 这场突发的经济危机成了推动迟来已久的政治改革的强大催化剂。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指生物催化剂，即酶类，生物学术语
phrases.example: Enzymes function as a biological catalyst, lowering the energy needed for cellular reactions.
phrases.example_translation: 酶作为生物催化剂发挥作用，降低了细胞反应所需的能量。

phrases.usage: 后接 in，指在增长中起催化作用，经济分析用语
phrases.example: Heavy infrastructure spending proved a decisive catalyst in the region's remarkable economic growth.
phrases.example_translation: 大规模基建投资被证明是该地区显著经济增长的决定性催化剂。

translations.translation: [眼科] 白内障；大瀑布；暴雨，洪水；奔流

phrases.usage: 名词修饰名词的医学搭配，指白内障摘除手术
phrases.example: Cataract surgery now restores sight in under thirty minutes at a busy outpatient clinic.
phrases.example_translation: 在繁忙的门诊，白内障手术如今三十分钟内即可恢复视力。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配（复数屈折），指患上白内障，医学叙述常用
phrases.example: Long exposure to ultraviolet light can make outdoor workers develop cataracts much earlier.
phrases.example_translation: 长时间接触紫外线会使户外劳动者更早患上白内障。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配取瀑布一义，自然写作中用来描摹水势与声响
phrases.example: A thundering cataract pours down the basalt cliff in the gorge every spring.
phrases.example_translation: 每年春天，一道轰鸣的瀑布从峡谷里的玄武岩峭壁倾泻而下。

phrases.usage: 名词后接 of 表示比喻性的暴雨，文学语域
phrases.example: Cataracts of rain flooded the narrow lane and its stone walls within half an hour.
phrases.example_translation: 倾盆大雨半小时内就淹了那条窄巷及其石墙。

phrases.usage: 眼科义的形名搭配，指晶状体混浊致密、遮挡视线的病变
phrases.example: During the routine exam, the ophthalmologist detected a dense cataract in her left eye.
phrases.example_translation: 常规检查中，眼科医生发现她左眼有密度很高的白内障。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指手术摘除混浊晶体，医疗程序描述
phrases.example: The surgeons removed the clouded cataract and replaced it with a clear plastic lens.
phrases.example_translation: 外科医生摘除了混浊的白内障，并植入一片透明的人工晶体。

phrases.usage: 被动结构后接 by，指视力被白内障遮蔽，文学与医学兼具
phrases.example: His eyes, clouded by cataracts, missed the small sign on the road.
phrases.example_translation: 被白内障模糊的双眼没看见路上的那块小提示牌。

phrases.usage: 及物动词加名词，指在灾祸发生前设法避免，社论与公文高频
phrases.example: Crews averted a catastrophe by draining the reservoir just before the aftershocks.
phrases.example_translation: 工作人员在主震后的余震来临前放空水库，避免了一场灾难。

phrases.usage: 系动态短语，指局势正滑向灾难，含警告意味，评论常用现在进行时
phrases.example: With the aquifers failing each summer, the valley was quietly heading for catastrophe.
phrases.example_translation: 含水层每年夏天都在衰竭，这个山谷正悄然滑向灾难。

phrases.usage: 介词短语作表语或状语，指濒临灾难，叙事与外交语体色彩浓重
phrases.example: Negotiators worked through the night while both economies teetered on the brink of catastrophe.
phrases.example_translation: 谈判者通宵工作，当时两种经济都摇摇欲坠地濒临灾难。

phrases.usage: 形容词加 of 类修饰，特指生态浩劫，环保议题论述的核心搭配
phrases.example: The spill became an environmental catastrophe that closed the fishery for a decade.
phrases.example_translation: 这次泄漏演变成一场环境灾难，让渔场关闭了十年。

phrases.usage: of 加 magnitude 表示规模，多用于事后复盘与预防性论述
phrases.example: Engineers insisted that a catastrophe of this magnitude could not recur without new flaws.
phrases.example_translation: 工程师坚持认为，若没有新的缺陷，如此规模的灾难不可能重演。

phrases.usage: 系动词短语，指事态由小变大转为灾难，强调演变过程
phrases.example: A modest power outage turned into a catastrophe when the refrigerators failed.
phrases.example_translation: 一次普通的停电在冷藏设备失灵后酿成了大祸。

phrases.usage: 介词 for 引出承受者，指对某群体而言是惨败，评论中立场鲜明
phrases.example: The revised tariff proved a catastrophe for small importers along the coast.
phrases.example_translation: 修订后的关税被证明是沿海小型进口商的一场浩劫。

phrases.usage: utter 作强化定语，指彻底的失败，戏剧、赛事或政策的比喻义
phrases.example: The second act collapsed into utter catastrophe, and half the audience left early.
phrases.example_translation: 第二幕彻底溃不成戏，一半观众提前退场。

translations.translation: 灾难的；悲惨的；灾难性的，毁灭性的

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，灾难性故障，工程安全与技术报告核心搭配
phrases.example: Engineers identified a catastrophic failure in the turbine blade before the scheduled test flight.
phrases.example_translation: 工程师在预定试飞前发现了涡轮叶片的一处灾难性故障。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，灾难性后果，评论与学术写作中的警示性用语
phrases.example: Ignoring repeated climate warnings could have catastrophic consequences for densely populated coastal megacities.
phrases.example_translation: 忽视反复发出的气候警告可能给人口稠密的沿海特大城市带来灾难性后果。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，毁灭性洪水，气象灾害报道与地理学术语
phrases.example: Catastrophic flooding displaced thousands of families and destroyed decades of agricultural investment.
phrases.example_translation: 毁灭性的洪水迫使数千个家庭流离失所，摧毁了数十年的农业投入。

phrases.usage: 副形搭配，潜在灾难性的，风险评估与政策文件常用
phrases.example: The report flagged a potentially catastrophic disruption in the supply of rare earth minerals.
phrases.example_translation: 报告指出稀土矿物供应方面可能存在灾难性中断的风险。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，灾难性损失，保险、金融与灾害管理用语
phrases.example: The hurricane caused a catastrophic loss of property along the entire barrier island chain.
phrases.example_translation: 飓风给整条障壁岛链造成了灾难性的财产损失。

phrases.usage: 系表结构 prove plus 形容词，被证明是灾难性的，事后评价
phrases.example: The hastily drafted policy proved catastrophic, triggering inflation beyond the central banks control.
phrases.example_translation: 仓促草拟的政策被证明是灾难性的，引发了央行无法控制的通胀。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，灾难性崩塌，地质与结构工程及比喻用法
phrases.example: Seismologists warned that a catastrophic collapse of the glacier could unleash deadly floods.
phrases.example_translation: 地震学家警告说，冰川的灾难性崩塌可能引发致命洪水。

phrases.usage: 副形搭配，经济上毁灭性的，财经与政策评论用语
phrases.example: The prolonged trade embargo was economically catastrophic for the small island nation.
phrases.example_translation: 旷日持久的贸易禁运令那个小岛屿国家经济遭受毁灭性打击。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指宣泄净化的效果，心理与文艺评论常用
phrases.example: Weekly group singing produced a measurable cathartic effect among the displaced families.
phrases.example_translation: 每周的合唱在流离失所的家庭中产生了可测量的宣泄疗效。

phrases.usage: 核心搭配，指令人释放净化、脱胎换骨的经历
phrases.example: Confessing the long-hidden truth aloud became a strange but cathartic experience for her.
phrases.example_translation: 把深藏已久的真相大声说出来，对她成了一次奇异却痛快淋漓的释放。

phrases.usage: 心理学术语搭配，指情感的宣泄释放，与压抑对举
phrases.example: The public elegy offered a cathartic release that the hurried funeral itself denied.
phrases.example_translation: 那场公开追悼会提供了仓促葬礼本身未能给予的情感宣泄。
