phrases.example: Poets of old imagined gods dwelling in the serene and radiant upper expanse.
phrases.example_translation: 古代诗人想象诸神居住在宁静灿烂的苍穹之上。

translations.translation: 使移居国外；流放，放逐；使放弃国籍

phrases.usage: 动词后接from，指从某地流放或移出，正式语体
phrases.example: The dissident poet was forcibly expatriated from his homeland shortly after the military coup.
phrases.example_translation: 政变之后不久，这位持不同政见的诗人便被强行逐出祖国。

phrases.usage: 动词后接to加地点，指自愿移居某地，文化人自述常用
phrases.example: In his late twenties the young novelist expatriated to Lisbon to write in solitude.
phrases.example_translation: 年近三十时，这位年轻小说家移居里斯本，独自写作。

phrases.usage: 形容词加名词，指侨民群体，社会学与新闻常用
phrases.example: The riverfront district hosts a large expatriate community drawn from more than forty countries.
phrases.example_translation: 滨江街区汇聚着来自四十多个国家的庞大侨民群体。

phrases.usage: 形容词加名词，指外派员工，跨国企业与税务文本常见
phrases.example: Multinational corporations typically send expatriate workers abroad on carefully negotiated three-year assignments.
phrases.example_translation: 跨国公司通常把外派员工按精心商定的三年任务派往海外。

phrases.usage: 形容词加名词，指旅居或流亡海外的作家，文学批评常用
phrases.example: James Joyce is perhaps the most celebrated expatriate writer of the early twentieth century.
phrases.example_translation: 詹姆斯·乔伊斯或许是二十世纪初最著名的旅居海外作家。

phrases.usage: 名词短语，指侨居身份，法律与税务语境常见
phrases.example: Recent tax reforms quietly altered the expatriate status of hundreds of freelance consultants.
phrases.example_translation: 近期的税改悄然改变了几百名自由顾问的侨居身份。

phrases.usage: 形容词加名词，指自愿移居海外者，与强制流放对照
phrases.example: She remained a voluntary expatriate, politely declining every family plea to return home.
phrases.example_translation: 她始终是自愿侨居海外的人，婉拒了家人每一次要她回国的请求。

phrases.usage: 后接不定式，指预料做某事，最常用结构
phrases.example: Most market analysts expect the central bank to raise interest rates again before autumn.
phrases.example_translation: 大多数市场分析师预计央行会在入秋前再次加息。

phrases.usage: 后接从句，指认为某事会发生
phrases.example: The committee had expected that the boldly revised plan would meet considerably more opposition.
phrases.example_translation: 委员会原以为大胆修改后的方案会遇到多得多的反对。

phrases.usage: 后接 of，指对某人寄予很高期望
phrases.example: A demanding yet devoted mentor will often expect far too much of a gifted student.
phrases.example_translation: 严格而尽职的导师常对天才学生寄予过高期望。

phrases.usage: 形容词义，指预期的结果，学术常用
phrases.example: The experiment failed to yield the expected result even after several careful repetitions.
phrases.example_translation: 即便多次仔细重复，这个实验仍未能产生预期的结果。

phrases.usage: 固定插入语，指出乎或不出所料
phrases.example: As expected, the quiet committee vote passed the measure without any serious debate.
phrases.example_translation: 不出所料，这场安静的委员会投票毫无严肃辩论就通过了该法案。

phrases.usage: 带宾语结构，指望某人做某事
phrases.example: Eager investors expected the new chief executive to stabilize falling prices within a single quarter.
phrases.example_translation: 热切的投资者指望新首席执行官在一个季度内稳住下跌的价格。

phrases.usage: 倒装句式，表出乎意料的转折，书面语
phrases.example: Little did the patient villagers expect that the wide river would soon vanish entirely.
phrases.example_translation: 村民们万万没想到这条宽阔的河很快会彻底消失。

phrases.usage: 被动结构，指按理应当，正式常用
phrases.example: The landmark report is widely expected to influence public policy for many years ahead.
phrases.example_translation: 这份里程碑式的报告被广泛认为将在未来多年影响公共政策。

phrases.usage: 动宾高频搭配，指加快流程，公文与商务邮件通用
phrases.example: The ministry hired extra clerks to expedite the process during the peak application season.
phrases.example_translation: 申请旺季，该部增雇文员以加快办理流程。

phrases.usage: 商务搭配，指加急运送，电商与物流语境常见
phrases.example: Paying extra to expedite shipping meant the replacement parts arrived a full day earlier.
phrases.example_translation: 付加急费加快运送，意味着替换零件提前一整天到达。

phrases.usage: 使役结构，指协助加速办理，请求函件常用
phrases.example: A notarized copy will help expedite the release of the sealed archive records.
phrases.example_translation: 经公证的副本将有助于加快封存档案的调阅手续。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指优先处理申请，服务与行政场景高频
phrases.example: The librarian agreed to expedite a request for the out-of-print thesis on behalf of a doctoral student.
phrases.example_translation: 图书管理员同意代一位博士生优先办理那份绝版论文的申请。

phrases.usage: 动宾后接 of，指加速某项审批，政策与工程语境常用
phrases.example: The governor moved to expedite the approval of flood repairs before winter.
phrases.example_translation: 州长着手加快洪水修复工程的审批，以便赶在入冬前完成。

phrases.usage: 副动搭配，指大幅缩短办理时间，建议类文体常用
phrases.example: Digitizing the ledger would vastly expedite work that now occupies three full-time clerks.
phrases.example_translation: 把台账数字化将极大加快目前占用的三名全职文员的工作。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指加快通关或许可，贸易报道常见
phrases.example: New software expedited clearance at the border, cutting queue times by nearly half.
phrases.example_translation: 新软件加快了边境通关，把排队时间削减了近一半。

phrases.usage: 后接 on + 名词或动名词，表示在…上耗费精力
phrases.example: The team expended little energy on defending a design the client had already rejected.
phrases.example_translation: 团队几乎不再为辩护一个客户早已否决的方案耗费精力。

phrases.usage: 后接动名词，指费力做某事，比 spare effort 更书面
phrases.example: He expended considerable effort persuading the committee to reconsider the original timeline.
phrases.example_translation: 他费了大力气劝说委员会重新考虑最初的时间表。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指消耗人力物力，常见于社科与军事语境
phrases.example: Ancient empires expended vast resources building monuments that later rulers dismantled for stone.
phrases.example_translation: 古代帝国为建造纪念碑耗尽了大量资源，后来的统治者却把它们拆去当石料。

phrases.usage: 夸张用法，指在…上花一大笔钱，口语书面皆可
phrases.example: The city expended a fortune repaving boulevards that flood again each spring.
phrases.example_translation: 市里花重金重铺大道，可这些街道每年春天依旧被淹。

phrases.usage: 反身用法，指精力耗尽、筋疲力尽，多见于书面语
phrases.example: She expended herself on the campaign and needed a full month to recover.
phrases.example_translation: 她为竞选拼尽全力，需要整整一个月才能缓过来。

phrases.usage: 被动搭配，指在战争中被消耗，常用于历史叙述
phrases.example: Much of the nation's gold was expended in wars that produced only barren treaties.
phrases.example_translation: 这个国家的大量黄金都在战争中消耗殆尽，换来的只是空洞的条约。

phrases.usage: 后接 on + 名词，指投入资本，经济类文章常见
phrases.example: The firm should not expend more capital on equipment its engineers have already questioned.
phrases.example_translation: 公司不该再为工程师已经提出质疑的设备追加资本。

phrases.usage: 动词加with后接材料或方法，指试用新事物以求改进，日常与学术皆可用
phrases.example: The chef experimented with fermented peppers before settling on the signature sauce.
phrases.example_translation: 这位厨师尝试过用发酵辣椒，最后才定下那道招牌酱汁。

phrases.usage: 动词加on后接实验对象，涉及动物或人体实验时带伦理敏感性
phrases.example: The ethics board now scrutinizes every proposal to experiment on living primates.
phrases.example_translation: 伦理委员会如今对每一项以活体灵长类为对象的实验提案都严加审查。

phrases.usage: 正式动宾搭配，conduct后接experiment，实验报告与学术写作首选动词
phrases.example: Students conducted an experiment to measure how light intensity affects bean growth.
phrases.example_translation: 学生们开展了一项实验，测量光照强度对菜豆生长的影响。

phrases.usage: 动宾短语，experiments常用复数表示多轮操作，叙述科研过程常用
phrases.example: The team carried out experiments over three winters to track the glacier melt.
phrases.example_translation: 团队连续三个冬天开展实验，以追踪冰川消融情况。

phrases.usage: 方法学术语，指设置对照、控制变量的实验，区别于观察性研究
phrases.example: A controlled experiment keeps every variable fixed except the one under study.
phrases.example_translation: 对照实验除研究对象所在变量外，其余变量一律保持不变。

phrases.usage: 心理与医学术语，指受试者与研究者在分组中均不知情，用以排除偏差
phrases.example: In a double-blind experiment, neither the subjects nor the researchers know who receives the placebo.
phrases.example_translation: 在双盲实验中，受试者和研究者都不知道谁服用了安慰剂。

phrases.usage: 量词短语，指一系列前后衔接的实验，用于总结系统性研究
phrases.example: In a series of experiments, the psychologists showed that sleep improves memory recall.
phrases.example_translation: 通过一系列实验，心理学家证明睡眠有助于记忆提取。

phrases.usage: 方法学术语，指在真实环境而非实验室进行的实验，社科与经济文本常见
phrases.example: The economists ran a field experiment in thirty villages to test the subsidy.
phrases.example_translation: 经济学家在三十个村庄开展实地实验，以检验这项补贴的效果。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，最常见的及物用法，指赎罪，宗教与文学语境
phrases.example: He believed that decades of silence could expiate the sin of his impulsive youth.
phrases.example_translation: 他相信数十年的沉默能够赎清他冲动年少时犯下的罪过。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指为罪行赎罪或补偿，法律与道德讨论常用
phrases.example: No monetary fine can fully expiate a crime that destroyed so many lives.
phrases.example_translation: 任何经济罚款都无法完全赎清那桩毁掉众多生命的罪行。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指通过苦行或善行消除内疚，心理学与文学批评常见
phrases.example: The protagonist spends the entire novel trying to expiate a guilt he cannot name.
phrases.example_translation: 主人公在整部小说里都在试图赎清一种他说不出名字的内疚。

phrases.usage: 反身用法加 by 短语，指通过某种具体行为赎罪，书面语结构
phrases.example: The disgraced general sought to expiate himself by surrendering his medals publicly.
phrases.example_translation: 那位失声誉的将军试图通过公开交还勋章来赎己之罪。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，wrongs 指错误或冤屈之举，历史反思与转型正义语境常用
phrases.example: The truth commission argued that public acknowledgement alone cannot expiate past wrongs.
phrases.example_translation: 真相委员会主张，仅有公开承认并不能赎清过往的错误。

phrases.usage: struggle to 加动词原形，强调赎罪之艰难，文学评论高频
phrases.example: She struggled all her life to expiate what she had done in that reckless summer.
phrases.example_translation: 她终其一生都在努力赎清自己在那个鲁莽夏天里做过的事。

phrases.usage: 动词加宾语加 of 结构，阐释某物的含义，最常见搭配
phrases.example: The lecture sought to explicate the meaning of the poem's final, deliberately ambiguous stanza.
phrases.example_translation: 这堂课试图阐释这首诗结尾那节故意含混的诗行的含义。

phrases.usage: 动词加介词短语状语，详尽地解说，学术论述文体，宾语可插入中间
phrases.example: She explicated the constitutional clause at length before turning to its modern implications.
phrases.example_translation: 在谈及其现代意涵之前，她用了大段篇幅详尽讲解那一条宪法条款。

phrases.usage: 副词修饰动词，强调条分缕析地阐释，书评与教材常用
phrases.example: The commentary carefully explicates each metaphor in the ode rather than paraphrasing the plot.
phrases.example_translation: 这部注释本逐条细析颂歌中的每个隐喻，而非泛泛复述诗意。

phrases.usage: 及物动词搭配段落文本类宾语，文学教学中细读一段
phrases.example: The exam requires students to explicate a passage without merely restating its surface content.
phrases.example_translation: 考试要求学生阐释一段文字，而不能只是复述其表面内容。

phrases.usage: 被动结构加 as，被解释为，引出某种定论式解读
phrases.example: The ritual is often explicated as a negotiation between the village and its ancestors.
phrases.example_translation: 这一仪式通常被解释为村民与祖先之间的一场协商。

phrases.usage: 名词 attempt 接不定式，阐释的努力，常见于方法论与书评
phrases.example: His attempt to explicate local superstition in economic terms impressed even the skeptics.
phrases.example_translation: 他尝试用经济学术语来解释当地迷信的做法，连怀疑论者都为之折服。

translations.translation: 明确的；清楚的；直率的；详述的

phrases.usage: 表语加in后接行为或表述，指在某方面说得毫不含糊，正式书面语
phrases.example: She was explicit in her rejection, leaving no room for misreading the committee's decision.
phrases.example_translation: 她的拒绝说得斩钉截铁，委员会的决定绝无被误读的空间。

phrases.usage: 后接about引出事项，指对某事明确交代细节，合同与管理语境常见
phrases.example: The grant terms were unusually explicit about data sharing, down to file formats and deadlines.
phrases.example_translation: 资助条款对数据共享的规定异常明确，细到文件格式和截止日期。

phrases.usage: 接that从句的固定句式，指明确声明某事，用于转述官方立场
phrases.example: The principal was careful to be explicit that the new dress code applied to everyone.
phrases.example_translation: 校长刻意明确宣布，新的着装规定适用于每一个人。

phrases.usage: 形容词修饰名词，指详尽清楚的指示说明，实验手册与流程文档常用
phrases.example: The lab manual gave explicit instructions for handling the reagent, yet two batches were still ruined.
phrases.example_translation: 实验手册对试剂处理给出了明确指示，却仍有两批样品被毁掉。

phrases.usage: 名词加to，指点名道姓的直接提及，法律与学术引用中高频
phrases.example: The report avoids any explicit reference to the board members who resigned that spring.
phrases.example_translation: 这份报告避免对那年春天辞职的董事会成员作出任何明确提及。

phrases.usage: 副词修饰形容词，指明确到足够程度，带法律审查口吻
phrases.example: The warning proved sufficiently explicit for the contractors, though not for the casual visitors.
phrases.example_translation: 这则警告对承包方而言已足够明确，对偶然来访的客人却不然。

phrases.usage: 动宾结构，指把原本隐含之事明确说清，学术写作修改意见常用
phrases.example: The amended clause made explicit what the earlier agreement had only implied about mineral rights.
phrases.example_translation: 修订后的条款把早先协议对矿权只做暗示的内容明确写清了。

phrases.usage: 不及物加介词短语，勃然大怒，情绪爆发的比喻用法
phrases.example: The weary editor exploded with rage when the misprinted pages finally arrived.
phrases.example_translation: 印错的页面终于送来时，疲惫的编辑勃然大怒。

phrases.usage: explode into 加抽象名词，突然爆发大笑，叙事描写常用句式
phrases.example: The lecture paused briefly as the whole auditorium exploded into laughter.
phrases.example_translation: 全场听众突然爆发出笑声，讲座只好短暂停顿。

phrases.usage: 习语，横空出世、一举成名，体育与文艺报道中高频
phrases.example: The teenage striker exploded onto the scene with eleven goals in a single autumn.
phrases.example_translation: 这名少年前锋在一个秋天攻入十一球，一举横空出世。

phrases.usage: 不及物加范围状语，人气暴涨，描述趋势与市场的常见结构
phrases.example: Board games have exploded in popularity among university students over five years.
phrases.example_translation: 五年间，桌游在大学生群体中迅速流行开来。

phrases.usage: 字面爆炸用法，explode in 加形态名词，事故与战地报道常见
phrases.example: The leaking gas tank exploded in a fireball visible from the distant ridge.
phrases.example_translation: 泄漏的油箱轰然爆炸，火球在远处的山脊上都清晰可见。

phrases.usage: explode into 加结果名词，碎裂开来，物理过程与新闻描写通用
phrases.example: The meteorite exploded into fragments high above the frozen lake surface.
phrases.example_translation: 陨石在结冰湖面的上空高空碎裂成块。

phrases.usage: 动词加副词，向外迸发，描写冲击与扩散方向的科技用语
phrases.example: When the pressurized drum ruptured, the vapor exploded outward in seconds.
phrases.example_translation: 加压桶破裂时，蒸汽在几秒内向外迸发开来。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，开发自然资源，环境与经济文本中带双面含义
phrases.example: Colonial administrations exploited natural resources recklessly, leaving depleted soils and fractured communities.
phrases.example_translation: 殖民当局肆意开采自然资源，留下贫瘠的土地与破碎的社会。

phrases.usage: 动宾习语，钻法律空子，贬义，常见于时评与调查报道
phrases.example: The firm exploited a loophole in the tax code that regulators later closed within one session.
phrases.example_translation: 这家公司钻了税法的空子，监管者随后在一会期内就把它堵上了。

phrases.usage: 社会批评动宾搭配，剥削廉价劳工，社科文本常用
phrases.example: Investigative reporting showed the workshops exploited cheap labor imported under misleading contracts.
phrases.example_translation: 调查报道显示，这些作坊剥削按误导性合同输入的廉价劳工。

phrases.usage: 积极动宾搭配，充分发挥潜力，科技与管理语境常用
phrases.example: New telescopes will exploit the full potential of infrared detection to map distant stellar nurseries.
phrases.example_translation: 新望远镜将充分发挥红外探测的潜力，绘制遥远的恒星诞生区。

phrases.usage: 对抗语境动宾搭配，利用对方弱点，军事与竞技评论通用
phrases.example: The opposing coach studied the tape to exploit weaknesses in the team's sluggish defense.
phrases.example_translation: 对方教练反复研究录像，以利用本队迟缓防守中的弱点。

phrases.usage: 名词复数用法，胆冒险行与功绩，文学化褒义表达
phrases.example: The explorer's daring exploits were retold in every parlor long before cameras recorded his journeys.
phrases.example_translation: 早在照相机记录其旅程之前，探险家的冒险壮举就已在各家客厅传颂。

phrases.usage: 名词限定搭配，军功战绩，史书与人物传记高频
phrases.example: The statue commemorates military exploits from a war that few residents now remember clearly.
phrases.example_translation: 这座雕像纪念的那场军功，如今已少有居民还记得清楚。

phrases.usage: 固定社科术语，人口激增，人口学与资源辩论的高频概念
phrases.example: Post-war family planning programmes slowed the population explosion without erasing its regional contrasts.
phrases.example_translation: 战后的计划生育规划延缓了人口激增，但未能消除地区间的差异。

phrases.usage: 后接 in + 领域，某事物的激增，经济与社会数据报道的隐喻延伸
phrases.example: The report charted an explosion in undergraduate enrollment across the public universities.
phrases.example_translation: 报告描绘了公立大学本科招生人数激增的轨迹。

phrases.usage: 常规动宾搭配，引发爆炸，安全与事故叙述的因果句式
phrases.example: A single spark can cause an explosion in a poorly ventilated grain silo.
phrases.example_translation: 在通风不良的粮仓里，一颗火星就可能引发爆炸。

phrases.usage: 后接 of + 抽象名词，某种情绪的爆发或创造力的喷涌，隐喻搭配
phrases.example: The lifting of censorship was followed by an explosion of satire in the capital.
phrases.example_translation: 审查解除之后，首都随即涌现出一股讽刺创作的高潮。

phrases.usage: 武器与物理语境术语，核爆炸，冷战史与军备文献高频
phrases.example: International treaties restricted any nuclear explosion conducted outside the two designated desert test sites.
phrases.example_translation: 国际条约限制在两个指定沙漠试验场之外进行任何核爆炸。

phrases.usage: 天文语境，恒星爆发即超新星，科普宇宙学文本的常用表达
phrases.example: Telescopes resolved the faint nebula as the expanding shell of an ancient stellar explosion.
phrases.example_translation: 望远镜把这片暗淡的星云解析为一场远古恒星爆发正在膨胀的外壳。

phrases.usage: 事故类型术语，燃气爆炸，新闻报道与安全调查文体常见
phrases.example: The gas explosion shattered windows along three blocks of the shopping street.
phrases.example_translation: 这起燃气爆炸震碎了商业街三个街区的橱窗玻璃。

phrases.usage: 数量框架，一连串爆炸，事故报道与调查叙述的典型表述
phrases.example: A series of explosions preceded the collapse of the abandoned munitions factory.
phrases.example_translation: 这座废弃兵工厂倒塌之前发生过一连串爆炸。

translations.translation: [数] 指数；典型；说明者，说明物

phrases.usage: 名词 + of，指某流派主张最有影响者，评论高频
phrases.example: She is widely regarded as the leading exponent of the minimalist dance style.
phrases.example_translation: 她被广泛视为极简主义舞蹈风格最具代表性的践行者。

phrases.usage: 名词 + of，拥护者、倡导者义，形名前置可加时间形容词
phrases.example: The young essayist became an early exponent of lucid civic argument in his notebooks.
phrases.example_translation: 这位年轻随笔作家在笔记中成为清晰公民论说文体的早期倡导者。

phrases.usage: 数学学科搭配，正指数，术语义
phrases.example: Any positive exponent of ten denotes a power larger than the base itself.
phrases.example_translation: 十的任何正指数都表示一个大于底数本身的幂。

phrases.usage: 数学学科搭配，负指数，即倒数幂
phrases.example: A negative exponent indicates the reciprocal of the corresponding positive integral power.
phrases.example_translation: 负指数表示相应正整数幂的倒数。

phrases.usage: 形名 + of，出人意料的倡导者，叙事反差
phrases.example: The retired soldier became an unlikely exponent of gentle pastoral verse in his memoir.
phrases.example_translation: 这位退役军人在回忆录中成了田园柔诗的意外倡导者。

phrases.usage: 介词短语，指数为二，公式与方程语境
phrases.example: In this equation each variable enters the calculation with an exponent of two.
phrases.example_translation: 在这个方程里，每个变量都以二的指数参与运算。

phrases.usage: 形名 + of，高声倡导某主张者，政治评论语境
phrases.example: As a vocal exponent of open access publishing, the librarian challenged several commercial journals.
phrases.example_translation: 作为开放获取出版的直言倡导者，这位图书馆员公开质疑了多家商业期刊。

phrases.usage: 名词后接 to，指暴露或接触某物，最常见的核心结构
phrases.example: Prolonged exposure to sunlight can damage the collagen layers deep in the skin.
phrases.example_translation: 长时间暴露于阳光下会损伤皮肤深层的胶原蛋白层。

phrases.usage: 名词作定语，指媒体曝光度，传播学与社会评论常用
phrases.example: The documentary gave the activists far more media exposure than they had hoped.
phrases.example_translation: 这部纪录片给活动人士带来的媒体曝光度远超他们的预期。

phrases.usage: 名词加 of，指对腐败等的揭露，新闻与司法语境
phrases.example: The gradual exposure of corruption took years of patient work by reporters.
phrases.example_translation: 对腐败的逐步揭露耗费了记者们多年耐心的工作。

phrases.usage: 经济金融术语，指风险敞口，常与削减类动词搭配
phrases.example: The fund reduced its financial exposure to volatile energy markets last spring.
phrases.example_translation: 该基金去年春季削减了对波动剧烈的能源市场的风险敞口。

phrases.usage: 动词加宾语，指尽量减少暴露，安全与防护建议常用
phrases.example: Hikers wear layered clothing to minimise exposure to the sudden mountain cold.
phrases.example_translation: 徒步者穿分层衣物，以尽量减少突如其来的山地寒冷的侵袭。

phrases.usage: 心理学固定术语，指暴露疗法，临床语境
phrases.example: Therapists often pair graded tasks with exposure therapy to ease intense phobias.
phrases.example_translation: 治疗师常将分级任务与暴露疗法配合使用，以缓解强烈恐惧症。

phrases.usage: 摄影术语，指长时曝光，技术类说明文本常见
phrases.example: A long exposure turned the rushing waterfall into a veil of white silk.
phrases.example_translation: 长时间曝光把奔泻的瀑布化作一袭白纱。

translations.translation: 表现，表示，表达；表情，脸色，态度，腔调，声调；式，符号；词句，语句，措辞，说法

phrases.usage: 法律与政治学固定搭配，表达自由，与protect或limit连用
phrases.example: Courts must balance freedom of expression against the harm caused by deliberate falsehoods.
phrases.example_translation: 法院须在表达自由与故意散布谎言造成的伤害之间作出权衡。

phrases.usage: 正式结构，使情感或诉求得到表达，比动词express更具文气
phrases.example: The symphony gave expression to a grief the composer could not state in plain words.
phrases.example_translation: 这部交响曲道出了作曲家无法用平实语言表达的悲痛。

phrases.usage: 心理学与生理学基础搭配，面部表情，是表情识别研究的对象
phrases.example: Children learn to read a facial expression long before they understand the matching adjective.
phrases.example_translation: 儿童很早便能读懂面部表情，远早于理解与之对应的形容词。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，面无表情，刻画无情绪或出神的神态
phrases.example: Her face held a blank expression while the verdict was read, and no one could guess how she felt.
phrases.example_translation: 宣读判决时她面无人色般一片空白，谁也猜不透她的心思。

phrases.usage: expression of加抽象名词，致谢的姿态或言辞，礼仪与演讲语域
phrases.example: He bowed slightly, a quiet expression of gratitude that needed no translation.
phrases.example_translation: 他微微鞠躬，这是一种无需翻译的无声致谢。

phrases.usage: 形容词加of结构，恰切地表现某种态度，文学批评常用
phrases.example: The novel's cold ending is an apt expression of the era's fading idealism.
phrases.example_translation: 小说冷峻的结尾，恰是那个时代理想主义衰退的贴切写照。

phrases.usage: 指词句措辞，belong to区分正式或口语，语言学注释语域
phrases.example: The dictionary marks each entry, noting whether the expression belongs to formal or everyday speech.
phrases.example_translation: 词典为每个词条加注，标明该表达属于正式用语还是日常口语。

phrases.usage: 表达关切的声明，外交与公文体常见，可加mild或grave修饰
phrases.example: The joint statement offered only a mild expression of concern about the detained researchers.
phrases.example_translation: 联合声明仅对被拘押的研究人员表达了温和的关切。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指面临开除处分，校园纪律语境最常见的结构
phrases.example: The sophomore faced expulsion after the cheating scandal spread through the school.
phrases.example_translation: 作弊丑闻传遍全校后，这名大二学生面临被开除的处分。

phrases.usage: 后接 from + 机构，指被某学校或组织驱逐，名词典型介词搭配
phrases.example: His expulsion from the academy surprised even his harshest critics at home.
phrases.example_translation: 他被学院开除一事，连国内最严厉的批评者都感到意外。

phrases.usage: threaten sb with sth 结构，指以开除相要挟，校规执行语境
phrases.example: Teachers threatened the boys with expulsion if the vandalism continued after warnings.
phrases.example_translation: 老师警告那几个男孩，若在告诫之后继续破坏就将开除他们。

phrases.usage: 后接 of + 群体，指史学中的驱逐事件，常与 medieval 等词同现
phrases.example: The expulsion of minority communities reshaped many medieval European towns and their local economies.
phrases.example_translation: 对少数族群的驱逐重塑了许多中世纪欧洲城镇及其地方经济。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指立即开除或罚下场，体育裁决与校政纪律语体常见
phrases.example: The referee ordered the player's immediate expulsion after a series of reckless fouls.
phrases.example_translation: 裁判在连续几次鲁莽犯规后下令将该球员当场罚下。

phrases.usage: 比较结构，指停学而非开除的处分，常作 chose、opt for 的宾语
phrases.example: The head teacher chose a short suspension rather than outright expulsion for the incident.
phrases.example_translation: 就这一事件，班主任选择了短期停学而不是直接开除。

phrases.usage: risk of 搭配，指开除的风险，常与 hang over 连用渲染压力
phrases.example: He wrote home describing the constant risk of expulsion hanging over him.
phrases.example_translation: 他写信回家，描述了始终悬在头顶的被开除风险。

phrases.usage: 结构为 expurgate sth from sth，从文本中删去某内容，出版史核心搭配
phrases.example: Victorian editors, anxious about propriety, quietly expurgated entire passages from the poet's published letters.
phrases.example_translation: 维多利亚时代的编辑顾虑体面，悄悄从诗人公开的信札中删去了整段文字。

phrases.usage: 过去分词作定语，删节本，与全本对照的文献学术语
phrases.example: The school's old expurgated edition omitted references that modern scholars now consider essential context.
phrases.example_translation: 学校用的旧删节本省略了现代学者如今视为必要背景的那些引文。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，删改文本，审查制度讨论中的典型用法，贬义色彩
phrases.example: Officials decided to expurgate the text before assigning it to undergraduate readers.
phrases.example_translation: 官员们决定在把该文本列为本科生读物之前先加以删改。

phrases.usage: 程度副词修饰过去分词，被大量删节的，版本比较描述
phrases.example: In seminar we compared the heavily expurgated manuscript line by line against the restored draft.
phrases.example_translation: 研讨课上，我们把大量删节过的手稿与复原草稿逐行比对。

phrases.usage: 近义动词并列，审查并删改，批评当局删削文献的搭配
phrases.example: Regimes often censor and expurgate archives to rewrite even the grim record of famine.
phrases.example_translation: 政权常审查并删改档案，连饥荒的残酷记录也要改写。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，删去若干段落，编辑与文献整理语境
phrases.example: According to the editor's preface, later reprinters expurgated passages describing the voyage's harsher discipline.
phrases.example_translation: 据编者序言所述，后来的重印者删去了描写航行中严酷惩戒的段落。

phrases.usage: 最高级加形容词，现存最早的抄本，文献学高频搭配
phrases.example: The earliest extant copy of the poem dates from the mid-thirteenth century.
phrases.example_translation: 这首诗现存最早的抄本可追溯到十三世纪中叶。

phrases.usage: 副词加形容词，仍然存世，强调历经劫毁而幸存
phrases.example: Two silent films from that year are still extant in a private archive.
phrases.example_translation: 那一年的两部默片至今尚存，藏于一处私人档案馆。

phrases.usage: 学术著录用语，已知的存世样本，博物馆与拍卖语境
phrases.example: Three known extant examples of the bronze lamp sit in museum storage.
phrases.example_translation: 这种铜灯已知存世的三件样品都藏于博物馆库房。

phrases.usage: 唯一性搭配，仅存的记述，史学考证常用
phrases.example: Her notebook remains the only extant account of that long winter crossing.
phrases.example_translation: 她的笔记本仍是那次漫长冬季穿越唯一存世的记述。

phrases.usage: 形容词加 in 加处所，存于某地，学术目录式表述
phrases.example: Two drafts are extant in the national library's cold vault, sealed for nearly a century.
phrases.example_translation: 两份草稿存于国家图书馆的恒温库中，已封存近一个世纪。

phrases.usage: 否定限定加名词，无存世证据，史学与法律论证
phrases.example: No extant evidence confirms the treaty was signed by the crown.
phrases.example_translation: 没有任何存世证据能证实这纸条约确由王室签署。

phrases.usage: 定冠词加名词，现存残片，古籍与考古文本常用
phrases.example: Scholars have catalogued the extant fragments of the lost chronicle.
phrases.example_translation: 学者们已把这散佚编年史现存的残片一一登记造册。

phrases.usage: 程度副词加最高级再加 extant，近乎最古老的存世标本，科普与史物语境
phrases.example: This may be nearly the oldest extant example of woven cotton.
phrases.example_translation: 这几乎是现存最古老的棉织物标本。

translations.translation: 即席的，临时的；无准备的；不用讲稿的；善于即席讲话的

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，即席演讲，政治与公共演说语境核心搭配
phrases.example: The candidate's extemporaneous speech at the factory gate moved even skeptical reporters.
phrases.example_translation: 候选人在工厂门口发表的即席演说，连心存怀疑的记者也深受触动。

phrases.usage: 动词加形名宾语，致即席讲话，典礼与宴会流程描述
phrases.example: The host asked the guest to deliver a few extemporaneous remarks before dinner.
phrases.example_translation: 主人请客人在晚宴开始前即兴讲上几句。

phrases.usage: 副词修饰形容词，完全未经准备，用于说明回应出自临场
phrases.example: The minister insisted that his controversial reply at the press conference had been purely extemporaneous.
phrases.example_translation: 部长坚称他在记者会上那番引发争议的回应纯属即兴。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，即席辩护或答辩，辩论与庭审口头表达语境
phrases.example: Her extemporaneous defense of the policy in the debate impressed even its harshest critics.
phrases.example_translation: 她在辩论中为该政策所作的即席辩护，连最严厉的批评者也为之侧目。

phrases.usage: 系表结构，看上去是临场发挥，叙事观察语气
phrases.example: The chant spread so quickly that the interruption seemed entirely extemporaneous.
phrases.example_translation: 呼喊声蔓延得太快，这一打断看上去完全是观众临场起意。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，即兴的妙语，文艺与沙龙趣谈的评语
phrases.example: The columnist was celebrated for extemporaneous wit at the capital's late-night literary dinners.
phrases.example_translation: 这位专栏作家以在首都深夜文学晚宴上的即兴妙语而闻名。

phrases.usage: 后接 research into 加课题，表示对某问题的大量研究，学术语境最高频
phrases.example: Extensive research into migration patterns informed the exhibition at the national archive.
phrases.example_translation: 对迁徙模式的大量研究为国家档案馆的展览提供了依据。

phrases.usage: knowledge 前加 extensive，表示渊博的某方面知识，人物描写与推荐信常用
phrases.example: The guide displayed an extensive knowledge of alpine plants during the two-day trek.
phrases.example_translation: 在为期两天的徒步中，向导展示了渊博的高山植物知识。

phrases.usage: 固定动宾搭配，cause extensive damage to 表示造成大范围破坏，灾情报道常用
phrases.example: The flood waters receded but had caused extensive damage to bridges and granaries.
phrases.example_translation: 洪水虽已退去，却对桥梁和粮仓造成了大面积破坏。

phrases.usage: collection 前加 extensive，指规模庞大的某类收藏，博物馆与遗产语境常见
phrases.example: The estate included an extensive collection of maps, many unsigned and rarely displayed.
phrases.example_translation: 这批遗产包含大量地图收藏，其中许多既无署名也很少展出。

phrases.usage: 教学法术语，与 intensive reading 相对，指以量为主的泛读，教育文本常见
phrases.example: Teachers recommend extensive reading of graded texts to build vocabulary beyond the syllabus.
phrases.example_translation: 老师们建议泛读分级读物，以在大纲之外积累词汇。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配 conduct surveys，加 extensive 强调勘察范围广，工程与科研语体
phrases.example: Engineers conducted extensive surveys before routing the railway through the mountain corridor.
phrases.example_translation: 在决定铁路穿山路线之前，工程师们进行了大范围勘察。

translations.translation: 减轻；低估；为…找借口；使人原谅

phrases.usage: 法律高频搭配，指可减轻罪责的情节
phrases.example: The disciplinary panel reduced the penalty only after reviewing the documented extenuating circumstances.
phrases.example_translation: 纪律委员会在审阅了有案可查的减轻情节之后才下调了处罚。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指减轻罪责，否定式常见
phrases.example: Nothing in the court record seemed to extenuate the offense against vulnerable tenants.
phrases.example_translation: 法庭卷宗里似乎没有任何情节能减轻那项针对弱势租客的罪行。

phrases.usage: 指开脱罪责，含道德质疑语气
phrases.example: The board report tried to extenuate corporate guilt through cosmetic governance reforms.
phrases.example_translation: 董事会报告试图借表面化的治理改革来为企业开脱罪责。

phrases.usage: 否定副词搭配，指情有可原但罪不可恕
phrases.example: Extreme fatigue might explain the night engineer's negligence, but it hardly extenuates the resulting damage.
phrases.example_translation: 极度疲劳或许能解释那位夜班工程师的疏忽，但几乎不能减轻造成的后果。

phrases.usage: 不定式框架，指辩方试图减轻指控
phrases.example: The defense counsel sought to extenuate the charges by introducing months of hospital records.
phrases.example_translation: 辩护律师试图提交数月住院记录以减轻指控。

phrases.usage: 伦理讨论搭配，指减轻道义上的责难
phrases.example: In the inquiry, pressure from superiors could not fully extenuate individual moral blame.
phrases.example_translation: 在调查中，来自上级的压力不能完全减轻个人的道义责任。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，建筑与工程语境指外墙，与 interior wall 相对
phrases.example: Crews insulated the exterior wall before replacing the narrow original window frames.
phrases.example_translation: 工队先给外墙做保温，然后才更换那些狭窄的原始窗框。

phrases.usage: 介词短语作状语，指从外表看，后常接转折说明内在不同
phrases.example: The cathedral appears austere on the exterior, yet its nave blazes with color.
phrases.example_translation: 这座大教堂外表显得朴素庄严，中殿里却流光溢彩。

phrases.usage: 天文与材料学科搭配，指天体或物体外表面，客观描述
phrases.example: Ice on the exterior surface of the moon suggests trapped water beneath the crust.
phrases.example_translation: 该星体外表面的冰层表明地壳之下封存着水。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指外在表现，文学评论用于揭示人物表里不一
phrases.example: His genial exterior appearance concealed a relentless impatience with slow deliberation and repeated second-guessing.
phrases.example_translation: 他和蔼的外表下隐藏着对迟缓商议和反复质疑的强烈不耐。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，the 特指建筑外部，日常维护与志愿服务语境
phrases.example: Volunteers spent a bright Saturday painting the exterior of the old community hall.
phrases.example_translation: 志愿者们在一个晴朗的周六给旧社区礼堂的外墙刷了漆。

phrases.usage: 力学术语，指系统外部施加的作用力，模型假设中常被忽略
phrases.example: The model ignores exterior forces such as air resistance, so its predictions drift.
phrases.example_translation: 该模型忽略了空气阻力等外力，因此其预测会逐渐偏离。

phrases.usage: 几何术语，指多边形外角，与 interior angle 对照考查
phrases.example: Each exterior angle of the regular pentagon measures seventy-two degrees, as the proof shows.
phrases.example_translation: 如证明所示，正五边形的每个外角都是七十二度。

phrases.usage: 及物动词后接具体生物对象，指彻底根除某群体，害虫防治语域常见
phrases.example: The crew worked two days to exterminate the termite colony beneath the old library foundation.
phrases.example_translation: 工作人员花了两天，才把老图书馆地基下的白蚁群体彻底消灭。

phrases.usage: 被动结构，by 引出施动者，强调被外力消灭殆尽，多用于生态与历史叙述
phrases.example: Within three decades, the island snail population was exterminated by introduced rats and habitat loss.
phrases.example_translation: 短短三十年内，岛上蜗牛种群便因引入的鼠类和栖息地丧失而被消灭干净。

phrases.usage: 后接动词不定式，主语多为入侵物种或疾病，表示有彻底灭绝之势
phrases.example: An invasive fungus threatens to exterminate salamander populations across several mountain valleys.
phrases.example_translation: 一种入侵真菌可能使数个山间谷地的蝾螈种群遭到根除。

phrases.usage: 接不定式表主观意图，常用于政策或历史叙述，语气严肃并多含批判
phrases.example: Pastoral boards sought to exterminate the coyotes that threatened their flocks each spring.
phrases.example_translation: 牧区委员会曾设法消灭那些每年春天威胁羊群的郊狼。

phrases.usage: campaign 后接不定式，指有组织、成规模的根除行动，公共卫生报道高频
phrases.example: The health department launched a costly campaign to exterminate mosquitoes near the flooded district.
phrases.example_translation: 卫生部门发起了一场耗资巨大的行动，以消灭洪泛区附近的蚊虫。

phrases.usage: 副词修饰被动分词，表示近乎灭绝，常与 by 短语连用，学术与新闻语体
phrases.example: The fur seals were nearly exterminated by hunting before protective laws took effect.
phrases.example_translation: 在保护性法律生效之前，毛皮海豹几乎被猎杀殆尽。

phrases.usage: 动词加宾语再加 from 引出地点，强调把某物种从特定区域清除干净
phrases.example: Rangers tried to exterminate invasive rats from the nesting islands within two seasons.
phrases.example_translation: 护林员试图在两个繁殖季内把入侵鼠类从筑巢岛屿上彻底清除。

translations.translation: 外部的；表面的；[药] 外用的；外国的；外面的

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，外部因素，与内部原因相对的分析写作
phrases.example: Economists weighed the external factors that had destabilized the currency, chiefly the new import tariffs.
phrases.example_translation: 经济学家权衡了导致货币不稳定的外部因素，主要是新加的进口关税。

phrases.usage: 形容词后接 to，在某物之外，学术正式语体
phrases.example: Feelings of belonging, the study argued, are often external to the formal institutional structure itself.
phrases.example_translation: 该研究认为，归属感往往存在于正式的制度结构本身之外。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，外部压力，政治与经济评论高频
phrases.example: Under external pressure, the ministry quietly reopened the investigation into the collapsed bridge.
phrases.example_translation: 在外部压力之下，该部悄悄重启了对坍塌大桥的调查。

phrases.usage: 定冠词加形名，外部世界，哲学与心理学话语
phrases.example: Infants learn the basic rules of the external world largely through touch and repeated failure.
phrases.example_translation: 婴儿主要通过触摸和一次次失败来习得外部世界的基本规则。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，外部证据，与内部证据相对，文献学与法律常用
phrases.example: The dating of the scroll rests on external evidence, including coins found in the same buried layer.
phrases.example_translation: 这卷文献的断代依据的是外部证据，包括在同一掩埋层中发现的硬币。

phrases.usage: external 作名词复数外观，以外在表象判断
phrases.example: It is easy to judge by externals, yet the shabby corner office housed the firm's actual founders.
phrases.example_translation: 人们很容易以貌取人，但那间寒酸的角落办公室恰恰坐着公司真正的创始人。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，外部观察者，代表中立评估视角
phrases.example: External observers rated the reform far more favorably than the employees it directly affected did.
phrases.example_translation: 外部观察者对这项改革的评价，远比受其直接影响的员工更为正面。

phrases.usage: 系表结构，指物种灭绝，生物与环保论述的核心搭配
phrases.example: Many island birds became extinct after rats first reached the island decades earlier.
phrases.example_translation: 许多岛屿鸟类在鼠类数十年前初上该岛后便灭绝了。

phrases.usage: 副形搭配，保护生物学术语，指数量少到无法维系种群
phrases.example: The population is functionally extinct despite a handful of survivors held in captivity.
phrases.example_translation: 尽管有少数个体在人工饲养中存活，该种群已功能性灭绝。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配取熄灭义，地质学描述，与休眠火山相区别
phrases.example: Farmers still till remarkably rich soil on the lower slopes of an extinct volcano.
phrases.example_translation: 农民仍在一座死火山山麓下方异常肥沃的土壤上耕作。

phrases.usage: 副形搭配，指几近消失，历史与生态叙述常用
phrases.example: By the 1930s the species had become nearly extinct across the northern plains.
phrases.example_translation: 到二十世纪三十年代，这一物种在北部平原已近乎绝迹。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指已灭绝物种，分类与科普文本高频
phrases.example: Natural history museums often label extinct species with the year of the last sighting.
phrases.example_translation: 自然历史博物馆常在已灭绝物种的标签上注明最后一次被目击的年份。

phrases.usage: 比喻用法，指习俗、语言在日常生活中消亡，人文学科常用
phrases.example: The remarkable archive revives several languages and customs long extinct in ordinary daily life.
phrases.example_translation: 这份珍贵的档案复兴了日常普通生活中早已消失的数种语言与习俗。

phrases.usage: 完成时后接 since 引出时间起点，说明灭绝的确切时段
phrases.example: The subspecies has been extinct since the middle of the last century.
phrases.example_translation: 这一亚种自上世纪中叶以来就已灭绝。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，面临灭绝，保护生物学报告的高频谓语
phrases.example: Without corridor protection, several lowland populations face extinction within a single decade.
phrases.example_translation: 若没有生态廊道保护，数个低地种群将在短短十年内面临灭绝。

phrases.usage: drive + 宾语 + to extinction，把……推向灭绝，强调人为推手
phrases.example: Sailors and rats together drove the island's flightless birds to extinction within two generations.
phrases.example_translation: 水手和鼠患共同将这个岛上不会飞的鸟类在两代人之间推向灭绝。

phrases.usage: 介词短语，濒临灭绝边缘，新闻报道与科普通用比喻
phrases.example: Only eleven sightings since 2000 leave the leopard population on the brink of extinction.
phrases.example_translation: 自 2000 年以来仅有十一次目击记录，这一豹种种群已濒临灭绝。

phrases.usage: 学科固定术语，大灭绝，地质与演化文本核心词组
phrases.example: The rock record preserves signs of five mass extinctions, each rewriting ecology.
phrases.example_translation: 岩层记录保存着五次大灭绝的痕迹，每一次都重写了生态格局。

phrases.usage: 名词定语搭配，灭绝事件，讨论陨石与火山成因时常用
phrases.example: An asteroid impact remains the leading explanation for the Cretaceous extinction event.
phrases.example_translation: 小行星撞击仍是解释白垩纪灭绝事件的主流学说。

phrases.usage: 名词 + of，某物种的灭绝，主标题式论述结构的枢纽
phrases.example: The extinction of pollinating bees would reshape agriculture faster than any policy.
phrases.example_translation: 授粉蜜蜂的灭绝将以超出任何政策的速度重塑农业格局。

phrases.usage: 名词定语，灭绝风险，评估模型与保护决策语境
phrases.example: Conservationists weighed the extinction risk of releasing captive-bred owls into the wild too early.
phrases.example_translation: 保护人士权衡了过早将人工繁育猫头鹰放归野外的灭绝风险。

phrases.usage: 因果句式，导致灭绝，说明机制链条时的常用谓语
phrases.example: Habitat fragmentation can lead to extinction long before the last animal is gone.
phrases.example_translation: 栖息地破碎化在最后一头动物消失很久之前便已通向灭绝。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，最本义用法，安全手册与事故报道通用
phrases.example: Volunteers extinguished the fire with damp burlap after the water main burst.
phrases.example_translation: 水管爆裂后，志愿者们用湿麻袋把火扑灭。

phrases.usage: 抽象比喻用法，宾语多为 hope、ambition，叙事中的转折语
phrases.example: The final verdict extinguished any hope of reopening the plant before winter.
phrases.example_translation: 终审判决彻底断绝了在入冬前重开工厂的任何希望。

phrases.usage: 法律搭配，指因时效或清偿而消灭权利主张，正式语体
phrases.example: Long possession can extinguish a claim to the land under local statute.
phrases.example_translation: 依当地法规，长期占有可消灭对该土地的权利主张。

phrases.usage: 不定式结构作表语，指传统或信念难以被压制，评论语体
phrases.example: Such traditions prove difficult to extinguish even under decades of official pressure.
phrases.example_translation: 即便在数十年的官方压力之下，这类传统也难以被消灭。

phrases.usage: 生物与演化语境，指使某一支系灭绝，学术叙述可用
phrases.example: Volcanic ash extinguished several lineages of ferns across the island chain within a generation.
phrases.example_translation: 火山灰在一代时间内使该岛链上数个蕨类支系灭绝。

phrases.usage: 被动结构后接 by，指被手段或力量压制下去，政治报道常见
phrases.example: The protest was extinguished by a mix of concessions and late-autumn arrests.
phrases.example_translation: 这场抗议在让步与深秋逮捕的双重作用下被平息。

phrases.usage: 最典型动宾框架，extol the virtues of，颂扬某事物的好处，常见于评论
phrases.example: Commentators extolled the virtues of communal farming while ignoring its long record of inefficiency.
phrases.example_translation: 评论人士颂扬集体耕作的好处，却对其长期低效的纪录视而不见。

phrases.usage: 副词加过去分词作定语，widely extolled，被广为赞誉的，暗含存疑语气
phrases.example: The widely extolled reforms quietly stalled once the national treasury ran unexpectedly dry.
phrases.example_translation: 一度被广为赞誉的改革，在国家国库意外枯竭后便悄然停滞了。

phrases.usage: 近义动词连用加强语气，praise and extol，称赞并颂扬，多用于批评语境
phrases.example: Official histories praise and extol the founder while smoothing over his most divisive decisions.
phrases.example_translation: 官方史书称赞并颂扬那位创始人，却淡化了他最具争议的决定。

phrases.usage: 被动加补语，be extolled as，被奉为，常含事后反思的意味
phrases.example: The young officer was extolled as a war hero long before the official inquiry had even opened.
phrases.example_translation: 早在官方调查开启之前，那位年轻军官就已被奉为战争英雄。

phrases.usage: 动宾框架变体，extol the merits of，颂扬某制度的优点，政论常用
phrases.example: The pamphleteer extolled the merits of free trade with far more zeal than careful evidence.
phrases.example_translation: 那位小册子作者颂扬自由贸易的优点，热情远多于严谨的证据。

phrases.usage: 副词修饰动词，uncritically extol，不加批判地颂扬，学术批评高频
phrases.example: Textbooks too often uncritically extol explorers whose voyages devastated whole indigenous coastal communities.
phrases.example_translation: 教科书往往不加批判地颂扬探险家，而他们的航行摧毁了整片沿海土著社群。

phrases.usage: 固定习语，extol to the skies，捧上天、极力称赞，新闻与书评常见
phrases.example: Reviewers extolled the debut novel to the skies, yet few readers finished its dense final chapter.
phrases.example_translation: 书评人把这部处女作小说捧上了天，可几乎没几个读者读完了它冗长的末章。

translations.translation: 勒索；敲诈；强夺；被勒索的财物

phrases.usage: 后接 of，勒索钱财，法律和新闻文体常用
phrases.example: The racketeering indictment centered on the extortion of money from hundreds of small businesses.
phrases.example_translation: 敲诈勒索起诉书的核心是对数百家小企业勒索钱财。

phrases.usage: 固定搭配，勒索骗局或敲诈团伙，执法和新闻用语
phrases.example: Federal agents dismantled an extortion racket operating through anonymous online threats.
phrases.example_translation: 联邦特工摧毁了一个通过匿名在线威胁运作的敲诈团伙。

phrases.usage: 有组织犯罪术语，保护费勒索，犯罪学常用
phrases.example: Local merchants reported years of protection extortion by a well-organized neighborhood gang.
phrases.example_translation: 当地商人报告多年来一直遭到组织严密的社区团伙的保护费勒索。

phrases.usage: 法律术语，勒索指控或勒索罪
phrases.example: The defendant pleaded guilty to a felony extortion charge carrying a ten-year maximum sentence.
phrases.example_translation: 被告对一项最高可判十年监禁的勒索重罪指控认罪。

phrases.usage: 在勒索威胁之下，叙事和新闻报道常见
phrases.example: The contractor signed the unfavorable agreement under threat of extortion.
phrases.example_translation: 承包商在勒索威胁下签了这份不利的协议。

phrases.usage: 官员敲诈，反腐和政治评论常用搭配
phrases.example: The investigative report documented systemic extortion by officials in the licensing process.
phrases.example_translation: 调查报告记录了审批过程中官员的系统性敲诈行为。

phrases.usage: 网络敲诈，数字时代法律和技术安全术语
phrases.example: Cyber extortion schemes using encrypted ransomware surged across small hospitals last year.
phrases.example_translation: 去年，使用加密勒索软件的网络敲诈方案在小型医院中激增。

translations.translation: 取出；抽出；拔出；抽出物；出身

phrases.usage: 后接 of + 对象，表示对某物的提取或获取，最核心的介词结构
phrases.example: The extraction of rare earth elements from seawater remains technically daunting and prohibitively costly.
phrases.example_translation: 从海水中提取稀土元素在技术上仍然十分艰巨，而且成本高得令人却步。

phrases.usage: 名词修饰名词，指从文本或数据库中抽取信息，社科与计算领域常用
phrases.example: Her new algorithm speeds up data extraction from bulky nineteenth-century parish registers.
phrases.example_translation: 她的新算法加快了从卷帙浩繁的十九世纪教区登记册中抽取数据的速度。

phrases.usage: 形容词搭配，暗含使用强力，常见于人权报道与法律评论，贬义
phrases.example: The report condemned the forceful extraction of confessions from detainees held without counsel.
phrases.example_translation: 报告谴责从未经律师会见即在押的被拘留者身上强行逼取供词的做法。

phrases.usage: 后接 from + 来源，强调从某环境或材料中取出，说明文常用
phrases.example: Sustained extraction from already overfished waters has pushed several commercial species toward collapse.
phrases.example_translation: 从本已过度捕捞的海域持续获取渔获，已使多个经济鱼种濒临崩溃。

phrases.usage: 医学具体搭配，指拔牙手术，日常与学术文本均可见
phrases.example: The surgeon advised postponing the tooth extraction until the surrounding infection had fully cleared.
phrases.example_translation: 外科医生建议把拔牙手术推迟到周围炎症完全消退之后。

phrases.usage: 指采矿或军事营救等有组织的行动，中性，新闻与地质文本常见
phrases.example: The desert extraction operation quietly relocated thirty stranded engineers before the sandstorm arrived.
phrases.example_translation: 这场沙漠营救行动在沙暴来临前悄悄转移了三十名受困工程师。

phrases.usage: 书面语，指出身卑微，修饰人物背景，传记与历史小说常用
phrases.example: The memoirist wrote proudly of his humble extraction from a small isolated mining village.
phrases.example_translation: 这位回忆录作者自豪地写下自己出身于一座偏远小矿村的卑微家境。

translations.translation: 外来的；没有关联的；来自体外的

phrases.usage: 形名，无关细节，编辑与写作语境
phrases.example: The editor cut the extraneous details that had swollen the manuscript's first draft.
phrases.example_translation: 编辑删去了那些令手稿初稿膨胀的无关细节。

phrases.usage: 形容词后接 to，与议题无涉，学术论辩常用
phrases.example: The chair ruled her objections extraneous to the narrow matter before the committee.
phrases.example_translation: 主持人裁定她的异议与委员会待议的狭义事项无关。

phrases.usage: 形名，外来杂音，录音与实验语境
phrases.example: The recording captured extraneous noise from the ventilation duct beneath the studio floor.
phrases.example_translation: 录音收录了摄影棚地板下通风管道传来的杂音。

phrases.usage: 形名，外来杂质，实验操作流程用语
phrases.example: Technicians filter extraneous material from water samples before running the chemical analysis.
phrases.example_translation: 技术员在做化学分析前先滤除水样中的外来杂质。

phrases.usage: 副形搭配，完全无关，强调排除性判断
phrases.example: He argued that the financial comparison was entirely extraneous to an essay on style.
phrases.example_translation: 他认为那段财务比较对一篇论风格的散文完全无关。

phrases.usage: 动词短语加宾语，剔除冗余成分
phrases.example: The coach taught recruits to strip away extraneous movement and skate with economy.
phrases.example_translation: 教练教新秀剔除多余动作，以省力的方式滑行。

translations.translation: 非凡的；特别的；离奇的；临时的；特派的

phrases.usage: 国际政治与法律术语，特别引渡，新闻与政论高频
phrases.example: The committee investigated years of extraordinary rendition carried out beyond judicial oversight.
phrases.example_translation: 委员会调查了多年游离于司法监督之外的特别引渡行动。

phrases.usage: 法律公文搭配，特殊情况，免责与紧急条款常用
phrases.example: Under extraordinary circumstances the charter allows the council to vote without public notice.
phrases.example_translation: 遇特殊情况，章程允许议会不事公告即行表决。

phrases.usage: 评价性搭配，非凡壮举，叙事中的赞叹语
phrases.example: Cataloguing every seed within three seasons was an extraordinary feat for one botanist.
phrases.example_translation: 仅凭一位植物学家之力，在三个生长季内登记所有种子，堪称壮举。

phrases.usage: 治理语境搭配，特别权力，常涉紧急状态讨论
phrases.example: Parliament granted the ministry extraordinary powers to contain the spreading wildfire.
phrases.example_translation: 议会授予该部特别权力，以遏制蔓延的山火。

phrases.usage: 固定强化句式，简直非凡，演讲与书评的最高赞美
phrases.example: Rebuilding the archive from burned fragments was nothing short of extraordinary, donors said.
phrases.example_translation: 捐赠者说，从烧焦的残片中重建档案，简直是了不起的奇迹。

phrases.usage: 形容词接不定式，观之令人惊叹，描写奇观
phrases.example: The migrating thousands of starlings, swirling at dusk, were extraordinary to behold.
phrases.example_translation: 黄昏时分，数千只椋鸟盘旋而迁，那景象壮观得令人惊叹。

phrases.usage: 动词短语，诉诸非常手段，政策辩论句式
phrases.example: Faced with collapsing revenue, the museum had to resort to extraordinary measures.
phrases.example_translation: 收入骤然塌缩，博物馆不得不诉诸非常手段。

translations.translation: 奢侈，浪费；过度；放肆的言行

phrases.usage: 形容词修饰，指政府或个人的财政挥霍，评论高频
phrases.example: The crown's fiscal extravagance provoked three separate parliaments to refuse new subsidies.
phrases.example_translation: 王室在财政上的挥霍让三届议会先后拒绝批准新的补贴。

phrases.usage: 后接 of + 名词或动名词，指…的奢侈，常见于批评语体
phrases.example: Critics questioned the extravagance of building a concert hall in an underfunded district.
phrases.example_translation: 批评者质疑在拨款不足的区域兴建音乐厅的奢侈。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指抑制奢靡之风，政策与道德劝诫常见
phrases.example: Sumptuary laws tried to curb extravagance by dictating the width of noble sleeves.
phrases.example_translation: 奢侈禁令试图通过规定贵族衣袖的宽度来抑制奢靡之风。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指王室或权贵的奢靡，历史与政论常见
phrases.example: The pamphlet contrasted royal extravagance with the empty granaries of the provinces.
phrases.example_translation: 那本小册子把王室的奢靡与地方仓库的空虚作了对比。

phrases.usage: 反讽或淡化用法，指无伤大雅的放纵
phrases.example: Buying the vintage typewriter was a harmless extravagance she regretted only on payday.
phrases.example_translation: 买那台老式打字机是一桩无伤大雅的奢侈，她只在发薪日才会后悔。

phrases.usage: 引申用法，指语言或修辞上的夸张铺陈，文学评论常见
phrases.example: The editor quietly trimmed the extravagance of language that clogged his student's essays.
phrases.example_translation: 编辑悄悄删去了堵在学生习作里那些过分铺张的语言。

phrases.usage: 反身加 from，设法摆脱束缚或麻烦，书面语高频
phrases.example: He spent years trying to extricate himself from a contract written entirely against him.
phrases.example_translation: 他花了好几年，想从一份全然对他不利的合同中脱身。

phrases.usage: 具体物理用法，from 后接泥泞、残骸等，抽出身体部位
phrases.example: She managed to extricate her foot from the mud and limp back to the path.
phrases.example_translation: 她总算把脚从泥里拔了出来，一瘸一拐地走回小径。

phrases.usage: 评价句式，指资金或人员难以撤出，经济与投资语境
phrases.example: Capital proved hard to extricate once the factory had been built on the site.
phrases.example_translation: 一旦厂房在该地建成，资金就很难再抽身了。

phrases.usage: 抽象用法，指巧妙摆脱尴尬局面，含机智应变意味
phrases.example: The diplomat extricated himself from an awkward question by praising both delegations.
phrases.example_translation: 那位外交官通过同时夸赞两方代表团，从棘手的问题中脱身。

phrases.usage: 副词修饰，表缓慢脱离债务或困境等长期状态
phrases.example: The economy slowly extricated itself from the debt that the war had created.
phrases.example_translation: 经济慢慢从战争所造成的债务中挣脱出来。

phrases.usage: barely 表勉强脱身，救援与事故叙述常用
phrases.example: Firefighters barely extricated the driver from the wreckage before the fuel ignited.
phrases.example_translation: 消防员赶在燃料起火之前，才勉强把司机从残骸中拖出。

translations.translation: 外向；外倾者；性格外向者（等于extravert）

phrases.usage: 以天生修饰，天性外向的人，人物侧写与心理科普的褒义刻画
phrases.example: The newscaster was a natural extrovert who thrived on live interviews and debate.
phrases.example_translation: 这位新闻主播天性外向，在直播访谈与辩论中如鱼得水。

phrases.usage: 典型外倾者，用于人格类型归类与对照讨论
phrases.example: By every classroom measure she was the classic extrovert, organising parties and clubs.
phrases.example_translation: 以课堂上的种种表现衡量，她都是典型的外向者，操持聚会和社团。

phrases.usage: 心理测评表达，被测出属于外倾型，人格量表语境
phrases.example: Half the sales staff tested as an extrovert on the standard personality inventory.
phrases.example_translation: 半数销售人员在这份标准人格量表上被测量为外倾型。

phrases.usage: 天生外向者，固定说法，口语与侧写文体均常见
phrases.example: The tour guide, a born extrovert, befriended strangers within minutes of the bus arriving.
phrases.example_translation: 导游是个天生的外向者，大巴一到没几分钟就和陌生人熟络起来。

phrases.usage: 对照框架，内向者与外向者，人格心理学的核心对立组合
phrases.example: The workshop examined how introverts and extroverts recover energy after the same lecture.
phrases.example_translation: 工作坊考察了内向者与外向者在听完同一场讲座后如何恢复精力。

phrases.usage: 场景限定搭配，家庭里最外向的那一个，传记叙事中的轻松笔调
phrases.example: As the family extrovert, he handled every phone call and dinner reservation.
phrases.example_translation: 作为家里最外向的人，他包揽了所有电话和晚餐订位。

phrases.usage: 后接模具或孔口，指从某物中挤出，工艺术语
phrases.example: The press extrudes molten aluminum through a narrow die to form long rods.
phrases.example_translation: 压力机把熔融铝通过狭窄模口挤出，制成长杆。

phrases.usage: 动宾学科搭配，指挤出熔融玻璃，材料学叙述
phrases.example: In the plant, workers extrude molten glass into fibers thinner than a human hair.
phrases.example_translation: 在这座工厂里，工人把熔融玻璃挤出成比头发还细的纤维。

phrases.usage: 被动句式，指被加工成某种形态，产品说明常用
phrases.example: The recycled compound can be extruded as flexible tubing or pressed into flat sheets.
phrases.example_translation: 这种再生材料可被挤出成柔性管材，也可压成薄板。

phrases.usage: 地质学搭配，指熔岩自裂隙涌出，自然科学文本
phrases.example: Thick lava extruded from a new fissure and sealed the old mountain road overnight.
phrases.example_translation: 黏稠的熔岩从一条新裂隙中挤出，一夜之间封住了旧山路。

phrases.usage: 副动搭配，指在压力下挤压成型，多见于工艺描述
phrases.example: The sticky paste is extruded under pressure through perforated metal plates into pellets.
phrases.example_translation: 黏稠的糊状物在压力下穿过穿孔金属板被挤成颗粒。

phrases.usage: 动宾工业搭配，指挤出金属型材，制造语境常用
phrases.example: The production line extrudes a reusable profile for window frames at a steady speed.
phrases.example_translation: 生产线以稳定速度挤出用于窗框的可复用型材。

translations.translation: 繁茂的；生气勃勃的，充溢的

phrases.usage: 形名搭配指生气勃勃的个性，人物描写高频
phrases.example: The casting director favored actresses with an exuberant personality over merely polished technique.
phrases.example_translation: 选角导演更看重女演员生机勃勃的个性，而非仅仅纯熟的技巧。

phrases.usage: 取繁茂之义修饰植物，自然与景观描写常用
phrases.example: Ivy smothered the abandoned factory, its exuberant foliage splitting the brickwork within a decade.
phrases.example_translation: 常春藤吞没了废弃的工厂，繁茂的枝叶十年内便胀裂了砖墙。

phrases.usage: 后接of引出对象，形容热烈颂扬，艺术评论常见
phrases.example: The mural is an exuberant celebration of the city's immigrant communities.
phrases.example_translation: 这幅壁画是对该市移民社群的一场热烈颂扬。

phrases.usage: 系动词加比较级副词，描写情绪逐渐高涨的过程
phrases.example: The crowd grew increasingly exuberant as the underdogs scored their second goal.
phrases.example_translation: 随着弱旅攻入第二球，观众的情绪愈发欢腾。

phrases.usage: 副词修饰形容词，喧闹奔放，常暗含与场合不合
phrases.example: His boisterously exuberant greeting embarrassed the reserved diplomat at the formal reception.
phrases.example_translation: 他喧闹奔放的祝福让这位内敛的外交官在正式招待会上颇为尴尬。

phrases.usage: 比较结构，程度副词far加强，用于风格或情绪对比
phrases.example: The sequel proved far more exuberant than the restrained original.
phrases.example_translation: 续集被证明远比克制的第一部来得热烈奔放。

translations.translation: 非常高兴的；欢跃的；狂喜的；欢欣鼓舞的

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指“一声狂喜的呼喊”，叙事与体育场景
phrases.example: An exultant shout rolled across the stadium when the final point was won.
phrases.example_translation: 赢得最后一分时，一声狂喜的呼喊在体育场中回荡。

phrases.usage: 后接 over，表示“为胜利而欢欣鼓舞”，情感强烈
phrases.example: The exultant crowd paraded through the streets, delirious over their narrow victory.
phrases.example_translation: 欢腾的人群游行穿过街道，为这场险胜而欣喜若狂。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指“狂喜的人群”，描写集体情绪的场面
phrases.example: An exultant crowd gathered outside the hall to hear the long-delayed result.
phrases.example_translation: 一群狂喜的人聚在大厅外，聆听那迟迟公布的选举结果。

phrases.usage: 后置形容词，指“语气中带着得意”，文学化倒装写法
phrases.example: He wrote back in a tone exultant but not quite unkind.
phrases.example_translation: 他回信时语气带着得意，却又不算尖刻。

phrases.usage: 形容词并置，指“既狂喜又桀骜”，塑造人物情绪
phrases.example: Standing on the summit, she felt exultant and defiant all at once.
phrases.example_translation: 站在顶峰上，她一时既狂喜又桀骜不驯。

phrases.usage: with 加名词，指“带着狂喜的解脱”，叙事收尾常用
phrases.example: The surgeon stepped back from the table with exultant, exhausted relief.
phrases.example_translation: 外科医生带着一阵狂喜而疲惫的解脱感从手术台旁退开。

phrases.usage: 动词加 through 结构，指通过目镜观察，天文与显微操作
phrases.example: Students queued to look through the eyepiece and find the crater line on the moon.
phrases.example_translation: 学生们排队通过目镜观察，寻找月球上的环形山连线。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指调节目镜，实验操作说明常用
phrases.example: Before photographing a faint comet, astronomers adjust the eyepiece with great patience.
phrases.example_translation: 在给暗弱的彗星拍照之前，天文学家会极耐心地调节目镜。

phrases.usage: 名名术语，指目镜透镜，光学器件描述语域
phrases.example: The old eyepiece lens clouded with age and blurred every image it formed.
phrases.example_translation: 那枚老旧的目镜透镜因年久而浑浊，把它形成的每个像都弄模糊了。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指通过目镜对焦，观察记录中的实用说法
phrases.example: She focused the eyepiece until the jellyfish tentacles resolved into separate threads.
phrases.example_translation: 她调节目镜对焦，直到水母的触丝分解成一条条清晰的细线。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，更换目镜以改变放大倍率，观测者口语与手册通用
phrases.example: By changing the eyepiece the club doubled magnification without buying a larger scope.
phrases.example_translation: 通过更换目镜，天文社不必购置更大的望远镜就把放大倍率翻倍了。

phrases.usage: 复合形容词修饰，指广角目镜，器材规格语域
phrases.example: A wide-field eyepiece let the class track the satellite without constant correction.
phrases.example_translation: 一副广角目镜让全班不用不断修正就能追踪那颗卫星。

phrases.usage: 专名搭配，指伊索寓言中的一篇，教育与文学评论常用
phrases.example: The teacher retold an Aesop's fable to expose the folly of boasting.
phrases.example_translation: 老师复述了一则伊索寓言，以此揭示吹嘘的愚蠢。

phrases.usage: 名词后接 about 引出题材，指借虚构动物故事讽喻人性
phrases.example: His novel reads like a fable about greed disguised as civic virtue.
phrases.example_translation: 他的小说读起来像一则把贪婪伪装成公德心的人性寓言。

phrases.usage: 固定所有格框架，指寓言寓意，文本分析高频用语
phrases.example: The moral of the fable is that flattery exacts a surprisingly costly price.
phrases.example_translation: 这则寓言的寓意是，奉承所要付出的代价出人意料地高昂。

phrases.usage: 指因不可信而斥为无稽之谈，学术史考证语境常见
phrases.example: Historians long dismissed the charter as fable until a contemporaneous copy surfaced.
phrases.example_translation: 史学家们长期把这份特许状斥为无稽之谈，直到一份同时代抄本现身。

phrases.usage: 文学性动宾搭配，指编织一则关于某题材的寓言，叙事传统用语
phrases.example: The chronicler wove a fable of wolves and shepherds to criticize the tax farm.
phrases.example_translation: 编年史家编织了一则狼与牧人的寓言，借此抨击包税制度。

phrases.usage: 文学术语，指动物寓言体裁，中世纪文学研究标准表述
phrases.example: The lecture traced the medieval beast fable from monastic Latin into vernacular verse.
phrases.example_translation: 这节课梳理了中世纪动物寓言从修道院拉丁文向方言诗歌的传播。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，法律语境，指捏造证据，司法丑闻报道的核心动词组合
phrases.example: Two officers were charged after the court found they had fabricated evidence.
phrases.example_translation: 法庭认定两人捏造证据后，两名警员被提起指控。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，学术不端语境，指伪造实验或调查数据，科研诚信讨论高频
phrases.example: The journal retracted three papers after a postdoc fabricated data.
phrases.example_translation: 一名博士后伪造数据之后，该期刊撤回了三篇论文。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指编造借口，日常叙事与校园语境的自然用法
phrases.example: The student fabricated an elaborate excuse for the missing term paper.
phrases.example_translation: 那名学生为没交学期论文编造了一个煞有介事的借口。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配的制造义，指加工装配零部件，工业与工程文本的本义用法
phrases.example: The workshop fabricates titanium components for regional aerospace programs.
phrases.example_translation: 这家车间为本地航空项目加工钛合金零部件。

phrases.usage: 动词加宾语再接 against，指炮制针对某人的指控，政治迫害叙事常用
phrases.example: Critics claimed the ministry fabricated accusations against the independent union.
phrases.example_translation: 批评人士称该部门炮制了针对独立工会的指控。

phrases.usage: 被动结构后接 from，指由某材料加工制成，制造义的材料说明句式
phrases.example: The harbor sculpture was fabricated entirely from reclaimed ship timbers.
phrases.example_translation: 这座港口雕塑完全用回收的船体木料加工而成。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指伪造签名，文件鉴定与欺诈案件报道中的具体搭配
phrases.example: Forensic experts proved the delivery order's signature had been fabricated.
phrases.example_translation: 鉴定专家证实送货单上的签名系伪造。

translations.translation: 难以置信的；传说的，寓言中的；极好的

phrases.usage: 取「传说般难以置信的」义，fabulous wealth，惊人的财富，史述常用
phrases.example: The chronicles describe the port city's fabulous wealth in numbers no surviving tax roll confirms.
phrases.example_translation: 编年史以现存税册无法证实的数字描述这座港口城市惊人的财富。

phrases.usage: 取「寓言传说中的」义，fabulous creatures，传说中的奇珍异兽
phrases.example: Medieval bestiaries catalogued fabulous creatures with the seriousness of modern field guides.
phrases.example_translation: 中世纪的动物志以现代野外图鉴般的认真态度收录传说中的异兽。

phrases.usage: 口语褒义「极好的」，simply fabulous，好极了，副词加强语气
phrases.example: Her cheerful account of the internship made exhausting city life sound simply fabulous.
phrases.example_translation: 她对实习经历的欢快讲述，把令人疲惫的都市生活说得美妙极了。

phrases.usage: 取「虚构的」本义，fabulous tales，荒诞不经的故事，评论辨伪语境
phrases.example: Courtiers circulated fabulous tales of gold-roofed temples that no verified traveler ever reported.
phrases.example_translation: 廷臣们流传着金顶神庙的荒诞故事，却没有任何可靠旅行者报告过。

phrases.usage: 历史地理语境，fabulous kingdom，传奇国度，古地图上的想象之地
phrases.example: Cartographers filled the map margins with fabulous kingdoms imagined from unreliable second-hand reports.
phrases.example_translation: 制图师在地图边缘绘满根据不可靠的二手报告想象出的传奇国度。

phrases.usage: 副词加强形容词，positively fabulous，好得不得了，偏口语赞美
phrases.example: After months of argument, the restored facade looked positively fabulous under the gallery lights.
phrases.example_translation: 争吵了几个月之后，修复一新的立面在展厅灯光下显得格外华美。

phrases.usage: 取「难以置信的」义，fabulous account，不堪采信的说法，正式驳斥用语
phrases.example: The senator dismissed the leaked memo as a fabulous account invented by political rivals.
phrases.example_translation: 参议员将泄露的备忘录斥为政敌编造的不可信的胡说。

translations.translation: 脸；表面；面子；面容；外观；威信

phrases.usage: 动词+宾语，指直面或应对挑战，议论文或新闻常用
phrases.example: Coastal cities face a challenge unprecedented in recorded history.
phrases.example_translation: 沿海城市正面临着有史以来前所未有的挑战。

phrases.usage: 介词短语作让步状语，指面对某情况仍……，正式或学术语体
phrases.example: In the face of mounting data, the committee revised its original projection.
phrases.example_translation: 面对不断增多的数据，委员会修订了最初的预测。

phrases.usage: 固定习语，指保全颜面，外交、职场或日常评论高频
phrases.example: The CEO issued a vague statement to save face before shareholders.
phrases.example_translation: 首席执行官发表了含糊声明，以便在股东面前保住颜面。

phrases.usage: 动宾固定搭配，指正视现实，劝诫或评论语境
phrases.example: The editorial urged the government to face the facts on housing shortages.
phrases.example_translation: 社论呼吁政府正视住房短缺的现实。

phrases.usage: 复合形容词，指大胆的或印刷中黑体的，不同语境各有含义
phrases.example: The bold-faced type in the contract drew attention to the liability clause.
phrases.example_translation: 合同中的黑体字引起了人们对责任条款的注意。

phrases.usage: 动词+副词+介词短语，指勇于正视某问题，正式劝告语气
phrases.example: The region must finally face up to its dependence on a single crop.
phrases.example_translation: 该地区必须终于正视自己对单一作物的依赖。

phrases.usage: 插入语，指从表面上看，用于引出初步印象再转折
phrases.example: On the face of it the proposal sounds generous, yet the fine print reveals limits.
phrases.example_translation: 表面上看这项提议似乎很大方，但细则却暗藏限制。

phrases.usage: 动词短语+against，指正面对抗或竞技对决，体育或冲突报道
phrases.example: The two rivals will face off against each other in the championship final.
phrases.example_translation: 两位对手将在冠军决赛中正面交锋。

phrases.usage: 后接 of + 抽象名词，指问题的某一个侧面，正式议论文常用
phrases.example: The report examines one neglected facet of the housing problem: long-vacant units.
phrases.example_translation: 报告考察了住房问题中一个被忽视的侧面：长期空置的住宅单元。

phrases.usage: 限定词 each 加强周遍义，指逐一方面地核查或论述
phrases.example: The audit reviewed each facet of the charity's finances, from payroll to grant awards.
phrases.example_translation: 这次审计核查了该慈善机构财务的方方面面，从员工薪资到资助款项。

phrases.usage: of 结构，指公共争论中的一环，评论与学术写作高频
phrases.example: His paper adds an unexpected facet to the debate over standardized testing.
phrases.example_translation: 他的论文为关于标准化考试的争论增添了一个出人意料的侧面。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指在宝石上切出小平面，取本义，工艺术语
phrases.example: The lapidary cut each facet at a precise angle so the stone would throw light.
phrases.example_translation: 宝石匠按精确的角度切出每一个小平面，好让宝石折射出光彩。

phrases.usage: 复数名词加 of 结构，指宝石的多个晶面，描写具体实物
phrases.example: Light entered the diamond through its upper facets and scattered across the dark table.
phrases.example_translation: 光线从钻石上方的晶面射入，在深色的台面上散射开来。

phrases.usage: 及物动词用法，指给宝石琢面，词性活用，工艺与矿物学语境
phrases.example: The workshop faceted the sapphire to bring out its deepest blue.
phrases.example_translation: 工坊为这颗蓝宝石琢面，以显出它最浓郁的蓝色。

phrases.usage: 表递进补充，指同一人或事的另一面，人物评述常见
phrases.example: The letters reveal another facet of a poet long reduced to a single anecdote.
phrases.example_translation: 这些书信展现了另一位诗人的另一面，他长久以来只被人记得一段轶事。

translations.translation: 诙谐的；爱开玩笑的；滑稽的；(尤指在不合适的时候)开玩笑的

phrases.usage: 系表动态搭配，指言谈逐渐变得油腔滑调，正式叙事常用
phrases.example: The witness grew facetious under questioning, and the judge warned him sharply.
phrases.example_translation: 证人在追问之下开始油嘴滑舌，法官严厉地警告了他。

phrases.usage: 形容词修饰言语名词，指不合时宜的玩笑话，评论常见
phrases.example: His facetious remark during the memorial struck even his closest friends as tasteless.
phrases.example_translation: 他在追思会上那句不合时宜的玩笑，连挚友都觉得失礼。

phrases.usage: 形容词后接about，指对严肃议题轻佻打诨，评价语境
phrases.example: The editorial accused the minister of being far too facetious about the inquiry.
phrases.example_translation: 社论指责部长对调查一事过于轻佻玩世。

phrases.usage: 固定双重否定句式，意为极度诙谐，人物素描常用
phrases.example: The campaign spokesman was nothing if not facetious, deflecting every hard question with a joke.
phrases.example_translation: 这位竞选发言人最突出的特点就是诙谐，用玩笑回避每一个尖锐问题。

phrases.usage: 接语气名词，指不严肃的口吻，书面文体与礼仪讨论
phrases.example: She abandoned the essay's facetious tone once the evidence turned genuinely somber.
phrases.example_translation: 一旦证据变得确实沉重，她便抛弃了文章中那调侃的语调。

phrases.usage: 系动词加形容词，指貌似在开玩笑，多用于评价
phrases.example: At first the pamphlet seemed facetious, but its data proved devastatingly serious.
phrases.example_translation: 起初这份小册子看似戏作，但其数据证明其态度极为严肃。

phrases.usage: 副词修饰形容词，指苦中作谐的调侃，评论笔调常见
phrases.example: His wryly facetious footnote softened the sting of an otherwise harsh critique.
phrases.example_translation: 他那苦涩诙谐的脚注冲淡了原本尖刻批评的锋芒。

translations.translation: （言语或理论）轻率的，未经深思熟虑的

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指未经深思熟虑的论点，学术批评高频
phrases.example: The reviewer dismissed the facile argument as ignoring decades of contrary evidence.
phrases.example_translation: 评论者驳斥了这一轻率论点，认为它忽视了几十年的反面证据。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指过于简单的解决方案，政策评论与社论常用
phrases.example: Critics warned that building a wall was a facile solution to a complex crisis.
phrases.example_translation: 批评者警告说，筑墙不过是应对复杂危机的轻率方案。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指轻率的类比，修辞与逻辑讨论常见
phrases.example: The professor flagged the facile analogy between governments and households as misleading.
phrases.example_translation: 教授指出将政府与家庭进行简单类比是一种误导。

phrases.usage: 系表结构，意为看似轻巧实则草率，评论性文章常用
phrases.example: The proposal seemed facile until the committee examined its assumptions in detail.
phrases.example_translation: 该提案看似简单，直到委员会详细审查其假设才发现问题。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指轻率的推理，逻辑学与辩论批评中使用
phrases.example: The essay's central flaw was facile reasoning drawn from a single anecdote.
phrases.example_translation: 这篇文章的核心缺陷是从单一轶事得出的轻率推理。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指轻率的乐观，文学批评与历史反思常用
phrases.example: After the war, the public's facile optimism about lasting peace proved premature.
phrases.example_translation: 战后公众对持久和平的轻率乐观被证明为时过早。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指促进学习或理解，教育与认知科学文本高频
phrases.example: Small seminars with open discussion facilitate learning far better than large lectures.
phrases.example_translation: 开放讨论的小型研讨课远比大班讲授更能促进学习。

phrases.usage: 动宾加of，指促进人员或信息的流通，社科学术文体常见
phrases.example: The agreement facilitated the exchange of researchers between the two academies each year.
phrases.example_translation: 该协议促进了两国科学院之间研究人员每年的互访交流。

phrases.usage: 后接between引出对话双方，指斡旋促成对话，外交语境常用
phrases.example: The neutral venue facilitated dialogue between factions that had not spoken for years.
phrases.example_translation: 中立场所促成了多年未曾交谈的各派别之间的对话。

phrases.usage: 后接with引出所遵守的法规，政策与法律评论常用表达
phrases.example: Plain-language summaries often facilitate compliance with regulations that confuse even experienced lawyers.
phrases.example_translation: 通俗语言的摘要常能促进对连资深律师都感到困惑的法规的遵守。

phrases.usage: 被动结构后接不定式，说明设施或制度的设计目的
phrases.example: The wide sidewalks are designed to facilitate wheelchair access throughout the historic district.
phrases.example_translation: 宽阔的人行道旨在为轮椅通行整个历史街区提供便利。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指催化或促发化学反应，自然科学说明文常见
phrases.example: Enzymes in saliva facilitate chemical reactions that begin starch digestion before food arrives.
phrases.example_translation: 唾液中的酶促发在食物到达胃部前就开始的淀粉消化反应。

phrases.usage: 后接to，指降低获取资源或场所的门槛，资助类语境高频
phrases.example: Scholarships facilitate access to laboratories and archives otherwise closed to most undergraduates.
phrases.example_translation: 奖学金让本科生得以进入对大多数人关闭的实验室与档案室。

phrases.usage: 定名复数，公共设施，城市规划语境
phrases.example: The redevelopment plan adds restrooms and ramps among the park's public facilities.
phrases.example_translation: 改造计划在公园的公共设施中增设卫生间与坡道。

phrases.usage: 数量短语，科研设施，机构报道常用
phrases.example: The university won funding to expand its coastal research facility this spring.
phrases.example_translation: 该大学今年春天获得经费，用于扩建其沿海科研设施。

phrases.usage: 名词后接 for，表示对某事的过人领悟力
phrases.example: Even before college she showed a remarkable facility for statistics, absorbing dense proofs without notes.
phrases.example_translation: 中学未毕她便显露出非凡的统计学天赋，无需笔记即可吃透繁难的证明。

phrases.usage: 介词短语作状语，娴熟自如地
phrases.example: He handled the lathe with facility, turning rough stock into smooth pillars.
phrases.example_translation: 他车床使得娴熟自如，毛坯转眼成光润立柱。

phrases.usage: 定名复数，体育设施，校园与市政议题
phrases.example: The school district modernized its athletic facilities despite objections from historic-district reviewers.
phrases.example_translation: 尽管历史街区评审人员提出异议，学区仍更新了体育设施。

phrases.usage: 数量短语，加工处理设施，环境与产业争议
phrases.example: The dispute centered on a waste processing facility proposed beside the reservoir.
phrases.example_translation: 争议聚焦于拟建于水库旁的一座废弃物处理设施。

phrases.usage: 出版术语，珍本的影印版，学术出版与图书馆语境
phrases.example: The library acquired a facsimile edition of the illuminated manuscript for classroom use.
phrases.example_translation: 图书馆购入这部泥金装饰手抄本的影印版，供课堂教学使用。

phrases.usage: 后接 of，与原物丝毫不差的复制品，强调还原度
phrases.example: The reprint is an exact facsimile of the 1798 pamphlet, water stains included.
phrases.example_translation: 这份重印本是那本一七九八年小册子分毫不差的副本，连水渍都保留。

phrases.usage: 通信术语，传真传输，描述电邮普及前商务往来的说法
phrases.example: Before email spread, orders reached the mill by facsimile transmission late each evening.
phrases.example_translation: 电子邮件普及之前，订单每天深夜通过传真传输送达磨坊。

phrases.usage: 印刷复制的签名，收藏与行政语境，暗含非亲笔之意
phrases.example: Collectors learned to doubt the facsimile signature stamped on the title page.
phrases.example_translation: 藏家渐渐学会怀疑扉页上印制的那种复制签名。

phrases.usage: 介词短语，以影印复制的形式，文献整理惯用语
phrases.example: Rare marginal notes were reproduced in facsimile so readers could judge the handwriting themselves.
phrases.example_translation: 稀有的页边批注以影印方式复制，以便读者自行判断笔迹。

phrases.usage: 名名搭配，影印复制品或复制行为，艺术出版用语
phrases.example: The museum authorized facsimile reproduction of the mural for its educational catalogue.
phrases.example_translation: 博物馆授权影印复制那幅壁画，收入其教育图录。

translations.translation: 派别；内讧；小集团；纪实小说

phrases.usage: dissenting 等形容词修饰 faction，指持异议的派别，政论高频
phrases.example: A dissenting faction within the committee published its own report on the findings.
phrases.example_translation: 委员会内部一个持异议的派别就调查结果发表了自己的报告。

phrases.usage: 与 split、divide、rive 连用，表分裂成派系，暗含争斗意味
phrases.example: After the leader died, the movement split into factions that argued endlessly for years.
phrases.example_translation: 领袖去世后，这场运动分裂成若干派系，此后多年争论不休。

phrases.usage: dominant、ruling 修饰 faction，指掌权派系，用于权力结构分析
phrases.example: The dominant faction controlled the party funds and quietly sidelined its rivals.
phrases.example_translation: 占主导的派系掌控着党的资金，并悄无声息地把对手边缘化。

phrases.usage: faction 后接 within 加组织名，指明派系所属范围，正式评论用法
phrases.example: Journalists traced the leak to a faction within the party opposed to the accord.
phrases.example_translation: 记者们追查发现，泄密来自党内一个反对该协定的派系。

phrases.usage: 动词 foment、promote 直接接 faction，指挑动派系争斗，贬义书面
phrases.example: The editor was accused of fomenting faction to weaken the reform coalition before the vote.
phrases.example_translation: 那位编辑被指控在表决前挑动派系之争，以削弱改革联盟。

phrases.usage: of 短语所属结构，指派系首领，史论与叙事通用
phrases.example: The leader of a minor faction negotiated a seat on the oversight panel.
phrases.example_translation: 一个小派系的首领谈成了监督委员会里的一个席位。

translations.translation: 好捣乱的；好搞派系的；源于派别的

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，好结党纷争的风气，政治史与制度评论常用
phrases.example: A factious spirit seized the town council after the boundary dispute was reopened.
phrases.example_translation: 边界争端重提之后，好搞派系的风气笼罩了镇议会。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，派系倾轧，书面贬义，形容内耗式冲突
phrases.example: The reform programme collapsed less from outside opposition than from factious strife among its backers.
phrases.example_translation: 改革计划失败，与其说由于外部反对，不如说源于支持者的派系倾轧。

phrases.usage: 系表结构加 grow，变得好捣乱、拉帮结派，描述组织退化
phrases.example: Once funding became scarce, the research group grew factious and stopped sharing data.
phrases.example_translation: 经费一紧张，课题组便开始结党相争，不再共享数据。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，出于派系立场的反对，暗示反对本身非就事论事
phrases.example: The committee dismissed the criticism as factious opposition rather than a genuine methodological concern.
phrases.example_translation: 委员会把这一批评斥为派系作祟的反对，而非真正的方法论疑虑。

phrases.usage: render 加宾语加形容词，使议事机构陷入党争，正式政论句式
phrases.example: A single procedural ruling rendered the assembly factious for the rest of the term.
phrases.example_translation: 一项程序性裁决让整个议会在此后任期内陷入党争。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，好争的门性，人物评价与心理描写用
phrases.example: His factious temperament made him brilliant in debate and hopeless in a coalition government.
phrases.example_translation: 他好争的天性让他在辩论中表现出色，在联合政府里却毫无办法。

translations.translation: 因素；要素；[物] 因数；代理人

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指起决定作用的因素，学术与评论文高频
phrases.example: Access to clean water was a decisive factor in choosing the settlement site.
phrases.example_translation: 能否取用洁净的水源是选择定居点时的决定性因素。

phrases.usage: 后接 in + 名词或动名词，指某一现象中的关键要素，社科通用
phrases.example: Housing affordability remains a key factor in how young workers choose a city.
phrases.example_translation: 住房可负担性仍是年轻工作者选择城市时的关键因素。

phrases.usage: 动词短语介词搭配，指把某因素纳入考虑或计算
phrases.example: The committee failed to factor local weather patterns into the construction schedule.
phrases.example_translation: 委员会没能把当地天气规律纳入施工计划考虑。

phrases.usage: 数学与经济学术语，指提取公因式或剔除变量，可比喻化使用
phrases.example: Analysts factor out energy prices to see whether underlying inflation is easing.
phrases.example_translation: 分析师剔除能源价格，以观察底层通胀是否正在缓解。

phrases.usage: 医学与流行病学固定搭配，后接疾病或事件，指风险因素
phrases.example: Chronic sleep deprivation is a recognized risk factor for hypertension in adults.
phrases.example_translation: 长期睡眠不足是成年人患高血压公认的危险因素。

phrases.usage: 现在分词作定语，指促成某一结果的因素，事故与政策分析常用
phrases.example: Poor signage turned out to be a contributing factor in the pileup on the bridge.
phrases.example_translation: 标识不清最终被认定为桥上连环追尾的促成因素之一。

phrases.phrase: factor X out of the equation
phrases.usage: 比喻句式，指把某个变量从讨论中剔除，评论文常见
phrases.example: Once you factor sentiment out of the equation, the market data looks far less alarming.
phrases.example_translation: 一旦把情绪因素从讨论中剔除，市场数据看起来就没那么令人担忧了。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指某局面中最难预测的变量
phrases.example: Voter turnout remained the unknown factor in a race this tightly contested.
phrases.example_translation: 在这场势均力敌的选战中，投票率始终是最难预测的变量。

phrases.usage: 代数术语，可因式分解的多项式，教材与课堂指令常用
phrases.example: The lesson reviews when a quadratic polynomial is factorable over the integers.
phrases.example_translation: 本课复习一个二次多项式何时在整数范围内可因式分解。

phrases.usage: completely 加形容词，指分解到既约为止，判定题高频表述
phrases.example: A monic quadratic whose roots are integers is completely factorable over the integers.
phrases.example_translation: 根为整数的首一二次三项式在整数范围内可以彻底分解。

phrases.usage: over 引出数域范围，指明分解所在的系数集合，术语结构
phrases.example: The expression is not factorable over the integers but splits neatly over the reals.
phrases.example_translation: 这个式子在整数范围不可分解，却在实数范围内干净分解。

phrases.usage: expression 代数式，指可分解的表达式，解题策略讨论中常用
phrases.example: Students learn to recognize a factorable expression by checking common factors first.
phrases.example_translation: 学生通过先检查公因式来学会辨认可分解的代数式。

phrases.usage: nicely 表恰好能漂亮分解，教师与解题笔记的口头搭配
phrases.example: The exam polynomial proved nicely factorable, sparing everyone lengthy written arithmetic under time pressure.
phrases.example_translation: 考卷上的多项式恰好能漂亮分解，让众人在时间压力下免受了冗长笔算之苦。

phrases.usage: 高频搭配，指事实层面的准确性，核查与评论语境
phrases.example: The editors checked every figure to protect the long article's factual accuracy.
phrases.example_translation: 编辑核对了每一个数字，以维护这篇长文的事实准确性。

phrases.usage: 指事实性错误，学术评审与更正声明常用
phrases.example: A single factual error in the opening chapter undermined the whole argument.
phrases.example_translation: 开篇章节里一个事实错误，就动摇了整个论证。

phrases.usage: 副形结构，强调只陈述事实、不作评判
phrases.example: Her summary remained purely factual, avoiding any hint of motive or blame.
phrases.example_translation: 她的概述纯粹只讲事实，避开了任何关于动机或责任的暗示。

phrases.usage: 后接 for，指某主张的事实依据，法律论说高频
phrases.example: The lawsuit lacked a factual basis for its claim of damages against the contractor.
phrases.example_translation: 这起诉讼针对承包商提出的赔偿请求缺乏事实依据。

phrases.usage: 指客观记述，与渲染式的讲述相对，史学写作常用
phrases.example: The museum preferred a factual account to the dramatic legend told in films.
phrases.example_translation: 博物馆更愿意呈现一份基于事实的记述，而不是电影里那个戏剧化的传说。

phrases.usage: 指可验证的事实主张，批判性阅读核心术语
phrases.example: Every factual claim in the report should cite a dated and reliable source.
phrases.example_translation: 报告中的每一项事实性主张，都应当注明日期并引用可靠来源。

phrases.usage: 指具体事实细节，叙事与新闻写作中的常见评价对象
phrases.example: Novelists may bend a factual detail, but historians are expected not to.
phrases.example_translation: 小说家或许可以改动事实细节，但历史学家被认为不该如此。

translations.translation: 懦弱的，胆小的；无精神的

phrases.usage: the + fainthearted 作集合名词，指胆小者群体，文学与宗教文本常见用法
phrases.example: The narrator cautioned that the fainthearted should not attempt the mountain crossing alone.
phrases.example_translation: 叙述者告诫胆弱者不应独自尝试翻越那座山。

phrases.usage: 系动词 grow + fainthearted，表示变得怯懦或气馁，叙事文学常见
phrases.example: As supplies dwindled, several expedition members grew fainthearted and urged an immediate retreat.
phrases.example_translation: 随着物资减少，探险队几名成员开始气馁并催促立即撤退。

phrases.usage: 否定并列 neither fainthearted nor，用于褒扬胆识，军事与体育报道常见
phrases.example: The squad proved neither fainthearted nor unprepared despite the sudden change in tactics.
phrases.example_translation: 尽管战术突然调整，该小队既非胆小也非毫无准备。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指畏缩怯懦的回应，用于批评性文本
phrases.example: The editorial denounced the government's fainthearted response to the escalating environmental crisis.
phrases.example_translation: 社论抨击了政府对不断升级的环境危机的畏缩应对。

phrases.usage: 并列形容词搭配，强化胆小无气的语义，文学描写与评论常用
phrases.example: Critics depicted the protagonist as timid and fainthearted, incapable of decisive moral action.
phrases.example_translation: 评论家将主人公描绘为胆小怯懦、无力做出果断道德行为的人。

phrases.usage: 后置修饰，指骨子里胆小，用于人物评价，含讽刺意味
phrases.example: For all his bluster, the general was fainthearted at heart and avoided every real skirmish.
phrases.example_translation: 尽管夸夸其谈，这位将军其实骨子里胆小，回避一切真正的交火。

translations.translation: 伪造， 捏造； 伪装

phrases.usage: 动宾惯用语，指伪造自身死亡，常见于犯罪与新闻叙事
phrases.example: The financier faked his death abroad and resurfaced only after the investigation closed.
phrases.example_translation: 那位金融家在国外伪造了自己的死亡，直到调查结案后才重新露面。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指勉强而不真诚的笑容，多用于人物神态描写
phrases.example: She concealed her irritation behind a fake smile throughout the negotiation over the contract.
phrases.example_translation: 在整个合同谈判中，她都用一个假笑掩盖着自己的恼怒。

phrases.usage: transparent 修饰名词 fake，指一眼可辨的赝品，含贬义
phrases.example: The so-called antique turned out to be a transparent fake with machine-cut edges.
phrases.example_translation: 那件所谓的古董结果是一件机器切割边缘的拙劣赝品。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，指识破伪造之物，用于艺术品鉴定与安检语境
phrases.example: Experienced dealers can detect a fake signature after a few glances at the stroke order.
phrases.example_translation: 经验丰富的交易商只需瞥几眼笔画顺序就能识破假签名。

phrases.usage: 常与 as 连用，指把假货冒充成真品，含欺诈意味
phrases.example: He tried to pass off a fake as a family heirloom to gain the collector's trust.
phrases.example_translation: 他试图把赝品冒充成家族传家宝，以骗取收藏家的信任。

phrases.usage: 动宾结构，指假装受伤，体育与骗保语境常见
phrases.example: The striker faked an injury in the penalty area to win a late spot kick.
phrases.example_translation: 那名前锋在禁区内假装受伤，从而在终场前赢得了一个点球。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指虚张声势的愤怒，评论文体常用，贬义
phrases.example: The editorial dismissed the senator's fake outrage as an election strategy dressed up as principle.
phrases.example_translation: 社论将那位参议员虚张声势的愤怒斥为伪装成原则的选举策略。

translations.translation: 谬误的；骗人的；靠不住的；不合理的

phrases.usage: 逻辑学高频搭配，指含谬误的论证，批改与评论常用
phrases.example: The instructor marked the slippery-slope case as a fallacious argument in the margin.
phrases.example_translation: 教师在页边批注滑坡论证为谬误论证。

phrases.usage: 抽象名词搭配，指错误的推理过程，学术与评论语域
phrases.example: Careful editors learn to flag fallacious reasoning long before a column reaches print.
phrases.example_translation: 严谨的编辑懂得在专栏付印之前就标出其中的谬误推理。

phrases.usage: 修辞与论证分析用语，指不成立的类比
phrases.example: Critics warned that comparing a public school with a business rests on a fallacious analogy.
phrases.example_translation: 评论者警告说，把公立学校比作企业建立在谬误的类比之上。

phrases.usage: 副词加强，指严格从逻辑上说不通，论证评断语
phrases.example: The final conclusion proved logically fallacious, though the author wrote in a confident tone.
phrases.example_translation: 尽管作者语气自信，最终结论在逻辑上却是谬误的。

phrases.usage: 动词搭配，指论证基于错误前提，社科批评常用
phrases.example: The ambitious enrolment forecast rests on fallacious premises about long-term migration patterns.
phrases.example_translation: 那份雄心勃勃的招生预测基于对长期迁移模式的错误前提。

phrases.usage: 系用动词，指事后被证明为谬误，史论回顾常用
phrases.example: Several confident census figures compiled in the 1890s later proved quietly fallacious.
phrases.example_translation: 十九世纪九十年代编制的若干自信满满的人口数字后来被证明有误。

phrases.usage: 副形搭配，指与生俱来难免出错，用于论证人或制度的局限
phrases.example: Any board of directors remains inherently fallible, however carefully its members are chosen.
phrases.example_translation: 任何董事会都天生难免犯错，无论其成员遴选得多么审慎。

phrases.usage: 冠形名结构，指易错的人类判断，哲学与法律评论常见
phrases.example: Sentencing reform rests on the premise that punishment reflects a fallible human judgment.
phrases.example_translation: 量刑改革建立在一个前提之上：刑罚反映的是易出错的人类判断。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指不可靠的目击证词，法律与认知心理学语境
phrases.example: DNA evidence repeatedly exposed how unreliable fallible eyewitness testimony can be in serious cases.
phrases.example_translation: DNA 证据一再表明，本已不可靠的目击证词在重大案件中能错到什么程度。

phrases.usage: admit to doing 结构，承认自身会犯错，褒义，指坦诚
phrases.example: A good scientist must eventually admit to being fallible in front of peers.
phrases.example_translation: 优秀的科学家终须在同侪面前承认自己也会犯错。

phrases.usage: 比较结构，指与对方同样易错，常用于破除技术迷信
phrases.example: Automated auditing tools are no less fallible than the clerks they gradually replace.
phrases.example_translation: 自动化审计工具与其逐步取代的文员同样难免出错。

phrases.usage: prove 作系动词，结果证明会出错，叙述与书评常用
phrases.example: The consensus weather prediction proved fallible when the storm abruptly changed course overnight.
phrases.example_translation: 当风暴一夜之间突然改向，各方一致的气象预报证明也会出错。

phrases.usage: 使役结构，leave 加宾语再加形容词，指让田地休耕休养
phrases.example: The trust asked tenants to leave the lower field fallow for a full season.
phrases.example_translation: 基金会要求佃户把下游那块地整季休耕。

phrases.usage: 系表结构，指田地处于休耕状态，农业政策与乡村描写常用
phrases.example: Half the parish lay fallow that winter after the wheat prices collapsed.
phrases.example_translation: 小麦价格暴跌后，那年冬天教区一半田地都撂了荒。

phrases.usage: 形名搭配，指休耕地，土地利用与土壤保护文本的固定词组
phrases.example: Heavy rains waterlogged the fallow land along the eastern boundary of the estate.
phrases.example_translation: 大雨把庄园东界旁的休耕地灌得积了水。

phrases.usage: 比喻用法，指创作或事业上的沉寂空窗期，人物传记高频
phrases.example: After the fallow period between commissions, her mural work regained its edge.
phrases.example_translation: 在两次委托之间的沉寂期之后，她的壁画创作重现锋芒。

phrases.usage: 系表动态结构，指田地从耕种转为撂荒，含无奈荒废的语气
phrases.example: The hillside terraces went fallow after the last families left the valley.
phrases.example_translation: 最后几户人家离开山谷后，山坡梯田便撂了荒。

phrases.usage: 固定复合名词，指黇鹿这一物种，与休耕义无关，属动物学搭配
phrases.example: A herd of fallow deer grazed quietly at the edge of the old deer park.
phrases.example_translation: 一群黇鹿在古老鹿苑的边上安静地吃草。

translations.translation: 伪造；篡改；歪曲；证明虚假

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，法律与刑侦语境，指伪造证据
phrases.example: The officer was dismissed after an inquiry found he tried to falsify evidence.
phrases.example_translation: 调查发现该警官曾试图伪造证据，随后他被免职。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，学术诚信讨论高频用语
phrases.example: A researcher who falsifies data undermines the credibility of the entire laboratory.
phrases.example_translation: 篡改数据的研究员会损害整个实验室的可信度。

phrases.usage: 动宾搭配，历史与政治评论语境，指歪曲历史
